projects.name: 江汉关大楼
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区沿江大道江汉路口，沿江大道88号
projects.address_en: No.88 Yanjiang Avenue, at the intersection of Jianghan Road, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 市政建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
projects.content_zh: 江汉关大楼位于汉口长江边，是江汉路步行街的起点。大楼由上海斯蒂华达生·斯贝司（Stewardson）建筑公司的英国建筑师辛浦生（Simpson）设计，景明洋行监工，魏清记营造厂施工，1922年动工，1924年建成，耗银200万两。大楼模仿英国伦敦国会大厦样式，为钢筋混凝土结构，主楼4层，钟楼8层，建筑面积四千余平方米。建筑的外观具有古典主义和文艺复兴风格的特征，矗立于江汉路与沿江大道转角，东面和北面可以俯瞰江面。由于沿江大道在这里拐了一个弯，大楼与沿江大道其他并列的建筑相比，显得格外宏伟。从长江来汉口的航船，在江面上最先看到的正是江汉关大楼。大楼平面呈三合院式的布局，正面沿江汉路，垂直于沿江大道，三段式构图。主入口设在二层，前有28级台阶，气势宏伟，同时也是出于对长江水患的充分考虑。改良的八根科林斯柱式，四层通高，其中入口两侧为一对双柱。外墙和柱全部用大件花岗岩建造。正中的钟楼高约46米，自下而上依次为摆陀室、机件室、音响室，内有钢梯通向顶层，四面均悬挂大钟，钟面直径达4米。站在钟楼上，武汉三镇、长江汉水尽收眼底。1861年汉口开埠，各国商船在上海报关纳税后，在汉口码头随意装卸货物，贸易买卖，甚至走私偷渡，均无人管束。经中国政府敦促，由英国领事官员牵头设立海关关卡，即为江汉关的前身。后江汉关税务司也由英国人担任，当时钟楼每天按时奏报旋律为《女王万岁》，文化大革命中改为《东方红》，1986年重新恢复原旋律。
projects.content_en: The Jianghan Customs House stands by the Yangtze River in Hankou, marking the starting point of Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street. Designed by British architect Simpson of the Shanghai Stewardson architecture firm, supervised by Hemmings & Berkley, and constructed by Wei Qingji Construction Company, it broke ground in 1922 and was completed in 1924 at a cost of 2 million taels of silver. Modeled after the Palace of Westminster in London, it is a reinforced concrete structure with a 4-story main building and an 8-story clock tower, covering over 4,000 square meters. Its facade combines Neoclassical and Renaissance features, standing prominently at the corner of Jianghan Road and Yanjiang Avenue, with views of the river to the east and north. Because Yanjiang Avenue curves here, the building appears especially grand compared to adjacent structures. Boats approaching Hankou along the Yangtze see the Customs House first. The plan is U-shaped, with the main facade facing Jianghan Road, perpendicular to Yanjiang Avenue, in a three-part composition. The main entrance is on the second floor, approached by 28 grand steps—an imposing design that also served as flood protection. Eight modified Corinthian columns rise four stories, with paired columns flanking the entrance. The exterior walls and columns are entirely clad in large granite blocks. The central clock tower rises about 46 meters, housing the pendulum room, mechanism room, and chime room from bottom to top, with a steel ladder leading to the top where four clock faces, each 4 meters in diameter, are mounted. From the tower, all three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze and Han rivers are visible. After Hankou opened as a treaty port in 1861, foreign ships could freely load, unload, and trade at Hankou docks after customs clearance in Shanghai, with no local oversight. Following Chinese government urging, the British consul led the establishment of a customs post—the predecessor of Jianghan Customs. The customs commissioner was always British. The clock tower originally played 'God Save the Queen' daily; during the Cultural Revolution this was changed to 'The East Is Red,' and the original melody was restored in 1986.

projects.name: 汉口花旗银行大楼
projects.name_en: Building of National City Bank of New York in Hankou
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区沿江大道青岛路口，青岛路1号
projects.address_en: No.1 Qingdao Road, at the intersection of Yanjiang Avenue and Qingdao Road, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
projects.content_zh: 在沿江大道青岛路口，有一栋非常雄伟而醒目的银行建筑，门楣上镌刻'THE NATIONAL CITY BANK OF NEW YORK'，即大名鼎鼎的美国花旗银行。花旗银行最早成立于1812年的美国纽约，最初以'万国宝通银行'之名进入中国内陆，因为银行办公楼前悬挂星条旗而被中国民众称为'花旗银行'，后来这一口头称呼逐渐变得官方化，即使位于美国的总公司屡次更名，中国分行的名称却一直沿用至今。花旗银行1910在汉口开展业务，1913年建造新楼，由美国建筑师亨利·墨菲设计（一说为景明洋行设计），魏清记营造厂施工，1921年完工，共耗白银17万两。抗日战争时期被日本人占据用作中国银行，1945年被租给美孚石油公司。建筑平面为矩形，地上五层，地下一层，钢筋混凝土结构。沿街的东、北两面采用三段式构图，一层极高，拱券门窗，主入口伸出的门廊由两圆两方四根立柱支撑；第二段为二至四层，立面上有三层通高的爱奥尼柱廊，各层露台在柱间装点金属栏杆；檐口以上的五层为第三段。另外两个立面则直接在墙上开窗。建筑整体呈立方体，显得简洁庄重，是新古典主义的优秀作品。
projects.content_en: At the intersection of Yanjiang Avenue and Qingdao Road stands an imposing bank building, its lintel engraved with 'THE NATIONAL CITY BANK OF NEW YORK'—the famous Citibank. Founded in New York in 1812, it first entered inland China under the name 'International Banking Corporation.' Chinese locals called it 'Flower Flag Bank' because the Stars and Stripes flew in front; this colloquial name gradually became official, and the Chinese branch retained it even as the American parent company repeatedly renamed itself. Citibank began operations in Hankou in 1910 and built new premises in 1913, designed by American architect Henry Murphy (or Hemmings & Berkley, according to some sources) and constructed by Wei Qingji, completed in 1921 at a cost of 170,000 taels of silver. During the Second Sino-Japanese War it was seized by the Japanese and used as the Bank of China; in 1945 it was leased to Standard Oil. The rectangular plan has five stories above ground and one below, in reinforced concrete. The east and north street facades use a three-part composition: the ground floor is very tall with arched doors and windows, and the projecting entrance portico is supported by four columns (two round, two square); the second section comprises stories 2-4 with a three-story Ionic colonnade and metal-railed terraces between columns; the fifth story above the cornice forms the third section. The other two facades have simple windows in the walls. The cubic building is简洁 and dignified, an outstanding example of Neoclassicism.

projects.name: 汉口汇丰银行旧址
projects.name_en: Historic Site of Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Building in Hankou
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区沿江大道143号
projects.address_en: No.143 Yanjiang Avenue, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
projects.content_zh: 汇丰银行总行设在香港，是在中国历史最悠久、业务最繁盛的西方银行，清同治五年（1866）在汉口开设支行。第一代汇丰银行是英租界四码头附近的一栋二层砖木小楼，1913年在沿江大道青岛路口兴建混合结构的大楼，1917年竣工，即今天看到的附楼；1914年又继续从转角处向右横推，兴建四层的钢筋混凝土结构主楼。主楼基础完成后因第一次世界大战爆发而停工，后于1916年复工，1920年完工。主楼由上海英籍工程师派纳设计绘图，汉协盛营造厂承包修建，是一座典型的新古典主义建筑。主楼地上三层，屋顶建有花园，附楼地上四层；地下一层。主立面沿江展开，总高20米左右，竖向三段式构图，横向分为五段。一、二层为通高柱廊，10根爱奥尼圆柱和六根方柱全部由花岗石拼接，柱间伸出有石雕栏杆的阳台，三层为方柱廊。柱头、阳台、门窗楣、腰线、檐口等部位均有丰富而精致的雕刻装饰。水平方向上，正中和两端向前突出，主入口隐藏在柱廊深处。一层大厅有三个巨大的玻璃穹顶，使得室内空间显得开阔明亮。大厅后为办公区，大厅和办公区之间还修建了四座坚壁固垒的银库，布局十分紧凑。二层以上的房间可以根据需要用于办公或居住。室内装修豪华，木地板、木墙裙、壁炉采暖、水电设施齐备，并有三部电梯。即使在以宏伟和豪华著称的汉口租借银行建筑中，汇丰银行大楼的规模之大，装饰之精致也令人叹服。抗日战争初期，大楼曾为孙科和白崇禧的办公室，后被日军占领。1944年12月，三名美军飞行员在武汉被日军俘虏并惨遭杀害，随后美国对日本占据的汉口进行了大规模报复性轰炸，一天之内出动飞机170多架次，对汉口开埠建筑造成了极大的破坏，汇丰银行大楼也未能幸免，楼顶被重磅炸弹击穿。1949年10月1日起，美国在华各机构撤离回国，随后英属各机构也全部撤离，汇丰银行在这一时期离开了中国。1999年，由光大银行出资对大楼进行全面整修，大楼恢复了往日宏丽的姿态，重新屹立于长江之滨。
projects.content_en: Headquartered in Hong Kong, HSBC was the oldest and most prosperous Western bank in China, opening a Hankou branch in 1866. The first HSBC building was a two-story brick-wood structure near the fourth wharf of the British concession. In 1913, a mixed-structure building was erected at the corner of Yanjiang Avenue and Qingdao Road, completed in 1917—this is the annex seen today. In 1914, construction extended rightward from the corner to build a four-story reinforced concrete main building. Work halted after the foundation was completed due to the outbreak of World War I, resumed in 1916, and finished in 1920. Designed by British engineer Painer of Shanghai and built by Hanxiesheng Construction, it is a典型 Neoclassical building. The main building has three stories above ground with a roof garden; the annex has four stories; both have one basement level. The main facade stretches along the river, about 20 meters high, with a vertical three-part composition and five horizontal sections. The first and second stories form a high colonnade of 10 Ionic round columns and 6 square columns, all assembled from granite, with stone-railed balconies projecting between columns; the third story has a square-column colonnade. Capitals, balconies, door and window lintels, belt courses, and cornices are richly and exquisitely carved. Horizontally, the center and both ends project forward, with the main entrance concealed deep in the colonnade. The ground-floor hall has three enormous glass domes, creating a bright and open interior. Behind the hall are offices, and between hall and offices stand four heavily fortified vaults in a compact layout. Rooms above the second floor could serve as offices or residences as needed. Interiors are luxurious, with wood floors, wood wainscoting, fireplace heating, full plumbing and electrical systems, and three elevators. Even among Hankou's grand concession bank buildings, HSBC stands out for its scale and refinement. In the early phase of the Second Sino-Japanese War, it housed the offices of Sun Ke and Bai Chongxi, then was occupied by the Japanese. In December 1944, after three American pilots were captured and killed by the Japanese in Wuhan, the US launched a massive retaliatory bombing raid on Japanese-occupied Hankou, dispatching over 170 sorties in one day and causing extensive damage to treaty-port buildings; HSBC was hit, its roof pierced by a heavy bomb. From October 1, 1949, American institutions in China withdrew, followed by all British institutions; HSBC left China during this period. In 1999, China Everbright Bank funded a comprehensive restoration, returning the building to its former grandeur by the Yangtze.

projects.name: 汉口俄商新泰大楼
projects.name_en: Xintai Building of the Russian Tea Office in Hankou
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区沿江大道兰陵路口，沿江大道158号
projects.address_en: No.158 Yanjiang Avenue, at the intersection of Yanjiang Avenue and Lanling Road, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
projects.content_zh: 俄商新泰大楼位于沿江大道兰陵路口，由景明洋行设计，永茂昌营造厂施工，是一座五层钢筋混凝土结构的大楼。1921年动工，1924年建成，楼高31米，总造价26万元。人们习惯称此楼为'俄商新泰大楼'，实际上这种说法尚存许多疑点。1866年，俄国人在新泰大楼现址创办了新泰洋行，也称新泰茶叶公司，总行设在彼得堡，主要从汉口进口茶叶至俄国境内。由此，汉口成为著名的'中俄茶叶之路'的起点。1891年新泰砖茶厂成立25周年时，特别邀请正在中国境内游历的俄皇太子，即后来的沙皇尼古拉二世来汉口参加庆典。然而1917年俄国'十月革命'后，国内政局的动荡也影响到海外，有推测认为1920年前后，汉口的新泰等四家俄商茶厂先后关闭，而新泰大楼是1921年接手新泰洋行的英国茶商所建；另一种说法则认为英商1932年才接手。此外，也有人认为新泰1927年才离开汉口，因为那一年苏维埃政府以人民政...
projects.content_en: The Russian Xintai Building stands at the intersection of Yanjiang Avenue and Lanling Road. Designed by Hemmings & Berkley and constructed by Yongmaochang, it is a five-story reinforced concrete building. Construction began in 1921 and was completed in 1924; it stands 31 meters tall at a total cost of 260,000 yuan. It is commonly called the 'Russian Xintai Building,' though this attribution remains debated. In 1866, Russians founded the Xintai Foreign Firm (also called Xintai Tea Company) on this site, with headquarters in St. Petersburg, primarily importing tea from Hankou into Russia. This made Hankou the starting point of the famous 'Sino-Russian Tea Road.' In 1891, for the 25th anniversary of the Xintai brick tea factory, the Russian crown prince—later Tsar Nicholas II—then traveling in China, was specially invited to Hankou for the celebration. However, after the 1917 October Revolution, political turmoil in Russia affected its overseas operations. It is speculated that around 1920, four Russian tea firms in Hankou, including Xintai, closed one after another, and the Xintai Building was built in 1921 by British tea merchants who took over the Xintai firm; another source claims the British did not take over until 1932. Some also believe Xintai did not leave Hankou until 1927, when the Soviet government...

projects.name: 华俄道胜银行
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区沿江大道黎黄陂路口，沿江大道161、162号
projects.address_en: Nos.161-162 Yanjiang Avenue, at the intersection of Yanjiang Avenue and Lihuangpi Road, Jiang'an District
highlights: 德国建筑师马尔克斯设计
projects.content_zh: 华俄道胜银行位于沿江大道黎黄陂路口，地处俄租界，建于1896年，由德国建筑师马尔克斯（Lother Marcks）设计。砖混结构，地上四层，地下一层，新古典主义风格。沿街两个立面都作三段式处理，但在细节上又有若干不同，使得建筑整体的效果在一致的风格中富于变化。面对沿江大道的主立面，一层为拱券门窗，二、三层为方窗外廊抹斜角，四层层高较低，开矩形小窗。方形壁柱三层贯通，一层柱身、柱顶和铁艺栏杆都有精美的纹样装饰。朝向黎黄陂路一侧的立面，二、三层为连续拱券外廊，拱券的比例瘦长，四层则与正面类似。各层之间有腰线分隔，每层的壁柱和廊柱不贯通，形式也各不相同。在两个主要立面的转角处还有一座四层塔楼，塔楼两侧的细节处理也有所不同，沿江一侧的二层还挑出一个小阳台。整个大楼墙身厚、净空高，内外装饰考究，通过壁柱、开窗和栏杆的造型和装饰变化，整体效果活泼明快。华俄道胜银行是一家俄法合资银行，总部设于圣彼得堡，在中国上海、北京、汉口、营口和哈尔滨均设有分行。1910年，华俄银行与北方银行合并，称为华俄道胜银行。1926年秋，由于对经济情况的错误估计，华俄道胜银行损失惨重，并被迫歇业。北伐军进入武汉后，将汉口分行用作财政部办公地。1927年宋庆龄到汉口，曾在这栋楼房的二层居住了八个月。1928年'宁汉合流'之后，南京政府设立国家银行，这里便成为国民中央银行武汉分行的办公地。大楼现为宋庆龄汉口旧居纪念馆，一楼展示明、清及近代名人字画真迹及陶瓷艺术品，二楼则复原了宋庆龄卧室和会客厅的状况，陈列着当时使用过的梳妆台、太师椅、书桌、藤床等珍贵的文物，并展出了与孙中山、宋庆龄有关的图片和实物资料。
projects.content_en: The Sino-Russian Daosheng Bank stands at the intersection of Yanjiang Avenue and Lihuangpi Road in the former Russian concession. Built in 1896 and designed by German architect Lother Marcks, it is a brick-concrete structure with four stories above ground and one basement, in Neoclassical style. Both street facades are treated in three horizontal sections, but with subtle differences in detail, giving the building variety within a unified style. The main facade facing Yanjiang Avenue has arched doors and windows on the ground floor, square-window loggias with chamfered corners on stories 2-3, and a lower fourth story with small rectangular windows. Square pilasters rise through three stories; the first-story pilasters, capitals, and iron railings all bear exquisite ornament. The facade facing Lihuangpi Road has a continuous arched loggia on stories 2-3 with slender, tall arches; the fourth story resembles the main facade. Belt courses separate each story, and pilasters and loggia columns do not贯通 between floors, taking different forms. A four-story tower marks the corner of the two main facades, with different detailing on each side; a small balcony projects from the second story on the river side. The building has thick walls, high ceilings, and refined interior and exterior decoration; variations in pilasters, openings, and railings create a lively and bright overall effect. Daosheng Bank was a Russo-French joint venture headquartered in St. Petersburg, with branches in Shanghai, Beijing, Hankou, Yingkou, and Harbin. In 1910, the Russo-Chinese Bank merged with the Northern Bank to form Daosheng Bank. In autumn 1926, due to miscalculations of economic conditions, it suffered heavy losses and was forced to cease operations. After the Northern Expeditionary Army entered Wuhan, the Hankou branch was used as Ministry of Finance offices. In 1927, Soong Ching-ling lived on the second floor for eight months. After the 1928 Ning-Han reconciliation, the Nanjing government established a national bank, and this building became the Wuhan branch of the Central Bank of China. Today it houses the Soong Ching-ling Former Residence Memorial in Hankou: the first floor displays authentic calligraphy, paintings, and ceramics from the Ming, Qing, and modern periods; the second floor recreates Soong Ching-ling's bedroom and reception room, with original dressing table, taishi chairs, desk, rattan bed, and photographs and artifacts related to Sun Yat-sen and Soong Ching-ling.

projects.name: 汉口美国领事馆旧址
projects.name_en: Historic Site of U.S. Consulate in Hankou
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区沿江大道车站路口，车站路1号
projects.address_en: No.1 Chezhan Road, at the intersection of Yanjiang Avenue and Chezhan Road, Jiang'an District
projects.content_zh: 汉口美国领事馆位于法国东方汇理银行对面，地属俄租界（美国当时在汉口并未设立租界），建于光绪三十一年（1905），设计者不详，由广兴隆建筑厂施工，三层砖混结构，后又扩建了一层的裙房。在沿江大道临街一排新古典主义建筑中，清水红砖，富有动感的弧线设计显示这是一座融合了巴洛克风格的作品。层层叠叠的灰色腰线、连续的拱券门窗以及凸出的拱顶石，构成了立面上最显眼的重复元素。沿街的主立面可以看到三个层高不同的体量阶梯向上。首先是沿街的裙房，平顶女儿墙，正中最大的拱券门是主入口，内部为公共大厅，内空超高；主楼有三层，为办公和居住场所，红色斜坡屋顶，设女儿墙；最后是转角处的四层塔楼，三层以下为圆形，第四层为八角形，平顶，塔顶设铁艺围栏。室内装修华丽，走道水磨石地平，房间内均为木地板，至今保存完好。汉口美国领事馆开设于1861年，最早设于汉阳，紧邻湖广总督府，后迁至车站路1号，1936年迁入天津路1号的亚细亚火油公司（亚细亚大楼）。在20世纪之前，美国在汉口的影响力一直没有英国大，商行和银行既没有英国开设得多，也不设立租界。1941年12月8日，'珍珠港事件'爆发的第二天，侵华日军闯进亚细亚大楼抓捕美国领事馆官员，领事馆被迫关闭。抗日战争胜利后，领事馆又重新开馆，直至1949年10月1日关闭。
projects.content_en: The former U.S. Consulate in Hankou stands opposite the Banque de l'Indochine, in the former Russian concession (the U.S. never established a concession in Hankou). Built in 1905 (Guangxu 31), designer unknown, constructed by Guangxinglong, it is a three-story brick-concrete structure with a later one-story annex. Among the row of Neoclassical buildings along Yanjiang Avenue, its exposed red brick and dynamic curved design mark it as a Baroque-influenced work. Stacked gray belt courses, continuous arched doors and windows, and projecting keystones form the most prominent repeating elements on the facade. The main street facade shows three volumes of differing heights stepping upward: first the street-level annex with a flat roof and parapet, its central large arched doorway the main entrance leading to a super-high public hall; then the three-story main building for offices and residences, with a red pitched roof and parapet; finally a four-story corner tower, round below the third story and octagonal on the fourth, with a flat roof and iron railing at the top. Interiors are ornate, with terrazzo floors in corridors and wood floors in rooms, all well preserved. The U.S. Consulate in Hankou opened in 1861, first in Hanyang near the Viceroy's yamen, then moved to No.1 Chezhan Road, and in 1936 relocated to the Asiatic Petroleum Company building at No.1 Tianjin Road. Before the 20th century, U.S. influence in Hankou never matched Britain's—fewer firms and banks, and no concession. On December 8, 1941, the day after Pearl Harbor, Japanese troops stormed the Asiatic Building and arrested consulate staff, forcing its closure. It reopened after the war and remained until October 1, 1949.

projects.name: 汉口亚细亚火油公司
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区沿江大道天津路口，天津路1号
projects.address_en: No.1 Tianjin Road, at the intersection of Yanjiang Avenue and Tianjin Road, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
highlights: 古典主义向现代主义转变
projects.content_zh: 亚细亚火油公司是英国壳牌与荷兰皇家石油公司合资开设的子公司，总部设在伦敦，1912年在汉口开设分公司。大楼由景明洋行设计，魏清记营造厂施工，1924年落成，是一座风格介于古典主义向现代主义转变过程中的建筑。大楼原设计八层，实建五层，钢筋混凝土结构。当时，英属亚细亚火油公司投资40万两白银建造这栋大楼，并聘请外籍工程师监督工程质量。由于监工极严，前后强行返工数次，大楼竣工后，魏清记营造厂亏损极大，于是请出当时亚细亚公司总买办涂望山出面调解。经过协商，亚细亚公司又支付了白银20万两作为补偿，使得大楼成为当时汉口施工要求最为严格的工程，也保证了它在今天依然能够昂然屹立长江之滨。大楼平面为直角梯形，在转角处抹圆角作为主入口。外观依然遵循三段式的划分原则，然而外墙已经完全取消了柱廊或壁柱，在仿花岗石墙面上直接开方窗，沿街各面四层挑出阳台。檐口、窗楣、阳台，包括窗户外的铁艺栏杆，这些细部的装饰处理得非常细腻，还留有一些传统的痕迹。
projects.content_en: The Asiatic Petroleum Company was a subsidiary jointly established by Britain's Shell and the Royal Dutch Petroleum Company, headquartered in London, opening a Hankou branch in 1912. The building was designed by Hemmings & Berkley and constructed by Wei Qingji, completed in 1924—a work transitioning from Neoclassicism to Modernism. Originally designed as eight stories, five were actually built, in reinforced concrete. The British-owned Asiatic Petroleum invested 400,000 taels of silver and hired foreign engineers to supervise quality. Supervision was extremely strict, requiring several forced reworks; after completion, the Wei Qingji firm suffered heavy losses and asked the compradore Tu Wangshan to mediate. After negotiation, Asiatic paid an additional 200,000 taels as compensation, making this the most rigorously constructed project in Hankou at the time—and ensuring it still stands proudly by the Yangtze today. The plan is a right trapezoid, with a rounded corner serving as the main entrance. The exterior still follows a three-part composition, but the wall has entirely eliminated colonnades or pilasters; square windows open directly on the imitation-granite facade, and balconies project from the fourth story along each street side. Cornices, window lintels, balconies, and even exterior iron railings are exquisitely detailed, retaining traces of tradition.

projects.name: 法国东方汇理银行旧址
projects.name_en: Historic Site of Banque de l'Indochine in Hankou
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区沿江大道车站路口，沿江大道171号
projects.address_en: No.171 Yanjiang Avenue, at the intersection of Yanjiang Avenue and Chezhan Road, Jiang'an District
projects.content_zh: 法国东方汇理银行由法国几个大银行联合设立，总行设在巴黎，经营法国在中南半岛殖民地业务，1888年开始进入中国，1901年在汉口法租界设立分行，其附属房屋于1920年全部完工，现存银行主楼。不同于汉口大多数的银行建筑，东方汇理银行是一座仅有二层的小楼，清水红砖外墙，带有洛可可艺术的风格，显得纤细、柔美。建筑平面为矩形，对称布局，居中设入口，高约15米，立面上最显眼的元素即为连续的拱券门窗和圆形壁柱。从绿色的宝瓶栏杆可以看出，二层原先是开敞式外廊。檐口以上的女儿墙也是同样的栏杆，而屋顶则为四坡红瓦。装饰设计非常细腻，层间有腰线划分，半圆形的壁柱，白色石雕柱头和拱顶石。下层为圆形素面柱头，之上装点三朵玫瑰花；上层的柱头则为麦穗和漩涡，有点像改良的科林斯柱头。主入口拱券上也有细致的石雕装饰。
projects.content_en: Banque de l'Indochine was jointly established by several major French banks, headquartered in Paris, operating France's colonial business in Indochina. It entered China in 1888 and opened a Hankou branch in the French concession in 1901; its ancillary buildings were all completed in 1920, and the main bank building survives today. Unlike most Hankou bank buildings, it is a modest two-story structure with exposed red brick exterior in Rococo style, appearing slender and graceful. The rectangular plan is symmetric with a central entrance, about 15 meters high; the most prominent facade elements are continuous arched doors/windows and round pilasters. Green baluster railings indicate the second floor was originally an open loggia. The parapet above the cornice uses the same railing, and the roof is a four-sided red-tile hip roof. Decoration is exquisite: belt courses separate stories, with semicircular pilasters, white stone capitals, and keystones. The lower story has plain round capitals adorned with three roses; the upper capitals combine wheat ears and volutes, resembling a modified Corinthian capital. The main entrance arch also bears delicate stone carving.

projects.name: 汉口麦加利银行大楼
projects.name_en: Building of the Chartered Bank of India, Australia & China in Hankou
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区洞庭街青岛路口，青岛路9号
projects.address_en: No.9 Qingdao Road, at the intersection of Dongting Street and Qingdao Road, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
highlights: 武汉最早的钢筋混凝土建筑
projects.content_zh: 麦加利银行汉口分行是武汉第一家外国银行，始建年代不详，1865年建成。与花旗银行类似，麦加利银行也是英国渣打银行中国分行的俗称。1858年，渣打银行在上海开设了中国内地第一家分行，第一任大班（经理）名叫约翰·麦加利（John McKellar）。也许是这个名字更朗朗上口，人们逐渐将渣打银行上海分行叫做麦加利银行，后来这一称呼也被渣打银行官方所接纳和采用。麦加利银行的设计师和设计单位不详，由英国发德普建筑公司施工，是武汉现存最早的使用钢筋混凝土构件的建筑。三层砖木结构，矩形平面，两端稍稍前凸，具有浓重的文艺复兴色彩。各面的二、三层都有贯通的拱券走廊，并装饰以花瓶式栏杆，在壁柱顶端和檐口的部分还雕饰了精致的卷草图案。而铁皮瓦屋顶和四角修建的锥形尖塔则保有一些哥特式建筑的趣味。建筑整体造型严谨对称而富于韵律感，墙面上虚实相应，细部非常精致，距今已有150年，依然保存完好。
projects.content_en: The Chartered Bank Hankou branch was Wuhan's first foreign bank; its founding date is uncertain, but it was completed in 1865. Like Citibank, 'MacDonald Bank' is the Chinese nickname for the Chartered Bank of India, Australia & China's Chinese branches. In 1858, Chartered Bank opened its first mainland China branch in Shanghai; its first manager (taipan) was John McKellar. Perhaps because the name was easier to pronounce, locals gradually called the Shanghai branch 'MacDonald Bank,' and this nickname was later officially adopted by the bank. The designer is unknown; it was constructed by Britain's Fadepu Construction Company and is the oldest surviving building in Wuhan using reinforced concrete components. A three-story brick-wood structure with a rectangular plan and slightly projecting ends, it has a strong Renaissance flavor. The second and third stories on all sides have continuous arched corridors decorated with vase-shaped balustrades; pilaster capitals and cornices bear exquisite acanthus ornament. The tin-tile roof and conical pinnacles at the four corners retain a Gothic touch. The overall composition is rigorous, symmetrical, and rhythmic, with solid and void interplay on the walls and exquisite details. After 150 years it remains well preserved.

projects.name: 汉口赞育药房
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区洞庭街车站路口，洞庭街103-105号
projects.address_en: Nos.103-105 Dongting Street, at the intersection of Dongting Street and Chezhan Road, Jiang'an District
highlights: 汉口第一家机制汽水厂
projects.content_zh: 汉口赞育药房又称为赞育汽水厂，设计和施工单位不详，三层砖木结构，以转角为中心，沿街两侧对称式布局。立面为三段式构图，由竖向的柱式进行划分，三个角部用厚重的柱式做了局部强化处理，中间角部底层以一根精美纤细的内退柱作为支撑，二层是突出的小飘台，之上配以椭圆形窗和圆形拱券及中间的连续弧形女儿墙，富有韵律感。大楼原为英商开办的赞育药房的附属工厂，后改建为汉口第一家机制汽水厂。
projects.content_en: The Hankou Dispensary Company, also known as the Zanyu Soda Water Factory, has an unknown designer and builder. A three-story brick-wood structure centered on the street corner, it is symmetrically arranged along both street sides. The facade uses a three-part composition divided by vertical pilasters; the three corners are locally reinforced with heavy pilasters. The central corner's ground floor is supported by an elegant, slender recessed column; the second floor has a projecting small balcony above which are oval windows, round arches, and a continuous curved parapet in the middle, creating a rhythmic quality. Originally an annex factory of the British-owned Hankou Dispensary, it was later converted into Hankou's first mechanized soda water factory.

projects.name: 汉口景明大楼
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区鄱阳街青岛路口，鄱阳街43号
projects.address_en: No.43 Poyang Street, at the intersection of Poyang Street and Qingdao Road, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
highlights: 武汉最高钢筋混凝土建筑
projects.content_zh: 1908至1910年间，景明洋行由毕业于英国伦敦皇家建筑学院的建筑师海明斯（R.E.Hemmings）和伯克利（Berkley）共同创立。大量优秀的设计作品对近代汉口的城市风貌有着极其重要的影响，这种影响也一直持续到今天。景明洋行的作品类型丰富，包括银行、洋行、工厂、影院、饭店、仓库、高级住宅和里弄住宅等，作品风格从新古典主义到装饰艺术风格，并逐步转向现代派，成为武汉建筑发展的一个缩影。同时，景明洋行最早将钢筋混凝土技术介绍到武汉，是武汉建筑行业的领军者。在这里工作过的工程师、建筑师，后来纷纷独立挂牌开设事务所，特别是自学成才的华人建筑师卢镛标也曾在这里工作，后来开设了汉口第一家华人建筑师事务所。可以说，景明洋行也是建筑师的摇篮。1921年，景明洋行在鄱阳街青岛路口为自己设计了一座具有早期现代主义风格的六层大楼，也是当时汉口最高的钢筋混凝土建筑。大楼由汉协盛营造厂承建，材料和施工费总计约8万元；作为献礼，这笔钱汉协盛没有收取分文。而大楼内部水电气、卫生设备、电梯和装修等费用6万余元则由景明洋行自理。受地形限制，大楼平面为不规则多边形，但功能布置合理：一层为营业办公用房，二、三层为公寓式住宅，四、五层业主自用。立面仍然保留了三段式的处理方法，但已不再使用柱式，取而代之的是大面积的玻璃窗，使室内光线充足。装饰也很克制，仅在檐口有所保留并使用了中式的支托。三层和六层正中各有一个出挑的阳台，两者长短不一，表明立面设计在努力摆脱古典主义的束缚。景明洋行在自己做业主时没有采用当时正流行的古典主义风格，而是大胆选择了刚刚兴起的现代主义建筑，显示出建筑师对新风格的敏感和追求探索。
projects.content_en: From 1908 to 1910, the Hemmings & Berkley architectural firm was co-founded by R.E. Hemmings and Berkley, both graduates of the Royal Academy of Architecture in London. Their many outstanding designs had an extremely important influence on modern Hankou's urban character—an influence that continues today. The firm's work spanned banks, foreign firms, factories, cinemas, hotels, warehouses, luxury residences, and lilong housing, with styles ranging from Neoclassicism to Art Deco and gradually toward Modernism, serving as a microcosm of Wuhan's architectural development. They were also the first to introduce reinforced concrete technology to Wuhan and led the local construction industry. Engineers and architects who worked there later established their own independent practices—notably the self-taught Chinese architect Lu Yongbiao, who later opened Hankou's first Chinese-owned architectural firm. Hemmings & Berkley was thus a cradle for architects. In 1921, the firm designed for itself a six-story early Modernist building at the intersection of Poyang Street and Qingdao Road—then the tallest reinforced concrete building in Hankou. Constructed by Hanxiesheng, materials and labor totaled about 80,000 yuan; as a gift, Hanxiesheng charged nothing. The firm paid over 60,000 yuan for interior plumbing, electrical, sanitary equipment, elevators, and finishes. Constrained by the site, the plan is an irregular polygon but functionally rational: ground floor for commercial offices, stories 2-3 as apartment-style residences, stories 4-5 for the owners' own use. The facade retains a three-part composition but no longer uses classical orders; instead, large glass windows provide ample interior light. Decoration is restrained, reserved mainly for the cornice with Chinese-style brackets. Projecting balconies at the center of the third and sixth stories differ in length, showing the facade's effort to break free from Neoclassical constraints. As their own client, the firm chose the newly emerging Modernism over the then-popular Neoclassicism, demonstrating architects' sensitivity to and exploration of new styles.

projects.name: 上海路天主堂
projects.name_en: Catholic Church on Shanghai Road in Hankou
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区鄱阳街上海路口，上海路16号
projects.address_en: No.16 Shanghai Road, at the intersection of Poyang Street and Shanghai Road, Jiang'an District
projects.content_zh: 上海路天主堂，也叫上海路堂，是意大利天主教方济各会的产业，由意大利教士余作宾设计，孙裕泰建筑厂施工，二层砖木结构。天主堂以罗马的耶稣会教堂为原型，带有一些意大利文艺复兴式样。建筑平面为拉丁十字，立面由整齐的柱廊构成巴西利卡式，三角形窗楣、门楣。正面的入口有两扇褐色木门，整块板材从一颗巨大的树木上锯下，从欧洲运来。室内为三拱廊大厅，空间高敞，是武汉市最大的教堂。教堂北侧原有一对圆柱形塔楼，1944年美军飞机轰炸武汉，炸毁了教堂的一部分和右侧塔楼。1948年修复教堂，1952年由中国神职人员接管。
projects.content_en: Shanghai Road Catholic Church, also called Shanghai Road Church, is a property of the Italian Franciscan Order. Designed by Italian priest Yu Zuobin and constructed by Sun Yutai, it is a two-story brick-wood structure. Modeled after the Jesuit church in Rome with Italian Renaissance elements, it has a Latin cross plan. The facade features an orderly colonnade in basilica style with triangular window and door lintels. The main entrance has two brown wooden doors, each cut as a single plank from a huge tree and shipped from Europe. The interior is a three-aisled hall with a lofty space—the largest church in Wuhan. A pair of cylindrical towers originally stood on the north side; in 1944, American aircraft bombing Hankou destroyed part of the church and the right tower. The church was repaired in 1948 and taken over by Chinese clergy in 1952.

projects.name: 汉口英商电灯公司旧址
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区鄱阳街合作路口，鄱阳街56号
projects.address_en: No.56 Poyang Street, at the intersection of Poyang Street and Hezuo Road, Jiang'an District
projects.content_zh: 汉口电灯公司由英商集资兴建，当年是中国最大的直流发电厂，百年前汉口夜晚的第一束生活用电灯光就是从这里输出的，但当时仅供英、俄、法三国租界用电。公司为一座文艺复兴风格的建筑，由景明洋行设计，汉协盛营造厂施工，三层混凝土结构，仿麻石粉刷外墙，红瓦屋顶。建筑位于鄱阳街与合作路转角，平面呈'L'形，转角处设主入口，其上是一个圆盔顶钟塔楼，由四根塔斯干柱式支撑。立面三段式设计，一层为基座，二、三层为通高的塔斯干柱廊，二层开小平窗，三层设出挑的封闭阳台，给人感觉稳定而变化丰富。2014年改造为湖北电力博物馆之后，通身粉刷成淡黄色，拆除三层封闭的阳台变为开敞外廊，摆脱了曾经暗沉的颜色，显得更加明快、活泼。
projects.content_en: The Hankou Light & Power Company was funded by British merchants and was China's largest DC power plant at the time; a century ago, the first beam of residential electric light in Hankou at night was generated here, though at first it supplied only the British, Russian, and French concessions. The building is in Renaissance style, designed by Hemmings & Berkley and constructed by Hanxiesheng. A three-story concrete structure with imitation-granite stucco exterior and red tile roof, it sits at the corner of Poyang Street and Hezuo Road with an L-shaped plan. The main entrance is at the corner, above which rises a domed clock tower supported by four Tuscan columns. The facade uses a three-part design: the ground floor as a plinth, stories 2-3 as a full-height Tuscan colonnade, with small flat windows on the second story and projecting enclosed balconies on the third, creating a stable yet varied composition. After conversion to the Hubei Electric Power Museum in 2014, the exterior was repainted pale yellow and the third-story enclosed balconies were removed to become open loggias, shedding its former dark appearance for a brighter, livelier look.

projects.name: 俄国东正教堂
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区鄱阳街天津路口，鄱阳街38号
projects.address_en: No.38 Poyang Street, at the intersection of Poyang Street and Tianjin Road, Jiang'an District
projects.content_zh: 俄国东正教堂，教内称'阿列克桑德聂夫堂'，位于天津路与洞庭街转角处，是武汉唯一一座俄国东正教堂。19世纪下半叶，俄商在中国的茶叶生意逐渐壮大，1873年起三家俄国砖茶厂先后迁到汉口，俄国人也随之大量迁入汉口。1981年俄国皇太子尼古拉二世来汉口参加俄商砖茶厂25周年庆典，见到汉口侨民日盛，于是建议集资兴建俄国教堂。现存建筑约在1900年前后建成，当时在汉口不发展信徒，不开门布...
projects.content_en: The Russian Orthodox Church, known within the church as 'St. Alexander Nevsky Church,' stands at the corner of Tianjin Road and Dongting Street. It is Wuhan's only Russian Orthodox church. In the second half of the 19th century, Russian merchants' tea business in China grew; from 1873, three Russian brick tea factories relocated to Hankou one after another, and Russians moved in large numbers. In 1891, the Russian crown prince (later Tsar Nicholas II) visited Hankou for the 25th anniversary of the Russian brick tea factory; seeing the growing Russian expatriate community, he proposed raising funds to build a Russian church. The surviving building was completed around 1900. At that time, it did not seek converts in Hankou nor hold public services...

projects.name: 汉口交通银行旧址
projects.name_en: Historic Site of Bank of Communications in Hankou
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区胜利街江汉路口，胜利街2号
projects.address_en: No.2 Shengli Street, at the intersection of Shengli Street and Jianghan Road, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
projects.content_zh: 交通银行与中国银行、中央银行和农业银行并称'中中交农'，代表了旧中国官僚资本发展的顶峰。1907年底，清政府新成立了总管交通行政事务的邮传部，为经理铁路、电报、邮政、航运四项事业的收付，邮传部向慈禧太后和光绪皇帝奏请设立交通银行。次年总行设立，1909年4月设立汉口分行。交通银行是中国最早的发钞行之一，成立后的第一件事就是负责借款赎回京汉铁路。汉口分行最初的选址在小关帝庙前，1912年后迁到京汉铁路局，后迁法租界霞飞路（今岳飞街），1919年筹建正式银行大楼。汉口交行大楼为英商景明洋行的建筑师喻明斯和工程师伯克利于1920年1月完成施工图设计，汉合顺营造厂承建，1921年建成，造价8.2万两白银，是新古典主义的优秀作品，也是20世纪20年代武汉汉银行大楼的典例之一。大楼为钢筋混凝土结构，地上四层，地下一层。矩形平面，首层中部为营业大厅，上设置3个采光天井，两侧为业务用房；二、三层为办公用房，四层为居住用房，地下室为库房。立面采用三段式设计，为台基、柱廊和檐口，正面四根爱奥尼亚式的花岗石立柱三层通高，高达14米，直径1.3米。1933年在南京建成的交通银行，门廊立柱高9米，便被赞誉为'非常宏伟'，那么汉口交通银行的廊柱可以被称为'宏伟之极'了。整座建筑外观严谨对称，尺度雄伟。从热闹的江汉路步行街拐到胜利街，看到交通银行古典庄重、仅有少量装饰的立面，使人顿生凝重肃穆之感。
projects.content_en: The Bank of Communications, together with the Bank of China, Central Bank, and Agricultural Bank, was known as 'Zhong-Zhong-Jiao-Nong,' representing the pinnacle of bureaucratic capitalism in pre-1949 China. In late 1907, the Qing government established the Ministry of Posts and Communications to manage the receipts and payments of railways, telegraphs, postal services, and shipping; the ministry petitioned Empress Dowager Cixi and Emperor Guangxu to establish the Bank of Communications. The head office was set up the following year, and the Hankou branch opened in April 1909. It was one of China's earliest note-issuing banks; its first task was to handle the loan to redeem the Beijing-Hankou Railway. The Hankou branch was initially located near Xiaoguan Emperor Temple, moved to the Beijing-Hankou Railway Bureau in 1912, then to Joffre Road (now Yuefei Road) in the French concession, and in 1919 began planning a proper bank building. Designed by architect Mings and engineer Berkley of Hemmings & Berkley, with construction drawings completed in January 1920, built by Hanheshun, and completed in 1921 at a cost of 82,000 taels of silver, it is an outstanding Neoclassical work and a典型 example of 1920s Hankou bank buildings. Reinforced concrete structure, four stories above ground and one below. Rectangular plan: the ground-floor center is the banking hall with three light wells above, business rooms on both sides; stories 2-3 are offices; story 4 is residential; the basement is a vault. The facade uses a three-part design—plinth, colonnade, and cornice—with four Ionic granite columns on the front rising three stories, 14 meters high and 1.3 meters in diameter. When the 1933 Nanjing Bank of Communications was built with 9-meter portico columns, it was praised as 'very grand'; the Hankou columns can thus be called 'supremely grand.' The building's exterior is rigorous and symmetrical with imposing scale. Turning from the bustling Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street onto Shengli Street, the classical, solemn, sparsely decorated facade evokes a sense of gravity and reverence.

projects.name: 汉口商业银行大楼
projects.name_en: Building of Commercial Bank in Hankou
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 胜利街南京路路口，南京路56号
projects.address_en: No.56 Nanjing Road, at the intersection of Shengli Street and Nanjing Road
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
projects.content_zh: 汉口商业银行大楼位于南京路与胜利街相交的转角，由汉口'烟土大王'赵典之投资修建，上海工程师陈念慈设计，汉兴昌营造厂承建。大楼为钢筋混凝土结构，地上四层，地下一层，是一座糅合古典主义与现代主义的建筑。大楼建成后，赵典之邀汉口具有一定资历的商人组建汉口商业银行，并将其作为行址。大楼平面为矩形，一层大厅有采光天窗，从二层开始，房间环绕中间的天井布置。主入口朝向南京路，立面保留了三段式构图。正面的柱廊设计很有特色，中间为一对爱奥尼亚双柱，两侧靠墙面各一根单柱，三道拱券门窗装饰精美。柱廊两侧向前伸出的三层体量则开长方形窗，简洁而并无任何装饰。临胜利街一侧为爱奥尼亚式单柱廊，侧门的装饰尤为华丽，纹样似是受到了新艺术运动的影响。檐口以上的部分楼顶采用中国古典的单檐歇山，绿色琉璃瓦，抗日战争时被炸，修复时改为现在的平顶。后部的楼顶上还能看到一个中式的八角凉亭，是楼顶花园的一部分。
projects.content_en: The Commercial Bank Building in Hankou stands at the corner of Nanjing Road and Shengli Street. Invested by Zhao Dianzhi, the 'King of Opium' of Hankou, designed by Shanghai engineer Chen Nianci, and constructed by Hanxingchang, it is a reinforced concrete structure with four stories above ground and one below—a blend of Neoclassicism and Modernism. After completion, Zhao invited experienced Hankou merchants to establish the Hankou Commercial Bank and used this building as its headquarters. Rectangular plan: the ground-floor hall has a skylight; from the second story upward, rooms surround a central courtyard. The main entrance faces Nanjing Road, and the facade retains a three-part composition. The front colonnade is distinctive: a pair of Ionic columns in the center, single columns against the walls on both sides, with three exquisitely decorated arched doors and windows. The three-story volumes projecting forward on both sides of the colonnade have simple rectangular windows with no ornament. On the Shengli Street side is an Ionic single-column colonnade; the side entrance is especially ornate, its patterns seemingly influenced by Art Nouveau. Above the cornice, the roof originally used a Chinese classical single-eave hip-and-gable form with green glazed tiles; it was bombed during the Second Sino-Japanese War and restored with the current flat roof. A Chinese-style octagonal pavilion can still be seen on the rear rooftop, part of the roof garden.

projects.name: 汉口平汉铁路局旧址
projects.name_en: Historic Site of Beiping-Hankou Railway Administration
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区胜利街174号
projects.address_en: No.174 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District
projects.content_zh: 平汉铁路是京汉铁路的别称，是甲午战争之后清政府自己修筑的第一条铁路，原称卢汉铁路。为了生产铁路所需要的钢轨，湖广总督张之洞在武汉筹办了汉阳铁厂等一系列重工厂。1906年，铁路终于正式全线通车，全长1200公里。1909年，清政府几经周折，终于从比利时收回了铁路的管理权，第二年平汉铁路以黄河为界，分南北两局管理，分管郑州至汉口段的南局设立于武汉；1931年又统一管理，在武汉设立平汉铁路管理局。沿着胜利街一路向北走，这一带车流骤减，街道两边是高大的法国梧桐，显得非常安静。白色的大楼在绿荫的掩映之下，让人眼前一亮：看累了古典建筑灰扑扑的柱廊、拱券、山花、线脚，突然看到亮色的汉阳铁砂砖和简洁的墙面，心情也不由得轻快起来。大楼由土木工程学家夏光宇设计，建于1920年至1925年间，四层砖混结构。平面布局为对称的'H'形，中间伸出主入口的门斗。底层的拱券长廊可以在下雨天供行人穿过，似乎是南方'骑楼'的一种变形。立面上保留了一些简单的出檐、外廊、小阳台等，但并不喧宾夺主。最有特色的是墙面上砖的使用，通过简单图案不断的重复和排列组合产生了丰富的变化，显得非常精致，即使以今天的审美来评价，仍然是一座优美大方的建筑。
projects.content_en: The Beiping-Hankou Railway, also known as the Beijing-Hankou Railway, was the first railway built by the Qing government itself after the First Sino-Japanese War, originally called the Lugouqiao-Hankou Railway. To produce the steel rails needed, Viceroy Zhang Zhidong of Huguang established the Hanyang Iron Works and other heavy industries in Wuhan. The railway finally opened fully in 1906, with a total length of 1,200 kilometers. In 1909, after much negotiation, the Qing government recovered management rights from Belgium; the following year, the railway was divided at the Yellow River into northern and southern administrations, with the southern bureau managing the Zhengzhou-Hankou section based in Wuhan. In 1931, management was unified and the Beiping-Hankou Railway Administration established in Wuhan. Walking north along Shengli Street, traffic thins dramatically and tall plane trees line both sides, creating a quiet atmosphere. The white building, half-hidden in green shade, is a refreshing sight: after tiring of the gray colonnades, arches, pediments, and moldings of classical buildings, the bright Hanyang iron-sand brick and clean walls lift the spirits. Designed by civil engineer Xia Guangyu and built between 1920 and 1925, it is a four-story brick-concrete structure. The plan is a symmetrical 'H' shape, with a projecting entrance porch at the center. The ground-floor arched corridor allows pedestrians to pass through in rain, seemingly a variation of the southern 'qilou' (arcade). The facade retains simple eaves, loggias, and small balconies, but these do not dominate. The most distinctive feature is the brickwork: simple patterns repeated and arranged in combinations create rich variation, appearing very refined. Even by today's aesthetic standards, it remains an elegant and generous building.

projects.name: 德明饭店
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区胜利街黎黄陂路口，胜利街245号
projects.address_en: No.245 Shengli Street, at the intersection of Shengli Street and Lihuangpi Road, Jiang'an District
highlights: 建国初期接待外宾的场所
projects.content_zh: 德明饭店位于平汉铁路局对面，它的起源也要从京汉铁路说起。1903年，铁路的终点大智门火车站落成，70岁的法国商人沈保禄（也译圣保罗）看中了毗邻地段，在当时法租界内的四民路185号投资兴建饭店，法籍犹太人史德生夫妇设计。工程施工时因承包商亏本，在完成基础工程后潜逃，后经担保人赔偿，1919年才正式完工开业。店名由英语'TERMINUS'（终点）音译为'德明'，含意是：京汉铁路以汉口为终点，四海旅客以德明为'终点'，这也是武汉最早由外国人开设的饭店。德明饭店是一座典型的法式建筑。平面为矩形，三层砖木结构，沿胜利街设两个入口。沿街的人行入口有突出的门廊，一对爱奥尼亚双柱；另一个入口前有宽敞的庭院以方便乘车前来的旅客。立面上最引人注目的是覆斗状的深黑色铁皮屋顶，坡度很大，圆形的老虎窗好似一只只明亮的眼睛，充满了浓郁法国风情。饭店的内部装修设施豪华，大厅富丽典雅，有旋转玻璃门、柳枝木护墙板、深红色金丝线绣花地毯和法式大沙发，金光闪烁的水晶吊灯悬垂而下。房间轩敞，卧室和起居室内外相隔，临街伸出凉台，是当时汉口最高档的酒店。资料记载，1949年前，在此下榻的政界名人有蒋介石、李宗仁、程潜、白崇禧等，还有唐生智——他东渡日本后不久唐公馆便易主，再次回到武汉已经是1937年底南京保卫战失利之后了。1938年，美国记者史沫特莱旅居武汉期间，在德明饭店的聚会上向记者同行们介绍了八路军在前线的作战情况。建国初期，德明饭店更名为江汉饭店，成为湖北省接待外宾的主要场所，在此下榻过的有法国总统戴高乐、朝鲜的金日成，还有尼赫鲁、胡志明、西哈努克、赫鲁晓夫等国际知名人士。毛泽东、周恩来、邓小平、宋庆龄等国家领导人也曾入住。徐悲鸿、齐白石、关山月、张仃、黄胄等著名书画家曾入住创作并留下墨宝。
projects.content_en: The Terminus Hotel stands opposite the Beiping-Hankou Railway Administration; its origins also trace back to the Beijing-Hankou Railway. In 1903, the railway's terminus, Dazhimen Station, was completed. The 70-year-old French merchant Shen Baolu (also translated as Saint-Paul) took a fancy to the adjacent plot and invested in building a hotel at No.185 Simin Road in the then French concession, designed by French Jewish couple Mr. and Mrs. Shi Desheng. During construction, the contractor went bankrupt and absconded after completing the foundation; after the guarantor paid compensation, it was not formally completed and opened until 1919. The name 'Terminus' was transliterated as 'Deming' in Chinese, meaning: the Beijing-Hankou Railway terminates at Hankou, and travelers from all corners of the world make Deming their 'terminus.' It was also Wuhan's earliest foreign-owned hotel. A典型 French building with a rectangular plan and three-story brick-wood structure, it has two entrances along Shengli Street. The pedestrian entrance has a projecting portico with a pair of Ionic columns; the other entrance fronts a spacious courtyard for arriving guests by car. The most striking facade feature is the hipped, deep-black tin roof with a steep pitch and round dormer windows like bright eyes, full of French charm. Interiors were luxuriously appointed: the lobby was rich and elegant with revolving glass doors, willow-branch wood wainscoting, deep-red gold-thread embroidered carpets, and French sofas, with glittering crystal chandeliers overhead. Rooms were spacious, with bedrooms and living rooms separated and balconies projecting toward the street—the most upscale hotel in Hankou at the time. Records show that before 1949, political figures who stayed here included Chiang Kai-shek, Li Zongren, Cheng Qian, Bai Chongxi, and Tang Shengzhi—who left for Japan and whose residence changed hands soon after, not returning to Wuhan until after the fall of Nanjing in late 1937. In 1938, American journalist Agnes Smedley, while residing in Wuhan, introduced the Eighth Route Army's frontline combat situation to journalist colleagues at a gathering at the Terminus Hotel. In the early PRC period, it was renamed Jianghan Hotel and became Hubei Province's main venue for receiving foreign guests; those who stayed included French President Charles de Gaulle, North Korea's Kim Il-sung, as well as Nehru, Ho Chi Minh, Sihanouk, Khrushchev, and other international figures. National leaders Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, Deng Xiaoping, and Soong Ching-ling also stayed. Famous calligraphers and painters including Xu Beihong, Qi Baishi, Guan Shanyue, Zhang Ding, and Huang Zhou stayed and created works here, leaving their calligraphy and paintings.

projects.name: 美最时洋行
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区胜利街一元路口，一元路2号
projects.address_en: No.2 Yiyuan Road, at the intersection of Shengli Street and Yiyuan Road, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
projects.content_zh: 一元路一带在旧汉口属于德国租界，不如英、法、俄租界热闹，但街道宽阔，建筑疏朗，非常宜居。美最时洋行大楼就矗立在胜利街和一元路的转角，整体显示出浓郁的德国古典风格，端庄、厚重，局部又有巴洛克风格的装饰，不失华丽和俏皮。这座大楼由汉协盛营造厂施工，外观四层，实则为三层，一层很高，从立面正中的主入口到大一层，要攀上十多级台阶，而室内的空间也很高敞。二、三层外墙的壁柱通高，但没有外廊，窗户也是更加简洁的方形长窗，与英法租界的建筑明显不同。红瓦坡顶，正立面屋顶两端各立一座平顶塔楼，细部的线脚非常精美。第一次世界大战期间，美最时洋行的德国人纷纷撤离回国，资产委托荷兰总领事代理，大楼一度被北洋政府作为产汉铁路局办公之用。1926年北伐军和国民政府相继进入武汉时，共产国际驻中国代表、国民政府总顾问鲍罗廷来到汉口，曾入住这座西式房子，这里一度非常繁忙，日日夜夜都有会议进行，因而人们也称之为'鲍公馆'。
projects.content_en: The Yiyuan Road area belonged to the German concession in old Hankou. Less bustling than the British, French, or Russian concessions, it had wide streets and sparse, spacious buildings—very livable. The C. Melchers & Co. building stands at the corner of Shengli Street and Yiyuan Road, overall displaying a strong German classical style: dignified and massive, with Baroque ornament in parts that is both ornate and playful. Constructed by Hanxiesheng, it appears four stories externally but is actually three; the ground floor is very tall, requiring more than ten steps from the main entrance at the facade center to the first floor, and the interior space is also very lofty. The second and third story exterior pilasters rise full height but without loggias; windows are simpler rectangular long windows, clearly different from buildings in the British and French concessions. Red-tile pitched roof, with a flat-roof tower at each end of the main facade roof, and exquisite moldings in detail. During World War I, the Germans of C. Melchers & Co. withdrew one after another, entrusting assets to the Dutch consul; the building was once used by the Beiyang government as offices for the Beijing-Hankou Railway. In 1926, when the Northern Expeditionary Army and the Nationalist government successively entered Wuhan, Borodin—the Comintern representative in China and chief advisor to the Nationalist government—came to Hankou and resided in this Western-style house. It was once very busy, with meetings day and night, and people thus called it 'Bao's Mansion.'

projects.name: 武汉国民政府旧址
projects.name_en: Historic Site of the National Government
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江汉区中山大道前进二路口，中山大道708号
projects.address_en: No.708 Zhongshan Avenue, at the intersection of Zhongshan Avenue and Qianjin 2nd Road, Jianghan District
projects.type: 市政建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
highlights: 第一次国共合作的历史见证
国民党二届三中全会会址
projects.content_zh: 也称为南洋大楼，1917年兴建，是南洋华侨简氏兄弟创办的南洋兄弟烟草公司汉口分公司的所在地。1926年第一次国共合作期间，国民政府由广州搬迁至此，并在此作出了收回汉口和九江英租界的决定。三层的旧址纪念馆悬挂着孙中山像和遗嘱，复原了国民党二届三中全会的会场，重现了这一历史场景。大楼为五层钢筋混凝土结构，平面呈不规则多边形。外立面为洗麻石粉面，局部镶嵌花岗石。屋顶建有回廊，正面中央一座二层尖顶塔楼，两边各一座圆顶塔楼。立面以出挑的阳台、竖向的线脚和局部的拱券、浮雕装饰，轮廓非常丰富。大楼占地面积近900平方米，建筑面积达到4700平方米，是武汉率先使用钢筋混凝土技术的建筑；外观相对简洁，也已具备了现代主义的雏形。
projects.content_en: Also known as the Nanyang Building, it was constructed in 1917 and housed the Hankou branch of the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Company, founded by overseas Chinese Jian brothers from Nanyang. During the first KMT-CPC cooperation in 1926, the National Government relocated here from Guangzhou and made the decision to recover the British concessions in Hankou and Jiujiang. The three-story memorial hall displays a portrait and will of Sun Yat-sen, and recreates the venue of the Third Plenary Session of the Second KMT Central Committee, reproducing this historical scene. The building is a five-story reinforced concrete structure with an irregular polygonal plan. The exterior is finished in washed granite stucco with granite inlays. A colonnade tops the roof, with a two-story pointed tower at the front center and a domed tower on each side. The facade features projecting balconies, vertical moldings, and local arches and relief ornament, with a very rich silhouette. Covering nearly 900 square meters of land and 4,700 square meters of floor area, it was among the first buildings in Wuhan to use reinforced concrete technology; its relatively simple exterior also shows the beginnings of Modernism.

projects.name: 汉口盐业银行大楼
projects.name_en: Building of Yien Yieh Commercial Bank in Hankou
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区中山大道北京路口，中山大道988号
projects.address_en: No.988 Zhongshan Avenue, at the intersection of Zhongshan Avenue and Beijing Road, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
projects.content_zh: 盐业银行由袁世凯表弟、久任长芦盐运使的张镇芳创办，于1915年成立，也是著名的'北四行'之一。1916年，盐业银行在汉口设立分行，总行在上海。1917年，张镇芳因参加'张勋复辟'被捕，总经理改由天津造币厂厂长吴鼎昌担任。武汉沦陷后，日军华中派遣军司令部曾设于此。1945年复业，1952年12月参加公私合营，走上社会主义金融道路而结业。大楼由景明洋行设计，钢混结构，地上四层，地下一层，矩形平面，布局对称。正面中部微微前凸形成柱廊，采用三层通高的双柱，柱廊之后为主入口，侧面则使用单柱廊，第四层上方有突出的檐口。大楼外墙麻石到顶，强调出简洁的竖向装饰线条，整体风格典雅庄重，细部装饰精美。2007年武汉市修建过江隧道，这一带老房子被毁掉不少，仅剩下老银行大楼孤零零地立在原处。
projects.content_en: The Yien Yieh Commercial Bank was founded by Zhang Zhenfang, a cousin of Yuan Shikai and long-serving salt commissioner of Changlu, established in 1915 and one of the famous 'Four Northern Banks.' In 1916, it opened a Hankou branch, with the head office in Shanghai. In 1917, Zhang Zhenfang was arrested for participating in the 'Zhang Xun Restoration,' and the general manager position was taken over by Wu Dingchang, director of the Tianjin Mint. After Wuhan fell, the Japanese Central China Expeditionary Army headquarters was located here. It resumed business in 1945 and participated in the public-private joint venture in December 1952, ending along the socialist financial path. Designed by Hemmings & Berkley, it is a steel-reinforced concrete structure with four stories above ground and one below, a rectangular plan with symmetrical layout. The front center projects slightly forward to form a colonnade using three-story-tall paired columns, with the main entrance behind; the sides use single colonnades, with a prominent cornice above the fourth story. The exterior is clad in granite to the top, emphasizing clean vertical decorative lines; the overall style is elegant and solemn with exquisite details. In 2007, when Wuhan built the river-crossing tunnel, many old houses in this area were demolished, leaving only the old bank building standing alone in place.

projects.name: 汉口电话局旧址
projects.name_en: Historic Site of Hankou Telephone Office
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区中山大道合作路口，合作路51号
projects.address_en: No.51 Hezuo Road, at the intersection of Zhongshan Avenue and Hezuo Road, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 市政建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
highlights: 英商通和有限公司设计
projects.content_zh: 1902年，汉口开始设立电话局。电话局大楼由英商通和有限公司设计，魏清记营造厂施工，四层钢筋混凝土结构，表层仿麻石粉刷并做横向线槽。大楼有一定的古典主义风格，还使用了柱式和具有古希腊建筑特征的山花，但整体的设计显得轻盈一些，相应的墙面、檐口和女儿墙也都富于变化。正中的入口使用了两层通高的四根多立克柱，但比例要更细长一些，分两组列于大门两侧。三层临中山大道面的窗户出挑有精巧的小阳台，设水平腰线。整栋大楼的立面语言虽然丰富，但没有复杂的装饰，线条简洁明快，体现出一定的现代风格。
projects.content_en: In 1902, Hankou began establishing a telephone office. The telephone office building was designed by the British firm Palmer & Turner and constructed by Wei Qingji. A four-story reinforced concrete structure, its surface is finished in imitation-granite stucco with horizontal grooves. The building has a certain Neoclassical style, using orders and pediments characteristic of ancient Greek architecture, but the overall design is lighter, with correspondingly varied walls, cornices, and parapets. The central entrance uses four two-story-tall Doric columns, but in more slender proportions, arranged in two pairs flanking the main door. On the third story facing Zhongshan Avenue, windows project with delicate small balconies, set off by horizontal belt courses. Although the facade's vocabulary is rich, there is no complex ornament; lines are clean and lively, reflecting a certain modern style.

projects.name: 汉口新市场
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江汉区中山大道前进二路口，中山大道734号
projects.address_en: No.734 Zhongshan Avenue, at the intersection of Zhongshan Avenue and Qianjin 2nd Road, Jianghan District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
highlights: 湖北第一座大型城市综合体
projects.content_zh: 汉口新市场是湖北第一座大型综合娱乐场所，1917年由当时的武汉稽查处长刘友才发起，由协力公司和协心公司合力兴建。'楚剧'在此正式命名，刘少奇、宋庆龄、邓演达、何香凝等国共要人都曾在此作过演讲，梅兰芳、尚小云、程砚秋、荀慧生等戏曲名家也曾在此演出。建筑由康城模仿上海大世界设计，汉合顺营造厂施工，文艺复兴风格，由前部的'V'字形大楼、内部的雍和厅、后部的大舞台和新舞台组成，分别安排3个剧场、2个书场、中西餐厅、小型商场，溜冰场以及杂技、舞台等。'V'形楼的转角设置主入口，顶部立一座七层塔楼，上覆圆形穹顶。进入后首先是七层的圆形大厅，内部有电梯可以通至顶层，供游客观光俯瞰。两翼左右对称，各为三层楼房，后来又加建一层。'V'字形的外侧，即沿街面有阳台出挑，内侧则为拱券外廊。'V'字形中间的场院上为半圆形的二层建筑雍和厅，一层的后部设舞台，二层有半圆形的柱廊。雍和厅之后是并列的大舞台和新舞台。新市场后部有一座日本设计师设计的园林，名为'趣园'。
projects.content_en: Hankou New Market was Hubei's first large-scale comprehensive entertainment venue. Initiated in 1917 by Liu Youcai, then head of Wuhan's inspection office, it was jointly built by the Xie-li and Xie-xin companies. 'Chu opera' was formally named here; KMT and CPC figures including Liu Shaoqi, Soong Ching-ling, Deng Yanda, and He Xiangning gave speeches here, and opera masters including Mei Lanfang, Shang Xiaoyun, Cheng Yanqiu, and Xun Huisheng performed here. Modeled on Shanghai's Great World by Kang Cheng and constructed by Hanheshun, it is in Renaissance style, composed of the front 'V'-shaped building, the inner Yonghe Hall, and the rear Grand Stage and New Stage, housing 3 theaters, 2 storytelling venues, Chinese and Western restaurants, a small mall, an ice rink, and acrobatics and performance spaces. The main entrance is at the corner of the 'V'-shaped building, topped by a seven-story tower with a circular dome. Upon entering, one first encounters a seven-story circular hall with elevators to the top floor for sightseeing and panoramic views. The two wings are left-right symmetrical, each three stories, with a later added story. The outer side of the 'V' (street side) has projecting balconies; the inner side has arched loggias. In the courtyard between the 'V' arms stands the semicircular two-story Yonghe Hall, with a stage at the rear of the ground floor and a semicircular colonnade on the second floor. Behind Yonghe Hall are the parallel Grand Stage and New Stage. At the rear of New Market is a garden designed by a Japanese architect, named 'Qu Garden' (Garden of Delights).

projects.name: 汉口总商会
projects.name_en: General Chamber of Commerce in Hankou
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江汉区中山大道前进四路口，中山大道489号
projects.address_en: No.489 Zhongshan Avenue, at the intersection of Zhongshan Avenue and Qianjin 4th Road, Jianghan District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
highlights: 汉协盛营造厂设计修建
projects.content_zh: 清朝末年张之洞总督两湖时，曾划拨今中山大道官地一段，筹建武汉总商会会址，后来因辛亥革命未能实现。1919年，时任商会会长的万泽生召集各行商人，筹款并委托汉协盛营造厂设计修建，建成后即成为商会办公楼。抗日战争时期，中华全国文艺界抗敌协会在此成立，大楼成为'保卫大武汉'的重要文化基地。大楼为简化的古典主义建筑，平面呈矩形，中段向外突出为主入口，正面设两层通高的爱奥尼亚壁柱，其上有檐口和山花。上部的两层相对简单，以水平线脚装饰。建筑内部装修精细，底层为水磨石地面，二层以上为木地板。
projects.content_en: In the late Qing dynasty, when Zhang Zhidong was Viceroy of Huguang, he allocated a plot of official land on today's Zhongshan Avenue to build the Wuhan General Chamber of Commerce headquarters, but this was not realized due to the 1911 Revolution. In 1919, then chamber president Wan Zesheng summoned merchants from all trades, raised funds, and commissioned Hanxiesheng to design and construct it; upon completion it became the chamber's office building. During the Second Sino-Japanese War, the All-China Association of Literary and Art Circles for Resistance Against Japan was founded here, making the building an important cultural base for 'Defending Greater Wuhan.' A simplified Neoclassical building with a rectangular plan, the central section projects outward as the main entrance, with two-story-tall Ionic pilasters on the front, topped by a cornice and pediment. The upper two stories are relatively simple, decorated with horizontal moldings. Interiors are finely finished: the ground floor has terrazzo floors, and the second story upward has wood floors.

projects.name: 汉口水塔
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江汉区中山大道前进五路口，中山大道539号
projects.address_en: No.539 Zhongshan Avenue, at the intersection of Zhongshan Avenue and Qianjin 5th Road, Jianghan District
projects.content_zh: 1906年，浙江籍商人宋炜臣得到鄂督张之洞的支持，邀集浙江、湖北、江西等地的巨商合办汉口水电业，成立汉口既济水电公司，是年水、电厂同时动工，3年后建成并投入使用。水厂建在硚口汉水岸边韩家宗关，至1923年夏季已达到每日700万加仑（约2.65万立方米）的供水量；电厂建在龙王庙附近的汉水边，共5部电机，发电总量达到1.05万千瓦；1909年又建成了汉口水塔。北伐战争以后，宋子文插手汉口既济水电公司，于1937年兼任董事长。武汉沦陷后，水电二厂皆落于日本人之手，至1949年前两厂仍是汉口唯一的公用自来水厂和火力发电厂，电厂发电量达1.825万千瓦。水塔为汉口既济水电公司的配水系统，由英籍工程师穆尔设计，广荣兴营造厂施工，塔身砖石结构，平面八角形，每边长8.2米，主体六层，一至五层为房室，六层为水箱，西面的楼梯间突出于主体，形成局部七层。建筑外墙底层为花岗石垒砌，上部均为清水红砖，每层每面设两扇木窗，饰以砖砌线脚，顶部曾装有一口重达千斤的铸铜警钟。水塔总高41.3米，为当时汉口最高的建筑，这一纪录一直保持到20世...
projects.content_en: In 1906, Zhejiang merchant Song Weichen, with the support of Huguang Viceroy Zhang Zhidong, gathered major merchants from Zhejiang, Hubei, and Jiangxi to jointly operate Hankou's water and electricity business, establishing the Hankou Ji-Ji Water & Electric Company. That same year, the water and power plants began construction simultaneously and were completed and put into use three years later. The water plant was built at Hanji Zongguan on the Han River bank in Qiaokou; by summer 1923 it reached a daily supply of 7 million gallons (about 26,500 cubic meters). The power plant was built by the Han River near Longwang Temple, with 5 generators totaling 10,500 kW; in 1909 the Hankou Water Tower was also completed. After the Northern Expedition, T.V. Soong intervened in the Ji-Ji company and became concurrent chairman in 1937. After Wuhan fell, both plants fell into Japanese hands; by 1949 they remained Hankou's only public water utility and thermal power plant, with the power plant generating 18,250 kW. The water tower served as the distribution system for the Ji-Ji company. Designed by British engineer Muir and constructed by Guangrongxing, the brick-stone tower has an octagonal plan with each side 8.2 meters long. The main body has six stories: stories 1-5 are rooms, story 6 is the water tank; the west stairwell projects beyond the main body, forming a partial seventh story. The exterior ground floor is built of granite blocks; the upper stories are all exposed red brick, with two wood windows on each side per story, decorated with brick moldings; the top once held a cast-bronze alarm bell weighing over 500 kilograms. The tower's total height is 41.3 meters, making it the tallest building in Hankou at the time—a record it held until the 20th...

projects.name: 汉口大清银行旧址/中国银行大楼
projects.name_en: Historic Site of Da Qing Bank/ Building of Bank of China
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区中山大道江汉路口，中山大道1021号
projects.address_en: No.1021 Zhongshan Avenue, at the intersection of Zhongshan Avenue and Jianghan Road, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
highlights: 英商通和有限公司设计
projects.content_zh: 中国银行的前身是清政府于1905年成立的户部银行，1908年改称为大清银行，当时在上海、天津、武汉等地已有二十多家分行。1911年辛亥革命爆发，汉口分行的总办贾鸿宾将行中宝银、现洋、钞票和账单分别储存于英租界的横滨正金银行和麦加利银行，因而大清银行的房屋器物虽然全部在战火中焚毁，银行业务却借浙江兴业银行之房屋而得以继续。1916年，改名后的中国银行在原址上兴建大楼，一年后落成。建筑由英商通和有限公司设计，汉合顺营造厂施工，地上四层，地下一层，钢筋混凝土结构，外墙以麻石铺面，立柱也以麻石拼接而成。沿中山大道的立面模仿了西方古典主义建筑的三段式设计手法，底层采用花岗岩基座，开拱券门，显得较为厚重；中部使用两层通高的爱奥尼亚双柱廊；顶部水平的檐口之上则变换为方形壁柱。沿江汉路立面则在三段式的基础上有一些不对称的处理。一楼的右侧的拱窗之上雕刻'中国银行'四字，此处曾为银行的侧门。大楼建成之时，正门面对英租界的围墙，侧门反而成了进出人流主要的出入口，直到1923年江汉路周围建立'模范区'，英租界的围墙方被撤除。大楼的地下层为仓库用房，地上部分为营业大厅等业务用房，平面布局为'口'字形，中有采光天井。室内装修精美，体现出银行业雄厚的实力。1949年武汉解放后，市军管会于5月下旬接管中国银行并在原址复业，后属中国人民银行汉口分行领导。新千年之际，银行对大楼进行了一次全面的修整与加固，使这座宏伟的建筑焕发出新的生命。
projects.content_en: The predecessor of the Bank of China was the Hubu Bank established by the Qing government in 1905, renamed Da Qing Bank in 1908, with over twenty branches in Shanghai, Tianjin, Wuhan, and elsewhere by then. When the 1911 Revolution broke out, Jia Hongbin, general manager of the Hankou branch, stored the bank's silver, cash, notes, and accounts separately in the Yokohama Specie Bank and Chartered Bank in the British concession; thus, although the Da Qing Bank's buildings and furnishings were entirely destroyed in the war, banking business continued using the premises of the Zhejiang Industrial Bank. In 1916, the renamed Bank of China built a new building on the original site, completed one year later. Designed by the British firm Palmer & Turner and constructed by Hanheshun, it has four stories above ground and one below, in reinforced concrete, with granite-clad exterior walls and columns assembled from granite blocks. The facade along Zhongshan Avenue imitates the three-part composition of Western Neoclassical architecture: the ground floor uses a granite plinth with arched doors, appearing relatively massive; the middle section uses a two-story-tall Ionic paired colonnade; above the horizontal cornice at the top, it transforms into square pilasters. The facade along Jianghan Road has some asymmetrical treatment based on the three-part composition. Above the arched window on the right side of the ground floor is carved 'Bank of China'; this was once the bank's side entrance. When the building was completed, the main entrance faced the British concession wall, and the side entrance instead became the main entry for people coming and going, until the 'Model District' was established around Jianghan Road in 1923 and the British concession wall was removed. The basement is for storage; the above-ground floors house the banking hall and other business spaces, with a 'mouth'-shaped plan and a central light well. Interiors are exquisitely decorated, reflecting the bank's strong financial strength. After Wuhan's liberation in 1949, the municipal military control committee took over the Bank of China in late May and resumed business on the original site, later under the Hankou branch of the People's Bank of China. Around the turn of the millennium, the bank carried out a comprehensive renovation and reinforcement of the building, giving this magnificent structure new life.

projects.name: 金城银行
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区中山大道南京路路口，保华街2号
projects.address_en: No.2 Baohua Street, at the intersection of Zhongshan Avenue and Nanjing Road, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
projects.content_zh: 金城银行由人称'银行奇才'的银行家周作民于1917年创办，取'金城汤池、永久坚固'之意，与盐业银行、中南银行、大陆银行一起，并称为'北四行'。这四家银行组成的紧密联合体曾建立四行准备库，联合发行钞票，合办四行储蓄会、企业部和信托部，并联合兴建了国际大饭店，在当时中国金融界影响巨大。1928年，金城银行汉口分行选址筹建，由中国第一代留美建筑师庄俊设计，景明洋行绘制出图纸，汉协盛营造厂施工。1931年大楼落成，1938年武汉沦陷，被日军用作宪兵司令部。1952年，金城银行参与公私合营，大楼被租给武汉图书馆，设立武汉少年儿童图书馆，2005年改建为武汉美术馆。
projects.content_en: Jincheng Bank was founded in 1917 by banker Zhou Zuomin, known as a 'banking prodigy,' taking the meaning of 'golden city and moat, permanent and solid.' Together with the Yien Yieh Commercial Bank, China & South Sea Bank, and Continental Bank, it was known as one of the 'Four Northern Banks.' The tight consortium formed by these four banks established the Four Banks Reserve, jointly issued banknotes, jointly operated the Four Banks Savings Association, Enterprise Department, and Trust Department, and jointly built the International Hotel, exerting enormous influence in China's financial world at the time. In 1928, the Hankou branch of Jincheng Bank selected a site and began planning. Designed by China's first generation of US-educated architect Zhuang Jun, with drawings by Hemmings & Berkley, and constructed by Hanxiesheng, the building was completed in 1931. After Wuhan fell in 1938, it was used by the Japanese military police as their headquarters. In 1952, Jincheng Bank participated in the public-private joint venture; the building was leased to the Wuhan Library, establishing the Wuhan Children's Library, and was converted into the Wuhan Art Museum in 2005.

projects.name: 汉口电报局/西门子洋行旧址
projects.name_en: Historic Site of Hankou Telegraph Office/ Siemens China
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区中山大道天津路口，中山大道1004号
projects.address_en: No.1004 Zhongshan Avenue, at the intersection of Zhongshan Avenue and Tianjin Road, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
highlights: 古典向现代过渡的风格
projects.content_zh: 汉口于1884年设立电报局，1908年收归国有，1920年迁至新建的天津路电报局大楼。当时大楼转角及天津路一侧属于汉口电报局，临中山大道一侧则由西门子洋行租用。德商西门子洋行是最早进入武汉的德国企业之一，对华业务历史可追溯至公司成立之初的1872年。1910年，西门子在汉口成立分行，最初的行址设在上海路天主堂对面。由于提供了汉口电话网铺装及设备的业务，因而能够与汉口电报局共用一栋大楼。1940年，西门子歇业；1944年，美军飞机轰炸日军占领下的汉口，炸毁大楼，1946年由永营造厂在原址按原样重建。这座共用的大楼由汉协盛营造厂施工，四层钢筋混凝土结构，建于英租界朝北街（今中山大道）与天津街（今天津路）的交汇处，并在临街角设主入口，两翼沿街。营业大厅位于主楼正中，采用中庭式采光天窗，内部功能十分紧凑。外墙使用汉阳产的铁砂砖砌筑，底层基座仿麻石粉刷，墙面上则附以砖砌花饰，十分朴实。电报局大楼简洁素净，立面上不再采用柱式，而是以简洁的墙面为主，但在整体的构图上仍然借鉴了古典三段式结构，体现出一种古典主义向现代主义过渡的风格。电报局大楼比相邻的电话局晚五年建成，虽然两座大楼都显示出这种过渡风格，但各自体现出不同倾向，由此折射出武汉近代建筑的发展历程。
projects.content_en: Hankou established a telegraph office in 1884, nationalized in 1908, and relocated to the newly built Tianjin Road Telegraph Office Building in 1920. At that time, the corner and Tianjin Road side of the building belonged to the Hankou Telegraph Office, while the side facing Zhongshan Avenue was rented by Siemens. The German firm Siemens was one of the earliest German enterprises to enter Wuhan; its business with China dates back to the company's founding in 1872. In 1910, Siemens established a Hankou branch, initially located opposite the Catholic Church on Shanghai Road. Because it provided the installation and equipment for the Hankou telephone network, it was able to share one building with the Hankou Telegraph Office. In 1940, Siemens ceased operations; in 1944, American aircraft bombed Japanese-occupied Hankou and destroyed the building, which was rebuilt on the original site in its original form by Yongying Construction in 1946. This shared building, constructed by Hanxiesheng, is a four-story reinforced concrete structure built at the intersection of Chaobei Street (now Zhongshan Avenue) and Tianjin Street (now Tianjin Road) in the British concession, with the main entrance at the street corner and wings extending along both streets. The business hall is in the center of the main building, using an atrium-style skylight, with very compact internal functions. The exterior walls are built with iron-sand bricks produced in Hanyang; the ground-floor plinth is finished in imitation-granite stucco, and the walls are adorned with brick ornament, very plain. The telegraph office building is simple and austere; the facade no longer uses classical orders but is dominated by clean wall surfaces, yet the overall composition still borrows from the classical three-part structure, reflecting a transitional style from Neoclassicism to Modernism. The telegraph office building was completed five years later than the adjacent telephone office; although both buildings show this transitional style, each reflects different tendencies, thus折射 out the development process of modern architecture in Wuhan.

projects.name: 台湾银行旧址
projects.name_en: Historic Site of Bank of Taiwan
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区江汉路洞庭街口，江汉路21-23号
projects.address_en: No.21-23 Jianghan Road, at the intersection of Jianghan Road and Dongting Street, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
projects.content_zh: 台湾银行大楼位于洞庭街与江汉路交汇的丁字路口，是当时一家日商投资的银行，最早起源于1895年日本占领台湾后开设的大阪中立银行基隆分行，1899年正式成立。汉口分行建成于1915年，地上五层，地下一层，为钢筋混凝土结构，由景明洋行设计，汉协盛营造厂施工。汉口台湾银行大楼在外观上与基隆的大阪中立银行很是相似，都采用古典的三段式的构图。一、二层为粗石砌筑的连续拱券，券高两层，主入口突出的圆弧形拱券以一种复杂组合的柱式来支撑；三、四层也用两层通高的双柱形成外廊，两侧则使用单柱；在檐口上方还有一层，使用更加平缓的弧形窗洞，让柱廊的通透感得以向上延伸。外立面在水平方向上也分为三段，两端微微向前突出，中段柱廊的长度约占总长度的五分之三，使得立面的内容丰富而不混乱，整体的进退、虚实、主次关系都显得清晰而有秩序。从大阪中立银行的老照片中，还能看到在大楼的一段有一座塔楼，使整个建筑的轮廓瞬间丰富了起来。而汉口台湾银行的两端也曾经有两尊大型塑像，是四个高鼻深目、头发卷曲的古希腊男性，以一种优美的姿势蹲伏，两手向后向上托举起地球。可惜的是这组充满力量感的雕塑不知毁于何时，现在屋顶上只剩下两个正方形的石头基座了。
projects.content_en: The Bank of Taiwan building stands at the T-junction of Dongting Street and Jianghan Road. It was a Japanese-invested bank, originating from the Keelung branch of the Osaka Neutral Bank opened after Japan occupied Taiwan in 1895, and formally established in 1899. The Hankou branch was completed in 1915, with five stories above ground and one below, in reinforced concrete, designed by Hemmings & Berkley and constructed by Hanxiesheng. The Hankou Bank of Taiwan building is very similar in appearance to the Osaka Neutral Bank in Keelung, both adopting a classical three-part composition. The first and second stories are continuous arches built of rusticated stone, two stories high; the prominent main entrance's circular arch is supported by a complex composite order. The third and fourth stories also use two-story-tall paired columns to form a loggia, with single columns on the sides; above the cornice is another story using flatter arched window openings, allowing the colonnade's sense of transparency to extend upward. The exterior facade is also divided into three sections horizontally, with both ends slightly projecting forward; the middle colonnade occupies about three-fifths of the total length, making the facade rich without being chaotic, with clear and orderly relationships of projection/recession, solid/void, and primary/secondary. From old photos of the Osaka Neutral Bank, a tower can be seen on one section of the building, instantly enriching its silhouette. The two ends of the Hankou Bank of Taiwan also once had two large sculptures: four high-nosed, deep-eyed, curly-haired ancient Greek males crouching in a graceful pose, hands backward and upward lifting the earth. Unfortunately, it is unknown when this powerful sculpture group was destroyed; now only two square stone bases remain on the roof.

projects.name: 中国实业银行旧址
projects.name_en: Historic Site of Industrial Bank of China
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区江汉路洞庭街口，江汉路24号
projects.address_en: No.24 Jianghan Road, at the intersection of Jianghan Road and Dongting Street, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
highlights: 装饰艺术风格向现代主义过渡
projects.content_zh: 这座大楼也在江汉路与洞庭街的丁字路口，台湾银行的斜对面。楼身的两翼沿街展开，六层高，转角的地方拔高成一座九层的塔楼，除了黑色磨光大理石的底层，通身刷以深红色的砂浆，使整个大楼非常显眼，从很远的地方一眼就能看到。大楼外表简洁，只有一些简单的竖向线条作为装饰，具有装饰艺术风格（Art-Deco）向现代主义过渡的特点。大楼于1936年落成，同年落成的还有后来身着迷彩的大平银行，以及由卢镛标设计的中央信托公司大楼和四明银行大楼。这几座建筑虽然体量大小各个不一，风格也有繁有简，但都体现出了鲜明的装饰艺术风格特点，因而这一年也是武汉近代建筑风格史上一个重要的年份。中国实业银行的总行位于上海，1922年在汉口扬子街开设分行，这座大楼则是汉口分行的第二代办公大楼。在新建筑如雨后春笋般拔地而起的1936年，大楼因为外观新颖、高大雄伟，引得市民竞相前来围观，一时成为街头奇景。新中国成立后银行业公私合营，大楼在很长时间内为湖北省药材公司所使用，如今则是中信银行营业厅。
projects.content_en: This building also stands at the T-junction of Jianghan Road and Dongting Street, diagonally opposite the Bank of Taiwan. Its two wings extend along the street, six stories high, with the corner rising into a nine-story tower. Except for the ground floor of black polished marble, the entire body is finished in deep-red mortar, making the building very conspicuous—visible at a glance from far away. The exterior is simple, with only some simple vertical lines as decoration, characteristic of the transition from Art Deco to Modernism. The building was completed in 1936; also completed that year were the later camouflaged Taiping Bank, and the Central Trust Company building and Siming Bank building, both designed by Lu Yongbiao. Although these buildings vary in size and style complexity, they all display distinct Art Deco characteristics, making this year an important one in the history of modern architectural styles in Wuhan. The head office of the Industrial Bank of China was in Shanghai; it opened a Hankou branch on Yangzi Street in 1922, and this building was the branch's second-generation office building. In 1936, when new buildings sprang up like bamboo shoots after rain, this building—novel in appearance, tall and majestic—drew citizens to come and watch, becoming a street spectacle for a time. After the founding of New China, the banking industry underwent public-private joint ventures; the building was used by the Hubei Provincial Medicine Company for a long time, and is now a CITIC Bank branch.

projects.name: 四明银行
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区江汉路鄱阳街口，江汉路45号
projects.address_en: No.45 Jianghan Road, at the intersection of Jianghan Road and Poyang Street, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
projects.content_zh: 四明银行距离中国实业银行大楼不远，由华人建筑师卢镛标设计，同样落成于1936年，也显示出强烈的装饰艺术色彩：简洁的立面装饰，竖直向上的线条，还有中部突起的塔楼。卢镛标是近代武汉著名的建筑设计师。1922年，经胞兄卢东阳介绍，不会讲普通话又毫无专业学历的卢镛标由浙江定海来到武汉，在景明洋行学习建筑测绘和设计。他勤奋好学，两年后便正式入职景明洋行工作，其间还与建筑师刘根泰合作，在汉口组建了宏泰测绘行。此后卢镛标又函授攻读了美国的土木工程专业，并接触到当时流行的芝加哥学派和装饰艺术运动。1929年，卢镛标辞去了景明洋行的工作，在汉口开办了武汉第一家华人建筑事务所，主要承接工业和民用建筑设计及测绘业务，雇员曾多达二三十人，在曾经由洋行包揽设计的武汉建筑行业逐渐占据了一席之地。这一时期，装饰艺术风格建筑开始在中国流行，汉口的商业和金融建筑开始逐步由古典主义风格，转而追求简洁明快的现代风格。卢镛标对装饰艺术风格的设计手法的运用炉火纯青，是这一时期武汉华人建筑师的杰出代表。大楼由汉协盛营造厂施工，地上五层，中间突起的部分有七层，地下一层，是卢镛标建筑事务所的成名之作，也是华人在武汉设计的第一幢钢筋混凝土建筑（设计时间要早于中央信托公司和中国实业银行）。大楼的平面呈不规则的'凹'字形，中央有轻钢屋架的玻璃中庭作为营业大厅，前后布置办公室、电梯间等附属用房，每一层都有暖气和卫生设备。大楼沿街的立面稍稍向后退，一道矮墙隔开了街道与花园，宽容了入口空间，又充分显现出银行建筑的威严。四明银行是中国最早的商业银行之一，成立于1908年，由旅沪的宁波商人集资创办，以宁波著名的四明山命名，所发行的钞票上也印有四明山的图样。1919年在汉口设立分行，先在江汉路中山大道以北修...
projects.content_en: Siming Bank is not far from the Industrial Bank of China building. Designed by Chinese architect Lu Yongbiao and also completed in 1936, it displays strong Art Deco coloring: clean facade ornament, vertically upward lines, and a centrally protruding tower. Lu Yongbiao was a famous modern Wuhan architect. In 1922, introduced by his elder brother Lu Dongyang, Lu Yongbiao—who spoke no Mandarin and had no professional credentials—came from Dinghai, Zhejiang, to Wuhan to study architectural surveying and design at Hemmings & Berkley. Diligent and eager to learn, he formally joined Hemmings & Berkley two years later; during this time he also collaborated with architect Liu Gentai to establish the Hongtai Surveying Office in Hankou. Later, Lu Yongbiao studied civil engineering in the US by correspondence and was exposed to the then-popular Chicago School and Art Deco movement. In 1929, Lu resigned from Hemmings & Berkley and opened Wuhan's first Chinese architectural firm in Hankou, mainly undertaking industrial and civil architectural design and surveying, with as many as 20-30 employees at its peak, gradually gaining a foothold in Wuhan's architectural industry once monopolized by foreign firms. During this period, Art Deco architecture began to spread in China, and Hankou's commercial and financial buildings gradually shifted from Neoclassicism to pursuing clean, lively modern styles. Lu Yongbiao's mastery of Art Deco design techniques made him an outstanding representative of Chinese architects in Wuhan during this period. Constructed by Hanxiesheng, the building has five stories above ground, with the central protruding portion reaching seven stories, and one basement. It was the signature work of Lu Yongbiao's architectural firm and the first reinforced concrete building designed by a Chinese person in Wuhan (designed earlier than the Central Trust Company and Industrial Bank of China). The plan is an irregular 'concave' shape, with a central glass atrium with light steel roof trusses serving as the banking hall, with offices, elevators, and other ancillary rooms arranged front and back; every floor has heating and sanitary facilities. The street-facing facade recedes slightly, with a low wall separating the street from the garden, accommodating the entrance space while fully manifesting the dignity of a bank building. Siming Bank was one of China's earliest commercial banks, founded in 1908 by Ningbo merchants in Shanghai raising capital, named after the famous Siming Mountain in Ningbo; the banknotes it issued also bore the image of Siming Mountain. It established a Hankou branch in 1919, first building north of Zhongshan Avenue on Jianghan Road...

projects.name: 上海银行旧址
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区江汉路胜利街口，江汉路60号
projects.address_en: No.60 Jianghan Road, at the intersection of Jianghan Road and Shengli Street, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
highlights: 上海三合兴营造厂施工
projects.content_zh: 上海银行全称为上海商业储蓄银行，成立于1915年，总行设在上海，创办者陈光甫是著名的银行家，也是近代旅游业的创始人。1917年，出生于武汉工商世家的周苍柏赴美留学归来，就职于上海商业储蓄银行。1919年，他回汉亲自选址，主持建造上海银行汉口分行大楼，第二年即宣告落成。大楼由三义洋行设计，上海三合兴营造厂施工，钢筋混凝土的现代结构，三段式的古典立面，白花岗岩雕花门窗，汉白玉台阶，即使在银行建筑中也不多见。对面是由原来的花楼街拓建成的一个小广场，站在广场上看这座用材考究、工艺精细的建筑，更显得漂亮又气派。大楼平面为矩形，对称布局，两端前凸，一眼看去与诸多三段式的立面设计相似。仔细观察的话，会发现柱头、门楣、栏杆和窗台下的雕饰非常精美，突出的小阳台与山花很是抢眼，铁件装饰的纹样也相当细致。走进大楼，室内装修延续了室外精致奢华的风格，一层大厅内全部为雪白大理石贴面。这虽然是一座新古典主义的建筑，但在细部装饰上结合了很多巴洛克风格的设计元素，使得建筑立面显得华美典雅又充满动感。大楼东侧的一片联排商铺原是属于上海银行的高等住宅，最早名为'鼎安里'，后来更名为'上海村'，共有27栋房屋，其中9栋临街为四层，其他为三层。上海村是典型的石库门住宅，一栋多户，临街底层为商店，建筑风格与上海银行一脉相承，材料考究，细节精致。在动荡的局势中，周苍柏主持的上海银行汉口分行，一直稳健保持信誉，成为汉口地区最具影响的银行。他在任行长期间，还投入自己的绝大部分收入在东湖西岸兴建了'海光农圃'，为武汉市民提供了一个休闲娱乐的场所。当时海光农圃是一座非常受欢迎的城市公园，其中有一个苗圃、一片桃林、一个动物园、一个用来观鱼的天鹅池、一间米坊和一间香坊，人们除了在其中锻炼身体、嬉戏游乐，还可以自己栽培花木果树。新中国成立后，周苍柏主动将海光农圃捐献给国家，随即更名为东湖公园，也就是今天东湖风景区的前身。为了纪念'东湖之父'周苍柏，人们将景区中原先周苍柏的私家花园改建为苍柏园，其中有'海光农圃'牌坊、周苍柏纪念馆等景点，还有一片周苍柏先生亲手栽下的桂花林，如今已经是华盖如云了。
projects.content_en: The full name of the Bank of Shanghai is the Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank, founded in 1915 with its head office in Shanghai. Its founder Chen Guangfu was a famous banker and also the founder of modern tourism in China. In 1917, Zhou Cangbai, born into a Wuhan industrial and commercial family, returned from studying in the US and joined the Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank. In 1919, he returned to Hankou, personally selected the site, and oversaw the construction of the Hankou branch building, which was completed the following year. Designed by Sanyi Architects and constructed by Shanghai Sanhexing, it uses a modern reinforced concrete structure with a three-part classical facade, white granite carved doors and windows, and white marble steps—rare even among bank buildings. Opposite is a small square formed by widening the original Hualou Street; standing in the square, this building with its refined materials and fine craftsmanship appears even more beautiful and imposing. The rectangular plan has a symmetrical layout with both ends projecting forward, at first glance similar to many three-part facade designs. On closer inspection, the capitals, door lintels, railings, and carvings under the windows are exquisitely detailed; the prominent small balconies and pediments are eye-catching, and the ironwork ornament patterns are quite delicate. Entering the building, the interior decoration continues the refined luxury of the exterior: the ground-floor hall is entirely clad in snow-white marble. Although this is a Neoclassical building, its detailed ornament incorporates many Baroque design elements, making the facade both ornate and elegant, full of dynamism. A row of attached shops east of the building originally belonged to the Bank of Shanghai as high-end residences, first named 'Ding'an Li' and later renamed 'Shanghai Village.' It has 27 houses total, 9 of which are four stories facing the street, the rest three stories. Shanghai Village is a典型 shikumen residence, multiple households per building, with shops on the ground floor facing the street; its architectural style is in the same lineage as the Bank of Shanghai, with refined materials and exquisite details. Amid turbulent times, the Hankou branch of the Bank of Shanghai under Zhou Cangbai steadily maintained its reputation and became the most influential bank in the Hankou area. During his tenure as branch manager, he also invested most of his income to build 'Haiguang Nongpu' on the west bank of East Lake, providing Wuhan citizens with a place for leisure and entertainment. At the time, Haiguang Nongpu was a very popular urban park, containing a nursery, a peach grove, a zoo, a swan pond for viewing fish, a rice mill, and an incense workshop; people could exercise, play, and even cultivate flowers, plants, and fruit trees themselves. After the founding of New China, Zhou Cangbai voluntarily donated Haiguang Nongpu to the state, which was then renamed East Lake Park—the predecessor of today's East Lake Scenic Area. To commemorate Zhou Cangbai, the 'Father of East Lake,' people converted his former private garden in the scenic area into Cangbai Garden, with attractions including the 'Haiguang Nongpu' archway and the Zhou Cangbai Memorial Hall, as well as a grove of osmanthus trees personally planted by Mr. Zhou Cangbai, now with canopies like clouds.

projects.name: 璇宫饭店
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 江岸区江汉路江汉一路，江汉路121号
projects.address_en: No.121 Jianghan Road, Jianghan 1st Road, Jiang'an District
projects.type: 商业建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
highlights: 上海联保水火险有限公司投资
projects.content_zh: 在广告林立的江汉路上，江汉一路转角那座大楼顶，红色的'璇宫饭店'四个字并不是很醒目。但在八十年前，这座由广东人集资二百万银元开办的饭店曾以装修考究和设施豪华著称，与当时的德明饭店不相上下。这座大楼由上海联保水火险有限公司投资，景明洋行设计，汉协盛营造厂与正兴隆营造厂施工。原高四层，后来加建了顶层。平面呈'L'形，主入口在转角处向内凹入，由两棵立柱支撑。两翼的布置基本对称，临江汉路的一侧为国货商店，三层以上有阳台的则为饭店房间；另一侧则全部是饭店，有独立入口和旋转门，二层以上每个房间都有阳台。下面四层门窗和墙壁的装饰都比较简洁，到第五层出现了爱奥尼亚式双壁柱，每侧的中部还各有一小段拱券外廊。在转角的顶端有一个三层八角形空心塔楼，逐层收进，显得活泼而精巧。建筑内部的装修也非常考究，底层为桃花石水泥地面，楼层为柚木席纹地板，柚木门窗。楼内有电梯一部，集中供暖。1945年抗日战争胜利后，璇宫饭店见证了国共两党的斗谋斗智，当时由美国代表马歇尔、中共代表周恩来和国民党代表张治中组成的'军事调处'三人小组曾在这里办公。新中国成立后，璇宫饭店被移交武汉市委作为交际处，接待了一大批党和国家领导人、外国元首，以及来访的外国艺术团。
