projects.address: 英山县陶家河乡陶家河村
projects.address_en: Taojiahe Village, Taojiahe Township, Yingshan County
projects.content_zh: 坐落在大别山余脉，牛头山的山脚，由老屋和新屋两个建筑组团构成。据族谱和安氏后人回忆，老屋大致建造于乾隆末年，新屋建造于咸丰年间，两组建筑相距约1公里。安家老屋位于陶家河街北，经历过数代产权变动后，布局已经相当复杂。根据学者的复原，可以看到老屋为三进天井式院落，两侧还有排屋和廊道，通面阔九间，总面积接近2000平方米。建筑为砖木结构，硬山青瓦顶，大门上装饰有牡丹、莲花等花卉浮雕。安家新屋位于严坳村四组，坐北朝南，也是砖木结构、硬山顶，而规模超过老屋，室内共有大小天井34个，建筑的布局也更为复杂。
projects.content_en: Located at the foot of Niutou (Bull Head) Mountain, a branch of the Dabie Mountains, it consists of two building groups: the old house and the new house. According to the genealogy and recollections of An family descendants, the old house was roughly built at the end of Qianlong, and the new house during the Xianfeng period; the two buildings are about 1 kilometer apart. An's Old House is located north of Taojiahe Street; after several generations of property rights changes, its layout has become quite complex. According to scholars' restoration, one can see that the old house is a three-courtyard layout, with row houses and corridors on both sides, with a total width of nine bays and a total area close to 2,000 square meters. The building is brick-wood structure, with a gable gray-tile roof, and the main gate is decorated with floral reliefs such as peonies and lotuses. An's New House is located in Group 4, Yan'ao Village, facing south, also brick-wood structure with a gable roof, but its scale exceeds the old house; there are a total of 34 courtyards (tianjing) of various sizes indoors, and the building layout is more complex.

projects.name: 李氏宅
projects.level: 县级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 英山县雷家店镇李家冲村二组李家坳
projects.address_en: Lijia'ao, Group 2, Lijiachong Village, Leijiadian Town, Yingshan County
projects.content_zh: 始建于清代，坐东南朝西北。室内曾有房屋59间，天井12个，现存仅一进及左右厢房，面阔十一间，进深五间，硬山顶，封火山墙，大门、山墙分别有石雕和彩绘装饰。该建筑现基本无人居住，而曾经的居民同属一个大家族，各个小家庭又相对独立，因而在住宅前的空地上，每家每户又修建了自己的厕所与猪圈。此建筑中原有家谱柜一对和家谱45卷，现已失窃。
projects.content_en: First built in the Qing dynasty, facing northwest from the southeast. The interior once had 59 rooms and 12 courtyards (tianjing); now only one section and left and right wing rooms remain, with a width of eleven bays and depth of five bays, gable roof, fire-sealing gable walls, and the main gate and gable walls have stone carvings and painted decorations respectively. The building is now basically uninhabited; its former residents all belonged to one large family, with each small family relatively independent, so on the open space in front of the residence, each household built its own toilet and pigsty. This building originally had a pair of genealogy cabinets and 45 volumes of genealogy, which have now been stolen.

projects.name: 张氏宗祠
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 英山县孔家坊乡竹坳亭村南泥湾
projects.address_en: Nanliwan, Zhuaoting Village, Kongjiafang Township, Yingshan County
projects.content_zh: 祠堂为一进两路天井式院落，面朝东南，为砖木混合结构，硬山如意山墙。正路面阔三间，进深近17米，大门和厅堂之间左右各设一天井，中间以穿廊连接，形成'工'字形的平面布局。大门二层设戏台，台裙上雕刻人物花鸟形象。侧路作为杂院使用，修建时间应晚于正路。张氏宗祠是鄂东小型祠堂中保存较为完整的实例，为研究鄂东地区的乡土建筑和工艺提供了宝贵的实物资料。
projects.content_en: The ancestral hall is a one-section two-route courtyard layout, facing southeast, of brick-wood composite structure, with a gable ruyi gable wall. The main route is three bays wide and nearly 17 meters deep; between the main gate and the hall, a courtyard is set on each side, connected by a passage in the middle, forming an 'I'-shaped planar layout. The second floor of the main gate has a stage, with the stage skirt carved with figures, flowers, and birds. The side route serves as a utility courtyard, and its construction time should be later than the main route. Zhang's Ancestral Hall is a relatively well-preserved example of small ancestral halls in eastern Hubei, providing valuable physical materials for studying vernacular architecture and craftsmanship in the eastern Hubei region.

projects.name: 万年台戏台
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 浠水县马垅镇福主村
projects.address_en: Fuzhu Village, Malong Town, Xishui County
projects.content_zh: 福主村曾经是长江沿岸的一个重要码头，是鄂、豫、皖三省货物的主要集散地之一。清代的商户多乘船沿长江而来，为祈求神灵保佑，于是入乡随俗，修建福主庙和戏楼；为使生意兴隆，又在每年八月二十三福主寿辰这一天举办庙会，村子也因此得名。有记载的福主庙建于乾隆年间，后于道光九年（1829）重建，但民间也有学者认为，戏台应该早在明中期就具雏形，而且是利用元末明初农民军检阅水军的高台改建而来的。1949年后由于兴修水利，长江改道，昔日繁华的商埠码头退出了历史舞台，庙会的传统却保留了下来，直至今日，每年阴历的八月二十三日，万年台上还会连唱七天大戏，十里八乡的村民都会赶来围观。今天的万年台孤立于福主村外，位于中心小学对面。如果不了解福主村曾经的盛极一时，很难想象在如此偏僻的小村子中，有这样一座异常华美的戏台。戏台分为前后台，平面呈'凸'字形，前台面宽约6米，单檐歇山灰瓦顶，在正中的位置高起一段，形成重檐的视觉效果，这也是戏台装饰常用的手法。前台檐下施如意斗拱，正面额枋浮雕云龙，片片龙鳞清晰可见，侧面雕缠枝花纹和瑞兽图案，后台则雕戏曲人物故事，各处雕饰均施以彩画。后台匾额书'神厘溥庆'，前台书'云管阳春'，取自杜甫《赠花卿》：'锦城丝管日纷纷，半入江风半入云。'清末当地翰林潘绍经还曾为戏台撰写一副对联：'八角装成，宛若君臣父子；一声鼓出，居然儿女夫妻。'妙趣横生，为戏台增色不少。万年台又称为'枫树万年台'，大概是因为戏台前有三棵巨大的古树，其中两棵为枫树，最粗的一棵为古樟，需六人才能合抱。至深秋时间，枫叶红而樟叶碧绿，红绿掩映，交相成辉。而戏台前自然升起的坡地，古树的荫凉，都成为天然的观众席。
projects.content_en: Fuzhu Village was once an important wharf along the Yangtze River, one of the main distribution centers for goods from Hubei, Henan, and Anhui provinces. Merchants in the Qing dynasty mostly came by boat along the Yangtze; to pray for divine protection, they followed local customs and built the Fuzhu Temple and theater tower; to make business prosper, they also held temple fairs on August 23 of the lunar calendar every year, the birthday of Fuzhu, and the village thus got its name. The recorded Fuzhu Temple was built during the Qianlong period and later rebuilt in the 9th year of Daoguang (1829), but some民间 scholars believe that the stage should have taken shape as early as the mid-Ming, and was converted from a high platform used by late-Yuan early-Ming peasant armies to review the navy. After 1949, due to water conservancy construction, the Yangtze River changed course, and the once-prosperous commercial wharf exited the historical stage, but the temple fair tradition has been preserved to this day. Every year on August 23 of the lunar calendar, seven consecutive days of opera are performed on the Wannian Stage, and villagers from miles around come to watch. Today's Wannian Stage stands isolated outside Fuzhu Village, opposite the central primary school. Without understanding the former prosperity of Fuzhu Village, it is hard to imagine such an unusually gorgeous stage in such a remote small village. The stage is divided into front and back stages, with a 'convex'-shaped plan; the front stage is about 6 meters wide, with a single-eave hip-and-gable gray-tile roof, raised in the center to create a double-eave visual effect, a common technique for stage decoration. Under the front eave are ruyi bracket sets; the front architrave has relief carvings of cloud dragons, with every dragon scale clearly visible; the sides are carved with interlocking branch patterns and auspicious animal patterns; the back stage is carved with opera figure stories, and all carvings are painted. The back stage plaque reads 'Shenli Puqing' (Divine Blessing Abundant), and the front stage reads 'Yunguan Yangchun' (Cloud Pipes Spring Sun), taken from Du Fu's 'To Hua Qing': 'The silk and pipes of Jincheng are bustling day by day, half entering the river wind and half entering the clouds.' In the late Qing, local Hanlin Pan Shaojing also wrote a couplet for the stage: 'Eight corners assembled, like lords, ministers, fathers, and sons; one drumbeat sounds, truly like children, daughters, husbands, and wives.' Full of wit and charm, it adds much to the stage. Wannian Stage is also called 'Maple Wannian Stage,' probably because there are three huge ancient trees in front of the stage, two of which are maples, and the thickest one is an ancient camphor requiring six people to embrace. In late autumn, the maple leaves turn red while the camphor leaves remain green, with red and green setting each other off. And the naturally rising slope in front of the stage and the shade of the ancient trees all become natural audience seating.

projects.name: 浠水文庙
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 浠水县新华正街349号
projects.address_en: No.349 Xinhua Zheng Street, Xishui County
projects.content_zh: 浠水文庙始建于北宋，元末遭兵燹，明洪武七年（1374）按照地方儒学的规制重修，正统、弘治、正德、天启等时期陆续扩建整修，具有了一定规模。明崇祯十六年（1643），文庙毁于张献忠之义军，清顺治七年（1650）复建。浠水文庙坐北朝南，占地面积约3000平方米，按轴线对称布局，现存建筑有泮池、棂星门、大成殿、崇圣祠、尊经阁、东西厢房，并存石碑多通。在棂星门和大成殿之间还曾有一道戟门，门内左有忠孝祠、右有节烈祠、乡贤祠，崇圣祠后曾有明伦堂，这些建筑现已不存，但戟门的基址依然可见。棂星门建于明弘治年间（1488-1505），为四柱三间式石牌坊建筑。棂星门前有半圆形的泮池，泮...
projects.content_en: The Xishui Confucian Temple was first built in the Northern Song, destroyed by war at the end of the Yuan, and rebuilt in the 7th year of Hongwu, Ming (1374) according to the regulations of local Confucian schools. It was successively expanded and renovated during the Zhengtong, Hongzhi, Zhengde, and Tianqi periods, reaching a certain scale. In the 16th year of Chongzhen, Ming (1643), the temple was destroyed by Zhang Xianzhong's rebel army, and rebuilt in the 7th year of Shunzhi, Qing (1650). The Xishui Confucian Temple faces south, covering about 3,000 square meters, with an axis-symmetric layout. The surviving buildings include the Pan Pond, Lingxing Gate, Dacheng Hall, Chongsheng Shrine, Zunjing Pavilion, east and west wing rooms, and multiple stone steles. Between the Lingxing Gate and Dacheng Hall there was once a Halberd Gate, with the Loyalty and Filial Piety Shrine on the left and the Chastity and Martyrdom Shrine and Local Worthies Shrine on the right inside; behind the Chongsheng Shrine there was once the Minglun Hall. These buildings no longer exist, but the foundation of the Halberd Gate is still visible. The Lingxing Gate was built during the Hongzhi period of the Ming (1488-1505), a four-column three-bay stone memorial archway building. In front of the Lingxing Gate is a semicircular Pan Pond, ...

projects.name: 斗方寺祖师殿/舍利塔
projects.name_en: Zushi Hall / Sarira Pagoda of Doufang Temple
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 浠水县斗方山
projects.address_en: Doufang Mountain, Xishui County
projects.content_zh: 斗方山在浠水县东五十里，形方如斗，故名为斗方山。据旧志记载，斗方禅寺为后唐同光元年（923）无著禅师始建，北宋更名崇果禅院，因苏轼的友人佛印和尚曾在此讲经传法，也称为'佛印斗方'。斗方禅寺在元代遭兵毁，明洪武年间由僧心节重建。祖师殿为斗方禅寺的主体建筑之一，面阔三间，进深三间，单檐歇山顶，抬梁式构架，全部以石材仿木结构建造，是湖北地区少见的石构建筑。殿前有石质月台，殿内石柱、石梁、石枋均雕刻精美。舍利塔位于斗方禅寺西北不远，建于北宋元丰五年（1082），为一座六角七层仿木结构楼阁式实心石塔，通高5米，造型纤细秀美。底层西面设拱门，两侧有龛，龛内浮雕武士像。第二层西壁嵌'舍利宝塔'石匾，左侧壁阴刻楷书'团陂市朱天觉舍钱造刘良献勾当元丰壬戌三月十二癸巳题'。
projects.content_en: Doufang Mountain is fifty li east of Xishui County, square in shape like a dou (measuring vessel), hence the name Doufang Mountain. According to old records, Doufang Chan Temple was first built by Wuzhao Chan Master in the 1st year of Tongguang, Later Tang (923), renamed Chongguo Chan Monastery in the Northern Song, and because the monk Foyin, a friend of Su Shi, once lectured and taught the Dharma here, it is also called 'Foyin Doufang.' Doufang Chan Temple was destroyed by war in the Yuan and rebuilt by monk Xinjie during the Hongwu period of the Ming. The Zushi (Patriarch) Hall is one of the main buildings of Doufang Chan Temple, three bays wide and three bays deep, with a single-eave hip-and-gable roof and a post-and-lintel frame, all built of stone imitating wood structure, a rare stone building in the Hubei region. In front of the hall is a stone platform; the stone columns, beams, and architraves inside the hall are all exquisitely carved. The Sarira Pagoda is located not far northwest of Doufang Chan Temple, built in the 5th year of Yuanfeng, Northern Song (1082), a hexagonal seven-story imitation-wood multi-eaved solid stone pagoda, with a total height of 5 meters and a slender and graceful shape. An arched door is set on the west side of the base, with niches on both sides containing relief warrior statues. On the west wall of the second story is embedded a stone plaque 'Sarira Precious Pagoda,' and on the left wall is engraved in regular script: 'Tuanpi City Zhu Tianjue donated money to build, Liu Liangxian supervised, 12th day of the 3rd month, Renxu year of Yuanfeng.'

projects.name: 程氏祠堂
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 浠水县绿杨乡查山村程家大湾
projects.address_en: Chengjia Dawan, Chashan Village, Luyang Township, Xishui County
projects.content_zh: 程氏祠堂坐落在查儿山下，坐西朝东，背山面水，由正厅和厢房两部分组成。正厅两进，单檐硬山灰瓦顶，如意山墙。入口背面为戏楼，与正殿之间有连廊相通，连廊左右各有一个天井。正门上有花岗岩石过梁，门楣上有三个石门簪，门前一对石门墩，檐下小龛中彩绘戏曲故事，浮雕和彩绘的装饰效果繁复、华丽。根据正厅梁木上'十五年夏正秋八月之吉裔孙必儿福生光明德及支下裔孙等企建'字样，可知程氏宗祠建于民国十五年，即1926年。据传19世纪至20世纪上半叶，程姓家族在鄂东一带非常兴盛，浠、英、罗、蕲四县共有48座程氏宗祠，而世事变迁，目前只有查儿山脚这座宗祠幸存了下来。
projects.content_en: Cheng's Ancestral Hall is located at the foot of Cha'er Mountain, facing east, backed by mountains and facing water, consisting of two parts: the main hall and wing rooms. The main hall has two sections, with a single-eave gable gray-tile roof and ruyi gable walls. The back of the entrance is a stage, connected to the main hall by a corridor, with a courtyard (tianjing) on each side of the corridor. The main gate has a granite lintel, with three stone door ornaments on the lintel, a pair of stone door piers in front of the gate, and painted opera stories in small niches under the eaves; the decorative effect of relief and painting is elaborate and gorgeous. According to the inscription on the main hall beam: 'On the auspicious day of the 8th month of the 15th year of the Republic, descendants Bi'er, Fusheng, Guangmingde and other descendants jointly built,' it can be known that Cheng's Ancestral Hall was built in the 15th year of the Republic, i.e., 1926. Legend has it that from the 19th to the first half of the 20th century, the Cheng family was very prosperous in eastern Hubei; there were a total of 48 Cheng ancestral halls in the four counties of Xishui, Yingshan, Luotian, and Qichun, but with the changes of the world, currently only this ancestral hall at the foot of Cha'er Mountain has survived.

projects.name: 龙门资教寺
projects.level: 县级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 蕲春县达城乡三角山村叫响尖东500米
projects.address_en: 500 meters east of Jiaoxiangjian, Sanjiaoshan Village, Dacheng Township, Qichun County
projects.content_zh: 从唐朝中晚期开始，三角山逐渐成为一处著名的佛教丛林。五代后梁时期的僧人慈应在三角山创立禅寺，宋仁宗赐额'龙门'，宋高宗加赐'资教'，明洪武元年（1368）由僧人止梁重修。两宋时期的三角山发展到极盛，所辖号称有三十六寺、七十二庵，盛况非同一般，文豪苏轼、欧阳修等人也曾登临三角山。龙门资教寺坐北朝南，原有朝阳阁、龙云阁、大慈阁等建筑，现仅存大慈阁。占地面积为400平方米，合院式布局，有前、后殿和左右偏殿，均为砖木结构的二层楼，单檐硬山灰瓦顶，抬梁式结构，封火山墙，门窗梁枋上雕刻有花草图案。
projects.content_en: From the mid-to-late Tang dynasty, Sanjiao (Triangle) Mountain gradually became a famous Buddhist forest. Monk Ciying of the Later Liang period of the Five Dynasties founded a Chan temple on Sanjiao Mountain; Emperor Renzong of Song bestowed the plaque 'Longmen,' and Emperor Gaozong of Song added 'Zijiao'; in the 1st year of Hongwu, Ming (1368), it was rebuilt by monk Zhiliang. During the Two Song periods, Sanjiao Mountain developed to its peak, with its jurisdiction号称 thirty-six temples and seventy-two nunneries, an extraordinary grandeur; literary giants Su Shi, Ouyang Xiu, and others also climbed Sanjiao Mountain. Longmen Zijiao Temple faces south, originally having buildings such as the Chaoyang Pavilion, Longyun Pavilion, and Daci Pavilion; now only the Daci Pavilion remains. It covers 400 square meters, with a courtyard layout, having front and rear halls and left and right side halls, all two-story brick-wood structures, with single-eave gable gray-tile roofs, post-and-lintel structure, fire-sealing gable walls, and doors, windows, beams, and architraves carved with flower and grass patterns.

projects.name: 金陵书院
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 蕲春县蕲州镇小西门街麒麟山
projects.address_en: Qilin Mountain, Xiaoximen Street, Qizhou Town, Qichun County
projects.content_zh: 清朝乾隆、嘉庆年间，在蕲州经商的南京商人聚资修建了金陵书院，也称为金陵会馆。这里既是商人们交谈商务贸易、娱乐聚会之所，也有读书、会友的功能。清朝末年，又在书院侧面扩建了聚德堂和保婴局。书院现存的建筑建于同治六年（1867），坐东朝西，中路有门厅、天井、正殿，两侧为回廊，北侧为...
projects.content_en: During the Qianlong and Jiaqing periods of the Qing, Nanjing merchants doing business in Qizhou pooled funds to build Jinling Academy, also called Jinling Guild Hall. Here was not only a place for merchants to discuss business trade and entertain and gather, but also had functions for reading and meeting friends. In the late Qing, Jude Hall and Baoying Bureau were also expanded on the side of the academy. The surviving building of the academy was built in the 6th year of Tongzhi (1867), facing west, with an entrance hall, courtyard (tianjing), and main hall on the central route, corridors on both sides, and on the north side...

projects.name: 万年台戏楼
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 蕲春县横车镇长石村
projects.address_en: Changshi Village, Hengche Town, Qichun County
projects.content_zh: 始建于乾隆十年（1745），光绪十年（1884）扩修。平面呈'凸'字形，分前后台。前台为单檐歇山灰瓦顶，前檐两棵八角石柱，台口三面均有石花格心栏杆。台基正面中心镶嵌一长条汉白玉石，雕刻福、禄、寿、寿等神话人物，两侧面也有以神话传说为题材的石雕装饰。后台面阔三间，进深一间，单檐硬山灰瓦顶，两侧山墙开圆形窗，装有石质菱花格心。
projects.content_en: First built in the 10th year of Qianlong (1745), expanded in the 10th year of Guangxu (1884). The plan is 'convex'-shaped, divided into front and back stages. The front stage has a single-eave hip-and-gable gray-tile roof, with two octagonal stone columns at the front eave, and stone lattice railings on all three sides of the stage opening. In the center of the front of the platform base is inlaid a long strip of white marble, carved with mythological figures such as Fortune, Prosperity, and Longevity; the sides also have stone carvings with mythological legends as themes. The back stage is three bays wide and one bay deep, with a single-eave gable gray-tile roof, and circular windows on both gable walls, fitted with stone linghua lattice.

projects.name: 仙人台庙
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 蕲春县大同镇仙人台顶峰
projects.address_en: Peak of Xianrentai, Datong Town, Qichun County
projects.content_zh: 仙人台初名'仙人庐'，《蕲州志》记载：'仙人台，在州北二百一十里，以名魁山、旋螺山，有九十九峰，高若列屏，横亘州北，陡其巅，可极目千里。'相传早在西晋永熙年间便有人在山上结庐修炼，唐时因道教受到皇室尊崇，仙人台殿宇林立，道侣云集，一时成为鄂东南影响最大的道教中心。五代时期，后晋国主石重贵不愿像其父石敬瑭一样对辽国称儿臣，引起契丹人的不满，大举挥兵进犯。石重贵派部将刘五、刘六领兵抗击，由于兵力悬殊而大败，后晋随之易主。刘五、刘六看破红尘，先奔武当山后赴仙人台，并在此苦修，终成正果。仙人台庙建在一处突出的巨石之上，三面都是悬崖峭壁。建筑本身是一座石殿，墙柱、梁枋、椽瓦，无一不是以石材仿木结构制成。建于清康熙四十年（1701），乾隆四十八年（1783）重修，面阔三间16米，进深三间6.43米，坐北朝南，正面为四柱牌坊。门额正中阳刻楷书'恩佑四民'，左右两侧为'文钦''武仰'。门框上还有一副阴刻对联：'眼光俯视大千界，心地高悬第一峰。'庙内有四根巨大的石质金柱，莲花柱础落地，大厅周围更有数百个姿态各异的小型浮雕佛像，并以仙鹤莲花卷草纹、如意纹及'万'字纹等图案装饰各处。仙人台庙前后左右无任何遮挡，只有近年在南侧又修建了一座小亭子。山风四季呼啸不绝，而庙内石供桌上的油灯火苗不徐不疾，十分平静。经考证，仙人台庙的大门在坐北朝南的基础上向东斜置了15°，因此山风得以不扰。这种精准的设置体现了风水理论中对自然规律的掌握和科学的运用，也是古代匠人智慧的体现。
projects.content_en: Xianrentai was originally called 'Xianren Lu' (Immortal's Hut); the 'Qizhou Annals' record: 'Xianrentai, 210 li north of the prefecture, with famous Kuishan and Xuanluo mountains, has ninety-nine peaks, high like a screen, stretching across the north of the prefecture, steep at its summit, with a view of a thousand li.' Legend has it that as early as the Yongxi period of the Western Jin, people built huts and cultivated on the mountain; in the Tang, because Taoism was revered by the imperial family, Xianrentai had many halls and gathered Taoist companions, becoming the most influential Taoist center in southeastern Hubei for a time. During the Five Dynasties period, Shi Chonggui, the lord of Later Jin, was unwilling to call himself a vassal to the Liao like his father Shi Jingtang, causing dissatisfaction among the Khitan, who launched a large invasion. Shi Chonggui sent generals Liu Wu and Liu Liu to lead troops to resist, but due to the disparity in forces they were defeated, and Later Jin changed hands. Liu Wu and Liu Liu, seeing through the vanity of the world, first went to Wudang Mountain then to Xianrentai, where they practiced asceticism and finally attained enlightenment. Xianrentai Shrine is built on a protruding giant rock, with cliffs on three sides. The building itself is a stone hall; walls, columns, beams, rafters, and tiles are all made of stone imitating wood structure. Built in the 40th year of Kangxi, Qing (1701), rebuilt in the 48th year of Qianlong (1783), three bays wide (16 meters) and three bays deep (6.43 meters), facing south, with a four-column memorial archway on the front. In the center of the lintel is carved in regular script 'En You Si Min' (Grace Protecting the Four Peoples), with 'Wen Qin' (Literary Reverence) and 'Wu Yang' (Martial Admiration) on the left and right. There is also an incised couplet on the door frame: 'Eyes look down upon the great chiliocosm, heart hangs high the first peak.' Inside the shrine are four huge stone gold columns, with lotus column bases on the ground; around the hall are hundreds of small relief Buddha statues in various postures, decorated with patterns such as crane lotus scrolling grass, ruyi, and 'wan' character patterns. Xianrentai Shrine has no obstruction in front, back, left, or right; only in recent years a small pavilion was built on the south side. The mountain wind howls endlessly in all four seasons, while the oil lamp flame on the stone altar inside the shrine is steady and calm. According to research, the main gate of Xianrentai Shrine is tilted 15° east on the basis of facing south, so the mountain wind does not disturb it. This precise setting reflects the mastery and scientific application of natural laws in feng shui theory, and is also a manifestation of ancient craftsmen's wisdom.

projects.name: 四祖寺
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 黄梅县大河镇四祖寺村
projects.address_en: Sizusi Village, Dahe Town, Huangmei County
projects.content_zh: 中国的禅宗，从初祖达摩到三祖僧粲，弘法传承的方式皆为'一僧一庵，一衣一钵，随缘而往，不恒其所'。而从四祖道信开始，禅宗聚居传法，僧徒不再化缘为生，而是集中生活，自行劳动，把搬柴运水都当作佛事。这种生活方式上的变化在禅宗的发展史上具有重要的意义，以禅宗为代表，佛教在中国的本土化走上了新的历程，而四祖寺也被尊为'第一座禅宗祖庭'。四祖寺位于黄梅县城西15公里的双峰山上，原名正觉寺，又名双峰寺，由四祖道信大师开创于唐武德七年（624）。唐宋年间，寺院一度达到鼎盛，有殿堂楼阁八百多间，僧侣千余人，曾被宋真宗赐为'天下祖庭'，宋神宗赐为'天下名山'。明正德十四年（1519）遭火灾，清咸丰四年（1845）毁于兵燹，光绪间复修，后又毁，仅存三间祖殿与古柏数株。现存重要的历史建筑有毗卢塔、众生塔、衣钵塔、灵润桥、明月桥等，又有授法洞、卓锡泉、洗笔池、钓鱼台、碧玉流等遗迹。其中三座佛塔年代久远，形制各异，具有较高的文物和艺术价值。
projects.content_en: Chinese Chan Buddhism, from the First Patriarch Bodhidharma to the Third Patriarch Sengcan, the way of spreading the Dharma was all 'one monk one hut, one robe one bowl, going according to conditions, not staying in one place.' But from the Fourth Patriarch Daoxin onward, Chan Buddhism gathered to transmit the Dharma, and monks no longer lived by alms but lived collectively and worked themselves, treating carrying firewood and fetching water as Buddhist affairs. This change in lifestyle had important significance in the development history of Chan Buddhism; represented by Chan, the localization of Buddhism in China embarked on a new journey, and Sizu Temple is also revered as the 'First Patriarchal Temple of Chan Buddhism.' Sizu Temple is located on Shuangfeng (Twin Peak) Mountain, 15 kilometers west of Huangmei County town, originally named Zhengjue Temple, also called Shuangfeng Temple, founded by the Fourth Patriarch Master Daoxin in the 7th year of Wude, Tang (624). During the Tang and Song dynasties, the temple once reached its peak, with over 800 halls and pavilions and more than a thousand monks; it was bestowed 'Patriarchal Temple Under Heaven' by Emperor Zhenzong of Song and 'Famous Mountain Under Heaven' by Emperor Shenzong of Song. It suffered a fire in the 14th year of Zhengde, Ming (1519), was destroyed by war in the 4th year of Xianfeng, Qing (1845), rebuilt during Guangxu, then destroyed again, leaving only three patriarch halls and several ancient cypresses. The existing important historical buildings include the Pilu Pagoda, Zhongsheng Pagoda, Yibo Pagoda, Lingrun Bridge, Mingyue Bridge, etc., as well as relics such as the Shoufa Cave, Zhuoxi Spring, Xibi Pool, Diaoyutai, and Biyu Flow. Among them, the three Buddhist pagodas are of ancient date with different forms, having high cultural relic and artistic value.

projects.name: 五祖寺
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.dynasty_en: Song, Ming, Qing, and Republican periods
projects.address: 黄梅县五祖镇北2.5公里
projects.address_en: 2.5 km north of Wuzu Town, Huangmei County
projects.content_zh: 五祖寺又名东山寺，位于黄梅县城东12公里的东山，由禅宗的五祖弘忍大师于唐咸亨年间（670-674）创建，是弘忍修行、说法和圆寂之地，也是六祖慧能大师传承衣钵之所。初建成时名为法雨寺，唐宣宗大中二年（848）改名为大中东山寺，北宋景德年间又改赐寺额为真慧禅寺，元代改为东山五祖寺，并一直沿用至今。五祖寺在唐宋时一直是一处香火兴旺的大寺，唐代诗人裴度形容其盛况为'上界弗知何处去，西天移向此间来'。到宋真宗年间更是达到鼎盛，有殿堂楼阁千余间，僧侣一千三百多人，其中包括百余名高僧，北宋御赐'天下祖庭'和'天下禅林'，苏轼、欧阳修都曾慕名游览并留下诗篇。明代万历年间重建，清咸丰四年（1854）毁于兵燹后又重修，现存的建筑多为这两次重修时所建。禅宗是汉传佛教最重要的流派，它糅合了佛教的经典与中国本土的哲学，在唐代得到了极大的发展。弘忍继承了四祖道信开创的'农禅并重'的生活方式，修行的经典不断增加，又择山林清幽处为居，以远离嚣尘，静心修行，这种对寺院选址的要求在中国佛教史上也有深远的影响。五祖弘忍的门徒数以万计，但可以传道的弟子不过十人左右，其中最突出、影响最大的又属高僧神秀和六祖慧能二人。后来慧能在南方讲经，神秀在北方，两人的禅法不尽相同，并称为'南顿北渐'。此后北禅逐渐衰微，南禅则发展出临济、曹洞、沩仰、云门和法眼五家，临济宗又分为黄龙、杨岐二派，并称为禅宗的'五家七宗'。禅宗流派如此丰富，皆源于五祖弘忍，足见五祖寺在佛教史上的重要地位。五祖寺最著名的故事是弘忍传衣钵与六祖慧能的经过。一日弘忍召集门人，要大家各作一偈，并表示将会将衣法传授给真正会悟大意的弟子。弘忍的上首弟子神秀在门前写了一偈：'身是菩提树，心如明镜台。时时勤拂拭，莫使有尘埃。'弘忍看到后召神秀到身边，说这首偈并非彻悟，命他再做一首，而神秀苦思数日都未有结果。当时慧能拜入五祖门下不到一年，在碓房踏碓春米，也不识字，他请人读神秀的偈语，又让人把自己的偈语题写在墙上：'菩提本无树，明镜亦非台，本来无一物，何处惹尘埃。'弘忍看到后，不动声色，却在夜里三更秘密召慧能入室，为其说法，并传授衣钵，又嘱咐慧能务必连夜南行，以免被人加害。慧能到岭南后，潜行一十六年，待弘忍入灭，衣钵之争渐息，才再次公开传法。今天的五祖寺位于东山山腰，依山而建，亭阁楼台、殿宇僧舍掩映于绿树翠竹之中，重门深通，曲径相连，深得'曲径通幽处，禅房花木深'的意趣。寺内现存'大满天下祖庭五祖真身印'汉白玉印一枚和六祖坠腰石一块，上刻有'龙塑元年，六祖坠腰石'字样，据说六祖春米时束此石于腰间以增加重量。中轴线上主要的建筑有山门、天王殿、大雄宝殿、毗卢殿、真身殿，真身殿西侧有通天门、通天路，可至大满禅师石塔，并通往东山主峰白莲峰顶。山门之外又有东西塔林，还保存着十余座宋代以来的石质佛塔。
projects.content_en: Wuzu Temple, also called Dongshan (Eastern Mountain) Temple, is located on Dongshan Mountain, 12 kilometers east of Huangmei County town. It was founded by the Fifth Patriarch of Chan Buddhism, Master Hongren, during the Xianheng period of the Tang (670-674), and is the place where Hongren practiced, taught, and attained parinirvana, as well as where the Sixth Patriarch Master Huineng inherited the robe and bowl. When first built it was named Fayu Temple; in the 2nd year of Dazhong, Tang Xuanzong (848), it was renamed Dadong Dongshan Temple; during the Jingde period of the Northern Song, the temple plaque was changed to Zhenhui Chan Temple; in the Yuan it was changed to Dongshan Wuzu Temple, and this name has been used ever since. Wuzu Temple was always a thriving temple with prosperous incense during the Tang and Song; Tang poet Pei Du described its grandeur as 'The upper realm knows not where to go, the Western Heaven has moved here.' It reached its peak during the reign of Emperor Zhenzong of Song, with over a thousand halls and pavilions and more than 1,300 monks, including over a hundred eminent monks; the Northern Song bestowed 'Patriarchal Temple Under Heaven' and 'Chan Forest Under Heaven,' and Su Shi and Ouyang Xiu both visited out of admiration and left poems. It was rebuilt during the Wanli period of the Ming, destroyed by war in the 4th year of Xianfeng, Qing (1854), then rebuilt again; the existing buildings are mostly from these two reconstructions. Chan Buddhism is the most important school of Han Chinese Buddhism, blending Buddhist classics with Chinese native philosophy, and developed greatly in the Tang. Hongren inherited the lifestyle of 'equal emphasis on farming and Chan' pioneered by the Fourth Patriarch Daoxin; the classics for practice不断 increased, and he chose secluded and clear mountain forests as residences, away from noise and dust, for quiet practice. This requirement for temple site selection has had a profound influence in the history of Chinese Buddhism. The Fifth Patriarch Hongren had tens of thousands of disciples, but no more than about ten could transmit the Dharma; among them, the most prominent and influential were the eminent monk Shenxiu and the Sixth Patriarch Huineng. Later Huineng taught in the south and Shenxiu in the north; their Chan methods were not entirely the same, known as 'Southern Sudden and Northern Gradual.' Thereafter Northern Chan gradually declined, while Southern Chan developed into five houses: Linji, Caodong, Weiyang, Yunmen, and Fayan; the Linji school further divided into Huanglong and Yangqi factions, collectively called the 'Five Houses and Seven Schools' of Chan. Such a rich variety of Chan schools all originated from the Fifth Patriarch Hongren, which shows the important position of Wuzu Temple in Buddhist history. The most famous story of Wuzu Temple is Hongren's transmission of the robe and bowl to the Sixth Patriarch Huineng. One day Hongren gathered his disciples, asking each to write a verse, saying he would transmit the robe and Dharma to the disciple who truly understood the great meaning. Hongren's chief disciple Shenxiu wrote a verse in front of the door: 'The body is the bodhi tree, the mind is like a clear mirror stand. Always diligently wipe it, so that no dust may collect.' After seeing it, Hongren summoned Shenxiu, saying this verse was not complete enlightenment, and ordered him to write another; but Shenxiu thought hard for several days without result. At that time Huineng had been under the Fifth Patriarch for less than a year, treading the pestle and hulling rice in the mortar room, and was illiterate; he asked someone to read Shenxiu's verse, then had someone write his own verse on the wall: 'Bodhi originally has no tree, the clear mirror is not a stand. Originally there is not a single thing, where can dust collect?' After seeing it, Hongren remained calm, but secretly summoned Huineng at the third watch of the night, taught him the Dharma, and transmitted the robe and bowl, also urging Huineng to travel south overnight to avoid being harmed. After arriving in Lingnan, Huineng lived in seclusion for sixteen years; after Hongren's parinirvana and the subsiding of the robe dispute, he again publicly transmitted the Dharma. Today's Wuzu Temple is located on the mountainside of Dongshan, built along the mountain, with pavilions, towers, halls, and monk quarters hidden among green trees and bamboo, with deep gates and winding paths connected, deeply capturing the charm of 'Winding paths lead to secluded places, Chan rooms amid flowers and trees.' The temple now preserves a white jade seal 'Great Full Patriarchal Temple Under Heaven Fifth Patriarch True Body Seal' and a piece of the Sixth Patriarch's waist-weight stone, inscribed with 'Dragon Su year, Sixth Patriarch waist-weight stone'; it is said that when the Sixth Patriarch hulled rice, he tied this stone around his waist to add weight. The main buildings on the central axis include the mountain gate, Heavenly King Hall, Mahavira Hall, Vairocana Hall, and True Body Hall; west of the True Body Hall are the Tongtian Gate and Tongtian Road, leading to the Great Full Chan Master Stone Pagoda and to the White Lotus Peak at the main peak of Dongshan. Outside the mountain gate are east and west pagoda forests, preserving more than ten stone Buddhist pagodas from the Song dynasty onward.

projects.name: 五祖寺殿堂
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 黄梅县五祖镇北2.5公里五祖寺内
projects.address_en: Inside Wuzu Temple, 2.5 km north of Wuzu Town, Huangmei County
projects.content_zh: 五祖寺中，山门、大雄宝殿等建筑多为近年重建，现存重要的历史建筑是大雄宝殿之后并列的圣母殿、毗卢殿和观音殿，以及这三座殿堂之后的真身殿。毗卢殿由麻城的信众募捐修建，又名麻城殿，是一座砖木结构硬山建筑，面阔三间。正面为牌楼式，门额篆书'西来卯叶'，或作'西来四叶'，读法不一，为明人彭好古所题；下书'万历卅三年乙巳岁季秋月麻城县建'。毗卢殿左为观音殿，右为圣母殿，这两座殿大规模体量与毗卢殿相当，也是三开间，黄色墙面上点缀蓝色斗拱，但装饰略朴素一些。三座大殿一字排开，具有浑然一体的效果。毗卢殿之后为供奉五祖弘忍真身的真身殿。由于时代动乱，真身现已不存，以弘忍的塑像替代。真身殿面阔三间，进深一间，外观为木结构，明间后退为牌楼式，门上挂有'真身殿'匾额，额枋透雕二龙戏珠，屋顶上有九龙盖顶，两侧均用雕花砖砌。正殿后部正中为法雨塔，五祖真身原藏于此。塔壁四周上层有数以百计的石刻小佛像，故也称千佛殿。
projects.content_en: In Wuzu Temple, buildings such as the mountain gate and Mahavira Hall are mostly recent reconstructions; the existing important historical buildings are the并列 Virgin Mary Hall, Vairocana Hall, and Guanyin Hall behind the Mahavira Hall, as well as the True Body Hall behind these three halls. The Vairocana Hall was built with donations from believers in Macheng, also called Macheng Hall, a brick-wood structure gable building, three bays wide. The front is a memorial-arch style, with the lintel in seal script 'Xi Lai Mao Ye,' or 'Xi Lai Si Ye,' with different readings, inscribed by Ming person Peng Haogu; below it reads 'Built by Macheng County, the last autumn month of the Yisi year, the 33rd year of Wanli.' To the left of the Vairocana Hall is the Guanyin Hall, and to the right is the Virgin Mary Hall; these two halls are comparable in scale to the Vairocana Hall, also three bays, with yellow walls dotted with blue bracket sets, but slightly simpler in decoration. The three great halls are arranged in a row, with an integrated effect. Behind the Vairocana Hall is the True Body Hall enshrining the true body of the Fifth Patriarch Hongren. Due to historical turmoil, the true body no longer exists, replaced by a statue of Hongren. The True Body Hall is three bays wide and one bay deep, with a wooden structure exterior; the central bay recedes into a memorial-arch style, with a 'True Body Hall' plaque hanging on the door, the architrave openwork-carved with two dragons playing with a pearl, the roof has nine dragons covering the top, and both sides are built with carved bricks. In the center of the rear of the main hall is the Fayu (Dharma Rain) Pagoda, where the Fifth Patriarch's true body was originally stored. On the upper layer around the pagoda walls are hundreds of small stone-carved Buddha statues, hence also called the Thousand Buddha Hall.

projects.name: 五祖寺佛塔
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 黄梅县五祖镇北2.5公里五祖寺内
projects.address_en: Inside Wuzu Temple, 2.5 km north of Wuzu Town, Huangmei County
projects.content_zh: 从真身殿右侧的通天路拾级而上，可以来到大满禅师石塔，相传五祖弘忍佛骨埋于其下。这是一座明代的覆钵式石塔，立于须弥座之上，塔身刻'大满宝塔'四字。沿路上有讲经台、授法洞，分别是弘忍讲经说法之处和弘忍向慧能传授衣钵之地。至峰顶有白莲池，为弘忍手植白莲之处，'东山白莲'自古便是黄梅十景之一。山门之外有另一座清代的覆钵式石塔，名为乞儿塔，或求儿塔，形制与大满禅师塔非常相似，但规模要稍小一些。此外，步行上山的道路两侧有东西塔林，其中有多座宋及以后的石塔，重要的有释迦多宝如来石塔、十方佛塔等。
projects.content_en: Climbing up the Tongtian (Sky-Reaching) Road on the right side of the True Body Hall, one can reach the Great Full Chan Master Stone Pagoda; legend has it that the Buddhist relics of the Fifth Patriarch Hongren are buried beneath it. This is a Ming dynasty stupa-style stone pagoda, standing on a Sumeru pedestal, with the pagoda body inscribed with the four characters 'Great Full Precious Pagoda.' Along the road are the Sutra-Preaching Platform and Dharma-Transmission Cave, respectively the places where Hongren preached the sutras and transmitted the robe and bowl to Huineng. At the peak is the White Lotus Pool, where Hongren planted white lotuses with his own hands; 'Dongshan White Lotus' has been one of the Ten Scenes of Huangmei since ancient times. Outside the mountain gate is another Qing dynasty stupa-style stone pagoda called the Beggar Pagoda, or Child-Seeking Pagoda, very similar in form to the Great Full Chan Master Pagoda but slightly smaller in scale. In addition, on both sides of the walking path up the mountain are east and west pagoda forests, with multiple stone pagodas from the Song and later periods; the important ones include the Shakyamuni Prabhutaratna Tathagata Stone Pagoda and the Ten Directions Buddha Pagoda.

projects.name: 牌楼湾民居
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 黄梅县杉木乡安乐村牌楼湾
projects.address_en: Pailouwan, Anle Village, Shanmu Township, Huangmei County
projects.content_zh: 牌楼湾古称鹳鸟湾，东晋陶渊明后裔在南宋咸淳年间定居于此。明代正统年间，由于民风淳朴，御赐'金字坊'牌匾，于是修建木牌楼，并嵌金匾于其上，一时声名鹊起，村名亦更为牌楼湾。清代乾隆年间，当地望族桂氏买下陶氏家产并进行扩建，现存的三栋建筑便是当时修建的。牌楼湾古民居建筑群现存三栋古民居，建筑之间以小巷、天井相连。中间的一栋规模最大，保存也较为完好，前后共有三进，梁柱门窗做工较为考究，屋檐下及隔墙上以素色线条绘动物、花卉、文房四宝等图案，可以窥见桂氏家族当年之兴盛。值得一提的是，第一进二层有一个略微外凸的低矮阁楼，虽然现在用来堆放杂草和农具，但在当年则是桂氏合族的家庭戏楼。这座小戏楼没有后台，有两侧台，并饰有垂花柱，下部供人通行。宅院第二进的正厅全部开放，是观戏的场地；后厅也开敞，但视线则不如前厅好。乾隆年间，逢节日、农闲或是红白喜事，桂氏都会邀请黄梅戏艺人到村中演出。戏台不大，印证了当时的黄梅戏还是一种只有两三个人表演的山歌小戏。
projects.content_en: Pailouwan was anciently called Guanniao (Stork) Bay; descendants of Tao Yuanming of the Eastern Jin settled here during the Xianchun period of the Southern Song. During the Zhengtong period of the Ming, due to the simple and honest folk customs, the emperor bestowed a 'Gold Character Workshop' plaque, so a wooden memorial archway was built with the gold plaque embedded on it, suddenly becoming famous, and the village name was also changed to Pailouwan (Archway Bay). During the Qianlong period of the Qing, the local prominent Gui family bought the Tao family property and expanded it; the three existing buildings were built at that time. The Pailouwan ancient vernacular building complex now preserves three ancient dwellings, connected by alleys and courtyards (tianjing). The middle one is the largest in scale and relatively well preserved, with a total of three front-to-back sections; the beams, columns, doors, and windows are exquisitely crafted, and under the eaves and on partition walls, plain-colored lines depict animals, flowers, and the four treasures of the study, allowing a glimpse of the prosperity of the Gui family in those years. It is worth mentioning that on the second floor of the first section there is a slightly protruding low attic; although now used to pile weeds and farm tools, in those years it was the family theater of the Gui clan. This small stage has no backstage, has side platforms, and is decorated with pendant columns, with the lower part for passage. The main hall of the second section of the residence is fully open, serving as the venue for watching opera; the rear hall is also open, but the view is not as good as the front hall. During the Qianlong period, on festivals, slack farming seasons, or weddings and funerals, the Gui family would invite Huangmei opera artists to perform in the village. The stage is not large, confirming that at that time Huangmei opera was still a kind of mountain-song small opera performed by only two or three people.

projects.name: 高塔寺塔
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 黄梅县古塔东路环城东路口
projects.address_en: Intersection of Guta East Road and Huancheng East Road, Huangmei County
projects.content_zh: 高塔寺塔位于黄梅县旧城关东南隅，当地人称为乱石塔，是一座八角十三层的楼阁式砖塔，建于北宋年间，清乾隆年间曾有修葺。除第一层叠涩中空，其他各层均为实心砖造。二层以上每面都以砖拱券做出小佛龛，又仿制出枋、柱、斗拱及破子棱窗，斗拱形制舒朗大方，颇有古风。塔身三层还以方砖镶嵌，上刻'雨顺风调''民安物泰'等字，每面各不相同。塔身收分明显，整体轮廓显得高耸尖矗。由于塔身一度年久失修，20世纪80年代时曾对其进行勘察、维修，发现各层塔心处均埋有石罐，石罐内外散放大量钱币，内又有一银罐，平底、腹鼓、高颈、荷叶盖，罐内放有佛舍利，以金银箔包裹，还有金弹簧，水晶球，铜饰件等。同时出土的还有一块方砖塔铭，铭文：'建塔施主唐守忠、守清、守贞、守珪、守羽谨自大中祥符八年乙卯岁润六月十五日癸巳，安葬砖塔第一层舍利，不住砌二，层层安葬，至天禧元年丁巳岁四月十八日丙戌，安葬十三层舍利初毕，故书示记。院主仁禀。'明确说明了塔为唐姓宗族合资兴建，从北宋大中祥符八年（1015）至天禧元年（1017），历时三年时间建成。
projects.content_en: The Pagoda of Gaota Temple is located at the southeast corner of the old county seat of Huangmei, locally called the Luanshi (Random Stone) Pagoda. It is an octagonal thirteen-story multi-eaved brick pagoda, built during the Northern Song, and was repaired during the Qianlong period of the Qing. Except for the first story which is corbelled and hollow, all other stories are solid brick construction. Above the second story, each face has small Buddhist niches made with brick arches, and imitates architraves, columns, bracket sets, and broken-lattice windows; the bracket set form is spacious and generous, quite ancient in style. The third story of the pagoda body is also inlaid with square bricks, inscribed with characters such as 'Rain and wind favorable' and 'People peaceful and things prosperous,' different on each face. The pagoda body has明显 tapering, with the overall轮廓 appearing tall and sharp. Due to the pagoda body once being long-neglected, in the 1980s it was surveyed and repaired, and stone jars were found buried at the center of each story; inside and outside the stone jars were scattered large amounts of coins, and inside there was another silver jar with flat bottom, bulging belly, high neck, and lotus-leaf lid; inside the jar were Buddhist relics wrapped in gold and silver foil, as well as gold springs, crystal balls, bronze ornaments, etc. Also unearthed was a square brick pagoda inscription: 'Pagoda builders Tang Shouzhong, Shouqing, Shouzhen, Shougui, Shouyu respectfully, on the 15th day of the leap 6th month, Yimao year, the 8th year of Dazhong Xiangfu (1015), interred the relics of the first story of the brick pagoda, not stopping at two layers, interring layer by layer, until the 18th day of the 4th month, Dingsi year, the 1st year of Tianxi (1017), the interment of the thirteen-story relics was first completed, hence written for record. Abbot Renbing.' This clearly states that the pagoda was jointly built by the Tang clan, from the 8th year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Northern Song (1015) to the 1st year of Tianxi (1017), taking three years to complete.

projects.name: 郑公塔
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 武穴市郑公镇老街东100米
projects.address_en: 100 meters east of Old Street, Zhenggong Town, Wuxue City
projects.content_zh: 又名赭山塔，始建于五代时期的后晋天福年间（936-944），元大德十一年（1307）和明成化三年（1467）分别重建，是一座明代早期的仿木结构砖塔，并保留了很多宋代晚期以来的造型特点。塔高约19米，为八角七层楼阁式，层层内收，整体轮廓挺拔坚实。塔身不完全垂直于地面，而是有近20度的夹角，斜而不倾，令人称奇。塔内空心，原分四层，有木质楼板、楼梯，现已不存。塔身每层均有佛龛及浮雕图案，并设门窗。每层出檐，以砖仿制出简单的斗拱和檩枋、椽子，顶层檐下斗拱则出跳。塔刹以铜铸成三级葫芦串，用铁链与八角分别相连，每角下坠铜铃。首层塔身上镶嵌数块铭文砖，分别嵌刻'大德十一年禅寺居''佛法僧观音宝塔''大明成化三年太岁丁亥十月吉日子继寿重修'等字样。郑公塔坐落在太白湖滨，背倚青山，前拥湖水，湖光山色非常优美。《广济县志》说：'因郑公者不知其名，宦居兹地土，舍地建塔，名椿山塔，俗呼郑公塔，不忘所自也。'县志中又有诗赞曰：'一塔犹今古，孤危耐雨风；湖山环锁外，烟月影笼中。'
projects.content_en: Also called Zheshan Pagoda, it was first built during the Tianfu period of the Later Jin in the Five Dynasties (936-944), and rebuilt separately in the 11th year of Dade, Yuan (1307) and the 3rd year of Chenghua, Ming (1467). It is an early-Ming imitation-wood brick pagoda, retaining many造型 characteristics from the late Song onward. The pagoda is about 19 meters high, an octagonal seven-story multi-eaved style, tapering inward story by story, with an overall轮廓 that is tall and solid. The pagoda body is not completely perpendicular to the ground, but has an angle of nearly 20 degrees, leaning but not toppling, amazing to behold. The pagoda interior is hollow, originally divided into four stories with wooden floors and stairs, which no longer exist. Each story of the pagoda body has Buddhist niches and relief patterns, with doors and windows. Each story's eaves are made with bricks imitating simple bracket sets, purlins, architraves, and rafters, while the bracket sets under the top story eave project outward. The pagoda finial is cast in bronze as a three-tier gourd string, connected to the eight corners with iron chains, with bronze bells hanging from each corner. The first story of the pagoda body is inlaid with several inscribed bricks, respectively engraved with '11th year of Dade, Chan Temple residence,' 'Buddha Dharma Sangha Guanyin Precious Pagoda,' '3rd year of Chenghua, Great Ming, Dinghai year, auspicious day of the 10th month, descendant Jishou rebuilt,' etc. Zhenggong Pagoda is located by the shore of Taibai Lake, backed by green mountains and fronted by lake water, with very beautiful lake and mountain scenery. The 'Guangji County Annals' say: 'Because Lord Zheng, whose name is unknown, served as an official here, donated land to build the pagoda, named Chunshan Pagoda, commonly called Zhenggong Pagoda, not forgetting its origin.' The county annals also have a poem praising it: 'One pagoda still spans ancient and modern, alone and precarious enduring rain and wind; lakes and mountains encircle outside, mist and moon shadows cage within.'

projects.name: 沈鸿宾故居
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市咸安区浮山办事处太乙村
projects.address_en: Taiyi Village, Fushan Office, Xian'an District, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 故居位于太乙村石乌山下，由清代名臣沈鸿宾于同治年间亲自主持修建。沈鸿宾生于道光二十年（1887），整个建筑面积约1400平方米，一进三重合院式布局，中轴对称，共有房屋63间，天井6个。外墙青砖到檐，青瓦布顶，设防火墙。'回'字形石板天井的两侧厢房，木雕做工考究。其中，木楼为雕花护栏，与两侧厢房连接，廊道相通。堂屋正中的第一层门楣上，有一由光绪帝亲笔题书'将军第'三字匾额，因此俗称'将军第'。第二重大门前檐有一块大理石凿成的同治帝亲笔提书的'皇恩旌裱'大匾。
projects.content_en: The former residence is located at the foot of Shiwu Mountain, Taiyi Village, built under the personal supervision of Qing dynasty famous official Shen Hongbin during the Tongzhi period. Shen Hongbin was born in the 20th year of Daoguang (1887); the entire building covers about 1,400 square meters, with a one-entry three-section courtyard layout, central axis symmetry, a total of 63 rooms and 6 courtyards (tianjing). The exterior walls are gray brick to the eaves, with gray tile roofs and fire walls. On both sides of the '回'-shaped stone slab courtyard are wing rooms with exquisite wood carvings. Among them, the wooden building has carved railings, connected to the wing rooms on both sides, with corridors communicating. On the first floor lintel in the center of the main hall is a plaque with the three characters 'Jiangjun Di' (General's Residence) personally inscribed by Emperor Guangxu, hence commonly called 'General's Residence.' On the front eave of the second main gate is a large marble plaque with 'Imperial Grace Commendation' personally inscribed by Emperor Tongzhi.

projects.name: 钱亦石故居
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市咸安区马桥镇钱庄村
projects.address_en: Qianzhuang Village, Maqiao Town, Xian'an District, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 钱亦石（1889-1938），字介磐，湖北咸宁人，中国共产党早期理论家。其故居为独立的一进两重连五'四合一'的二层老式砖木结构楼房，建于清光绪十五年（1899），占地741平方米，楼枋下背青砖，上泥砖。共有8间房、4个堂屋和3个天井，以大天井为房子的中心，两边依次建有1个小天井、1个小天井，大小天井四周、底部和墙的地下部分皆青石墁铺。大门框及门两边的窗户均为青石板雕琢。与其堂弟惕元共有，其中钱亦石烈士3间，占地180平方米。
projects.content_en: Qian Yishi (1889-1938), courtesy name Jiepan, a native of Xianning, Hubei, was an early theorist of the Communist Party of China. His former residence is an independent one-entry two-section connected-five 'four-in-one' two-story old-style brick-wood structure building, built in the 15th year of Guangxu, Qing (1899), covering 741 square meters; below the building beams are backed with gray bricks and above with mud bricks. There are a total of 8 rooms, 4 main halls, and 3 courtyards (tianjing), with the large courtyard as the center of the house, and on both sides依次 built 1 small courtyard and 1 small courtyard; around, at the bottom, and in the underground part of the walls of the large and small courtyards are all paved with bluestone. The main door frame and the windows on both sides of the door are all carved from bluestone slabs. It is shared with his cousin Qian Tiyuan, of which martyr Qian Yishi has 3 rooms, covering 180 square meters.

projects.name: 刘家桥民居
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市桂花镇刘家桥村
projects.address_en: Liujiaqiao Village, Guihua Town, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 坐落于咸宁市桂花镇的刘家桥古民居，始建于明崇祯三年（1630），村落建筑总面积为3.5万平方米，共有大小房屋740间，楼道38条，天井54个，通过一座廊桥和一座独木桥（后改为石板桥），将四处民居连成一个整体。刘家桥古民居为特点鲜明的徽派建筑，风格为明清古庄园建筑雏形。屋宇皆为两层，房屋廊道相连通，内部迂回曲折，整体以青灰色为主调，青砖到檐，青瓦盖顶，垛墙叙伸。
projects.content_en: The ancient vernacular dwellings of Liujiaqiao, located in Guihua Town, Xianning City, were first built in the 3rd year of Chongzhen, Ming (1630). The total building area of the village is 35,000 square meters, with a total of 740 rooms of various sizes, 38 corridors, and 54 courtyards (tianjing). Through a covered bridge and a single-log bridge (later changed to a stone slab bridge), the four residential areas are connected into a whole. The ancient vernacular dwellings of Liujiaqiao are distinctive Hui-style architecture, in the style of the embryonic form of Ming-Qing ancient manor buildings. The houses are all two stories, with corridors connected, the interior winding and tortuous, the overall tone dominated by blue-gray, with gray brick to the eaves, gray tile roofs, and parapet walls extending.

projects.name: 笔峰塔
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市咸安区向阳湖镇严家嘴
projects.address_en: Yanjiazui, Xiangyanghu Town, Xian'an District, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 笔峰塔又名慈恩雁塔，俗称宝塔，'文革'期间曾改名向阳塔，始建于宋朝，现存建筑为清道光戊戌年（1838）重建。塔身七层八面，楼阁式砖石结构，塔身高28米，底边长2.2米，周长17.6米，底层南侧有一高2米、宽0.8米的拱门，门额题为'直达蟾宫'。塔内有可容2人并行的盘旋旋石阶，上66级至五层，六、七层实心不可攀。除底层外，每层有4个圆窗，直径0.6米，间方错落而开。
projects.content_en: Bifeng Pagoda, also called Ci'en Yanta (Kindness Wild Goose Pagoda), commonly known as Baota (Precious Pagoda), was renamed Xiangyang Pagoda during the Cultural Revolution. It was first built in the Song dynasty, and the existing building was rebuilt in the Wuxu year of Daoguang, Qing (1838). The pagoda body has seven stories and eight faces, a multi-eaved brick-stone structure, with a pagoda body height of 28 meters, base side length of 2.2 meters, and perimeter of 17.6 meters. On the south side of the base is an arched door 2 meters high and 0.8 meters wide, with the lintel titled 'Directly Reaching the Toad Palace' (a metaphor for passing the imperial examination). Inside the pagoda are winding stone steps allowing 2 people to walk side by side, climbing 66 steps to the fifth story; the sixth and seventh stories are solid and cannot be climbed. Except for the base, each story has 4 round windows, 0.6 meters in diameter, opened alternately and staggered.

projects.name: 王明璠府第
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市通山县大路乡吴田村畈上王湾
projects.address_en: Fanshang Wangwan, Wutian Village, Dalu Township, Tongshan County, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 王明璠（1829-1906）湖北通山人，字奂若，号璞夫，清咸丰八年（1858）中举。曾任江西上饶、丰城、瑞昌、萍乡等县知县。在瑞昌'倡筑长堤以捍水患'，人们纪其功绩，称该堤为'王公堤'。在萍乡，'保甲之法，亦全省效之'。从政不长，却有政声，被上司誉为'江西干员'。同治十二年（1887）辞官回乡，同治年间被朝廷诰授奉政大夫，光绪年间晋封'朝议大夫'衔，享受从四品俸禄而终老余年。故称'朝...'
projects.content_en: Wang Mingfan (1829-1906), a native of Tongshan, Hubei, courtesy name Huanruo, art name Pufu, passed the provincial examination in the 8th year of Xianfeng, Qing (1858). He served as county magistrate of Shangrao, Fengcheng, Ruichang, and Pingxiang in Jiangxi. In Ruichang, he 'advocated building long dikes to defend against floods,' and people commemorated his achievements by calling the dike 'Lord Wang's Dike.' In Pingxiang, 'the baojia method was also emulated throughout the province.' His political career was not long, but he had a reputation for good governance, praised by superiors as a 'capable official of Jiangxi.' In the 12th year of Tongzhi (1887), he resigned and returned to his hometown; during the Tongzhi period he was conferred the title of Fengzheng Dafu by the court, and during the Guangxu period he was promoted to the title of 'Chaoyi Dafu' (Court Discussion Grand Master), enjoying the salary of the fourth rank from副 until his old age. Hence called 'Court...'

projects.name: 圣庙
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市通山县通羊镇四街
projects.address_en: Sijie, Tongyang Town, Tongshan County, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 通山圣庙坐落于通山县通羊镇，背靠龟山，面临雉水，又称'学宫'，清代祭祀建筑。始建于北宋庆历四年（1044），明嘉靖年间、清康熙、乾隆、嘉庆年间重修。现存建筑为嘉庆十八年（1813）修建。圣庙坐东北朝西南，三进院落占地约4000平方米，对称布局，现尚存大成门、大成殿、崇圣祠及两侧有名宦祠、乡贤祠、东西庑等建筑。大成殿，面阔五间27.2米，进深三间11.2米，是圣庙的主体建筑。单檐硬山青瓦顶。崇圣祠，又称明伦堂，为抬梁式大木构架，明间出六角攒尖顶抱厦，造型特别。前、后院配房屋架简陋，面阔分别为六间、四间，进深二间，中部抬梁式构架，脊檩直接搭于两山墙上。1930年4月，彭德怀率红三军攻占通山县城，以圣庙为指挥部，召开军团扩大会议，在此制订了攻打岳州的军事方案。
projects.content_en: The Tongshan Confucian Temple is located in Tongyang Town, Tongshan County, backed by Turtle Mountain and facing Zhi River, also called 'Xuegong' (School Palace), a Qing dynasty sacrificial building. First built in the 4th year of Qingli, Northern Song (1044), rebuilt during the Jiajing period of Ming and the Kangxi, Qianlong, and Jiaqing periods of Qing. The existing building was built in the 18th year of Jiaqing (1813). The temple faces southwest from the northeast, with a three-courtyard layout covering about 4,000 square meters, symmetrically arranged; now still surviving are the Dacheng Gate, Dacheng Hall, Chongsheng Shrine, and on both sides the Famous Officials Shrine, Local Worthies Shrine, east and west wing rooms, etc. The Dacheng Hall is five bays wide (27.2 meters) and three bays deep (11.2 meters), the main building of the temple. Single-eave gable gray-tile roof. The Chongsheng Shrine, also called Minglun Hall, is a post-and-lintel large wooden frame, with the central bay projecting a hexagonal pyramidal-roof porch, with a special shape. The front and rear courtyard auxiliary buildings have simple frames, with widths of six and four bays respectively, two bays deep, with central post-and-lintel frames, and the ridge purlins directly resting on the two gable walls. In April 1930, Peng Dehuai led the Third Red Army to capture Tongshan County town, using the Confucian Temple as headquarters, holding an enlarged legion meeting, and formulating the military plan to attack Yuezhou here.

projects.name: 祖爷殿舍利塔
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市通山县九宫山
projects.address_en: Jiugong Mountain, Tongshan County, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 祖爷殿又称真君石殿，位于通山九宫山，始建于南宋庆元元年（1195），明初重建。石殿实为一楼阁式六角舍利石塔，仿木结构，残存三层，高约7.2米。南壁设壶门，基座为须弥座式。单筒式殿身，单壁砌置。檐下置四铺作斗拱，塔内存阳刻'伴仙台'，阴刻'敕建钦天瑞庆宫''万寿宫'及百戏图浮雕石匾各一方。
projects.content_en: Zuye Hall, also called Zhenjun Stone Hall, is located on Jiugong Mountain, Tongshan, first built in the 1st year of Qingyuan, Southern Song (1195), rebuilt in the early Ming. The stone hall is actually a multi-eaved hexagonal sarira stone pagoda, imitation-wood structure, with three surviving stories, about 7.2 meters high. A pot-door is set on the south wall, and the base is a Sumeru pedestal type. Single-cylinder hall body, single-wall construction. Under the eaves are four-puzuo bracket sets; inside the pagoda are a yang-carved 'Banxian Terrace' and yin-carved 'Imperially Built Qintian Ruiqing Palace,' 'Wanshou Palace,' and a hundred-performance relief stone plaque each.

projects.name: 宝石民居群
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市通山县闯王镇宝石村
projects.address_en: Baoshi Village, Chuangwang Town, Tongshan County, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 位于通山县闯王镇宝石村，紧依九宫山的环形旅游公路，是舒氏宗族聚居地，发源于九宫山、太阳山的宝石河从村中流过，'宝石河'得名于河床堆积的卵石。宝石村现规模约7万平方米，相传始建于明万历年间，以宝石河为中心，现存有明代，清代早、中、晚期和民国时期各式风格民居130多栋，被誉为'楚天第一古民居群'。其建筑形制包括住宅、祠堂、商铺三种类型。南岸以门楼、祖祠与商贸街形成片区，此处商贾多为前堂商铺，后堂住人，中间以一道砖墙分隔，称塞墙。北岸以单栋建筑为主，形式各异，多为单檐硬山布瓦顶，砖木结构，抬梁和穿斗混合构架，山墙直接承接檩条。一般面阔为三间或五间，进深方向有多重天井，最多一处有五重天井院。木石装修工艺精致，隔扇、门窗、看梁、柱础、阁楼栏板等都是雕饰的重点。
projects.content_en: Located in Baoshi Village, Chuangwang Town, Tongshan County, close to the ring tourist road of Jiugong Mountain, it is a settlement of the Shu clan. The Baoshi (Gemstone) River, originating from Jiugong Mountain and Taiyang Mountain, flows through the village; 'Baoshi River' gets its name from the pebbles accumulated in the riverbed. Baoshi Village now has a scale of about 70,000 square meters; legend has it it was first built during the Wanli period of the Ming, centered on the Baoshi River, and now preserves more than 130 vernacular dwellings of various styles from the Ming, early, middle, and late Qing, and Republican periods, known as the 'No.1 Ancient Vernacular Dwelling Group in Chutian.' Its architectural forms include three types: residences, ancestral halls, and shops. The south bank forms a district with gate towers, ancestral halls, and commercial streets; here merchants mostly had front halls as shops and rear halls as living quarters, separated by a brick wall in the middle, called a plug wall. The north bank is mainly single buildings, with various forms, mostly single-eave gable tile roofs, brick-wood structure, mixed post-and-lintel and column-and-tie frames, with gable walls directly承接 purlins. Generally three or five bays wide, with multiple courtyards (tianjing) in the depth direction, with at most five layers of courtyard compounds at one place. The wood and stone decoration craftsmanship is exquisite; partitions, doors and windows, viewing beams, column bases, attic parapets, etc., are all the focus of carving decoration.

projects.name: 舒氏宗祠
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市通山县闯王镇宝石村
projects.address_en: Baoshi Village, Chuangwang Town, Tongshan County, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 舒氏宗祠为舒氏宗族的总祠，位于宝石村宝石河北岸中段，始建于清末，1940年毁于战火，解放后改建为村礼堂。宗祠格局中正，背山面水，坐北朝南，共五重天井，砖木结构，明间抬梁，第一重有戏台，第五重为祭祀场所。祠前的月台、做工讲究，雕刻精细，方瓶式柱础四面浮雕动物、花卉。
projects.content_en: Shu's Ancestral Hall is the main ancestral hall of the Shu clan, located in the middle section of the north bank of the Baoshi River in Baoshi Village, first built in the late Qing, destroyed by war in 1940, and converted into a village auditorium after liberation. The ancestral hall has a centered layout, backed by mountains and facing water, facing south, with a total of five courtyards (tianjing), brick-wood structure, with the central bay using post-and-lintel frames; the first section has a stage, and the fifth section is a sacrificial place. The platform in front of the hall is exquisitely crafted with fine carvings; the square-vase-shaped column bases have relief animals and flowers on all four sides.

projects.name: 宝石牌坊屋
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市通山县闯王镇宝石村
projects.address_en: Baoshi Village, Chuangwang Town, Tongshan County, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 清朝末年修建，厅堂内有一块红漆木牌记录宣统皇帝御批：'宣统辛亥年''旌表节孝准予建坊''儒士舒朴夫之妻陈氏立'等字样。牌坊为五间三楼式，六根立柱皆不落地，三组坊檐下有砖制如意斗拱，次梢间额枋做成扇面月梁式样，坊间墙体以六边形龟背锦面砖饰面。
projects.content_en: Built in the late Qing, there is a red-lacquered wooden plaque in the hall recording the imperial approval of Emperor Xuantong: 'Xuantong Xinhai year,' 'Commending chastity and filial piety, permitted to build an archway,' 'Erected by Chen, wife of scholar Shu Pufu,' etc. The archway is a five-bay three-story style, with six columns none of which touch the ground; under the three groups of arch eaves are brick ruyi bracket sets; the secondary and end bay architraves are made into fan-shaped moon-beam styles, and the walls between archways are faced with hexagonal turtle-back brocade brick tiles.

projects.name: 行意堂
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市通山县闯王镇宝石村
projects.address_en: Baoshi Village, Chuangwang Town, Tongshan County, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 行意堂坐落于宝石河北岸，坐北朝南，面阔三间，通深两进，青砖黛瓦，矮小逼仄，极其简朴，现仅存明代进士舒宏绪居住的一间房间还大体保持着原貌。舒宏绪为明万历癸未年进士，后因'国本之争'而被罢官归乡，闲居于此简陋居室，与诗书为伴达20余年，直到53岁病逝。他自名所居寓所为'行意草堂'，留下了《行意草堂纪事》。天启皇帝诏赠舒宏绪为光禄寺少卿、西粤楚王，赐给'天垣补衮'匾，以表彰他护卫朝纲、御使郭惟贤送'正色立朝'匾予以缅怀，并在其家居门口建立牌楼。
projects.content_en: Xingyi Hall is located on the north bank of the Baoshi River, facing south, three bays wide, two sections deep, with gray brick and black tiles, small and cramped, extremely simple; now only one room where Ming jinshi Shu Hongxu lived still大体 maintains its original appearance. Shu Hongxu was a jinshi of the Guiwei year of Wanli, Ming, later dismissed from office and returned to his hometown due to the 'National Foundation Dispute,' living in seclusion in this simple dwelling, accompanied by poetry and books for more than 20 years, until he died of illness at 53. He named his dwelling 'Xingyi Thatched Hall,' leaving behind 'Records of Xingyi Thatched Hall.' Emperor Tianqi posthumously granted Shu Hongxu as Shaoqing of the Guanglu Temple and King of Western Guangdong, bestowing the 'Tianyuan Bugun' (Heavenly Wall Mending Robe) plaque to commend him for guarding the court order; Censor Guo Weixian sent the 'Zhengse Lichao' (Upright Color Standing in Court) plaque in remembrance, and a memorial archway was built at the entrance of his home.

projects.name: 接客厅
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市通山县闯王镇宝石村
projects.address_en: Baoshi Village, Chuangwang Town, Tongshan County, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: '接客厅'为并排的两栋房屋，坐东朝西，总面积580平方米。北侧一栋有前院，为二进三开间，南侧为五进三开间。整个建筑为抬梁式构架，檐高6米，外墙青砖，内墙为板壁和直棂条方格格扇，木石构件素净无华。
projects.content_en: The 'Reception Hall' consists of two houses side by side, facing west, with a total area of 580 square meters. The northern one has a front courtyard, two sections and three bays; the southern one is five sections and three bays. The entire building uses post-and-lintel frames, with eave height of 6 meters, exterior walls of gray brick, interior walls of plank walls and straight-lattice square-grid partitions, with plain and unadorned wood and stone components.

projects.name: 仁德堂
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市通山县闯王镇宝石村
projects.address_en: Baoshi Village, Chuangwang Town, Tongshan County, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 建于清代同治年间，坐落于宝石河北岸，坐北朝南，依台地渐进高而建。正屋面阔三间，进深三进，面积303平方米。偏屋受地基限制，一进为二间，二、三进为三间，面积约200平方米。正屋、偏屋的二、三进有门连通。正屋石质大门的'门当''户对'上浅浮雕梅花、菊花图案。并设构造精美、装修考究的内门楼。一、二进东西厢房之上各有绣楼和腰廊，绣楼通体镂雕各色图案。二进厢房扇裙板阳刻刘家格通镂雕人物故事图案。
projects.content_en: Built during the Tongzhi period of the Qing, located on the north bank of the Baoshi River, facing south, built progressively higher along terraces. The main house is three bays wide, three sections deep, with an area of 303 square meters. The side house, limited by the foundation, has two bays in the first section and three bays in the second and third sections, with an area of about 200 square meters. The second and third sections of the main house and side house are connected by doors. On the 'Mendang' and 'Hudui' of the stone main gate of the main house are shallow relief plum blossom and chrysanthemum patterns. An exquisitely constructed and finely decorated inner gate tower is also set. Above the east and west wing rooms of the first and second sections are each embroidery towers and waist corridors; the embroidery towers are entirely openwork-carved with various patterns. The second-section wing room fan skirt boards are yang-carved with Liujiage openwork figure story patterns.

projects.name: 千总居
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市通山县闯王镇宝石村
projects.address_en: Baoshi Village, Chuangwang Town, Tongshan County, Xianning City
highlights: 节孝坊与住宅并排两栋
projects.content_zh: 建成于清朝光绪年间，节孝坊与住宅并排两栋，互相连通，坐东朝西，北侧的一栋面阔三间，通深两进，占地110平方米。正面墙为清光绪年间'皇恩旌表'的节孝坊，四柱三门五楼式门楼，墙面六边形龟背青砖贴饰。南侧的一栋面阔五间，通深两进，占地160平方米。房屋为两层，一、二层布局相同。明间之上建有三楼，为银库，称银楼。两栋房屋的厢房、楼室均为木雕隔扇。
projects.content_en: Built during the Guangxu period of the Qing, the chastity-filial piety archway and residence are two buildings side by side, interconnected, facing west; the northern one is three bays wide, two sections deep, covering 110 square meters. The front wall is a chastity-filial piety archway with 'Imperial Grace Commendation' from the Guangxu period of Qing, a four-column three-door five-story gate tower, with hexagonal turtle-back gray brick decoration on the wall surface. The southern one is five bays wide, two sections deep, covering 160 square meters. The house is two stories, with the first and second floors having the same layout. Above the central bay is built a third floor, serving as a silver vault, called the Silver Tower. The wing rooms and tower rooms of both buildings are all wood-carved partitions.

projects.name: 米应生故居
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市崇阳县白霓镇浪口村
projects.address_en: Langkou Village, Baini Town, Chongyang County, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 米应生（1780-1832）生于乾隆年间，为崇阳县大白麻石米家人，字石泉，号桃林，当地人称'米戏官'，汉调名伶，京剧主要奠基人，在汉调过度到京调的过程中起了关键作用。其在崇阳县的故居有两处，分别位于白霓镇浪口村麻石米家和天城镇白泉村。其中前者为省级文物保护单位，后者尚没有得到较好保护。白霓故居始建于清康熙年间，是米应生出生以及少年时生活的地方，坐西朝东，四合院式布局，一进三重两天井，依次为门厅、中堂和后堂（祖堂）。占地面积1000平方米，保存较为完整。面阔五间，门当上刻有麒麟送子、凤鸣牡丹等精美雕刻；故居内保存有米氏先人神主牌及民国续修的米氏家谱；每年正月初一、十五，米家湾20多户米家人会来此祭拜。天城故居建于嘉庆初年，是米应生晚年自京回乡所建、并在此设科授徒13年。故居亦为四合院布局，面阔五间，二进两厢，占地面积300平方米。屋柱石础及大门石雕花极为精致——石门框门楣上阳雕有缠枝纹花草图，石门框横梁内各阳雕一只飞天瑞兽，阁楼上护栏为龙形曲线，显得古朴典雅。此处故居并没有被申请为省保单位，现由故居旁的米氏后代人为照管。
projects.content_en: Mi Yingsheng (1780-1832), born during the Qianlong period, was from the Mi family of Mashi, Dabai, Chongyang County, courtesy name Shiquan, art name Taolin, locally called 'Mi Xi Guan' (Mi the Opera Official). He was a famous Han tune opera singer and a main founder of Peking Opera, playing a key role in the transition from Han tune to Jing tune. He has two former residences in Chongyang County, located respectively at Mashi Mi family, Langkou Village, Baini Town, and Baiquan Village, Tiancheng Town. The former is a provincial cultural heritage protection unit, while the latter has not yet been well protected. The Baini former residence was first built during the Kangxi period of the Qing, the place where Mi Yingsheng was born and lived in his youth, facing east, in a courtyard layout, one entry with three sections and two courtyards (tianjing),依次 being the entrance hall, central hall, and rear hall (ancestral hall). Covering 1,000 square meters, it is relatively well preserved. Five bays wide, with the door ornaments exquisitely carved with qilin delivering sons, phoenix singing peonies, etc.; inside the residence are preserved the ancestral spirit tablets of the Mi family ancestors and the Mi family genealogy continued in the Republic; every year on the first and fifteenth of the first lunar month, more than 20 Mi households in Mijiawan come here to worship. The Tiancheng former residence was built in the early Jiaqing period, built by Mi Yingsheng after returning to his hometown from Beijing in his later years, where he taught disciples for 13 years. The residence is also in a courtyard layout, five bays wide, two sections with two wing rooms, covering 300 square meters. The house column stone bases and main gate stone carvings are extremely exquisite—the stone door frame lintel has yang-carved interlocking branch flower and grass patterns, and inside the stone door frame beams are each yang-carved with a flying auspicious beast; the attic guardrail is a dragon-shaped curve, appearing simple and elegant. This former residence has not been applied for as a provincial protection unit, and is now cared for by Mi family descendants living next to the residence.

projects.name: 崇阳大市村老屋
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市崇阳县白霓镇大市村东1km处
projects.address_en: 1 km east of Dashi Village, Baini Town, Chongyang County, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 位于崇阳县白霓镇大市村，坐北朝南，占地面积约1000平方米，多为清代所建。五间三天井三进式布局，分别为前厅、中堂、祖堂及厢房，通面阔五间22.34米，通进深38.2米。中轴线上建筑均为单檐硬山灰瓦顶，穿斗式构架。砖木混合结构，其中结构框架以木为主，墙柱混合承重，宅院内承重柱以及临天井的檐柱和厅堂、厢房的转角柱，多为'一柱双料'做法，围合的墙体则大量使用土坯砖，表面以白灰粉刷。在后院天井的一角有一眼水井，石作井沿雕饰精细，至今保存完好。
projects.content_en: Located in Dashi Village, Baini Town, Chongyang County, facing south, covering about 1,000 square meters, mostly built in the Qing dynasty. Five-bay three-courtyard three-section layout, respectively the front hall, central hall, ancestral hall, and wing rooms, with a total width of five bays (22.34 meters) and total depth of 38.2 meters. The buildings on the central axis all have single-eave gable gray-tile roofs and column-and-tie frames. Brick-wood composite structure, in which the structural frame is mainly wood, with walls and columns jointly bearing loads; the load-bearing columns in the courtyard, the eave columns facing the courtyard, and the corner columns of the halls and wing rooms mostly use the 'one column double material' method, while the enclosing walls largely use adobe bricks, with surfaces plastered with white lime. In a corner of the backyard courtyard is a water well, with the stone well rim exquisitely carved, well preserved to this day.

projects.name: 崇阳白霓镇老街及民居
projects.name_en: Old Street and Vernacular Dwellings in Baini Town
projects.level: 湖北省重点文物保护单位
projects.level_en: Hubei Provincial Key Cultural Heritage Site
projects.address: 咸宁市崇阳县白霓镇
projects.address_en: Baini Town, Chongyang County, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 白霓镇位于湖北咸宁市崇阳县，曾出土众多商周时期文物，其中商代青铜礼乐器重铜鼓据鉴定属殷商晚期遗物，是目前国内保存的唯一的一件商至西周早期的铜鼓。镇西南有崇阳古八景之一的'金城墨沼'，据旧县志记载：'金城山……黄庭坚读书其上，常洗笔于白石港石矾之下。'白霓位于崇阳盆地东缘的丘陵低山区，地势平坦，土质肥沃，宜粮宜茶。据《崇阳县志》载，白霓地区河道众多，水运便利，但陆道不通，虽村落繁多，但无商家集市，故以村落名相互称谓，本身无统一地名。明嘉靖四十年（1561），当地商人熊白泥捐资修建一座石桥，贯通了南北陆路，交通优势随即凸显，桥边出现集市，并逐渐形成古镇之规模。为铭熊白泥善举，桥以其为名，后改'泥'为'霓'，成为'白霓桥'。白霓镇上中节街为武昌至长沙的古驿路必经之地，区位优势使得众商贾富豪纷纷在此设置商铺。前有由王允臣开设的'启大祥当铺'和蔡宿德的祖先开设的'蔡协和商店'，后有'刘仁裕''前丰厚''协兴和'3家当铺，还有'复兴祥''尧永记'等较大的商店。'市'逐渐由白霓桥附近的上街头延伸至中港口，又因用地受到河水的限制而沿河发展至余拱桥，中节街雏形逐渐显示完整，并形成'因市成街，以街为市'的局面。
projects.content_en: Baini Town is located in Chongyang County, Xianning City, Hubei, and has unearthed many cultural relics from the Shang and Zhou periods; among them, the Shang dynasty bronze ritual musical instrument heavy bronze drum, identified as a relic of the late Yin-Shang period, is currently the only bronze drum from the Shang to early Western Zhou preserved in China. Southwest of the town is 'Jincheng Mo Zhao' (Golden City Ink Pool), one of the Eight Ancient Scenes of Chongyang; according to old county annals: 'On Jincheng Mountain... Huang Tingjian studied there, often washing his brushes below the Baishigang stone rock.' Baini is located in the hilly low-mountain area at the eastern edge of the Chongyang Basin, with flat terrain, fertile soil, suitable for grain and tea. According to the 'Chongyang County Annals,' the Baini area has many rivers with convenient water transport, but land routes were impassable; although there were many villages, there were no commercial markets, so they were called by village names, with no unified place name itself. In the 40th year of Jiajing, Ming (1561), local merchant Xiong Baini donated to build a stone bridge, connecting the north-south land route; the transportation advantage immediately became prominent, and a market appeared by the bridge, gradually forming the scale of an ancient town. To commemorate Xiong Baini's good deed, the bridge was named after him, later changing '泥' (mud) to '霓' (rainbow), becoming 'Baini Bridge.' The Zhongjie Street in Baini Town was a必经 place on the ancient post road from Wuchang to Changsha, and its locational advantage led many wealthy merchants to set up shops here. Earlier there were the 'Qidaxiang Pawnshop' opened by Wang Yunchen and the 'Cai Xiehe Store' opened by the ancestors of Cai Sude; later there were three pawnshops 'Liu Renyu,' 'Qian Fengyu,' and 'Xie Xinghe,' as well as larger stores such as 'Fu Xingxiang' and 'Yao Yongji.' The 'market' gradually extended from the upper street near Baini Bridge to Zhonggang Port, and due to land being limited by the river, developed along the river to Yugong Bridge; the embryonic form of Zhongjie Street gradually became complete, forming the situation of 'market creating street, street serving as market.'

projects.content_zh: 中节街62号甘宅原为'保生和'药铺，始建于明清年间，位于中节街中段，为三天井单层建筑，带...
projects.content_en: The Gan residence at No.62 Zhongjie Street was originally the 'Baoshenghe' medicine shop, first built during the Ming and Qing dynasties, located in the middle section of Zhongjie Street, a single-story building with three courtyards (tianjing), with...

projects.name: 白霓杨宅
projects.level: 湖北省重点文物保护单位
projects.level_en: Hubei Provincial Key Cultural Heritage Site
projects.address: 咸宁市崇阳县白霓镇中节街35号
projects.address_en: No.35 Zhongjie Street, Baini Town, Chongyang County, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 杨宅位于中节街35号，为天井半天井式建筑。该户为麻花加工作坊兼副食品店铺，建筑面宽6.8米。两层砖木结构，室内一天斗和一天井，天井位于一、二进建筑之间，约4米见方，两侧留有气缝，其上亮瓦采光。第一进为店铺柜台，中间以天井斗作为过渡空间，其下形成一个'光庭'，兼备采光通风和工作间的功用，户主在此进行原料初加工，厢房为工人房。第二进布置了仓库和加工间，其后二、三进之间有天井，三进为厕所等辅助用房。建筑现一层居住，二层空置，可通过活动木梯上到二层。
projects.content_en: Yang's Residence is located at No.35 Zhongjie Street, a courtyard half-courtyard type building. This household is a mahua (fried dough twist) processing workshop and non-staple food shop, with a building width of 6.8 meters. Two-story brick-wood structure, with one sky-well and one courtyard (tianjing) indoors; the courtyard is located between the first and second section buildings, about 4 meters square, with air gaps on both sides, and bright tiles above for lighting. The first section is the shop counter, with the courtyard well in the middle as a transition space, forming a 'light court' below, serving both lighting ventilation and workshop functions; the household performs raw material initial processing here, and the wing room is the worker's room. The second section arranges warehouses and processing rooms; behind it, between the second and third sections, is a courtyard; the third section is auxiliary rooms such as toilets. The building now has the first floor occupied and the second floor vacant, accessible to the second floor via a movable wooden ladder.

projects.name: 白霓丁宅
projects.level: 湖北省重点文物保护单位
projects.level_en: Hubei Provincial Key Cultural Heritage Site
projects.address: 咸宁市崇阳县白霓镇中节街11号
projects.address_en: No.11 Zhongjie Street, Baini Town, Chongyang County, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 中节街11号丁宅建于清嘉庆后期，为前店后坊式街屋，纯商业建筑，一楼为前店后坊，二楼用来堆放原料、半成品和成品；堂屋左右两边分别是柜台和加工间，堂屋后是饭堂，其右侧是厢房，左侧为账房，账房一角有两堵墙围合的长0.8米，宽0.5米的矩形空间，用来安置仅能从二楼垂吊下来的保险箱。账房另一侧为厨房和厕所。建筑中轴线上有三处亮瓦，分别位于堂房前、后和饭堂。大门门楣及窗沿下雕有鹿及蝙蝠木雕，分别代表谐音字'禄'和'福'，有'福禄成祥'的意思。据说店主及帮工晚上回各自住处休息，因此，为了防止夜间盗窃，四周山墙甚至临街面皆用青石山墙砌筑，将建筑围合于其中，这一做法在防火、防盗的同时，也符合当地所谓'聚财'的一种风水学说。丁家一直经营麻花和糕点加工，并以'石大门'这一字号命名。
projects.content_en: Ding's Residence at No.11 Zhongjie Street was built in the late Jiaqing period of the Qing, a front-shop-back-workshop street house, a purely commercial building. The first floor is front shop and back workshop, and the second floor is used to stack raw materials, semi-finished products, and finished products; on the left and right sides of the main hall are respectively the counter and processing room; behind the main hall is the dining hall, with a wing room on its right side and an accounting room on the left; in a corner of the accounting room is a rectangular space 0.8 meters long and 0.5 meters wide enclosed by two walls, used to place a safe that can only be winched down from the second floor. The other side of the accounting room is the kitchen and toilet. On the central axis of the building are three bright tiles, located respectively in front of and behind the main hall and in the dining hall. The main gate lintel and under the window sills are carved with deer and bat wood carvings, respectively representing the homophone characters 'Lu' (prosperity) and 'Fu' (blessing), meaning 'fortune and prosperity bring auspiciousness.' It is said that the shop owner and helpers returned to their respective residences to rest at night; therefore, to prevent nighttime theft, the surrounding gable walls and even the street-facing side are all built with bluestone gable walls, enclosing the building within. This practice, while fireproof and theft-proof, also conforms to a local so-called 'wealth-gathering' feng shui theory. The Ding family has always operated mahua and pastry processing, and named it with the trade name 'Stone Gate.'

projects.name: 赤壁之战遗址
projects.name_en: Historic Site of the Battle of Red Cliffs
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.dynasty_en: Tang, Song, Ming, and Qing dynasties
projects.address: 咸宁市赤壁市西北长江南岸
projects.address_en: South bank of Yangtze River, northwest of Chibi City, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 赤壁之战遗址古名石头关，位于赤壁市西北36公里的长江南岸，隔江与乌林相望。是著名的'赤壁之战'的发生地。赤壁之战是三国时期最为著名的一场战役，孙权、刘备联军以少胜多，在长江赤壁一带大破曹操大军，奠定三国鼎立的基础。《元和郡县图志》载：'赤壁山在蒲圻县西一百二十里，北临大江，其北岸即乌林，即周瑜用黄盖策，焚曹公舟船败走处。'当然，关于这场战役的具体位置，学术界除了蒲圻赤壁说，还有武昌赤壁说、钟祥赤壁说、汉阳赤壁说、汉川赤壁说、黄州赤壁说等多种说法，20世纪80年...
projects.content_en: The historic site of the Battle of Red Cliffs, anciently named Shitou Pass, is located on the south bank of the Yangtze River, 36 kilometers northwest of Chibi City, facing Wulin across the river. It is the location of the famous 'Battle of Red Cliffs.' The Battle of Red Cliffs was the most famous battle of the Three Kingdoms period; the allied forces of Sun Quan and Liu Bei, with fewer troops defeating more, dealt a major blow to Cao Cao's large army at Red Cliffs on the Yangtze, laying the foundation for the tripartite division of the Three Kingdoms. The 'Yuanhe Maps and Records of Prefectures and Counties' record: 'Red Cliff Mountain is 120 li west of Puqi County, bordering the Great River to the north; its north bank is Wulin, the place where Zhou Yu used Huang Gai's strategy to burn Cao Cao's boats and defeat him.' Of course, regarding the specific location of this battle, in addition to the Puqi Red Cliff theory, academia also has multiple theories such as Wuchang Red Cliff, Zhongxiang Red Cliff, Hanyang Red Cliff, Hanchuan Red Cliff, and Huangzhou Red Cliff; in the 1980s...

projects.name: 羊楼洞、新店明清石板街
projects.name_en: Stone Path of Yangloudong and Xindian
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市赤壁市赵李桥镇
projects.address_en: Zhaoliqiao Town, Chibi City, Xianning City
projects.content_zh: 羊楼洞古镇地处湘鄂交界处，东靠赣北，北依武汉，南接岳阳，西北与江汉平原隔江相望，是进出湘、赣的门户之地。羊楼洞古镇始建于明万历年间，距今已有400多年历史，是著名的'砖茶之乡'古镇因茶而起、因茶而盛，全镇的形成与演变都与当地茶叶加工、茶叶贸易发展密不可分。据传羊楼洞是蒲圻著名特产'松峰绿茶'的最早产地，自唐代太和年间（827-835）皇诏普种山茶起，当地就开始种植绿茶，史称'松峰茶'。宋代曾以砖茶作为通货与内蒙左地区进行茶马交易。清道光年间，晋商、粤商陆续在这里开坊设庄，收购红茶。汉口开埠后，俄、英、日、德等国商人在这里竞相占地建厂，开展茶业贸易。同治、光绪年间，羊楼洞有茶庄200余家，旅店、其他商业铺面达百余家，人口近4万，主要街道5条。民国初年是羊楼洞砖茶生产的极盛期。1938年赤壁沦陷，茶叶产区遭到战争的严重破坏，茶坊、茶庄相继倒闭，羊楼洞也随之萧条。镇中一条主要街道南北贯穿全镇，以青石板墁铺，宽6米，长约1000米，中间设三座石拱桥，两侧有数条'丁'字巷。街东大多为木构吊脚楼，街西均为单檐硬山顶砖木建筑。街道两侧保留清代、民国时期的住宅80多处。
projects.content_en: The ancient town of Yangloudong is located at the Hunan-Hubei border, leaning against northern Jiangxi to the east, Wuhan to the north, connecting Yueyang to the south, and facing the Jianghan Plain across the river to the northwest; it is the gateway to and from Hunan and Jiangxi. The ancient town of Yangloudong was first built during the Wanli period of the Ming, with a history of over 400 years, and is a famous 'brick tea hometown.' The ancient town rose because of tea and prospered because of tea; the formation and evolution of the entire town are inseparable from the development of local tea processing and tea trade. Legend has it that Yangloudong is the earliest production area of the famous Puqi specialty 'Songfeng Green Tea'; since the Taihe period of the Tang (827-835), when the imperial edict universally planted mountain tea, local people began growing green tea, historically called 'Songfeng Tea.' In the Song dynasty, brick tea was once used as currency for tea-horse trade with the Inner Mongolia Left region. During the Daoguang period of the Qing, Shanxi and Guangdong merchants successively opened workshops and estates here to purchase black tea. After Hankou was opened as a treaty port, merchants from Russia, Britain, Japan, Germany and other countries competed to occupy land and build factories here to carry out tea trade. During the Tongzhi and Guangxu periods, Yangloudong had over 200 tea estates, and over a hundred inns and other commercial shops, with a population of nearly 40,000 and 5 main streets. The early Republican period was the peak period of Yangloudong brick tea production. In 1938, after Chibi fell to the enemy, the tea producing area was severely damaged by war, and tea workshops and tea estates closed one after another, and Yangloudong also declined accordingly. A main street in the town runs north-south through the entire town, paved with bluestone slabs, 6 meters wide and about 1,000 meters long, with three stone arch bridges in the middle and several 'T'-shaped alleys on both sides. Most of the east side of the street are wooden stilted buildings, and the west side are all single-eave gable roof brick-wood buildings. Over 80 residences from the Qing and Republican periods are preserved on both sides of the street.

projects.name: 蒲圻城墙
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 咸宁市赤壁市蒲圻街道
projects.address_en: Puqi Subdistrict, Chibi City, Xianning City
highlights: 三国吴鲁肃修筑的粮城
projects.content_zh: 蒲圻城，古称莼川，为三国吴鲁肃修筑的粮城，系东吴屯粮草之处。唐贞观七年（633）蒲圻县治从陆溪川中迁驻鲍口（白云山北麓，现属陆溪镇）；历为蒲圻县治所。唐初鲍口以山水为屏，无城廓。明万历三年（1575）始建城垣，清嘉庆三年（1798）建成，石城周长3500米，墙高7米，厚5.3米，女儿墙高1.7米，建有六门——东曰聚奎（东门）、西曰宝成（西门）、南曰迎薰（南门）、北曰拱极（北门）、西南曰丰乐、西北曰通汇（水西门），高5.2米，宽4.4米，深5.3米，券石纵联砌置，三券三伏。清道光二十四年（1844），邑人王钟瑞补修蒲圻石城六门谯楼。1968年，为了城区扩建，拆除了宝成、丰乐二门及宝成门一段城墙。蒲圻石城建筑风格独特，清一色条石砌垒，严丝合缝，门拱采用三合土、糯米、石灰浇注而成，经千年风雨雪霜侵蚀，至今仍屹立不倒。今存长约800米的城墙和聚奎、迎薰、通汇、拱极4门，上起南门头，下至陆水一桥桥头，沿陆水河右岸而行。
projects.content_en: Puqi City, anciently called Chun River, was a grain city built by Lu Su of Wu in the Three Kingdoms, a place where Eastern Wu stored grain and forage. In the 7th year of Zhenguan, Tang (633), the Puqi county seat moved from Luxichuan to Baokou (north foot of Baiyun Mountain, now under Luxi Town); it has historically been the Puqi county seat. In the early Tang, Baokou used mountains and rivers as screens, with no city wall. In the 3rd year of Wanli, Ming (1575), city walls were first built, completed in the 3rd year of Jiaqing, Qing (1798). The stone city has a perimeter of 3,500 meters, wall height of 7 meters, thickness of 5.3 meters, parapet height of 1.7 meters, with six gates—east called Jukui (East Gate), west called Baocheng (West Gate), south called Yingxun (South Gate), north called Gongji (North Gate), southwest called Fengle, northwest called Tonghui (Water West Gate), 5.2 meters high, 4.4 meters wide, 5.3 meters deep, with arch stones built in longitudinal connection, three arches and three伏. In the 24th year of Daoguang, Qing (1844), local Wang Zhongrui repaired the six gate watchtowers of the Puqi stone city. In 1968, for urban expansion, the Baocheng and Fengle gates and a section of the Baocheng gate wall were demolished. The Puqi stone city has a unique architectural style, uniformly built with dressed stone, tightly fitted; the gate arches are cast with sanhetu (triple mixed earth), glutinous rice, and lime, and after a thousand years of wind, rain, snow, and frost erosion, still stand firm today. Now there remains a city wall about 800 meters long and 4 gates: Jukui, Yingxun, Tonghui, and Gongji, starting from the South Gate head and ending at the bridgehead of the First Lushui Bridge, running along the right bank of the Lushui River.
