projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市沙市区碧波路17号
projects.address_en: No.17 Bibo Road, Shashi District, Jingzhou City
projects.content_zh: 川主宫坐落在荆州市沙市区江津湖畔。江津即沙市的古称，自汉代开通至沙洋的大漕河后，江津成为江南数省向洛阳进贡财物和运送漕粮的枢纽，发展为著名的商业要地。明清时期，沙市已成为湖北仅次于汉口的重要市场，各省市客商先后在沙市组织行帮，形成了著名的'十三帮'，而各帮除举办各种帮会活动之外，也多建以会馆、书院或寺院，作为喝酒、唱戏等各种帮会活动的载体。如十三帮总会馆的旃檀庵、山陕帮的金龙寺、安徽帮的泾太会馆、四川帮的川主宫、湖南帮的禹王宫、浙江帮的孤魂会馆、黄州帮的帝王宫、广东帮的广东会馆、福建帮的天后宫、河南帮的中州会馆、汉阳帮的晴川书院、武昌帮的鄂城书院、江西帮的万寿宫、南京帮的金陵会馆、以及作为各省钱铺公馆的财神殿等。至明朝末年，沙市的商业氛围已经非常浓厚，清人刘献廷所著《广阳杂记》中如是描述：'沙市明末极盛，列巷九十九条，每行占一巷，舟车辐凑，繁盛甲宇内。'这种盛况一直持续了整个清代，刊印于光绪年间的《通商各关关华洋贸易总册》下卷中《光绪二十二年沙市口华洋贸易情形论略》曾有描述：'转奂巍然，足称美备。即其经费之充裕，可知其商务之殷繁，且其款项均由捐集而来，亦足知善贾者之多财矣。'川主宫是四川帮的帮会会馆，而在沙市的川人更是早在宋代便已成规模，南宋乾道六年（1170）陆游到沙市日记记载：'十七日，日入后，迁行李过嘉州赵青船、盖入峡船也。沙市堤上居者，大抵皆蜀人也；不然、则与蜀人为婚姻者也。'据《重修川主宫碑记》记载，川主宫始建于清乾嘉年间，系在滨江港口原杨泗庙旧址兴建而成，为四川商帮集资兴建，又称'蜀英会馆'。宫内正殿供奉三国时期蜀汉国主刘备，因而得名'川主宫'。川主宫戏楼是诸多会馆戏楼中最为有名的一座，宽阔高大，雕梁画栋，装饰富丽，也...
projects.content_en: Chuanzhu Shrine is located by Jiangjin Lake in Shashi District, Jingzhou City. Jiangjin is the ancient name of Shashi; since the Han dynasty opened the Great Canal River to Shayang, Jiangjin became a hub for several southern provinces to pay tribute goods to Luoyang and transport tribute grain, developing into a famous commercial hub. During the Ming and Qing, Shashi had become an important market in Hubei second only to Hankou; merchants from various provinces and cities successively organized trade guilds in Shashi, forming the famous 'Thirteen Guilds.' Besides holding various guild activities, each guild mostly built guildhalls, academies, or temples as venues for drinking, opera performances, and other guild activities. For example, the Zhantan Nunnery of the Thirteen Guilds General Guildhall, the Jinlong Temple of the Shan-Shaan Guild, the Jingtai Guildhall of the Anhui Guild, the Chuanzhu Shrine of the Sichuan Guild, the Yuwang Palace of the Hunan Guild, the Guhun Guildhall of the Zhejiang Guild, the Diwang Palace of the Huangzhou Guild, the Guangdong Guildhall of the Guangdong Guild, the Tianhou Palace of the Fujian Guild, the Zhongzhou Guildhall of the Henan Guild, the Qingchuan Academy of the Hanyang Guild, the Echeng Academy of the Wuchang Guild, the Wanshou Palace of the Jiangxi Guild, the Jinling Guildhall of the Nanjing Guild, and the God of Wealth Hall as the money-shop mansion of various provinces, etc. By the end of the Ming, Shashi's commercial atmosphere was already very strong; in the 'Guangyang Miscellaneous Records' written by Qing dynasty Liu Xianting, it is described as: 'Shashi was extremely prosperous at the end of the Ming, with ninety-nine lanes, each trade occupying one lane; boats and carts converged, its prosperity unmatched in the empire.' This grand situation lasted throughout the entire Qing. In the second volume of the 'General Records of Chinese and Foreign Trade at Various Treaty Ports' printed during the Guangxu period, the 'Brief Discussion on the Situation of Chinese and Foreign Trade at Shashi Port in the 22nd Year of Guangxu' once described: 'The turnover is magnificent, sufficient to be called excellent. From the abundance of its funds, one can know the prosperity of its commerce, and since its funds are all raised by donations, one can also know the wealth of good merchants.' Chuanzhu Shrine is the guildhall of the Sichuan Guild, and the Sichuan people in Shashi had already reached a scale as early as the Song dynasty; in the 6th year of Qiandao, Southern Song (1170), Lu You recorded in his Shashi diary: 'On the 17th, after sunset, I moved my luggage onto the Zhao Qing boat of Jiazhou, which is a boat entering the gorges. Most of the people living on the Shashi dike are Shu (Sichuan) people; otherwise, they are those married to Shu people.' According to the 'Record of the Rebuilding of Chuanzhu Shrine,' Chuanzhu Shrine was first built during the Qianlong-Jiaqing period of the Qing, constructed on the former site of the Yangsi Temple at the riverside port, built with funds raised by Sichuan merchant guilds, also called 'Shuying Guildhall.' The main hall inside enshrines Liu Bei, the ruler of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms, hence the name 'Chuanzhu Shrine' (Sichuan Lord Shrine). The Chuanzhu Shrine Theater is the most famous one among many guildhall theaters, broad and tall, with carved beams and painted pillars, richly decorated, also...

projects.name: 章华寺
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市沙市区太师渊路西段北侧
projects.address_en: North side of west section of Taishiyuan Road, Shashi District, Jingzhou City
projects.content_zh: 章华寺位于荆州市沙市区东北隅太师渊路北侧，东北邻太师渊公园，地处高阜，视野开阔。章华寺原名章台寺，得名于传此地为楚灵王六年（公元前535年）所建之章华台旧址，据寺碑记载：'章华古台，楚灵王故宫旧址也。'章华台俗称'细腰宫'，即'楚王好细腰，宫中多饿死'的楚灵王所建之离宫。然而关于章华台的位置的推测，众说纷纭，绝不仅此一处。从史料、传说和考古来看，有沙市说（即沙市章华寺所在），监利说，潜江说，武汉说，商水说，等等。据考古学界的逐年探索，对沙市之章华寺所在，或认为楚离宫故址豫章台所在。在唐代诗人韦庄《楚行吟》中如此描述：'章华台下草如烟，故郢城头月似弦。惆怅楚宫云雨后，露啼花笑一千年。'宋代苏轼则如此描述：'池空野迥楼阁小，唯有深竹藏狐狸。'可见至少在唐代，章华寺所在高台已湮灭成遗址，一派荒芜景象，或因此被当时文人附会成楚灵王'楚宫云雨'之处，当时已有僧人在此结茅静修，植下银杏树。据寺内碑文记载，元泰定二年（1325），高僧悟开禅师募化十年，在宋代草庐僧寮的基础上，大兴土木，始建为寺，名章台寺。元天历二年（1329），元文宗图帖睦尔曾亲临寺。到至正十四年（1354）悟开祖师参禅圆寂时，章台寺已达七殿九阁的规模，弟子遍天下。
projects.content_en: Zhanghua Temple is located on the north side of Taishiyuan Road in the northeast corner of Shashi District, Jingzhou City, adjacent to Taishiyuan Park to the northeast, situated on a high mound with a broad view. Zhanghua Temple was originally named Zhangtai Temple, named after the legend that this place is the former site of Zhanghua Terrace built in the 6th year of King Ling of Chu (535 BC). According to the temple stele records: 'Zhanghua Ancient Terrace is the former site of King Ling of Chu's palace.' Zhanghua Terrace is commonly called 'Slim Waist Palace,' i.e., the detached palace built by King Ling of Chu, of whom it is said 'the King of Chu loved slim waists, and many in the palace starved to death.' However, speculations about the location of Zhanghua Terrace are varied, certainly not limited to this one place. From historical materials, legends, and archaeology, there are the Shashi theory (i.e., where Zhanghua Temple in Shashi is located), the Jianli theory, the Qianjiang theory, the Wuhan theory, the Shangshui theory, etc. According to the year-by-year exploration of the archaeological community, the location of Zhanghua Temple in Shashi is considered by some to be the site of Yuzhang Terrace, the former site of the Chu detached palace. In Tang dynasty poet Wei Zhuang's 'Chanting of a Journey to Chu,' it is described as: 'Below Zhanghua Terrace, grass is like smoke; above the old Ying city head, the moon is like a string. Melancholy after the cloud and rain of the Chu palace, dew cries and flowers laugh for a thousand years.' Song dynasty Su Shi described it as: 'The pool is empty, the wilderness vast, the pavilions small; only deep bamboo hides foxes.' It can be seen that at least in the Tang, the high terrace where Zhanghua Temple is located had been annihilated into ruins, a scene of desolation, and perhaps because of this it was associated by literati of the time as the place of King Ling of Chu's 'cloud and rain of the Chu palace'; at that time there were already monks building thatched huts for quiet cultivation here, planting ginkgo trees. According to inscriptions inside the temple, in the 2nd year of Taiding, Yuan (1325), the eminent monk Wukai Chan Master spent ten years alms-raising, and on the basis of Song dynasty thatched huts and monk quarters, undertook large-scale construction, first building it as a temple, named Zhangtai Temple. In the 2nd year of Tianli, Yuan (1329), Emperor Wenzong of Yuan, Tugh Temür, once personally visited the temple. By the 14th year of Zhizheng (1354), when the founding master Wukai passed away in meditation, Zhangtai Temple had reached the scale of seven halls and nine pavilions, with disciples all over the world.

projects.name: 春秋阁
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市沙市区公园路1号中山公园内
projects.address_en: Inside Zhongshan Park, No.1 Gongyuan Road, Shashi District, Jingzhou City
projects.content_zh: 春秋阁位于荆州市沙市中山公园内，建于嘉庆十一年（1806），原位于荆州城东郊金龙寺，为寺内的一座戏楼，因金龙寺毁于天火，民国二十年（1931）迁建于现荆州市中山公园内东北隅，并被改建为阁楼，但总体仍保留着戏楼形式。阁内供奉关羽拜读《春秋》塑像，故名春秋阁。阁宇建在高大厚实的台阶之上，三面环水，绿树掩映。阁基为条石砌筑。正面置有横向石梯两道。阁平面呈矩形，通高13米，其中台高5.45米，阁分上下两层，上为阁、下为室。上层面阔三间，明间面阔5米，次间面阔2.5米，进深两间，均为4.2米。阁顶为单檐歇山琉璃顶，主体木结构，方形石柱支撑，底部为六层黑色祥云装饰高柱础，上刻有凤凰、牡丹、鹿等吉祥浮雕。前额中置'春秋阁'三个大字，正中两檐柱上悬挂一幅咏叹关羽的楹联：'绍尼山大一统心传遗憾三分缺汉鼎；为守土留两间正气声灵万古濯荆江。'每个转角处施双昂五踩斗拱两架，前檐下遍施斗拱，其上雕有华丽精致的镀金龙头、凤首和祥云图案。斗拱连同额枋均按旧制拼装，结构严密。上层台基的石栏杆上则雕有黑色的花虫、走兽等图案，朴素却不失细腻。
projects.content_en: Chunqiu Pavilion is located in Zhongshan Park, Shashi District, Jingzhou City, built in the 11th year of Jiaqing, Qing (1806), originally located at Jinlong Temple in the eastern suburb of Jingzhou City, serving as a theater tower in the temple; because Jinlong Temple was destroyed by natural fire, in the 20th year of the Republic (1931) it was relocated and built at the northeast corner inside the current Zhongshan Park of Jingzhou City, and was converted into a pavilion, but overall it still retains the theater tower form. Inside the pavilion is enshrined a statue of Guan Yu reading the 'Spring and Autumn Annals,' hence the name Chunqiu (Spring and Autumn) Pavilion. The pavilion is built on a tall and solid platform, surrounded by water on three sides, shaded by green trees. The pavilion base is built with strip stones. On the front there are two horizontal stone staircases. The pavilion has a rectangular plan, with a total height of 13 meters, of which the platform is 5.45 meters high; the pavilion is divided into upper and lower two stories, with the upper being the pavilion and the lower being rooms. The upper floor is three bays wide, with the central bay 5 meters wide and the secondary bays 2.5 meters wide, two bays deep, both 4.2 meters. The pavilion top is a single-eave hip-and-gable glazed roof, with a main wooden structure supported by square stone columns; the bottom has six layers of black auspicious-cloud decorated high column bases, carved with auspicious reliefs such as phoenixes, peonies, and deer. In the middle of the front forehead is placed the three large characters 'Chunqiu Pavilion'; on the two central eave columns hangs a couplet chanting Guan Yu: 'Inheriting the unified teaching of Nishan, regretting that the three kingdoms lack the Han tripod; leaving the righteous spirit of two spaces for defending the land, its soul cleanses the Jingjiang River for eternity.' At each corner, two ang five-step bracket sets are applied; under the front eave, bracket sets are applied everywhere, above which are carved gorgeous and exquisite gilded dragon heads, phoenix heads, and auspicious cloud patterns. The bracket sets together with the architraves are all assembled according to the old system, with a strict structure. On the stone railings of the upper platform base are carved black patterns of flowers, insects, and beasts, simple yet not lacking in delicacy.

projects.name: 沙市民居
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市沙市区胜利街等
projects.address_en: Shengli Street, etc., Shashi District, Jingzhou City
highlights: 洋式与传统结合的建筑风貌
projects.content_zh: '天下口，要汉口，天下市，算沙市。'明清时期，沙市凭借其便利的漕运已成为湖北仅次于汉口的繁华商会。随着清末沙市的进一步开埠，其街市也进一步繁荣和开放。如《沙市志略校由》载：'沙市其为楚都外港，当随之而兴。且荆襄为旧日西南各省人都通商，沙市正其枢纽。'《竹枝词》'偶咽沙头市，玲珑竹岸窗'，知其繁盛，在唐时已然矣……青石大街、刘家场、丝线街，赤帝宫街等，全市精华，荟萃于斯。'又如《沙市志记》载：'……至清光绪二十一年中日《马关条约》，开沙市、苏州、杭州为商埠后，此处更见兴盛耳。'胜利街、崇文街（俗称'丝线街'）、中山路是当时最为繁华的街市。明清时期，得胜街沿街商铺密集，故名'九十铺'或'九十埠'，荆州沦陷时曾名兴亚街，光复后改为中正一、二、三街，1949年后改现名，现为荆州市传统历史文化保护街区。胜利街西起管家牌，东至青龙观，长约1.8公里，青石路面。街两侧为密集的传统民居，建于晚清的邓氏住宅、恒春懋大药房等都在此地。其中，较典型的是清光绪二十七年（1901）满汉旗后裔邓氏迁至沙市九十埠兴建的大宅，构造、格局、装修、雕饰均非常讲究。沙市中山路类似汉口中山路以及广州、天津等地的一些街道，它们处于中国建筑承上启下、中西交错、新老并存、相互影响的阶段，具有独特的历史价值和建筑艺术价值。中山大马路和原青石大街、拖船埠、三府街、刘家场一起，作为商埠城市的骨架，出现了不少中西合璧的洋行、领事馆、商铺、民居、会馆。中山路沿街商铺的设计吸取了不少洋式店面形式，临街建筑一般3-4层，大多横三段，竖三段划分。有的采用西方古典凹拱式门窗线脚，有的采用西方方柱子或壁柱。柱子上多用横向窗脚按功能划分墙体，正面开间檐部有折线或曲线状的山墙装饰。在建材上，较早采用了铁件、油漆、水泥、玻璃等新兴建材，同时，我国民间常用的建材如布瓦、薄砖、杉松木料等也得到了广泛应用。当时的金融商业建筑中，较为典型的则有同震银楼、老天宝银楼、老丹凤银楼、老万年银楼、聚兴城、徐万源布庄等。
projects.content_en: 'The mouth under heaven, count Hankou; the market under heaven, count Shashi.' During the Ming and Qing, Shashi, relying on its convenient water transport, had become a prosperous commercial city in Hubei second only to Hankou. With the further opening of Shashi as a treaty port at the end of the Qing, its streets and markets further prospered and opened up. As recorded in the 'Collation of Shashi Local Records': 'Shashi as the outer port of the Chu capital, should prosper accordingly. Moreover, Jingxiang was the hub for merchants from all southwestern provinces in the old days, and Shashi was exactly its pivot.' The 'Bamboo Branch Ci' says 'Occasionally passing the Shatou market, exquisite bamboo shore windows,' showing that its prosperity already existed in the Tang... Qingshi Street, Liujiachang, Sixian Street, Chidigong Street, etc., the essence of the whole city, gathered here.' Another example from the 'Records of Shashi': '...After the Treaty of Shimonoseki between China and Japan in the 21st year of Guangxu, Qing, opened Shashi, Suzhou, and Hangzhou as treaty ports, this place became even more prosperous.' Shengli Street, Chongwen Street (commonly called 'Sixian Street'), and Zhongshan Road were the most prosperous streets at that time. During the Ming and Qing, Desheng Street had dense shops along the street, hence the name 'Ninety Shops' or 'Ninety Ports'; during the Japanese occupation of Jingzhou it was once named Xingya Street, after recovery it was changed to Zhongzheng First, Second, and Third Streets, and after 1949 changed to its current name; it is now a traditional historical and cultural protection block in Jingzhou City. Shengli Street starts from Guanjia Pai in the west and reaches Qinglong Temple in the east, about 1.8 km long, with bluestone pavement. On both sides of the street are dense traditional dwellings; the Deng family residence built in the late Qing and the Hengchunmao Pharmacy are all located here. Among them, the more typical one is the large mansion built by the Deng family, descendants of Manchu-Han bannermen, who moved to Shashi's Ninety Ports in the 27th year of Guangxu, Qing (1901); its construction, layout, decoration, and carvings are all very exquisite. Zhongshan Road in Shashi is similar to Zhongshan Road in Hankou and some streets in Guangzhou, Tianjin and other places; they are at a stage where Chinese architecture connects the past and future, with Chinese and Western styles interlaced, old and new coexisting, and mutually influencing, having unique historical value and architectural artistic value. Zhongshan Main Road, together with the original Qingshi Street, Tuochuan Port, Sanfu Street, and Liujiachang, as the skeleton of the treaty port city, saw the emergence of many Chinese-Western combined foreign firms, consulates, shops, dwellings, and guildhalls. The design of shops along Zhongshan Road absorbed many Western-style storefront forms; the street-facing buildings are generally 3-4 stories, mostly divided horizontally into three sections and vertically into three sections. Some adopt Western classical concave arch door and window moldings, some adopt Western square columns or pilasters. On the columns, horizontal window feet are mostly used to divide the wall by function, with broken-line or curved gable decorations on the front eaves. In terms of building materials, emerging building materials such as iron parts, paint, cement, and glass were adopted relatively early; at the same time, commonly used Chinese folk building materials such as cloth tiles, thin bricks, and fir and pine wood were also widely used. Among the financial and commercial buildings of the time, the more typical ones include Tongzhen Silver Building, Laotianbao Silver Building, Laodanfeng Silver Building, Laowannian Silver Building, Juxingcheng, Xu Wanyuan Cloth Store, etc.

projects.name: 沙市同震银楼
projects.level: 优秀历史建筑
projects.address: 荆州市沙市区中山路73号
projects.address_en: No.73 Zhongshan Road, Shashi District, Jingzhou City
projects.type: 民居建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
highlights: 仿汉口璇宫饭店建筑造型
projects.content_zh: 清光绪十一年（1885），宁波商人童澄海出资兴建了同震银楼，该楼是当时沙市最大的金银首饰商铺，也是沙市较早的巴洛克风格圆拱顶建筑。其建筑面积为828平方米，正立面采用奉化产玉石砌筑，赭红色水泥砂浆抹面。窗、门、阳台均有浮雕花饰。内部原为木屋架结构，按清代营造法式制作。双坡屋盖上置有玻璃天棚，'U'形回廊，有镂花直棂式推窗。三方围护体均为灌斗墙，因自重较重，恐地基下沉，施工时基础采用铁箍木桩，开沙市地基处理之先河。民国二十三年（1934年）扩宽中山路时，按原样朝北后退5米重建，梁柱改为钢筋混凝土现浇。
projects.content_en: In the 11th year of Guangxu, Qing (1885), Ningbo merchant Tong Chenghai funded the construction of Tongzhen Silver Building; this building was the largest gold and silver jewelry shop in Shashi at that time, and also one of the earlier Baroque-style round-arch-top buildings in Shashi. Its building area is 828 square meters; the front facade is built with jade stone produced in Fenghua, plastered with ochre-red cement mortar. The windows, doors, and balconies all have relief floral decorations. The interior was originally a wooden roof frame structure, made according to Qing dynasty construction methods. On the double-slope roof there is a glass canopy, a 'U'-shaped corridor, and openwork straight-lattice push windows. The three-sided enclosing walls are all bucket-filled walls; due to heavy self-weight and fear of foundation settlement, iron-hooped wooden piles were used for the foundation during construction, pioneering foundation treatment in Shashi. When widening Zhongshan Road in the 23rd year of the Republic (1934), it was rebuilt 5 meters backward to the north according to the original appearance, and the beams and columns were changed to cast-in-place reinforced concrete.

projects.name: 沙市天宝银楼
projects.level: 优秀历史建筑
projects.address: 荆州市沙市区中山路73号
projects.address_en: No.73 Zhongshan Road, Shashi District, Jingzhou City
projects.type: 民居建筑·钢筋混凝土结构
highlights: 仿汉口璇宫饭店建筑造型
projects.content_zh: 1920年，汉阳帮老板洪发利兴建天宝银楼，1949年前为私人银楼，1949年后曾改作沙市百货公司纺织品商店。该楼模仿了汉口景明洋行设计的璇宫饭店的建筑造型，四层钢筋混凝土结构，建筑面积886平方米，立面两端凸出，正中每层皆有双柱圈状阳台，造型精致。顶部左右原各有一角塔，中部有钢筋混凝土结构亭一座，皆在'文革'中遭到破坏。
projects.content_en: In 1920, Hanyang gang boss Hong Fali built Tianbao Silver Building; before 1949 it was a private silver building, and after 1949 it was converted into a textile goods store of the Shashi Department Store Company. This building imitated the architectural form of the Xuangong Hotel designed by Hankou Jingming Foreign Firm; it is a four-story reinforced concrete structure with a building area of 886 square meters; both ends of the facade protrude, and each floor in the center has a double-column circular balcony, with an exquisite shape. Originally there was a corner tower on each side of the top, and a reinforced concrete pavilion in the middle, all of which were damaged during the 'Cultural Revolution.'

projects.name: 沙市中华圣公会
projects.level: 优秀历史建筑
projects.address: 荆州市沙市区北京路269号（沙市三中内）
projects.address_en: No.269 Beijing Road (inside Shashi No.3 Middle School), Shashi District, Jingzhou City
projects.content_zh: 沙市中华圣公会于1900由美国教会所建，现存建筑为会长、传道人员住宅，1953年出租给沙市中学作宿舍。住宅建筑面积376平方米，二层砖木结构，矩形平面，南面正中设入口，每层有房屋三间。外立面采用壁柱与券拱作装饰，上有券顶石，红瓦歇山坡屋顶。
projects.content_en: The Episcopal Church of Shashi was built by the American church in 1900; the existing building is the residence of the president and preaching personnel, and was rented to Shashi Middle School as a dormitory in 1953. The residential building has an area of 376 square meters, a two-story brick-wood structure, a rectangular plan, with an entrance set in the center of the south face, and three rooms on each floor. The exterior facade uses pilasters and arches as decoration, with arched top stones above, and a red-tile hip-and-gable sloped roof.

projects.name: 监利周老嘴正街及民居
projects.name_en: Laozheng Street and Vernacular Dwellings in Zhoulaozui
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 监利县周老嘴镇老正街
projects.address_en: Laozheng Street, Zhoulaozui Town, Jianli County
highlights: 湘鄂西革命根据地中心
projects.content_zh: 周老嘴镇位于监利县北部，洪湖西岸，江汉平原南缘。据当地周、李、杨三姓族谱载，其祖早在西周宣王时就居住此地，此地先后为容城国、成都王国、华容县、监利县的治所。历史上此处河湖密布，监利县的治所。旧时有小荆河、西荆河、内荆河、龙潭河、胭脂河从南到北，由西向东在这里汇入洪湖，水陆交通便利，自古便为渡口，也是古华容道的必经之地，赤壁之战中，周老嘴为魏兵辎重后方，有'仓卒垸'之称。明嘉靖年间，民间自发筹款修建了老正街石板街道。清初，南北商贾多涉此地，周老嘴逐渐发展成为集镇。第二次国内革命战争时期，周老嘴曾是湘鄂西革命根据地的中心，以及湘鄂西地区政治、军事、经济的中心。湘鄂西革命根据地旧址主要分布在监利县周老嘴地区和洪湖市瞿家湾地区，后者见下文'洪湖瞿家湾老街及民居'条。在后来的战争及政治运动中，周老嘴的一些老建筑如心慈庵、栅子门、五显庙、瑶台观、河王庙等建筑相继被拆。但历经千年，古镇仍保留了明清时的街巷格局和传统风貌。老街正是周老嘴古镇的主街，与南侧次街沿河街以及更南端西荆河向东向平行展开，全长628米，宽约3米。明清时期，老正街上分布的商铺有烟草铺、药铺、百货铺、南货铺、理发店、茶馆、饭馆、金银铺、布丝店、当铺、骡马店等，作坊有面粉作坊、春米行、糟坊、油料交易行、杂粮行、碾米作坊、豆腐坊等。
projects.content_en: Zhoulaozui Town is located in the north of Jianli County, on the west bank of Honghu Lake, at the southern edge of the Jianghan Plain. According to the genealogy of the three local surnames Zhou, Li, and Yang, their ancestors lived here as early as the reign of King Xuan of the Western Zhou; this place was successively the seat of Rongcheng State, Chengdu Kingdom, Huarong County, and Jianli County. Historically, rivers and lakes were densely distributed here, and it was the seat of Jianli County. In old times, the Xiaojing River, Xijing River, Neijing River, Longtan River, and Yanzhi River flowed from south to north and from west to east into Honghu Lake here, with convenient land and water transportation; since ancient times it has been a ferry crossing and also a necessary place on the ancient Huarong Road. In the Battle of Red Cliffs, Zhoulaozui was the rear of Wei army's supplies, known as 'Cangcu Yuan' (Emergency Depot). During the Jiajing period of the Ming, the people自发 raised funds to build the stone-paved Laozheng Street. At the beginning of the Qing, merchants from north and south often came here, and Zhoulaozui gradually developed into a market town. During the Second Revolutionary Civil War, Zhoulaozui was once the center of the Hunan-Western Hubei Revolutionary Base Area, as well as the political, military, and economic center of the Hunan-Western Hubei region. The former sites of the Hunan-Western Hubei Revolutionary Base Area are mainly distributed in the Zhoulaozui area of Jianli County and the Qujiawan area of Honghu City; the latter is seen in the entry 'Qujiawan Old Street and Vernacular Dwellings in Honghu' below. In subsequent wars and political movements, some old buildings in Zhoulaozui, such as Xinci Nunnery, Zhazi Gate, Wuxian Temple, Yaotai Temple, and Hewang Temple, were successively demolished. But after a thousand years, the ancient town still retains the street and lane pattern and traditional style of the Ming and Qing. The old street is exactly the main street of the Zhoulaozui ancient town, parallel to the secondary street Yanhe Street on the south side and the further south Xijing River extending eastward, with a total length of 628 meters and a width of about 3 meters. During the Ming and Qing, the shops distributed on Laozheng Street included tobacco shops, medicine shops, general stores, southern goods shops, barbershops, teahouses, restaurants, gold and silver shops, cloth and silk shops, pawnshops, mule and horse inns, etc.; workshops included flour workshops, rice-pounding shops, distilleries, oil trading houses, grain shops, rice-milling workshops, tofu shops, etc.

projects.name: 程家集民居/监利程集老街（石板街）及民居
projects.name_en: Vernacular Dwellings in Chengjiaji / Old Street (Stone Slab Street) and Vernacular Dwellings in Chengji, Jianli
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市监利县程集镇程集老街
projects.address_en: Chengji Old Street, Chengji Town, Jianli County, Jingzhou City
projects.type: 民居建筑·砖木、砖石结构
highlights: 商业铺面、魏桥、文昌宫、民居整体风貌
projects.content_zh: 程家集今称程集，地处监利县西陲，位于江陵、监利、石首三县（市）交界之处。程集始建于南宋嘉定年间，据当地居民流传，南宋初年，有程姓富户在此地临水处辟建码头开设店铺，形成集市，始称程家集。后沿河发展成东西连向的小街，至明永乐年间，形成了两街相交的三岔型布局，沿街店铺竞列，为程集之鼎盛时期。直至清初，程家集仍是当时远近闻名之商埠，一度有'小汉口'之称。镇内现存的中兴街、程集老街和三岔街，都具有较好的明清街道风貌。
projects.content_en: Chengjiaji is now called Chengji, located in the western border of Jianli County, at the junction of Jiangling, Jianli, and Shishou three counties (cities). Chengji was first built during the Jiading period of the Southern Song. According to local residents'流传, in the early Southern Song, a wealthy household surnamed Cheng built a dock and opened shops at the waterside here, forming a market, initially called Chengjiaji. Later it developed along the river into an east-west connected small street; by the Yongle period of the Ming, a three-fork layout with two intersecting streets was formed, with shops competing along the street, marking the heyday of Chengji. Until the early Qing, Chengjiaji was still a well-known commercial port near and far, once known as 'Little Hankou.' The existing Zhongxing Street, Chengji Old Street, and Sancha Street in the town all have good Ming-Qing street styles.

projects.name: 文昌宫
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市监利县程集镇三岔街最南端
projects.address_en: Southernmost end of Sancha Street, Chengji Town, Jianli County, Jingzhou City
highlights: 前殿、大雄宝殿、弥陀殿、斋缮房、客堂
projects.content_zh: 文昌宫位于三岔街最南端，现存有前殿、大雄宝殿、弥陀殿、斋缮房、客堂等五座主要建筑。相传明朝天启年间初建，清道光年间易地新建，规模宏大。1938年遭火灾焚毁，翌年秋在原废址上重修小庙一座。1950年改建为粮仓，1986年增修大雄宝殿及其他配套工程。
projects.content_en: Wenchang Palace is located at the southernmost end of Sancha Street, with five main buildings existing: the front hall, Mahavira Hall, Mituo Hall, dining and preparation rooms, and guest hall. Legend has it that it was first built during the Tianqi period of the Ming, and was rebuilt at a different location during the Daoguang period of the Qing, with a grand scale. It was destroyed by fire in 1938, and the following autumn a small temple was rebuilt on the original ruined site. In 1950 it was converted into a granary, and in 1986 the Mahavira Hall and other supporting projects were added and repaired.

projects.name: 程集46号民居
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市监利县程集镇程集老街北段
projects.address_en: Northern section of Chengji Old Street, Chengji Town, Jianli County, Jingzhou City
projects.content_zh: 该建筑位于程集老街北段，建于清代。建筑为两开间的三合院形式，两进一天井，硬山屋顶，一层砖木结构，开间共5.3米，进深共17.8米。临街立面为木排门，中间以横梁隔开，上半部分封闭，下半部分木板可拆卸，形成开敞的大门和临街柜台。其余围护结构均为青砖砌筑成的空斗墙，屋面材料为青灰色的冷摊瓦。
projects.content_en: This building is located in the northern section of Chengji Old Street, built in the Qing Dynasty. The building is in the form of a two-bay three-sided courtyard, with two entries and one courtyard, a gable roof, a one-story brick-wood structure, with a total bay width of 5.3 meters and a total depth of 17.8 meters. The street-facing facade is a wooden plank door, separated in the middle by a crossbeam; the upper part is closed, and the lower part's wooden boards are removable, forming an open main door and a street-facing counter. The remaining enclosure structures are all cavity walls built with blue bricks, and the roof material is blue-gray cold-laid tiles.

projects.name: 程集58号民居
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市监利县程集镇程集老街中段
projects.address_en: Middle section of Chengji Old Street, Chengji Town, Jianli County, Jingzhou City
projects.content_zh: 该建筑位于程集老街中段，建于清代。建筑形式为两进一天斗，硬山屋顶，一层砖木结构，带阁楼，面阔三间，开间共7.84米，进深共21.4米。原为临街店铺，1949年后改为临街住宅，近10年一直经营茶馆至今，建筑功能为前店后宅，前后两进房屋的堂屋和左侧的厢房全部摆放茶桌，仅右侧部分厢房作为屋主的卧室，屋后院落作为菜园。
projects.content_en: This building is located in the middle section of Chengji Old Street, built in the Qing Dynasty. The building form is two entries and one courtyard, with a gable roof, a one-story brick-wood structure with an attic, three bays wide, with a total bay width of 7.84 meters and a total depth of 21.4 meters. Originally a street-facing shop, it was converted into a street-facing residence after 1949, and has been operating a teahouse for nearly 10 years to this day; the building function is front-shop-back-dwelling, with the main halls of the front and rear two entries and the left wing rooms all furnished with tea tables, only the right part of the wing rooms serving as the owner's bedroom, and the courtyard behind the house serving as a vegetable garden.

projects.name: 程集76号民居
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市监利县程集镇程集老街中段
projects.address_en: Middle section of Chengji Old Street, Chengji Town, Jianli County, Jingzhou City
projects.content_zh: 该建筑位于程集老街中段，建于清代。一进屋架，局部阁楼，整体中轴对称布局，在程集镇的历史建筑中尺度较大。该宅过去作为店铺使用，临街面为活动木排门，二层阁楼层临街有出挑的栏杆，左侧两间开荒弃，无室内隔断，右侧临街部分经营茶馆和棋牌室，堂屋内侧隔出一倒房（俗称拔巷）作为厨房，内侧厢房为主卧室。
projects.content_en: This building is located in the middle section of Chengji Old Street, built in the Qing Dynasty. One-entry roof frame, with a partial attic, an overall centrally symmetric layout, and a relatively large scale among the historical buildings of Chengji Town. This residence was used as a shop in the past; the street-facing side is movable wooden plank doors, and the second-story attic floor has overhanging railings facing the street; the two bays on the left are abandoned with no interior partitions, the right street-facing part operates a teahouse and chess room, an inverted room (commonly called a 'pulled alley') is partitioned inside the main hall as a kitchen, and the inner wing room is the main bedroom.

projects.name: 程集126号民居
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市监利县程集镇程集老街南端
projects.address_en: Southern section of Chengji Old Street, Chengji Town, Jianli County, Jingzhou City
highlights: 三进一天井一天斗形制
原监利县电力局局长刘少方旧宅
projects.content_zh: 126号民居位于老街南端，建于清代，为原监利县电力局局长刘少方旧宅，坐东朝西，单层带阁楼，三进一天井一天斗，硬山屋顶，砖木结构，沿街面阔三间，宽7.85米，进深23.47米。临街立面亦为典型的木排门，其余围护结构均为青砖空斗墙。
projects.content_en: Dwelling No.126 is located at the southern end of the old street, built in the Qing Dynasty; it was the former residence of Liu Shaofang, director of the Jianli County Electric Power Bureau, facing west from east, single-story with an attic, three entries with one courtyard and one skywell, gable roof, brick-wood structure, three bays wide along the street, 7.85 meters wide and 23.47 meters deep. The street-facing facade is also a typical wooden plank door, and the remaining enclosure structures are all blue-brick cavity walls.

projects.name: 监利容城镇民宅
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市监利县容城镇民主路229号（原为201号）
projects.address_en: No.229 Minzhu Road (formerly No.201), Rongcheng Town, Jianli County, Jingzhou City
highlights: 民宅室内梁架及楼梯及装饰
projects.content_zh: 监利容城镇民宅又称湘鄂西特委机关旧址，是1930年中共容城特委所设之处。同时，作为传统民居，该建筑又是建于清代的传统民居，具有典型的江汉平原特色。监利容城镇民宅1949年前是监利县城北正街'方松泰'商号，始建于清代，坐东北朝西南，前铺后寝，上下两层，平面为三进四合院布局，占地345平方米，建筑主体砖木结构，硬山布瓦顶，通面阔三间10.8米，通进深31.8米；结构形式为'七柱九檩'，鼓皮隔墙。第一进天井上架有天斗，中间为前厅和堂屋，两边四间厢房，有楼梯通向二楼；堂屋一层通高，前厅、厢房和后院有二层阁楼前后贯通，可供居住或堆放杂物；最后一进房屋建有两层。天斗为双坡屋面，为双层屋面，盖有布瓦，造型小巧，重量直接落在周围的屋面上，屋脊两端有飞檐。主入口安有华丽的门头，饰有卷草、人物等雕刻图案，拴马石也有石刻装饰；横梁表面、挑梁端头等构件都有木雕装饰，隔扇和花镂窗也饰以各色图案。2012年5月开始，该旧址经历了近两年的保护性修缮工作，并在此基础上进行了革命历史和容城地方史的陈列布展工作。维修前，第一进宅院住了8户人家，第二进的房屋全部坍塌，第三进也是摇摇欲坠。据监利县人民政府网站发布的新闻：维修时，为了尽可能还原历史原貌，减少修缮带来对原貌的破坏，'参与此次修缮工作的人员，都是年近八旬的手艺精湛的老艺人'。容城镇民宅'保持了原有建筑形式、建筑结构、建筑材料、建筑工艺'，达到了'整旧如旧、修旧如故'的效果。
projects.content_en: The dwellings in Rongcheng Town, Jianli, also called the former site of the Hunan-Western Hubei Special Committee, were where the Rongcheng Special Committee of the Communist Party of China was set up in 1930. At the same time, as a traditional dwelling, this building is a traditional dwelling built in the Qing Dynasty, with typical Jianghan Plain characteristics. Before 1949, the dwellings in Rongcheng Town, Jianli, were the 'Fang Songtai' firm on North Zheng Street in the county town of Jianli; first built in the Qing Dynasty, facing southwest from northeast, with shop in front and living quarters behind, two stories up and down, with a three-entry courtyard layout, covering 345 square meters; the main building is of brick-wood structure, with a gable tile roof, a total width of three bays of 10.8 meters, and a total depth of 31.8 meters; the structural form is 'seven columns and nine purlins,' with drum-skin partition walls. Above the first-entry courtyard is a skywell (tiandou), with the front hall and main hall in the middle, and four wing rooms on both sides, with stairs leading to the second floor; the main hall has a full-height first floor, and the front hall, wing rooms, and backyard have two-story attics贯通 front and back, available for living or storing sundries; the last entry building has two stories. The skywell has a double-slope roof, a double-layer roof, covered with tile, with a compact shape, its weight directly resting on the surrounding roof, and the two ends of the ridge have flying eaves. The main entrance has a gorgeous doorhead, decorated with carved patterns such as scrolling grass and figures, and the horse-tying stones also have stone-carved decorations; components such as the surface of the crossbeams and the ends of the挑 beams all have wood-carved decorations, and the lattice partitions and carved windows are also decorated with various patterns. Starting in May 2012, this former site underwent nearly two years of protective repair work, and on this basis, exhibition and display work on revolutionary history and local history of Rongcheng was carried out. Before the repair, the first-entry courtyard housed 8 households, the second-entry buildings had all collapsed, and the third entry was also crumbling. According to news published on the website of the Jianli County People's Government: during the repair, in order to restore the historical original appearance as much as possible and reduce the damage to the original appearance caused by repair, 'the personnel participating in this repair work were all skilled old artisans nearly eighty years old.' The dwellings in Rongcheng Town 'maintained the original architectural form, architectural structure, building materials, and building craftsmanship,' achieving the effect of 'repairing the old as old, restoring the old as before.'

projects.name: 洪湖瞿家湾老街及民居
projects.name_en: Old Street and Vernacular Dwellings in Qujiawan
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市监利县瞿家湾镇
projects.address_en: Qujiawan Town, Jianli County, Jingzhou City
projects.content_zh: 瞿家湾镇位于洪湖市与监利县交界处，南临洪湖，北濒内荆河，东接沙口镇，西邻监利县柳关。此地属古云梦泽，湖水浩荡，芦苇丛生，有'水乡泽国'之称。据《瞿家湾志》记载，北宋初期，此地名为'张家铺'，已有外地渔民迁居至此，以种田和捕鱼为业。明弘治九年（1496），江陵草市人瞿文暹与女子周氏定居长夏河（即内荆河）畔，插标为记，开荒造田，成为瞿氏家族在瞿家湾的第一代开拓者。嘉靖年间，此地在瞿文暹之子胜祥、胜禄经营下逐渐形成村落。崇祯十七年（1644）改名为'打铳湾'，因此地人经常出湖打野鸭作为生活来源。此时，瞿家湾沿着内荆河朝东、西向发展为上湾、中湾、下湾三个自然村。
projects.content_en: Qujiawan Town is located at the junction of Honghu City and Jianli County, bordering Honghu Lake to the south, facing the Neijing River to the north, connecting Shakou Town to the east, and neighboring Liuguan in Jianli County to the west. This place belongs to the ancient Yunmeng Marsh, with vast lake waters and dense reeds, known as a 'land of waters and marshes.' According to the 'Qujiawan Annals,' in the early Northern Song, this place was named 'Zhangjiapu,' and already had fishermen from other places moving here, making a living by farming and fishing. In the 9th year of Hongzhi, Ming (1496), Qu Wenxian from Caoshi, Jiangling, and a woman surnamed Zhou settled by the Changxia River (i.e., the Neijing River), inserting markers as records, reclaiming wasteland for farming, becoming the first-generation pioneers of the Qu family in Qujiawan. During the Jiajing period, this place gradually formed a village under the management of Qu Wenxian's sons Shengxiang and Shenglu. In the 17th year of Chongzhen (1644), it was renamed 'Dachongwan' (Gun-Bay), because people here often went out onto the lake to hunt wild ducks as a source of livelihood. At this time, Qujiawan developed eastward and westward along the Neijing River into three natural villages: Shangwan (Upper Bay), Zhongwan (Middle Bay), and Xiawan (Lower Bay).

projects.name: 瞿氏宗祠/宗伯府/湘鄂西省苏维埃政府、联县政府、新六军军部暨湘鄂西革命历史遗迹陈列室
projects.name_en: Qu Family Ancestral Hall / Zongbo Mansion / Hunan-Western Hubei Provincial Soviet Government, United County Government, New Sixth Army Headquarters and Exhibition Hall of Hunan-Western Hubei Revolutionary Historical Relics
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市监利县瞿家湾镇老街西段南侧
projects.address_en: South side of west section of Old Street, Qujiawan Town, Jianli County, Jingzhou City
highlights: 瞿家湾形制最高的建筑
六柱五间仿木结构牌楼
projects.content_zh: 宗伯府坐落于瞿家湾老街西段南侧，坐南朝北，是瞿氏家族的祠堂，也是瞿家湾形制最高的建筑。据《瞿氏族谱》记载，宗伯府始建于清代中叶，后多有重建、扩建：'我族祠宇之创造，约当乾隆中叶，祠只一重，可由朝门直达寝殿。道光年间大水，有浮尸撞入院墙，族众目击心伤，经户道传忠公移建街头，将原祠改作拜殿，添修正殿并朝门为三重。'宗伯府最主要的功能是存放和祭祀祖先神位，同时还是举行重要礼仪活动（婚丧）、议事、社交（迎宾宴客）的场所。现存建筑为三进二天井，正立面为一六柱五间砖仿木结构牌楼，第一进为朝门，第二进为拜殿，第三进为正殿。单檐硬山灰布瓦顶，通面阔16.2米，通进深30米，落地柱108根。屋顶设置多处采光亮瓦。
projects.content_en: Zongbo Mansion is located on the south side of the west section of Qujiawan Old Street, facing north from south; it is the ancestral hall of the Qu family and also the building with the highest standard in Qujiawan. According to the 'Qu Family Genealogy,' Zongbo Mansion was first built in the mid-Qing Dynasty, and was later rebuilt and expanded many times: 'The creation of our clan's ancestral hall was approximately in the mid-Qianlong period, with only one layer, allowing direct access from the gate to the sleeping hall. During the great flood in the Daoguang period, floating corpses crashed into the courtyard wall, and the clan members were heartbroken at the sight; through the efforts of household head Chuan Zhonggong, it was moved and built at the street head, converting the original hall into a worship hall, and adding the main hall and gate to make three layers.' The main function of Zongbo Mansion was to store and sacrifice ancestral spirit tablets, and it was also a place for holding important ceremonial activities (weddings and funerals), deliberation, and socializing (welcoming guests and banqueting). The existing building is three entries with two courtyards; the front facade is a six-column five-bay brick imitation-wood paifang; the first entry is the gate, the second entry is the worship hall, and the third entry is the main hall. Single-eave gable gray tile roof, with a total width of 16.2 meters and a total depth of 30 meters, with 108 floor columns. Multiple lighting bright tiles are set on the roof.

projects.name: 瞿声宝宅/湘鄂西省委会旧址
projects.name_en: Qu Shengbao Residence / Former Site of Hunan-Western Hubei Provincial Committee
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市监利县瞿家湾镇老街北侧西段
projects.address_en: Western section of north side of Old Street, Qujiawan Town, Jianli County, Jingzhou City
highlights: 瞿家湾商人瞿声宝住宅兼棺木店铺
projects.content_zh: 该宅为瞿家湾商人瞿声宝住宅兼棺木店铺，建于1922年，位于老街北侧西段，坐北朝南，前店后宅，穿斗式梁架砖木结构，共三进屋架，局部二层，通进深24.4米，通面阔11.3米。第一进为店铺，敞口门面，进深九柱十檩，共五间。檐下阁楼堂面装有堂面门二合（双门扇），铺面左右装有柜台活动铺板，堂面装有大板门六合，板门左右设抱鼓石一对，前檐柱上装有云龙纹撑拱四根。第二进为厢房，局部二层，进深五柱五檩，厢房围绕天斗布置；第三进为正屋，进深九柱九檩。1997年对该建筑进行抢救性维修，复原当年省委机关的室内陈设。
projects.content_en: This residence was the home and coffin shop of Qu Shengbao, a merchant of Qujiawan, built in 1922, located in the western section of the north side of Old Street, facing south, with shop in front and residence behind, a column-and-tie frame brick-wood structure, with a total of three-entry roof frames, partially two-story, with a total depth of 24.4 meters and a total width of 11.3 meters. The first entry is a shop, with an open storefront, a depth of nine columns and ten purlins, totaling five bays. Under the eaves, the attic hall face is fitted with two hall-face doors (double door leaves); on the left and right of the storefront are installed movable counter boards; the hall face is fitted with six large board doors; on the left and right of the board doors are set a pair of drum-holding stones; on the front eave columns are installed four cloud-dragon pattern supporting brackets. The second entry is the wing rooms, partially two-story, with a depth of five columns and five purlins; the wing rooms are arranged around the skywell; the third entry is the main house, with a depth of nine columns and nine purlins. In 1997, rescue repairs were carried out on this building, restoring the interior furnishings of the provincial committee organ of that year.

projects.name: 春义行/《工农日报》社等革命机关旧址
projects.name_en: Chunyixing / Former Site of Revolutionary Organs such as the 'Workers and Peasants Daily' Office
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市监利县瞿家湾镇老街东段北侧
projects.address_en: North side of eastern section of Old Street, Qujiawan Town, Jianli County, Jingzhou City
highlights: 商人瞿宏佐的住宅兼店铺
projects.content_zh: 春义行原为商人瞿宏佐的住宅兼店铺，始建于1928年，位于老街东段北侧，坐北朝南，原为三进，其中第三进原为铺面，现已无存。现存建筑为二进合院，通进深21.3米，通面阔7米，砖木结构，单檐硬山灰布瓦顶。第一进为堂屋，第二进为套间，一、二进间有天井；堂屋局部二层，靠近天井处有一天斗。建筑外立面为砖砌西式墙面。1931—1932年，湘鄂西省《工农日报》社、总工会、少共（共青团）省委、妇女生活改善委员会（省妇委）等群团机关曾设于此。1994年对该建筑进行了局部维修，复原部分室内陈设。
projects.content_en: Chunyixing was originally the residence and shop of merchant Qu Hongzuo, first built in 1928, located on the north side of the eastern section of Old Street, facing south, originally three entries, of which the third entry was originally a storefront and now no longer exists. The existing building is a two-entry courtyard, with a total depth of 21.3 meters and a total width of 7 meters, of brick-wood structure, with a single-eave gable gray tile roof. The first entry is the main hall, the second entry is an inner room, with a courtyard between the first and second entries; the main hall is partially two-story, with a skywell near the courtyard. The building's exterior facade is a brick-built Western-style wall. From 1931 to 1932, the Hunan-Western Hubei Provincial 'Workers and Peasants Daily' Office, General Trade Union, Provincial Committee of the Communist Youth League, Women's Life Improvement Committee (Provincial Women's Committee), and other mass organizations were once located here. In 1994, partial repairs were carried out on this building, restoring some interior furnishings.

projects.name: 南平文庙
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市公安县南平镇南平正街200号
projects.address_en: No.200 Nanping Zheng Street, Nanping Town, Gongan County, Jingzhou City
projects.content_zh: 南平镇为湘鄂边陲重镇，曾是公安县老县城。南平文庙是有着双重价值的省级文物保护单位：既是古代建筑，也是革命文物。据革命史料记载，1930年，刚成立的红二军团在大成殿内召开过前委联席会议。作为古代建筑的南平文庙始建于明代，原有黄墙、棂星门、礼门、义路、状元桥、泮池、大成门、大成殿、启圣殿、东庑、西庑等建筑，此外还有照墙、东斋、西斋组成的东西侧跨院。清同治十二年（1873），南...
projects.content_en: Nanping Town is an important town on the border of Hunan and Hubei, and was once the old county seat of Gongan County. Nanping Temple of Confucius is a provincial-level cultural heritage protection unit with dual value: it is both an ancient building and a revolutionary cultural relic. According to revolutionary historical records, in 1930, the newly established Second Red Army Corps held a joint meeting of the former committee in the Dacheng Hall. As an ancient building, Nanping Temple of Confucius was first built in the Ming Dynasty, originally having yellow walls, Lingxing Gate, Ritual Gate, Righteousness Path, Zhuangyuan Bridge, Pan Pond, Dacheng Gate, Dacheng Hall, Qisheng Hall, East Wing, West Wing, and other buildings; in addition, there were east and west side courtyards composed of screen walls, East Studio, and West Studio. In the 12th year of Tongzhi, Qing (1873), Nan...

projects.name: 云联塔
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市松滋市老城镇宝塔村宝塔水库东北角
projects.address_en: Northeast corner of Baota Reservoir, Baota Village, Laocheng Town, Songzi City, Jingzhou City
highlights: 六角五层楼阁式空心砖塔
projects.content_zh: 云联塔建于道光二十八年（1848），现占地500平方米，塔旁有新建正殿。塔的形制为六角五层楼阁式空心砖塔，可上人。塔高约21米，底层塔门面向西南，二至五层各交错设一拱门及左右圆窗，塔身敦实略有收分，简洁质朴。资料记载塔门右壁嵌石匾，上有塔铭：'文林郎知松滋县事陆锡璞监修，皇清道光二十八年岁次戊申...'
projects.content_en: Yunlian Pagoda was built in the 28th year of Daoguang, Qing (1848), currently covering 500 square meters, with a newly built main hall beside the pagoda. The pagoda's form is a hexagonal five-story multi-eaved hollow brick pagoda, accessible to people. The pagoda is about 21 meters high, with the bottom-story pagoda door facing southwest; from the second to the fifth story, each alternately sets an arch door and left and right round windows; the pagoda body is sturdy with slight tapering, simple and plain. According to records, a stone plaque is embedded in the right wall of the pagoda door, with a pagoda inscription: 'Wenglinlang, Magistrate of Songzhi County Lu Xipu supervised the repair, in the 28th year of Daoguang of the Great Qing, corresponding to the year Wushen...'

projects.name: 万寿桥
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 荆州市松滋市涴市镇九岭岗村九岭岗南大路上
projects.address_en: On Jiulinggang South Road, Jiulinggang Village, Yuanshi Town, Songzi City, Jingzhou City
highlights: 拱券券脸处的石雕龙头
projects.content_zh: 松滋万寿桥位于松滋市涴市镇九岭岗村九岭岗南大路上，九岭岗南大路东起七里庙，北至东西堰，全长4.5公里，九岭岗村即九岭岗起义爆发所在地。万寿桥建于清道光十三年（1833），桥名寓意'万古长春，千秋长寿'，桥东西向横跨乌溪沟上，1936年曾进行维修，而近年刚完成对九岭岗南大路上的维修，现万寿桥桥面及以上已失去原有风貌。形制为单孔石拱桥，方块石浆砌，拱券纵联砌置，长14.5米，宽4.5米，孔跨7.5米。万寿桥的拱券券脸处的石雕龙头，是万寿桥独具特色之处。
projects.content_en: Songzi Wanshou Bridge is located on Jiulinggang South Road, Jiulinggang Village, Yuanshi Town, Songzi City; Jiulinggang South Road starts from Qili Temple in the east and reaches Dongxi Weir in the north, with a total length of 4.5 km; Jiulinggang Village is the place where the Jiulinggang Uprising broke out. Wanshou Bridge was built in the 13th year of Daoguang, Qing (1833); the bridge name寓意 'Eternal spring through the ages, longevity for a thousand autumns'; the bridge spans the Wuxi Gully east-west; it was repaired in 1936, and in recent years the repair of Jiulinggang South Road has just been completed; now the bridge deck and above of Wanshou Bridge have lost their original style. The form is a single-arch stone arch bridge, built with square stones in mortar, with the arch券 built in longitudinal connection, 14.5 meters long, 4.5 meters wide, with a span of 7.5 meters. The stone-carved dragon head at the arch券 face of Wanshou Bridge is a unique feature of Wanshou Bridge.

projects.name: 司马桥
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 仙桃市沔城回族镇金华村北
projects.address_en: North of Jinhua Village, Miancheng Hui Town, Xiantao City
highlights: 古沔阳城四十八石桥之一
projects.content_zh: 司马桥又名兴门头桥，建于清朝道光年间，位于古沔阳城建兴门（北门）外，南北向跨沔阳古城护城河，为当时卫署官员出入要道。其形制为单孔石拱桥，长14米，宽5米，高5米，孔径8米，孔跨6米。拱额嵌'司马桥'石匾，款署'光绪岁次庚寅众姓重建'，阴刻楷书。石桥两侧设石护栏，栏板有石浮雕，内容为人物、龙凤；桥头立两件石象，据传在沔城政府大院内尚存一尊来自此桥的石象。桥中央青石板尚能辨出。古沔阳城始设于西魏，唐、明、清多有重建，其古迹有'四十八古井、四十八牌坊、四十八石桥、四十八寺庙'之多。沔阳城周有玉带河环绕，河上有十余座桥，多为砖石、砖木结构。分别为：七里城的东梁桥、龙家湾的汉津桥、永盛关街的永盛关桥、下关街北的玉带桥、楚望门外的官梁桥、建兴门外的司马桥、古柏门外的司金桥、南纪门外的文明桥、广长律院前的桂子桥和仁和门外的云路桥。可惜沔阳城毁于1938年日军的飞机轰炸，如今地面尚存明清石刻、孔子石雕像、陈友谅故居以及数座古庙，地下有隋唐至明清的铜器、陶瓷器等。
projects.content_en: Sima Bridge, also called Xingmentou Bridge, was built during the Daoguang period of the Qing Dynasty, located outside the Jianxing Gate (North Gate) of the ancient Mianyang City, spanning the moat of the ancient Mianyang City north-south, and was an important passage for officials of the guard office at that time. Its form is a single-arch stone arch bridge, 14 meters long, 5 meters wide, 5 meters high, with an aperture of 8 meters and a span of 6 meters. The arch forehead is inlaid with a stone plaque 'Sima Bridge,' inscribed with 'Rebuilt by all surnames in the Gengyin year of Guangxu,' in incised regular script. On both sides of the stone bridge are stone guardrails; the railing panels have stone reliefs, with content of figures, dragons and phoenixes; at the bridgehead stand two stone elephants; it is said that one stone elephant from this bridge still remains in the courtyard of the Miancheng government. The bluestone slab in the center of the bridge can still be distinguished. The ancient Mianyang City was first established in the Western Wei, and was rebuilt many times in the Tang, Ming, and Qing; its ancient sites include as many as 'forty-eight ancient wells, forty-eight memorial archways, forty-eight stone bridges, and forty-eight temples.' Around Mianyang City is the Yudai (Jade Belt) River, with more than ten bridges over it, mostly of brick-stone or brick-wood structure. They are respectively: the Dongliang Bridge in Qilicheng, the Hanjin Bridge at Longjiawan, the Yongshengguan Bridge on Yongshengguan Street, the Yudai Bridge north of Xiaguan Street, the Guanliang Bridge outside the Chuwang Gate, the Sima Bridge outside the Jianxing Gate, the Sijin Bridge outside the Gubai Gate, the Wenming Bridge outside the Nanji Gate, the Guizi Bridge in front of the Guangchang Monastery, and the Yunlu Bridge outside the Renhe Gate. Unfortunately, Mianyang City was destroyed by Japanese aircraft bombing in 1938; today, Ming-Qing stone carvings, a stone statue of Confucius, the former residence of Chen Youliang, and several ancient temples still remain on the ground, and underground there are bronze and ceramic artifacts from the Sui-Tang to Ming-Qing periods.

projects.name: 白龙寺
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 皂市街道办事处，五华山村
projects.address_en: Wuhua Mountain Village, Zaoshi Subdistrict Office
highlights: 因白龙引水解救一方生灵
projects.content_zh: 白龙寺位于五华山北麓，现存为明清佛教寺院。据道光年间《天门县志》记载：'白龙寺在县北五华山，离城七十里，建寺不详所始，雍正年间邑士刘爱莲率众重修，独建楼阁。'白龙寺始建年代不详，相传因白龙引水解救一方生灵，人们于此设祭坛以祀；南朝时，齐武帝萧赜次子竟陵王萧子良好佛，将其改建为佛寺，并沿袭原名白龙寺；唐时，鄂国公尉迟恭奉唐太宗命重建白龙寺，...
projects.content_en: Bailong Temple is located at the northern foot of Wuhua Mountain; the existing building is a Ming-Qing Buddhist temple. According to the 'Tianmen County Annals' from the Daoguang period: 'Bailong Temple is on Wuhua Mountain north of the county, seventy li from the city; the beginning of the temple's construction is unknown; during the Yongzheng period, local scholar Liu Ailian led the public to rebuild it, independently building the pavilion.' The original construction date of Bailong Temple is unknown; legend has it that because a white dragon diverted water to rescue the living beings of one place, people set up an altar here to sacrifice to it; during the Southern Dynasties, Xiao Ziliang, the Prince of Jingling and second son of Emperor Wu of Qi, Xiao Ze, was fond of Buddhism and converted it into a Buddhist temple, retaining the original name Bailong Temple; during the Tang, Yuchi Gong, Duke of E, was ordered by Emperor Taizong of Tang to rebuild Bailong Temple, ...

projects.name: 白龙寺前殿
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 天门市皂市街道办事处五华山村白龙寺内
projects.address_en: Inside Bailong Temple, Wuhua Mountain Village, Zaoshi Subdistrict Office, Tianmen City
projects.content_zh: 白龙寺的前殿面阔三间12米，进深三间8.6米，门额嵌'白龙寺'石匾，据传为钟惺手书。殿内立柱16根。前殿斗拱为具有地方特色的如意斗拱。
projects.content_en: The front hall of Bailong Temple is three bays wide, 12 meters, and three bays deep, 8.6 meters; the door lintel is inlaid with a stone plaque 'Bailong Temple,' reportedly handwritten by Zhong Xing. There are 16 columns inside the hall. The bracket sets of the front hall are ruyi (as-you-wish) bracket sets with local characteristics.

projects.name: 白龙寺大雄宝殿
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 天门市皂市街道办事处五华山村白龙寺内
projects.address_en: Inside Bailong Temple, Wuhua Mountain Village, Zaoshi Subdistrict Office, Tianmen City
projects.content_zh: 大雄宝殿前嘉靖十五年碑文载：'嘉靖辛卯重修大雄殿。'故大殿主体为嘉靖辛卯（嘉靖十年，1531）重修，清代亦有修葺。大雄宝殿面阔三间14米，进深三间10.6米，殿中立柱28根，金柱4根，约高8米，柱围宽达1.89米，檐柱12根，约高5米余；廊柱12根，约高4.22米；后檐柱2根。下檐有阑额，无普柏枋；上檐阑额与普柏枋呈'T'形。大雄宝殿斗拱亦有古风。下檐仅有柱头科及角科斗拱，皆重拱出挑，无横拱或斜拱；上檐斗拱当心间平身科二朵，次间平身科各一朵，侧面仅当心间一朵，次间无，各斗拱皆为计心五铺作重拱、出如意头双假昂。
projects.content_en: The inscription from the 15th year of Jiajing in front of the Mahavira Hall records: 'In the Xinmao year of Jiajing, the Mahavira Hall was rebuilt.' Therefore, the main body of the main hall was rebuilt in the Xinmao year of Jiajing (10th year of Jiajing, 1531), and was also repaired in the Qing. The Mahavira Hall is three bays wide, 14 meters, and three bays deep, 10.6 meters; there are 28 columns in the hall, 4 golden columns, about 8 meters high, with a column circumference of up to 1.89 meters; 12 eave columns, about 5 meters high; 12 corridor columns, about 4.22 meters high; 2 rear eave columns. The lower eave has an architrave but no pupaifang (plate); the upper eave architrave and pupaifang form a 'T' shape. The bracket sets of the Mahavira Hall also have an ancient style. The lower eave only has column-top and corner bracket sets, all with double arms projecting, without transverse or diagonal arms; the upper eave has two intermediate bracket sets in the central bay, one in each secondary bay, only one in the central bay on the side, none in the secondary bays; each bracket set is a five-step double-arm with ruyi-head double fake ang.

projects.name: 白龙寺石碑
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 天门市皂市街道办事处五华山村白龙寺内
projects.address_en: Inside Bailong Temple, Wuhua Mountain Village, Zaoshi Subdistrict Office, Tianmen City
highlights: 存明、清以来的石刻碑5块
明崇祯十二年刻《奉道县禁碑》
二龙戏珠的碑额和龟座
正德年间《大明五华山白龙寺改造记》
projects.content_zh: 寺院内存明、清以来的石刻碑5块，以大殿西南角外明崇祯十二年（1639）刻《奉道县禁碑》最为珍贵。大雄宝殿前左右各有石碑一通，大小相若，形制相仿，都有二龙戏珠的碑额和龟座。一为正德年间《大明五华山白龙寺改造记》，一为嘉靖年间《五华山白龙寺增修殿阁记》。
projects.content_en: Inside the temple, there are 5 stone-carved steles from the Ming and Qing dynasties; the most precious is the 'Fengdao County Prohibition Stele' carved in the 12th year of Chongzhen, Ming (1639), outside the southwest corner of the main hall. In front of the Mahavira Hall, there is one stone stele on each side, similar in size and form, both with a stele forehead of two dragons playing with a pearl and a tortoise base. One is the 'Record of the Reconstruction of Bailong Temple on Daming Wuhua Mountain' from the Zhengde period, and the other is the 'Record of the Addition and Repair of Halls and Pavilions at Bailong Temple on Wuhua Mountain' from the Jiajing period.

projects.name: 胡家花园
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 竟陵雁叫街孝子里
projects.address_en: Xiaozili, Yanjiao Street, Jingling
highlights: 湖北省现存唯一的前衙后府官厅式建筑
projects.content_zh: 胡家花园又称胡巡抚官厅，是湖北省现存唯一的前衙后府官厅式建筑，建于1899年，为清代山西巡抚胡聘之故居。据《天门县志》记载，胡聘之为天门竟陵人，1864年中举人而入仕途，历任内阁侍读学士，太仆寺少卿，顺天府知府，山西和陕西巡抚。在山西任职期间，力主开矿山、办学堂、设立机器局、招商局等，备受山西各界好评。戊戌变法失败后，力主革新的胡聘之遭到保守派的排挤而免官回家，晚年在天门县建设胡家花园，闭门谢客，以诗词书画自娱。1912年病逝于上海。胡家花园总占地面积约1.8万平方米，主体建筑面积约3000平方米，由主殿、厢房、前堂、客厅、乡楼、天井、花园等组成。建筑格局为前衙后府，前面是正堂、客厅，供会客使用，两旁有东西厢房，供杂役和来客居住，类似清代官衙；后面是主人的卧室、洋楼（书楼）和花园，即府。胡家花园的建筑形式、形制、结构处理手法明显带有中国北方民居的特色，同时又因地制宜，结合南方的气候特征，采取了相应的构造形式。该建筑在墙体、天花板、门柱的装修装饰上，还带有西方装饰的特点，因而具有相当深厚的历史文化积淀，这种南北结合、中西融合的前衙后府式建筑样式，现在仍具有很高的研究价值。建筑中的牌坊、冲天牌楼、斗拱、马头墙、匾联、天井等，至今仍基本保持完好，但东厅和园林已不复...
projects.content_en: Hu's Mansion, also called Hu Governor's Official Hall, is the only existing former-yamen-later-mansion official-hall-style building in Hubei Province, built in 1899, and is the former residence of Hu Pinzhi, Governor of Shanxi in the Qing Dynasty. According to the 'Tianmen County Annals,' Hu Pinzhi was a native of Jingling, Tianmen; he passed the juren examination in 1864 and entered official career, successively serving as Reader of the Grand Secretariat, Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, Prefect of Shuntian Prefecture, and Governor of Shanxi and Shaanxi. During his tenure in Shanxi, he strongly advocated opening mines, establishing schools, setting up machine bureaus and merchant bureaus, etc., and was highly praised by all sectors of Shanxi. After the failure of the Hundred Days' Reform, Hu Pinzhi, who strongly advocated innovation, was squeezed out by conservatives and dismissed from office and returned home; in his later years he built Hu's Mansion in Tianmen County, closing his door to visitors and entertaining himself with poetry, calligraphy, and painting. He died of illness in Shanghai in 1912. Hu's Mansion has a total area of about 18,000 square meters, with a main building area of about 3,000 square meters, composed of the main hall, wing rooms, front hall, living room, township tower, courtyards, garden, etc. The building layout is former yamen and later mansion; the front is the main hall and living room for receiving guests, with east and west wing rooms on both sides for servants and guests to live in, similar to a Qing dynasty official yamen; the rear is the master's bedroom, Western-style building (study tower), and garden, i.e., the mansion. The architectural form, shape, and structural treatment of Hu's Mansion明显 bear the characteristics of northern Chinese vernacular architecture, while also adapting to local conditions and combining the climatic characteristics of the south, adopting corresponding structural forms. In the decoration of walls, ceilings, door columns, the building also has Western decorative characteristics, thus having a fairly profound historical and cultural accumulation; this former-yamen-later-mansion architectural style combining north and south, Chinese and Western, still has high research value today. The archways, sky-reaching paifang, bracket sets, horse-head walls, plaques and couplets, courtyards, etc. in the building still basically remain intact today, but the east hall and garden no longer exist...

projects.name: 王松和宅
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 熊口镇红军街
projects.address_en: Hongjun Street, Xiongkou Town
highlights: 1930年中国工农红军第六军在此设立军部
projects.content_zh: 王松和宅建于清代，王家世代行医，曾将此宅兼做药店，1930年2月，中国工农红军第六军在此设立军部。王松和宅所在的红军街为熊口集镇的三条主街之一，街道仍保有良好的传统风貌。街面青石板铺筑，街道两旁民宅均为大小店铺，房屋比街道高出尺余，在高低差中间用砖砌成两坎坡，民间称其为'疆台坎'，极具地域特色。王松和宅为砖木结构，硬山布瓦顶，灌斗墙。穿斗式木结构，保留了清代长江中游民宅的典型特点。面阔五间14.8米，进深12.5米。平面'明三暗五'，最前端的两间'暗'房与前厅贯通，作为放置药柜和卖药之处，后端的'暗'房为主人的住房，后有小院和厨房、厕所等辅助用房。建筑正立面为一面砖石墙体，用砖砌出仿梁架的突出，顶部为柔和的曲线，略带西式风格，与内部典型的中式结构、布局大相径庭。建筑结构的特色在于横向结构部件的运用：建筑物内部柱子不多，大部分结构重量都由水平方向的结构部件传递到仅有的几根柱子上。以天斗为例，四根垂柱将天斗的重量通过横枋传递到房间的四根角柱上，虽然此处的天斗相对而言体量较大，却并没有增加柱子的数量，而且因为天斗较高，使得内部光线充足，再加上前厅面积不大，使得整个建筑物的气氛庄严安详，非常符合药店的要求。
projects.content_en: Wang Songhe's Residence was built in the Qing Dynasty; the Wang family practiced medicine for generations and once used this residence also as a pharmacy; in February 1930, the Sixth Army of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army established its military headquarters here. The Hongjun Street where Wang Songhe's Residence is located is one of the three main streets of the Xiongkou market town, and the street still retains a good traditional style. The street surface is paved with bluestone slabs; the residences on both sides of the street are all shops of various sizes, with the houses more than a chi higher than the street; in the middle of the height difference, two sloped banks are built with bricks, folk-called 'Jiangtai Kan' (border platform bank), highly regionally characteristic. Wang Songhe's Residence is of brick-wood structure, with a gable tile roof and cavity walls. The column-and-tie wood structure retains the typical characteristics of mid-Yangtze River residences of the Qing Dynasty. Five bays wide, 14.8 meters, and 12.5 meters deep. The plan is 'three apparent, five hidden'; the two front 'hidden' rooms are贯通 with the front hall, serving as places for placing medicine cabinets and selling medicine; the rear 'hidden' rooms are the master's living quarters, with a small courtyard and auxiliary rooms such as kitchen and toilet behind. The front facade of the building is a brick-stone wall, with brick-built imitations of beam frames protruding, and the top is a gentle curve, slightly Western in style, quite different from the typical Chinese structure and layout inside. The feature of the building structure lies in the use of horizontal structural components: there are not many columns inside the building, and most of the structural weight is transmitted by horizontal structural components to the few existing columns. Taking the skywell as an example, four hanging columns transmit the weight of the skywell through horizontal lintels to the four corner columns of the room; although the skywell here is relatively large in volume, it does not increase the number of columns, and because the skywell is relatively high, the interior light is sufficient; coupled with the small area of the front hall, the atmosphere of the entire building is solemn and serene, very much meeting the requirements of a pharmacy.

projects.name: 胡夫先宅
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 熊口镇红军街25号
projects.address_en: No.25 Hongjun Street, Xiongkou Town
highlights: 1930年中国工农红军第二军团在此设军团部
projects.content_zh: 胡夫先宅建于清代，现位于熊口镇红军街25号。1930年7月，中国工农红军第二军团在此设军团部，1931年7月和1932年8月，中国工农红军第三军军部亦设于此。建筑主体为砖木结构，硬山布瓦顶，内部为典型的穿斗式木结构，单檐硬山顶铺小布瓦，外围砌有灌斗墙，内部以鼓皮分隔。面阔三间12.5米，进深18.9米。建筑平面有两进院落，第一进天井上架有天斗，天斗为四面攒尖，造型小巧，重量直接落在周围的屋面上；天斗上盖有亮瓦，因此虽然高度不够，仍然可以满足采光需求。建筑形制为'明三暗六'，中间为前厅和堂屋，两边四间厢房，有暗楼梯通向二楼阁楼，阁楼可供居住或堆放杂物。第一进院落之后连接一个三合院，形成第二进院落，设有厨房、厕所等辅助用房。建筑立面中心对称，一层中间装有板门，两侧有突出的货柜，二层有卷棚轩。立面整体虽无繁复的细部，但凸凹有致，虚实有度，阴影丰富，十分耐看。
projects.content_en: Hu Fuxian's Residence was built in the Qing Dynasty, now located at No.25 Hongjun Street, Xiongkou Town. In July 1930, the Second Army Corps of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army established its corps headquarters here; in July 1931 and August 1932, the military headquarters of the Third Army of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army was also established here. The main building is of brick-wood structure, with a gable tile roof; the interior is a typical column-and-tie wood structure, with a single-eave gable roof covered with small tiles, and the exterior is built with cavity walls, the interior separated by drum-skin partitions. Three bays wide, 12.5 meters, and 18.9 meters deep. The building plan has two courtyards; above the first-entry courtyard is a skywell, which is four-sided pyramidal, compact in shape, with its weight directly resting on the surrounding roof; the skywell is covered with bright tiles, so although the height is insufficient, it can still meet the lighting needs. The building form is 'three apparent, six hidden'; the middle is the front hall and main hall, with four wing rooms on both sides, and there are hidden stairs leading to the second-floor attic, which can be used for living or storing sundries. After the first-entry courtyard, a three-sided courtyard is connected, forming the second-entry courtyard, with auxiliary rooms such as kitchen and toilet. The building facade is centrally symmetric; the middle of the first floor is fitted with board doors, with protruding counters on both sides, and the second floor has a rolling-roof pavilion. Although the overall facade has no complicated details, it is well-proportioned in convex and concave, with a good balance of solid and void, rich in shadows, very pleasing to the eye.

projects.name: 西湖桥
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 孝南区西门外正街
projects.address_en: Zheng Street outside West Gate, Xiaonan District
projects.content_zh: 西湖桥因位于孝感城西的湖泊之上而得名，相传为宋太祖沽酒处，清乾隆年间还据此在桥头立一石碑。根据可考的文字记载，西湖桥始建于明英宗正统四年（1439），万历四十四年（1616）重修，1926年由本县富商捐资重建，并保存至今。桥为花岗岩单孔石拱桥，东西向跨在古城河之上，长14米，孔跨4米。拱券纵联砌筑，桥面铺大型条石，两侧设望柱栏板，望柱头刻成南瓜状。过去河水清澈时，半圆形的石拱与水中倒影合为一体，恰似一轮美丽的满月。西湖桥位于交通要道之上，是安陆、应城、云梦和本县西北商旅往来武汉的必经之路。桥头曾有楼阁式牌楼，横额刻'帝子停骖'四字，诗题：'高馆临湖旧业荒，青帘市岸指垂杨，金舆玉辇无消息，犹想当年酒瓮香。'不远处即为'宋太祖沽酒处'石碑。据清《孝感县志》转引《方舆胜览》记载，宋太祖微时曾以推车贩运为业，一日风雪黄昏，寻至西湖桥头酒家。时逢战乱，朝廷严禁民间酿酒，店主人取出私酿，并以客人带来的莲藕与店内仅剩的两张油豆皮制成'豆油藕卷'招待客人。太祖登基后，想起当年在西湖酒馆的际遇，不禁感慨万分，特对孝感颁发诏书，取消禁酒令。此后，'西湖酒馆'成为孝感八景之一，而豆油藕卷也成为孝感一道著名的风味小吃。
projects.content_en: Xihu Bridge is named because it is located above the lake west of Xiaogan City; legend has it that it was the place where Emperor Taizu of Song bought wine, and during the Qianlong period of the Qing, a stone stele was erected at the bridgehead based on this. According to verifiable written records, Xihu Bridge was first built in the 4th year of Zhengtong, Emperor Yingzong of Ming (1439), rebuilt in the 44th year of Wanli (1616), and rebuilt in 1926 with donations from wealthy merchants of the county, and has been preserved to this day. The bridge is a granite single-arch stone bridge, spanning the ancient city river east-west, 14 meters long, with a span of 4 meters. The arch券 is built in longitudinal connection, the bridge deck is paved with large strip stones, and baluster columns and railing panels are set on both sides, with the tops of the baluster columns carved into pumpkin shapes. In the past when the river water was clear, the semicircular stone arch and its reflection in the water merged into one, just like a beautiful full moon. Xihu Bridge is located on an important transportation route, and was the only way for merchants and travelers from Anlu, Yingcheng, Yunmeng, and the northwest of the county to travel to and from Wuhan. At the bridgehead there was once a pavilion-style paifang, with the horizontal plaque engraved with the four characters 'Dizi Tingcan' (The Emperor's Son Stops His Carriage), and a poem inscribed: 'The tall mansion by the lake has old industries abandoned, green curtains on the market shore point to weeping willows; the golden carriage and jade carriage have no news, yet one still thinks of the fragrance of wine jars in those years.' Not far away is the stone stele 'Place Where Emperor Taizu of Song Bought Wine.' According to the 'Xiaogan County Annals' of the Qing, quoting the 'Fangyu Shenglan' (A Survey of the Realm), when Emperor Taizu of Song was still humble, he once made a living by pushing a cart to trade; one snowy and windy evening, he found a wine shop at the head of Xihu Bridge. At that time, during wartime, the court strictly prohibited private wine brewing; the shop owner took out privately brewed wine, and used the lotus root brought by the guest and the only two oil bean skins left in the shop to make 'bean oil lotus root rolls' to entertain the guest. After ascending the throne, the emperor recalled his experience at the Xihu wine shop, could not help feeling deeply emotional, and specially issued an edict to Xiaogan to cancel the prohibition on alcohol. Thereafter, 'Xihu Wine Shop' became one of the Eight Scenes of Xiaogan, and bean oil lotus root rolls also became a famous local snack in Xiaogan.

projects.name: 文峰塔
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 应城市沙岗村
projects.address_en: Shagang Village, Yingcheng City
highlights: 六角七层楼阁式空心砖塔
projects.content_zh: 文峰塔，又名文笔峰、凌云塔，是应城市仅有的一座古塔。始建于明嘉靖三十四年（1555），历经多次坍圮和重建，最后一次重建在清同治十年（1871），并保存至今。据《光绪应城志》记载，邑人熊汝弼著《新文昌阁序》：'明季时，于栎林立新市，镇水口，而起文峰塔。'文峰塔立于市集之中，不仅有祈愿文风昌盛之意，也成为应城石膏、食盐、芦柴的转运中心。文峰塔坐北朝南，为一座六角七层楼阁式空心砖塔，条石塔基，铁宝珠塔刹，通高34米。首层西南面设门，门额题'青云直上'，塔内厅为方形；2至6层各面交错设拱门，7层每面开拱门，各层内厅为六边形。各层以砖砌腰檐划分，收分均匀，线条柔和。塔内可循梯而上，凭高远眺，四周景色一览无遗。
projects.content_en: Wanfeng Pagoda, also called Wenbi Peak and Lingyun Pagoda, is the only ancient pagoda in Yingcheng City. It was first built in the 34th year of Jiajing, Ming (1555), underwent multiple collapses and reconstructions, and the last reconstruction was in the 10th year of Tongzhi, Qing (1871), and has been preserved to this day. According to the 'Guangxu Yingcheng Annals,' Xiong Ruyi, a local, wrote in the 'Preface to the New Wenchang Pavilion': 'At the end of the Ming, a new market was established at Lishulin to control the water mouth, and the Wanfeng Pagoda was built.' Wanfeng Pagoda stands in the middle of the market, not only having the meaning of praying for the prosperity of literary style, but also becoming a transshipment center for gypsum, salt, and reed firewood in Yingcheng. Wanfeng Pagoda faces south, and is a hexagonal seven-story multi-eaved hollow brick pagoda, with a strip-stone pagoda base and an iron precious pearl finial, with a total height of 34 meters. On the southwest face of the first story, a door is set, with the door lintel inscribed 'Rising Straight to the Blue Clouds,' and the interior hall of the pagoda is square; from the 2nd to the 6th story, each face alternately sets an arch door; on the 7th story, each face opens an arch door, and the interior hall of each story is hexagonal. Each story is divided by brick-built waist eaves, with uniform tapering and soft lines. Inside the pagoda, one can climb up by stairs, and looking far from a height, the surrounding scenery is fully visible.

projects.name: 应城文庙
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 应城市人民公园内
projects.address_en: Inside People's Park, Yingcheng City
projects.content_zh: 应城文庙也称孔庙，位于应城市人民公园内，其建造的历史可以上溯到唐代的黉舍（校舍），明在此先后修建了学宫、明伦堂，明成化七年（1471）改造学宫，重建大成殿，始称孔庙，后多次重修。现存大成殿、大成门（1992年改为至圣门）、乡贤祠、名宦祠、泮池、泮桥等建筑。文庙大成殿坐北朝南，面阔五间，重檐歇山绿色琉璃瓦屋顶，正脊装饰宝瓶与鸱尾，檐下施斗拱。三面有回廊和隔扇门窗，背面砖墙围砌。
projects.content_en: Yingcheng Temple of Confucius, also called Confucius Temple, is located inside People's Park in Yingcheng City; its construction history can be traced back to the hongshe (schoolhouse) of the Tang Dynasty. In the Ming, the school palace and Minglun Hall were successively built here; in the 7th year of Chenghua, Ming (1471), the school palace was renovated and the Dacheng Hall was rebuilt, beginning to be called Confucius Temple, and it was repaired many times later. The existing buildings include the Dacheng Hall, Dacheng Gate (changed to Zhisheng Gate in 1992), Xiangxian Shrine (Shrine of Local Worthies), Minghuan Shrine (Shrine of Famous Officials), Pan Pond, and Pan Bridge. The Dacheng Hall of the Temple of Confucius faces south, five bays wide, with a double-eave hip-and-gable green glazed tile roof; the main ridge is decorated with a precious vase and chiwei (owl-tail ornaments), and bracket sets are applied under the eaves. There are surrounding corridors and lattice doors and windows on three sides, with the back enclosed by brick walls.

projects.name: 圣家岭天主教堂
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 应城市北街通红堂村卧虎岗
projects.address_en: Wohugang, Tonghongtang Village, North Street, Yingcheng City
projects.content_zh: 圣家岭教堂最早由天主教徒、应城青盐商廖仁仁出资修建，并从随县聘请意大利籍康神甫来应城传教。教堂建于清光绪三十一年（1905），当时仅有三间平房。康神甫年老退休后，继任的梅神甫横行乡里，盘剥乡民，引起很大的不满。1923年，被激怒的乡民将其绑起游行示众，造成轰动一时的'应城教案'。经天主教会从中斡旋，北洋政府与意、法两国签订赔款协议，用赔款修建汉口梅神甫医院（即今武汉市传染病医院），并重建应城卧虎岗天主堂，即保存至今天的圣家岭教堂。教堂重建于1924年，第二年年底落成，由于使用红瓦和彩色压花玻璃，新落成时流光溢彩，火红一片，因此俗称'红堂'。坐北朝南，有三重房屋，第二重为罗马风格的教堂主体建筑，平面为长方形，北面有祭台，祭台两边各有耳房，可供500人做弥撒。教堂之后为一栋两层楼房，西半楼为藏经室和收藏室，东半楼为修士的住所。楼房后是后院，栽花种树。整个教堂布局开阔，富丽清雅。红堂落成后除了开展传教活动，还扩建了红堂小学，并开办诊所。日军占领应城后，时任教主的意籍法国人德明达神甫利用自己的身份，将红堂辟为保护所，为一些中国人提供了庇护。
projects.content_en: Shengjialing Church was first funded and built by Liao Renren, a Catholic and green-salt merchant of Yingcheng, who hired Italian Father Kang from Sui County to come to Yingcheng to preach. The church was built in the 31st year of Guangxu, Qing (1905), at that time with only three bungalows. After Father Kang retired due to old age, the succeeding Father Mei ran rampant in the countryside and exploited the villagers, causing great dissatisfaction. In 1923, the enraged villagers tied him up and paraded him through the streets, creating the sensational 'Yingcheng Religious Case.' Through the mediation of the Catholic Church, the Beiyang government signed a compensation agreement with Italy and France, using the compensation to build the Hankou Father Mei Hospital (now Wuhan Infectious Disease Hospital), and rebuild the Catholic Church at Wohugang in Yingcheng, i.e., the Shengjialing Church preserved to this day. The church was rebuilt in 1924 and completed at the end of the following year; because it used red tiles and colored patterned glass, when newly completed it was radiant and fiery red, hence commonly called 'Red Church.' Facing south, it has three layers of buildings; the second layer is the main church building in Roman style, with a rectangular plan, an altar on the north side, and side rooms on both sides of the altar, capable of holding 500 people for Mass. Behind the church is a two-story building; the west half is the scripture storage room and collection room, and the east half is the residence of the monks. Behind the building is the backyard, with flowers planted and trees grown. The entire church has an open layout, rich and elegant. After the completion of the Red Church, in addition to carrying out missionary activities, the Red Church Primary School was expanded and a clinic was opened. After the Japanese army occupied Yingcheng, the then-priest, French-Italian Father Demingda, used his identity to turn the Red Church into a shelter, providing refuge for some Chinese people.

projects.name: 德安府儒学大成殿
projects.name_en: Confucian Dacheng Hall in De'an Prefecture
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 安陆市解放大道安陆市博物馆
projects.address_en: Anlu City Museum, Jiefang Avenue, Anlu City
projects.content_zh: 北宋时期，宋徽宗未登九五前，曾任安州团练使，登基之后仿效隋唐历来的传统，将原本立于安陆的安远军设置为德安府。德安府儒学始建于北宋庆历六年（1046），嘉佑、淳熙年间及明洪武三年（1370）三易其位重建，清咸丰五年（1855）毁于战火，光绪十一年（1885）重建。现仅存大成殿，坐北朝南，面阔五间27.4米，进深三间15.9米，高12.5米，原为重檐歇山灰瓦顶，现已改建为黄色琉璃瓦顶，明、次间抬梁式构架，两山穿斗构架。
projects.content_en: During the Northern Song, before Emperor Huizong of Song ascended the throne, he once served as the military training commissioner of Anzhou; after ascending the throne, following the tradition of the Sui and Tang dynasties, he established the Anyuan Army, originally located in Anlu, as De'an Prefecture. The De'an Prefecture Confucian School was first built in the 6th year of Qingli, Northern Song (1046), and was rebuilt three times at different locations during the Jiayou and Chunxi periods and in the 3rd year of Hongwu, Ming (1370); it was destroyed by war in the 5th year of Xianfeng, Qing (1855), and rebuilt in the 11th year of Guangxu (1885). Now only the Dacheng Hall remains, facing south, five bays wide, 27.4 meters, three bays deep, 15.9 meters, 12.5 meters high; originally a double-eave hip-and-gable gray-tile roof, it has now been converted to a yellow glazed tile roof; the central and secondary bays use a post-and-lintel frame, and the two gable sides use column-and-tie frames.

projects.name: 泗洲寺
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 云梦县下辛店镇泗洲村
projects.address_en: Sizhou Village, Xiayindian Town, Yunmeng County
projects.content_zh: 泗洲寺始建于南朝梁（502-557），唐代重修，寺前元代石碑记载元泰定四年（1327）再次重修，后毁于战乱。泗洲寺因寺周多湖沼，常被水环绕而得名，沿轴线布置山门、钟鼓楼和大雄宝殿。大雄宝殿和鼓楼为清代重建，其它建筑为当代修复。大殿原为重檐歇山灰瓦屋顶，现已改建为黄色琉璃瓦。面阔三间，上层檐下施斗拱。三面围墙，正面木格槅门窗，明间有'井'字形天花藻井。鼓楼同样面阔三间，原有卷棚前廊，现已拆除。泗洲寺所处圣寿山，环境清幽，历来受文人墨客...
projects.content_en: Sizhou Temple was first built during the Liang of the Southern Dynasties (502-557), rebuilt in the Tang; a Yuan dynasty stele in front of the temple records that it was rebuilt again in the 4th year of Taiding, Yuan (1327), and was later destroyed by war. Sizhou Temple is named because there are many lakes and marshes around the temple, often surrounded by water; along the axis are arranged the mountain gate, bell and drum towers, and Mahavira Hall. The Mahavira Hall and drum tower were rebuilt in the Qing, and other buildings were restored in contemporary times. The main hall originally had a double-eave hip-and-gable gray-tile roof, which has now been converted to yellow glazed tiles. Three bays wide, with bracket sets under the upper eave. Three sides are enclosed by walls, with wooden lattice doors and windows on the front; the central bay has a 'well'-shaped coffered ceiling. The drum tower is also three bays wide, originally with a rolling-roof front porch, which has now been demolished. The Shengshou Mountain where Sizhou Temple is located has a quiet and elegant environment, and has always been appreciated by literati and scholars...

projects.name: 双桥古镇
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 大悟县双桥镇
projects.address_en: Shuangqiao Town, Dawu County
projects.content_zh: 双桥古镇位于大悟县以北12公里，澴水西岸，古驿道东侧。南北朝北周时期，便有迁徙而来的居民在此建立村落。村落南北两端，在澴河之上各建了一个单孔石桥，以供澴河两岸通行，故此地命名为双桥。清康熙年间，由于双桥镇地处孝感县小河镇与三里城骡路之间，水陆交通便利，逐渐形成了农历双日为集的习俗，双桥镇亦由此慢慢成为以商贸为主的集镇。镇中的主体建筑由刘氏家族完成，重心偏向北石桥，重要的建筑有界山上的刘氏宗祠（今已毁）、刘氏家族族长和子女住宅；随着市集的发展，异姓逐渐迁入，镇区逐步向南发展，新建了异姓住宅和基督教堂。整座小镇由一条主街串联而起，街道全长约350米，宽约5米，街道两边多为店宅街屋，以三开间居多，主要经营杂货、染行、粮油、药材和木材。由主街通往濉河码头还有三条小巷，小巷长35米左右，宽2到3米。双桥街两侧的住宅以前店后宅、前坊后宅为主，典型的两座住宅是73号刘氏宗族族长宅和85号刘宅。73号为邻水住宅，四重三天井，三个天井将建筑划分为店铺、住宅和仓储三部分，临河仓储可以利用便利的河运。85号刘宅在主街的另一侧，背依驿道，原有五重四天井，现存三重两天井，临街一进为商铺，紧邻天井两侧的披屋为作坊，二进建筑以后均为住宅，临驿道一进建筑为佣人房，多重天井良好地区分了店铺、作坊与住宅的功能。镇上的基督教堂也采取了传统建筑的布局和做法，在教堂之后本有一进以附属用房围合的院落，现已基本被毁。教堂内部使用穿斗抬梁混合式木结构，外墙为片石垒砌，白灰粉刷，两侧弧线封火山墙，正立面和门窗则使用了拱券形的细节，体现出中西合璧的特点。
projects.content_en: Shuangqiao Ancient Town is located 12 km north of Dawu County, on the west bank of the Huan River, east of the ancient post road. During the Northern Zhou period of the Northern and Southern Dynasties, migrating residents already established villages here. At the north and south ends of the village, a single-arch stone bridge was built over the Huan River respectively, for passage on both sides of the Huan River, hence this place was named Shuangqiao (Double Bridge). During the Kangxi period of the Qing, because Shuangqiao Town was located between Xiaohe Town in Xiaogan County and Sanli City on the mule road, with convenient land and water transportation, it gradually formed the custom of holding markets on even-numbered days of the lunar calendar, and Shuangqiao Town thus slowly became a market town mainly based on commerce and trade. The main buildings in the town were completed by the Liu family, with the center偏向 the north stone bridge; important buildings include the Liu Family Ancestral Hall on Jieshan Mountain (now destroyed), the residences of the Liu family patriarch and his children; with the development of the market, people of other surnames gradually moved in, the town area gradually developed southward, and new residences of other surnames and a Christian church were built. The entire small town is串联 by one main street, with a total length of about 350 meters and a width of about 5 meters; on both sides of the street are mostly shop-residence street houses, mostly with three bays, mainly operating groceries, dyeing, grain and oil, medicinal materials, and timber. From the main street to the Huan River dock there are also three alleys, about 35 meters long and 2 to 3 meters wide. The residences on both sides of Shuangqiao Street are mainly front-shop-back-residence and front-workshop-back-residence; the two typical residences are the Liu Family Patriarch's Residence at No.73 and the Liu Residence at No.85. No.73 is a waterside residence, with four entries and three courtyards; the three courtyards divide the building into three parts: shop, residence, and storage, and the riverside storage can utilize convenient river transport. No.85 Liu Residence is on the other side of the main street, backing onto the post road; originally it had five entries and four courtyards, now three entries and two courtyards remain; the street-facing entry is a shop, the lean-to rooms on both sides adjacent to the courtyard are workshops, the buildings after the second entry are all residences, and the post-road-facing entry building is a servant's room; the multiple courtyards well distinguish the functions of shop, workshop, and residence. The Christian church in the town also adopted the layout and practices of traditional architecture; behind the church there was originally an entry of courtyard enclosed by auxiliary rooms, which has now been basically destroyed. The interior of the church uses a column-and-tie and post-and-lintel mixed wood structure; the exterior walls are built with rubble stone, plastered with white lime, with curved fire-sealing gable walls on both sides; the front facade and doors and windows use arched details, reflecting the characteristics of Chinese-Western combination.

projects.name: 孝昌小河镇环西街及民居
projects.name_en: Huanxi Street and Vernacular Dwellings in Xiaohe Town
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 孝昌县小河镇环西街
projects.address_en: Huanxi Street, Xiaohe Town, Xiaochang County
highlights: 一条南北向的环西街贯穿全镇
projects.content_zh: 小河镇地处大别山向江汉平原的过渡地段，紧邻京师到武昌的古驿道旁，今天则位于京珠高速沿线，交通十分便利。早在北宋时期，小河镇便已形成集镇，到明清时，孝感县在此设分县衙门，分治县北，小河成为官道上一处重要的驿站。明清时期的小河镇，一条南北向的环西街贯穿全镇，明清时期全长1600米，两旁有500多户居民。今天街上民居仍基本保持了传统建筑风格，以二层砖木阁楼为主，前店后宅。沿街有2米左右的廊檐，因此无论雨雪风霜，均可在檐下营业。民居面宽小、进深大，天井纵深，大户人家的房屋甚至可以有六七进天井，长达百米。小河镇的公共建筑数量不多，但类型丰富，有巡检司署和分县衙门这样的行政建筑，有官道驿站配备的公馆，山陕商人也曾在这里建置会馆，还有观山禅寺、东岳庙、四官殿和书院、私塾、善堂（收养弃婴的育婴堂）。现仅存山陕会馆、东岳庙主殿和私塾。
projects.content_en: Xiaohe Town is located in the transition zone from the Dabie Mountains to the Jianghan Plain, close to the ancient post road from the capital to Wuchang, and today it is located along the Beijing-Zhuhai Expressway, with very convenient transportation. As early as the Northern Song period, Xiaohe Town had already formed a market town; by the Ming and Qing, Xiaogan County established a branch county yamen here to govern the north of the county, and Xiaohe became an important post station on the official road. During the Ming and Qing, in Xiaohe Town, a north-south Huanxi Street ran through the entire town, with a total length of 1600 meters during the Ming and Qing, and more than 500 households on both sides. Today, the residences on the street still basically maintain the traditional architectural style, mainly two-story brick-wood attics, with shops in front and residences behind.
