除正屋单层外余两层硬山顶砖木结构
装饰重点主要在正厅前后檐轩廊和木构件雕刻、彩绘
以及正堂高耸的五花山墙
被朴素的青瓦屋面衬托出几分华丽的风采
院落里有依地而盘的一整块山石
戏台、私塾、药铺、粮仓等一应俱全
正堂、山墙、雕花窗棂、板壁、磉蹬、石壁、壁画和廊柱等保存完好
是保康现存规模较大、保存最为完整的民居之一
建筑的匾额由三块木板拼合而成
右端自上而下题写着大总统题褒5字
从右到左自上而下为跋文保康节妇吴陈氏
落款日期为中华民国五年四月
其正上方还刻有荣典之玺
此匾为民国大总统袁世凯为吴元泽儿媳陈氏（长子吴世特妻子
当时悬挂在武昌吴家（时从武昌蛇山到黄土坡即今首义路均为吴家房产）
1938年武汉沦陷前夕由吴元钧继室龚敬勤（1948年在保康病故）带回保康祖宅
projects.content_zh: 吴氏庄园又称吴德峰故居。吴德峰，1949年后任武汉市首任市长。建筑始建于晚清时期，祖屋庄园位于海拔1100米的一个坡地上，为晚清鄂西北典型的庄园式建筑。其结构、雕花门窗、石质窗格、石阶、防火墙、壁画等都具有非常独特的民居风格，大量的壁画、石刻、木雕现仍依稀可见。建筑背倚山体，坐西朝东，整组建筑占地面积3500平方米，建筑面积1320平方米。建筑有两进院落，前进大天井三合院，面阔十间，后并列三个小四合院，中路四合面阔三间。除正屋单层外余两层硬山顶砖木结构。庄园外观古朴典雅，装饰重点主要在正厅前后檐轩廊和木构件雕刻、彩绘，以及正堂高耸的五花山墙，被朴素的青瓦屋面衬托出几分华丽的风采。建筑主屋系徽派风格，次房以半坡覆顶，院落里有依地而盘的一整块山石，引人注目。整个庄园构思精巧，布局浑然一体。除起居生活空间，戏台、私塾、药铺、粮仓等一应俱全。正堂、山墙、雕花窗棂、板壁、磉蹬、石壁、壁画和廊柱等保存完好，是保康现存规模较大、保存最为完整的民居之一。建筑的匾额由三块木板拼合而成，长185厘米，宽85厘米。右端自上而下题写着'大总统题褒'5字；主题匾文为'志洁行芳'，为黑漆浮雕，字迹清晰，保存完整；木匾左端，从右到左自上而下为跋文'保康节妇吴陈氏'，落款日期为'中华民国五年四月'，其正上方还刻有'荣典之玺'，约14厘米见方。据考证，此匾为民国大总统袁世凯为吴元泽儿媳陈氏（长子吴世特妻子，18岁病故）题写，当时悬挂在武昌吴家（时从武昌蛇山到黄土坡即今首义路均为吴家房产），1938年武汉沦陷前夕由吴元钧继室龚敬勤（1948年在保康病故）带回保康祖宅。
projects.content_en: Wu's Mansion is also called the Former Residence of Wu Defeng. Wu Defeng served as the first mayor of Wuhan after 1949. The building was first built in the late Qing period; the ancestral mansion is located on a slope at an altitude of 1100 meters, and is a typical manor-style building of northwest Hubei in the late Qing. Its structure, carved doors and windows, stone window grilles, stone steps, fire walls, murals, etc., all have a very unique vernacular dwelling style; a large number of murals, stone carvings, and wood carvings are still faintly visible today. The building backs onto the mountain body, faces east from west, and the entire building complex covers an area of 3500 square meters, with a building area of 1320 square meters. The building has two courtyards; the front entry is a large courtyard (tianjing) three-sided courtyard, ten bays wide; behind it are three small courtyards arranged side by side, with the middle-road courtyard three bays wide. Except for the main house which is single-story, the rest are two-story gable-roof brick-wood structures. The exterior of the mansion is simple and elegant; the decorative focus is mainly on the front and rear eaves porches of the main hall, the carving and painting of wooden components, and the towering five-flower gable wall of the main hall, which is set off by the simple blue-tile roof to show a bit of gorgeous style. The main house of the building is in the Huizhou style, and the secondary houses are covered with half-slope roofs; in the courtyard there is a whole block of mountain stone coiled according to the terrain, eye-catching. The entire mansion is exquisitely conceived, with an integrated layout. In addition to living spaces, there is a theater stage, private school, pharmacy, granary, etc., all available. The main hall, gable walls, carved window lattice, plank walls, plinths, stone walls, murals, and porch columns are well-preserved, and it is one of the larger-scale and best-preserved vernacular dwellings existing in Baokang. The inscribed plaque of the building is composed of three wooden boards joined together, 185 cm long and 85 cm wide. At the right end, from top to bottom, are inscribed the 5 characters 'Bestowed and Praised by the Great President'; the main plaque text is 'Zhi Jie Xing Fang' (Pure Will and Virtuous Conduct), in black lacquer relief, with clear characters and complete preservation; at the left end of the wooden plaque, from right to left and top to bottom, is the postscript 'Baokang Chaste Widow Wu Chenshi', with the date 'April of the 5th Year of the Republic of China'; directly above it is also carved the 'Seal of Honorary Edicts', about 14 cm square. According to research, this plaque was inscribed by Yuan Shikai, President of the Republic, for Chen Shi, daughter-in-law of Wu Yuanze (wife of eldest son Wu Shite, died of illness at 18); it was then hung at the Wu family in Wuchang (at that time, from Snake Mountain to Huangtupo, i.e., present-day Shouyi Road, were all Wu family properties); on the eve of the fall of Wuhan in 1938, it was brought back to the Baokang ancestral residence by Gong Jingqin, the second wife of Wu Yuanjun (died of illness in Baokang in 1948).

projects.name: 黄陵庙
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 夷陵区三斗坪镇黄陵庙三斗坪镇
projects.address_en: Sandouping Town, Huangling Shrine, Yiling District
projects.type: 宗教建筑·砖石、砖木结构
highlights: 黄牛峡是西陵峡的四峡之一
黄陵庙就坐落在黄牛峡南岸的黄牛山上
黄陵庙的历史非常悠久
相传是春秋时期为纪念神助大禹开峡治水而修建的
寺中保存的黄牛庙记石碑
也很有可能是三国时诸葛亮重建庙宇时所镌刻的
唐大中元年复建时改名为黄牛祠
因而改黄牛祠为黄陵庙
还为此写下一首黄牛祠诗
清同治九年曾遭遇过一次特大洪水
现存建筑多在此之后修建
主轴线上有山门、禹王殿、祖师殿
左侧轴线上依次排列武侯祠和长生殿
院墙以外右侧还新建了一座九龙榭
山门于清光绪十二年重建
为砖木结构单檐硬山灰瓦顶
正中高耸起一道四柱三间牌楼
黑色竖匾上嵌隶书老黄陵庙四个鎏金大字
各道额枋上均有精美的镂空石雕
两侧还有各种祥瑞图案
牌坊和主体建筑屋脊两段都饰有高高翘起的鸱尾
与背后黄牛岭起伏的山势相映成趣
山门外有石阶三十三步又十八级
分别寓意三十三重天和十八层地狱
两旁还有一对通高近3米的镇水神兽石雕
禹王殿是庙中最重要的建筑
面阔和进深均为五开间
前后檐柱上端均置有五彩鳌鱼木雕
殿内梁额下方还可看到最后一次重修时的题字
有大清光绪十七年和红色钦命等字样
大殿正面的两块匾额各有来历
下檐悬挂的一块褐底金字玄功万古匾
是明崇祯年间惠王朱常润手书
匾额四周饰以一圈二龙戏珠
表明题写者尊贵的身份
上檐悬挂的褐底绿字砥定江澜匾
是清乾隆时期的公主爱新觉罗·琪格题写的
殿内供奉一尊6米高的大禹像
禹王殿的西侧是武侯祠
原本紧挨在禹王殿的左侧
现存建筑重建于清光绪十二年
古朴雅致的风格与黄陵庙内其他建筑的华丽精致迥然不同
长生殿最早为覃家老屋
黄牛岭覃氏于明代从四川搬到夷陵
族中一户富裕人家认为黄陵庙的形势为九龙捧圣
便买下这块地建起祖屋
明间两侧也升起马头墙
室内的房间按中轴对称布局
这座老屋同时也是覃氏最早的祠堂
老屋被用作黄陵庙中的普舍堂和积善堂
projects.content_zh: 黄牛峡是西陵峡的'四峡'之一，江水翻滚不息，波涛汹涌，两岸山势高耸，粗犷多变，黄陵庙就坐落在黄牛峡南岸的黄牛山上。黄陵庙的历史非常悠久，相传是春秋时期为纪念神助大禹开峡治水而修建的，而寺中保存的《黄牛庙记》石碑，也很有可能是三国时诸葛亮重建庙宇时所镌刻的：'……古传所载，黄牛助禹开江治水，九载而功成，信不诬也，惜乎庙貌废去，使人太息……仆复而兴之，再建其庙号，目之曰黄牛庙。'唐大中元年（847）复建时改名为黄牛祠。欧阳修任夷陵县令时，不信神牛触石之说，只信禹王开山之功，因而改黄牛祠为黄陵庙，还为此写下一首《黄牛祠》：'……峡山侵天起青嶂，崖崩路绝无由上。黄牛不下江头饮，行人惟向舟中望。'此后黄陵庙多次重修，清同治九年（1870）曾遭遇过一次特大洪水，山门冲毁，现存建筑多在此之后修建。整座庙宇坐南朝北，环以围墙，主轴线上有山门、禹王殿、祖师殿，祖师殿现仅存遗址，左侧轴线上依次排列武侯祠和长生殿，院墙以外右侧还新建了一座九龙榭。山门于清光绪十二年（1886）重建，为砖木结构单檐硬山灰瓦顶，正中高耸起一道四柱三间牌楼，饰以黑白为主的彩画，显得庄严、凝重，黑色竖匾上嵌隶书'老黄陵庙'四个鎏金大字。各道额枋上均有精美的镂空石雕，正中上方为双龙戏珠，下方是八仙祝寿，两侧还有各种祥瑞图案。牌坊和主体建筑屋脊两段都饰有高高翘起的鸱尾，与背后黄牛岭起伏的山势相映成趣。山门外有石阶三十三步又十八级，分别寓意'三十三重天'和'十八层地狱'，两旁还有一对通高近3米的镇水神兽石雕。禹王殿是庙中最重要的建筑，面阔和进深均为五开间，平面接近正方形，重檐歇山屋顶，黄色琉璃瓦屋面，全部36根柱子均用楠木，显示出极高的规格。柱子原为黑色，现已被翻新为红色，明间金柱上盘有金龙，前后檐柱上端均置有五彩鳌鱼木雕。殿内梁额下方还可看到最后一次重修时的题字，有'大清光绪十七年'和红色'钦命'等字样。大殿正面的两块匾额各有来历。下檐悬挂的一块褐底金字'玄功万古'匾，是明崇祯年间惠王朱常润手书，匾额四周饰以一圈二龙戏珠，表明题写者尊贵的身份；上檐悬挂的褐底绿字'砥定江澜'匾，字体较为清秀，是清乾隆时期的公主爱新觉罗·琪格题写的。殿内供奉一尊6米高的大禹像。禹王殿的西侧是武侯祠，始建于唐代，原本紧挨在禹王殿的左侧，1983年修缮时移到现在的位置。现存建筑重建于清光绪十二年（1886），是一座三开间的小殿，单檐硬山灰瓦屋顶，正面有前廊，木隔扇装修，掩映在丛丛绿荫中。武侯祠之后是长生殿，青砖灰瓦，古朴雅致的风格与黄陵庙内其他建筑的华丽精致迥然不同。长生殿最早为覃家老屋。根据《覃氏族谱》的记载，黄牛岭覃氏于明代从四川搬到夷陵，以打鱼为生，族中一户富裕人家认为黄陵庙的形势为'九龙捧圣'，是块风水宝地，便买下这块地建起祖屋。老屋面阔三间，青砖砌筑，单檐硬山灰瓦顶，马头封火山墙，明间两侧也升起马头墙，同时墙面后退，形成入口。室内的房间按中轴对称布局，有前厅、后堂，后堂分上下两层。覃氏族人认为，这座老屋同时也是覃氏最早的祠堂，后来的一段时间里，老屋被用作黄陵庙中的普舍堂和积善堂。
projects.content_en: Huangniu (Yellow Ox) Gorge is one of the 'Four Gorges' of Xiling Gorge; the river water rolls ceaselessly, with surging waves; the mountains on both banks tower high, rugged and varied; Huangling Shrine sits on Huangniu Mountain on the south bank of Huangniu Gorge. The history of Huangling Shrine is very long; legend has it that it was built in the Spring and Autumn period to commemorate the divine help to Yu the Great in opening the gorge and controlling floods; the 'Record of Huangniu Temple' stone stele preserved in the temple was also very likely carved when Zhuge Liang of the Three Kingdoms rebuilt the temple: '...According to ancient legends, the yellow ox helped Yu open the river and control floods, succeeding in nine years; this is truly not false. Unfortunately, the temple appearance was abandoned, making one sigh... I restored and revived it, rebuilt its temple name, calling it Huangniu Temple.' When rebuilt in the 1st year of Dazhong, Tang (847), it was renamed Huangniu Shrine. When Ouyang Xiu served as the magistrate of Yiling, he did not believe the legend of the divine ox touching the rocks, but only believed in Yu the Great's merit of opening the mountains; hence he changed Huangniu Shrine to Huangling Shrine, and also wrote a poem 'Huangniu Shrine' for this: '...The gorge mountains rise against the sky with green peaks, cliffs collapse and roads are cut off with no way up. The yellow ox does not come down to drink at the river head; travelers only look toward it from their boats.' Thereafter Huangling Shrine was repaired many times; in the 9th year of Tongzhi, Qing (1870), it once encountered an extraordinary flood, and the mountain gate was washed away; most of the existing buildings were constructed after this. The entire temple faces north from south, surrounded by walls; on the main axis there are the mountain gate, Yu King Hall, and Patriarch Hall; the Patriarch Hall now only remains as a site; on the left axis, Wuhou Shrine and Changsheng Hall are arranged in sequence; outside the wall on the right side, a Nine-Dragon Pavilion was also newly built. The mountain gate was rebuilt in the 12th year of Guangxu, Qing (1886); it is a brick-wood structure single-eave gable gray-tile roof, with a four-column three-bay paifang towering in the center, decorated with paintings mainly in black and white, appearing solemn and dignified; on the black vertical plaque are inlaid the four gilded characters 'Old Huangling Shrine' in clerical script. On each额枋 there are exquisite openwork stone carvings; above the center is two dragons playing with a pearl, below is the Eight Immortals celebrating longevity, and on both sides there are various auspicious patterns. Both ends of the ridges of the paifang and the main building are decorated with high-upward chiwei (owl-tail ornaments), echoing the undulating terrain of Huangniu Ridge behind. Outside the mountain gate there are 33 stone steps plus 18 more, respectively symbolizing the 'Thirty-Three Heavens' and the 'Eighteen Levels of Hell'; on both sides there is also a pair of water-subduing mythical beast stone carvings with a total height of nearly 3 meters. The Yu King Hall is the most important building in the temple; both its width and depth are five bays, with a plane nearly square, a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, and a yellow glazed tile roof; all 36 columns are made of nanmu wood, showing an extremely high specification. The columns were originally black and have now been refurbished to red; on the golden columns of the central bay, golden dragons are coiled; at the upper ends of the front and rear eave columns, colorful giant fish wood carvings are placed. Below the beams and额枋 inside the hall, inscriptions from the last repair can still be seen, with words such as '17th year of Guangxu, Qing' and red 'Imperial Order.' The two plaques on the front of the main hall each have their origins. The brown-background gold-character 'Xuan Gong Wan Gu' (Profound Merit Through the Ages) plaque hanging under the lower eave was handwritten by Zhu Changrun, Prince Hui, during the Chongzhen period of the Ming; the plaque is decorated with a circle of two dragons playing with a pearl around it, indicating the noble status of the inscriber; the brown-background green-character 'Di Ding Jiang Lan' (Stabilizing the River Waves) plaque hanging on the upper eave has a more delicate font, and was inscribed by Aisin Gioro Qige, a princess of the Qianlong period of the Qing. Inside the hall is enshrined a 6-meter-high statue of Yu the Great. West of the Yu King Hall is Wuhou Shrine, first built in the Tang, originally紧挨着 on the left side of the Yu King Hall, and moved to its current position during repairs in 1983. The existing building was rebuilt in the 12th year of Guangxu, Qing (1886); it is a small three-bay hall with a single-eave gable gray-tile roof, a front porch on the front, and wooden lattice doors and windows, nestled in clusters of green shade. Behind Wuhou Shrine is Changsheng Hall, with blue bricks and gray tiles; its simple and elegant style is quite different from the gorgeous and exquisite other buildings in Huangling Shrine. Changsheng Hall was originally the Qin Family Old House. According to the records of the 'Qin Family Genealogy,' the Qin family of Huangniu Ridge moved from Sichuan to Yiling in the Ming, making a living by fishing; a wealthy household in the clan believed that the terrain of Huangling Shrine was 'Nine Dragons Holding the Sage,' a fengshui treasure land, so they bought this land and built an ancestral house. The old house is three bays wide, built with blue bricks, with a single-eave gable gray-tile roof and horse-head fire-sealing gable walls; horse-head walls also rise on both sides of the central bay, while the wall recedes to form an entrance. The indoor rooms are laid out symmetrically along the central axis, with a front hall and rear hall; the rear hall is divided into upper and lower two stories. The Qin clan believes that this old house was also the earliest ancestral hall of the Qin family; for a period later, the old house was used as the Pushe Hall and Jishan Hall in Huangling Shrine.

projects.name: 杨家湾老屋
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 夷陵区三斗坪镇东岳庙村
projects.address_en: Dongyuemiao Village, Sandouping Town, Yiling District
highlights: 杨家湾老屋又名黎永志老屋
始建于清乾隆五十二年
老屋的创始者名为黎大镜
回乡后从事水上运输服务行业
他的次子黎永志继承了这座杨家湾老屋
使现存建筑面积达到1300平方米
老屋曾是抗日部队三十军的长江上游江防总指挥部所在地
杨家湾老屋为横长方形布局
明间及主要厅堂有较为考究的木质屋架
其他房屋则以墙体支撑屋面
婆娑叶影投映在干净的墙面上
projects.content_zh: 杨家湾老屋又名黎永志老屋，始建于清乾隆五十二年（1787）。老屋的创始者名为黎大镜，他曾远渡日本留学，回乡后从事水上运输服务行业，逐渐累积了财富，先后三处建房；他的次子黎永志继承了这座杨家湾老屋，又将老屋向两边扩建，使现存建筑面积达到1300平方米。'抗战'时期，老屋曾是抗日部队三十军的长江上游江防总指挥部所在地。杨家湾老屋为横长方形布局，进深两进，横连十一屋，共有七个天井。青砖砌筑外墙，明间及主要厅堂有较为考究的木质屋架，其他房屋则以墙体支撑屋面，硬山灰瓦顶。每屋两侧都有马头墙。门前屋后绿树环抱，婆娑叶影投映在干净的墙面上，让人觉得清新雅致。
projects.content_en: The Old House in Yangjiawan is also called Li Yongzhi Old House, first built in the 52nd year of Qianlong, Qing (1787). The founder of the old house was named Li Dajing; he once traveled far to study in Japan, and after returning home engaged in the water transportation service industry, gradually accumulating wealth and building houses at three places successively; his second son Li Yongzhi inherited this Yangjiawan Old House and expanded it to both sides, making the existing building area reach 1300 square meters. During the 'War of Resistance' period, the old house was once the location of the General Headquarters of River Defense in the Upper Yangtze of the 30th Army of the anti-Japanese forces. The Old House in Yangjiawan has a horizontal rectangular layout, with two entries in depth and eleven houses connected horizontally, with a total of seven courtyards (tianjing). The exterior walls are built with blue bricks; the central bay and main halls have more exquisite wooden roof trusses, while other houses use walls to support the roof, with gable gray-tile roofs. Each house has horse-head walls on both sides. Green trees surround the front and back of the house, and the dancing leaf shadows are cast on the clean walls, making people feel fresh and elegant.

有两栋保存较好、规模较大的清代古民居
这两座老屋都是当地易氏的故居
易氏先祖由山西太原移至峡州（今宜昌）
又于清朝迁入深山峡谷的南边
族中的忠祚公支脉读书致仕
又开办钱庄、放高利贷、开设酒坊商店
今天南边民居的主人便是这一支的后人
projects.content_zh: 夷陵区黄花乡南边村深处，有两栋保存较好、规模较大的清代古民居，分别名为'宝和'和'老号'，两栋老屋相距不到200米。这两座老屋都是当地易氏的故居，始建于清嘉庆六年（1801）。据《易氏族谱》记载，易氏先祖由山西太原移至峡州（今宜昌），后为避乱，又于清朝迁入深山峡谷的南边。此后，族中的忠祚公支脉读书致仕，通过科举起家，又开办钱庄、放高利贷、开设酒坊商店，并编纂了《易氏族谱》12卷，今天南边民居的主人便是这一支的后人。'宝和'清末建成，主人名为易起芬，占地面积...
projects.content_en: Deep in Nanbian Village, Huanghua Township, Yiling District, there are two well-preserved and relatively large-scale Qing ancient vernacular dwellings, respectively named 'Baohe' (Treasure Harmony) and 'Lao Hao' (Old Name); the two old houses are less than 200 meters apart. Both old houses are the former residences of the local Yi family, first built in the 6th year of Jiaqing, Qing (1801). According to the records of the 'Yi Family Genealogy,' the ancestors of the Yi family moved from Taiyuan, Shanxi to Xiazhou (present-day Yichang), and later, to avoid chaos, moved to Nanbian in the deep mountain gorges during the Qing. Thereafter, the Zhongzuo Gong branch of the clan studied to become officials, rose through the imperial examinations, and also opened money shops, lent high-interest loans, opened wine workshops and shops, and compiled 12 volumes of the 'Yi Family Genealogy'; today's owners of the Nanbian dwellings are descendants of this branch. projects.name: 望家祠堂
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 夷陵区太平溪镇高峡大道60号

highlights: 望家祠堂原址在太平溪镇伍厢庙村
2000年配合三峡工程建设迁至现址
望是一个历史悠久的姓氏
其始祖可以追溯到周朝的齐太公吕尚
即封神榜中大名鼎鼎的姜子牙
望家祠堂占地面积约300平方米
正如民间俗语所说走马转阁楼

projects.content_zh: 望家祠堂原址在太平溪镇伍厢庙村，2000年配合三峡工程建设迁至现址。'望'是一个历史悠久的姓氏，其始祖可以追溯到周朝的齐太公吕尚，即《封神榜》中大名鼎鼎的姜子牙。望家祠堂占地面积约300平方米，一进二层，中间为天井，前厅后堂，两侧有厢房。前厅为穿斗式木构架，后堂为抬梁式木构架，二楼天井四周有回廊，正如民间俗语所说'走马转阁楼，下雨不湿鞋'。青砖外墙，灰瓦屋面，封火山墙，正门高起的墙面做成简单的牌楼式样，屋檐下有一圈彩画装饰。
projects.content_en: The original site of Wang's Ancestral Hall was in Wuxiangmiao Village, Taipingxi Town; in 2000, it was moved to the current site in coordination with the Three Gorges Project construction. 'Wang' is a surname with a long history; its first ancestor can be traced back to Lü Shang, Duke Tai of Qi in the Zhou Dynasty, i.e., the famous Jiang Ziya in 'Investiture of the Gods.' Wang's Ancestral Hall covers an area of about 300 square meters, with one entry and two stories, a courtyard (tianjing) in the middle, front hall and rear hall, and wing rooms on both sides. The front hall has a column-and-tie wooden frame, and the rear hall has a post-and-lintel wooden frame; around the courtyard on the second floor there are corridors, just as the folk saying goes, 'galloping horses turn the attic, no wet shoes in rain.' Blue brick exterior walls, gray tile roof, fire-sealing gable walls; the high wall at the main gate is made into a simple paifang style, with a circle of painted decoration under the eaves.

projects.name: 圆通寺
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位

highlights: 院庄寺在院庄铺伏牛山
乡人谭仲华施有常住地
国朝康熙四年僧笔峰重修
圆通寺现仅存山门和大殿
但可以看出这里曾经是一座规模宏大的佛刹
山门和大殿均为五间单檐悬山屋顶
山门正面匾额上书圆通禅林四字
正殿脊檩下方还能看到清楚的大清光绪五年三月初三题记
最有意思的是两座建筑中保存的石雕构件
如山门的门框上雕刻凤凰、喜鹊、梅花等图案
并使用了三种不同的浮雕技法
类似于营造法式中的剔地凸起
而大殿的八角形柱础每面都雕刻不同的图案
projects.content_zh: 圆通寺始建于元朝，亦名院庄寺，据清代《东湖县志》记载：'院庄寺在院庄铺伏牛山，旧名圆通刹，元建。明洪武初，乡人谭仲华施有常住地，国朝康熙四年僧笔峰重修。'圆通寺现仅存山门和大殿，坐北朝南，虽然保存状况不佳，但可以看出这里曾经是一座规模宏大的佛刹。山门和大殿均为五间单檐悬山屋顶，外观朴素，但木结构用材讲究，做工规整，构架制作精细。山门正面匾额上书'圆通禅林'四字，正殿脊檩下方还能看到清楚的'大清光绪五年三月初三'题记。最有意思的是两座建筑中保存的石雕构件，如山门的门框上雕刻凤凰、喜鹊、梅花等图案，并使用了三种不同的浮雕技法，类似于《营造法式》中的剔地凸起、压地隐起和减地平钑。而大殿的八角形柱础每面都雕刻不同的图案，非常富有民间趣味。
projects.content_en: Yuantong Temple was first built in the Yuan Dynasty, also called Yuanzhuang Temple; according to the records of the 'Donghu County Annals' of the Qing: 'Yuanzhuang Temple is at Funiu Mountain, Yuanzhuang Pu, formerly named Yuantong Cha, built in the Yuan. At the beginning of Hongwu, Ming, local Tan Zhonghua donated permanent land; in the 4th year of Kangxi of the current dynasty, monk Bifeng rebuilt it.' Yuantong Temple now only retains the mountain gate and main hall, facing south; although the preservation condition is poor, it can be seen that this was once a large-scale Buddhist temple. Both the mountain gate and main hall have five-bay single-eave overhanging gable roofs, with a simple exterior, but the wooden structure uses refined materials, with regular workmanship and exquisite frame construction. On the front plaque of the mountain gate are written the four characters 'Yuantong Chan Lin' (Yuantong Buddhist Forest); below the ridge purlin of the main hall, a clear inscription '3rd day of the 3rd month, 5th year of Guangxu, Qing' can still be seen. The most interesting are the stone carving components preserved in the two buildings, such as the door frame of the mountain gate carved with patterns of phoenixes, magpies, plum blossoms, etc., using three different relief techniques, similar to the 'ti-di tu-qi' (raised carving), 'ya-di yin-qi' (subtle relief), and 'jian-di ping-ji' (flat carving) in the 'Yingzao Fashi' (State Building Standards). The octagonal column plinths of the main hall are carved with different patterns on each face, very rich in folk charm.

projects.name: 宜昌近代建筑
projects.address: 宜昌市沿江一带
projects.address_en: Along the river area, Yichang City
highlights: 1876年中英烟台条约辟宜昌为通商口岸
美孚、亚细亚、德士古等煤油公司纷纷建立了专用码头
此后英国、德国和日本相继在宜昌设立领事馆
修建了通惠路（今解放路）、中山路、云集路、陶朱路（今陶珠路）等新型街道
宜昌近代建筑主要分布在沿江的云集路、红星路一带
以及亚细亚火油公司的办公楼、住宅
projects.content_zh: 1876年，《中英烟台条约》辟宜昌为通商口岸，开埠后的宜昌，舟楫往来，美孚、亚细亚、德士古等煤油公司纷纷建立了专用码头。1877年4月1日，宜昌海关设立，英国人任税务司，此后英国、德国和日本相继在宜昌设立领事馆。中华民国三年（1914），宜昌成立商埠工程局，市区向南郊扩展，修建了通惠路（今解放路）、中山路、云集路、陶朱路（今陶珠路）等新型街道，近代城市初具规模。宜昌近代建筑主要分布在沿江的云集路、红星路一带，现存数量不多，但类型十分丰富，包括宜昌海关公署，教堂，英国领事馆，海军俱乐部，以及亚细亚火油公司的办公楼、住宅，太古轮船公司办公楼，海鸥百货商店等。
projects.content_en: In 1876, the 'Sino-British Chefoo Convention' opened Yichang as a trading port; after the opening, Yichang saw boats coming and going, and kerosene companies such as Mobil, Asiatic Petroleum, and Texaco successively built dedicated docks. On April 1, 1877, the Yichang Customs was established, with a British person serving as the tax commissioner; thereafter, Britain, Germany, and Japan successively established consulates in Yichang. In the 3rd year of the Republic of China (1914), Yichang established the Commercial Port Engineering Bureau; the urban area expanded to the southern suburbs, and new-type streets such as Tonghui Road (present-day Jiefang Road), Zhongshan Road, Yunji Road, and Taozhu Road (present-day Taozhu Road) were built, and the modern city began to take shape. Modern architecture in Yichang is mainly distributed along the river in the Yunji Road and Hongxing Road area; the existing number is not large, but the types are very rich, including the Yichang Customs Office, churches, the British Consulate, the Navy Club, as well as the office building and residence of the Asiatic Petroleum Company, the office building of the China Navigation Company, the Seagull Department Store, etc.

projects.name: 英国领事馆
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 伍家岗区红星路42号
projects.address_en: No.42 Hongxing Road, Wujiagang District
highlights: 是长江边一条热闹的商业街
宜昌商会取怀远以德中怀远二字为这条街道命名
宜昌市政府选址红星路
在地图上画一颗红星来标注党政机关
随着搬来的机关部门不断增多
地图上的红星也越来越多
于是怀远路更名为红星路
宜昌英国领事馆开设于1877年
最初设立在英国金河号军舰上
后迁至怀远路东侧（现址）
光绪十八年建成现存办公楼
顶部三角山花上饰1892字样
原有四个烟囱伸出屋顶
这座见证了宜昌被侵略历史的建筑
2008年在一片争议中被用作酒楼
原本米色的外墙也被刷成红色
经过业主、市民、专家和文化局各方面的沟通交流
而酒店也得以继续运营
文物建筑的保护和开发利用的规范更加深入人心
projects.content_zh: 红星路原名怀远路，是长江边一条热闹的商业街。宜昌开埠后，宜昌商会取'怀远以德'中'怀远'二字为这条街道命名。新中国成立后，宜昌市政府选址红星路。按照当时的惯例，在地图上画一颗红星来标注党政机关；随着搬来的机关部门不断增多，地图上的红星也越来越多，于是怀远路更名为红星路。宜昌英国领事馆开设于1877年，最初设立在英国金河号军舰上，后迁至怀远路东侧（现址），光绪十八年（1892）建成现存办公楼。领事馆占地约300平方米，为二层砖木混合结构，方形平面，正面设拱券外廊，顶部三角山花上饰'1892'字样。红瓦坡屋顶组合，错落有致。室内大厅设有壁炉，原有四个烟囱伸出屋顶。这座见证了宜昌被侵略历史的建筑，2008年在一片争议中被用作酒楼，原本米色的外墙也被刷成红色。经过业主、市民、专家和文化局各方面的沟通交流，外墙最终恢复了原貌，而酒店也得以继续运营，经过这件事，文物建筑的保护和开发利用的规范更加深入人心。
projects.content_en: Hongxing Road was originally named Huaiyuan Road, a lively commercial street by the Yangtze River. After Yichang was opened as a port, the Yichang Chamber of Commerce named this street after the two characters 'Huaiyuan' from 'huai yuan yi de' (cherishing the distant with virtue). After the founding of New China, the Yichang Municipal Government chose Hongxing Road as its site. According to the convention at the time, a red star was drawn on the map to mark party and government organs; as more and more organs moved in, there were more and more red stars on the map, so Huaiyuan Road was renamed Hongxing Road. The British Consulate in Yichang was established in 1877, initially set up on the British warship HMS Kinsha, and later moved to the east side of Huaiyuan Road (the current site); the existing office building was completed in the 18th year of Guangxu (1892). The consulate covers an area of about 300 square meters, a two-story brick-wood mixed structure with a square plan, arched exterior corridors on the front, and the triangular gable at the top decorated with the characters '1892.' The red-tile sloped roof combination is well-proportioned. The indoor hall has a fireplace, and originally four chimneys protruded from the roof. This building, which witnessed the history of Yichang being invaded, was used as a restaurant amid controversy in 2008, and the originally beige exterior wall was also painted red. Through communication and exchange among the owner, citizens, experts, and the Cultural Bureau, the exterior wall was finally restored to its original appearance, and the hotel could continue to operate; through this incident, the norms for the protection and development of cultural heritage buildings became more deeply rooted in people's hearts.

projects.name: 亚细亚火油公司
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 西陵区云集路29号
projects.address_en: No.29 Yunji Road, Xiling District
highlights: 宜昌亚细亚火油分公司开设于1912年
二层是带有栏杆的柱廊
亚细亚公司除了这一处办公楼
还在万寿桥江边设立油栈、码头、仓库和油池
几座大型油池的储存量已经达到1.4万吨
云、贵、川、藏地区的所用大部分洋油都是从这里中转出去的
保存下来的还有一只高15米
这也是长江沿岸保存的唯一一只洋油油罐
以1厘米厚的钢板焊接而成
已逾百岁的油罐被开辟为港口文化陈列馆
projects.content_zh: 宜昌亚细亚火油分公司开设于1912年，'L'形平面，浅黄色水泥拉毛墙面，红瓦坡屋顶。南面有外廊，底层为连续的拱券，二层是带有栏杆的柱廊；两端各有一个入口，以塔司干柱装饰。亚细亚公司除了这一处办公楼，还在万寿桥江边设立油栈、码头、仓库和油池，到1925年，几座大型油池的储存量已经达到1.4万吨，云、贵、川、藏地区的所用大部分'洋油'都是从这里中转出去的。今天除了办公楼，保存下来的还有一只高15米，直径21米的大油罐，这也是长江沿岸保存的唯一一只洋油油罐。这只油罐共分七层，以1厘米厚的钢板焊接而成，可容4000立方米煤油。2009年，已逾百岁的油罐被开辟为港口文化陈列馆，迎来了新的使命。
projects.content_en: The Yichang branch of the Asiatic Petroleum Company was established in 1912, with an 'L'-shaped plan, light yellow cement roughcast walls, and a red-tile sloped roof. There are exterior corridors on the south side; the ground floor has continuous arches, and the second floor has columned corridors with railings; there is an entrance at each end, decorated with Tuscan columns. In addition to this office building, the Asiatic Company also established oil depots, docks, warehouses, and oil tanks by the river at Wanshou Bridge; by 1925, the storage capacity of several large oil tanks had reached 14,000 tons, and most of the 'foreign oil' used in the Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, and Tibet regions was transshipped from here. Today, in addition to the office building, a large oil tank 15 meters high and 21 meters in diameter has also been preserved; this is also the only foreign-oil tank preserved along the Yangtze River. This oil tank is divided into seven layers, welded with 1-centimeter-thick steel plates, and can hold 4,000 cubic meters of kerosene. In 2009, the oil tank, which had passed its centenary, was opened as a Port Culture Exhibition Hall, welcoming a new mission.

projects.name: 太古轮船办公楼
projects.name_en: Office Building of China Navigation Company Limited
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 伍家岗区红星路13号
projects.address_en: No.13 Hongxing Road, Wujiagang District
highlights: 太古轮船公司是英国太古洋行旗下的轮船公司
其业务集中在长江中上游
也是最早进入川江航运的外国公司之一
是太古经营重庆至宜昌段航运最兴盛的时期
太古轮船公司的这座办公楼建于1918年
阳台、窗户、栏杆等细节具有欧式风格
这座办公楼曾被用作临时指挥中心
projects.content_zh: 太古轮船公司是英国太古洋行旗下的轮船公司，1872年创立于上海，其业务集中在长江中上游，也是最早进入川江航运的外国公司之一。20世纪20—30年代，是太古经营重庆至宜昌段航运最兴盛的时期。太古轮船公司的这座办公楼建于1918年，二层砖木结构，红瓦四坡屋顶。平面整体为矩形，一角伸出阳台，入口有廊道，阳台、窗户、栏杆等细节具有欧式风格。1938年著名的'宜昌大撤退'时，这座办公楼曾被用作临时指挥中心。
projects.content_en: The China Navigation Company is a shipping company under the British Butterfield & Swire, founded in Shanghai in 1872; its business was concentrated in the middle and upper reaches of the Yangtze River, and it was also one of the earliest foreign companies to enter the Chuanjiang (Sichuan River) shipping. The 1920s–1930s was the most prosperous period for Swire's operation of the Chongqing–Yichang shipping route. This office building of the China Navigation Company was built in 1918, a two-story brick-wood structure with a red-tile hipped roof. The overall plan is rectangular, with a balcony protruding from one corner and a corridor at the entrance; details such as the balcony, windows, and railings have a European style. During the famous 'Yichang Great Retreat' in 1938, this office building was once used as a temporary command center.

projects.name: 圣方济各堂
projects.name_en: St. Francis Catholic Church in Yichang
projects.level: 市级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 伍家岗区自立路2号
projects.address_en: No.2 Zili Road, Wujiagang District
projects.type: 宗教建筑·砖木结构、钢筋水泥结构
projects.type_en: Religious Building · Brick-Wood, Reinforced Concrete Structure
highlights: 宜昌圣方济各堂又称宜昌天主堂
教堂建筑面积约2000平方米
现存主教堂、住宅、出租用房、酒窖等建筑
主教堂平面为拉丁十字
内部依次为门廊、小经堂、过厅
然后是进深7间、通高2层的大厅
正立面有三间方柱廊和三角山花
两侧三层方形尖顶塔楼一对
圣方济各堂是天主教宜昌教区的主教堂
在今天依然发挥着重要的宗教职能
projects.content_zh: 宜昌圣方济各堂又称宜昌天主堂，始建于1883年；1891年毁于火灾，1892年重建，砖木结构；1931年改建为钢筋水泥结构，保存至今。教堂建筑面积约2000平方米，现存主教堂、住宅、出租用房、酒窖等建筑。主教堂平面为拉丁十字，长55米，宽19米，内部依次为门廊、小经堂、过厅，然后是进深7间、通高2层的大厅，最后是半圆形祭室。正立面有三间方柱廊和三角山花，两侧三层方形尖顶塔楼一对。圣方济各堂是天主教宜昌教区的主教堂，在今天依然发挥着重要的宗教职能。
projects.content_en: St. Francis Catholic Church in Yichang, also called Yichang Catholic Church, was first built in 1883; it was destroyed by fire in 1891 and rebuilt in 1892 with a brick-wood structure; in 1931 it was converted to a reinforced concrete structure and has been preserved to this day. The church building area is about 2000 square meters; the existing buildings include the main church, residences, rental rooms, wine cellar, etc. The main church has a Latin cross plan, 55 meters long and 19 meters wide; the interior is in sequence: porch, small chapel, vestibule, then a hall 7 bays deep and 2 stories high, and finally a semicircular apse. The front facade has three square columned porches and a triangular gable, with a pair of three-story square spired towers on both sides. St. Francis Church is the main church of the Catholic Diocese of Yichang and still plays an important religious function today.

projects.name: 天然塔
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 伍家岗区江滨公园内
projects.address_en: Jiangbin Park, Wujiagang District
highlights: 据清同治三年宜昌府志·艺文志中的重修天然塔记记载
旧传晋郭景纯侨寓时所建
可见天然塔既是一座风水塔
对于城市景观也有很好的美化作用
天然塔最后一次重建可谓一波三折
大学士文安之曾想把原来的小塔拆掉
重建一座高大宏伟的塔
文安之随南明朝廷流亡
本地士绅想在原塔基处重建天然塔
然而由于工匠技术的缺陷
这次主持重修的士绅徐经业对建筑营造的知识颇有研究
又奔走各地聘请施工技术人员
并亲临现场解决各种疑难问题
整个工程期间共投入土木砖石各种工匠100余名
为八角七层楼阁式空心砖塔
塔基八角各有一座石雕的托塔金刚
首层的拱券塔门西向面向长江
天然塔是长江航道上重要的航标
来往的航船无论在上游还是下游
七楼上还会点燃为船舶航行指路的明灯
今天的天然塔立于长江之滨
依然是宜昌的一处地标
projects.content_zh: 天然塔虽名为'天然'，却是人工所建。据清同治三年（1864）《宜昌府志·艺文志》中的《重修天然塔记》记载：'东湖为古彝陵州……城东主山卑弱，受其欺压。且江水自西峡一束……非高标凌跨，无以束其势。故城南青草铺有塔，岿然耸峙江干。旧传晋郭景纯侨寓时所建，培地脉，壮文峰，制客山，镇水口，咸于塔乎是赖。'可见天然塔既是一座风水塔，对于城市景观也有很好的美化作用。天然塔最后一次重建可谓一波三折。明末时，大学士文安之曾想把原来的小塔拆掉，重建一座高大宏伟的塔。工程刚刚准备就绪，清军便攻破山海关，文安之随南明朝廷流亡，建塔事宜随之停止。此后直到清乾隆十年（1745），本地士绅想在原塔基处重建天然塔，然而由于工匠技术的缺陷，塔屡建屡垮，最后仅建好了塔基；又过了45年，这次主持重修的士绅徐经业对建筑营造的知识颇有研究，又奔走各地聘请施工技术人员，并亲临现场解决各种疑难问题，天然塔终于得以建成。整个工程期间共投入土木砖石各种工匠100余名，历时3年。天然塔高40余米，为八角七层楼阁式空心砖塔，每层出檐，檐下有斗拱装饰。塔基八角各有一座石雕的托塔金刚，可惜现状均有残损。首层的拱券塔门西向面向长江，额刻'天然塔'三字，门柱刻一对楹联：'玉柱耸江，干威镇荆门十二；文峰凌汉表，雄当蜀道三千。'在过去，天然塔是长江航道上重要的航标，来往的航船无论在上游还是下游，都可以看到这座宝塔，在夜间，七楼上还会点燃为船舶航行指路的明灯。今天的天然塔立于长江之滨，依然是宜昌的一处地标。
projects.content_en: Although named 'Tianran' (Natural), Tianran Pagoda was artificially built. According to the 'Record of Rebuilding Tianran Pagoda' in the 'Yichang Prefecture Annals · Arts and Literature' of the 3rd year of Tongzhi, Qing (1864): 'Donghu was the ancient Yiling Prefecture... the main mountain east of the city is low and weak, oppressed by it. And the river water is constricted from the West Gorge... without a high mark spanning across, there is no way to restrain its momentum. Therefore, there is a pagoda at Qingcaopu south of the city, towering majestically by the river. Legend has it that it was built when Guo Jingchun of the Jin lived here in exile, to nourish the earth's veins, strengthen the literary peak, control the guest mountain, and guard the water mouth; all rely on this pagoda.' It can be seen that Tianran Pagoda is both a fengshui pagoda and has a good beautifying effect on the urban landscape. The last reconstruction of Tianran Pagoda can be described as full of twists and turns. At the end of the Ming, Grand Secretary Wen Anzhi once wanted to tear down the original small pagoda and rebuild a tall and magnificent one. The project had just been prepared when the Qing army broke through Shanhai Pass; Wen Anzhi went into exile with the Southern Ming court, and the pagoda construction stopped accordingly. Thereafter, until the 10th year of Qianlong, Qing (1745), local gentry wanted to rebuild Tianran Pagoda at the original pagoda foundation; however, due to the technical deficiencies of the craftsmen, the pagoda was built and collapsed repeatedly, and finally only the foundation was built; another 45 years later, the gentry Xu Jingye, who presided over this reconstruction, had considerable research on architectural construction knowledge, and traveled around to hire construction technicians, personally visiting the site to solve various difficult problems; Tianran Pagoda was finally completed. During the entire project, more than 100 craftsmen of various types (earth, wood, brick, stone) were invested, lasting 3 years. Tianran Pagoda is over 40 meters high, an octagonal seven-story pavilion-style hollow brick pagoda, with eaves on each story and bracket-set decoration under the eaves. At each of the eight corners of the pagoda base there is a stone-carved pagoda-supporting vajra warrior; unfortunately, all are now damaged. The arched pagoda door on the first floor faces west toward the Yangtze River, with the three characters 'Tianran Ta' carved on the lintel, and a pair of couplets carved on the door pillars: 'Jade pillar towers over the river, its majesty guards the twelve Jingmen gates; literary peak reaches the Han sky, its might faces the three thousand Shu roads.' In the past, Tianran Pagoda was an important navigation mark on the Yangtze waterway; passing ships, whether upstream or downstream, could see this pagoda; at night, a guiding lamp for ship navigation would also be lit on the seventh floor. Today's Tianran Pagoda stands by the Yangtze River and remains a landmark of Yichang.

projects.name: 杨守敬故居和墓
projects.name_en: Former Residence and Tomb of Yang Shoujing
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 宜都市陆城街道邻苏里30号
projects.address_en: No.30 Linsuli, Lucheng Street, Yidu City
highlights: 杨守敬生于清道光十九年
集舆地、金石、书法、泉币、藏书以及碑版目录学于一身
被誉为晚清民初学者第一人
清史稿对他的评价为其学通博
为鄂学灵光者垂二十年
在杨守敬的诸多成就中
而在他舆地学的20多种著作中
又以水经注疏最为重要
这部鸿篇巨著是对郦道元水经注的注释
杨守敬一一考证了其中的1200条水道
杨守敬的书法在日本影响巨大
他的藏书在私人藏书家中也是屈指可数的
杨守敬是清代300年间最有成就的学者之一
宜都市清江边的杨守敬故居是一处占地500多平方米的院落民居
建筑均为硬山灰瓦屋面
各个房间分别开辟为惺吾厅、典籍厅、真迹厅、遗著室、卧室等
整个建筑掩映在绿树丛中
是宜都地区土、汉民族杂居的典型建筑
杨守敬墓位于宜都市陆城街道龙窝村三组
正中浮雕杨守敬半身像
projects.content_zh: 杨守敬生于清道光十九年（1839），字云鹏，因曾在黄冈任职，临近东坡赤壁，晚年自号邻苏老人。杨守敬勤奋治学，博闻强记，长于考证，集舆地、金石、书法、泉币、藏书以及碑版目录学于一身，一生著述多达83种，被誉为'晚清民初学者第一人'。《清史稿》对他的评价为：'其学通博，精舆地，用力于水经尤勤；通训诂，考证金石文字，能书摹钟鼎至精；工俪体，为箴铭之属，古奥耸拔，为鄂学灵光者垂二十年。'在杨守敬的诸多成就中，以舆地学最为突出；而在他舆地学的20多种著作中，又以《水经注疏》最为重要。这部鸿篇巨著是对郦道元《水经注》的注释，杨守敬一一考证了其中的1200条水道，并编绘《水经注图》，图文对照，相得益彰。此外，杨守敬的书法在日本影响巨大，他的藏书在私人藏书家中也是屈指可数的。可以毫不夸张地说，杨守敬是清代300年间最有成就的学者之一。宜都市清江边的杨守敬故居是一处占地500多平方米的院落民居，砖木结构。平面呈长方形，两进院落，中轴对称布局，建筑均为硬山灰瓦屋面，青砖封火山墙刷白色。第一进为单层，中间客厅，两侧厢房；第二进有两层，有书房、卧室和藏书楼。开辟为纪念馆后，各个房间分别开辟为惺吾厅、典籍厅、真迹厅、遗著室、卧室等，陈列着近千件展品。大门面对清江，整个建筑掩映在绿树丛中，古朴雅致，是宜都地区土、汉民族杂居的典型建筑。杨守敬墓位于宜都市陆城街道龙窝村三组，1915年建成。墓冢为圆形土堆，总高约3.2米，其下部1米由青石浆砌。墓前立3道石碑，嵌在石质碑框中，其上雕刻屋檐、屋脊，有如石牌坊形制，正中浮雕杨守敬半身像。
projects.content_en: Yang Shoujing was born in the 19th year of Daoguang, Qing (1839), styled Yunpeng; because he once served in Huanggang, near Dongpo Red Cliff, he called himself Linsu Laoren (Old Man Neighboring Su) in his later years. Yang Shoujing was diligent in scholarship, with extensive knowledge and a strong memory, skilled in textual research; he integrated geography, epigraphy, calligraphy, numismatics, book collection, and stele bibliography into one, with as many as 83 works in his lifetime, known as 'the No.1 scholar of the late Qing and early Republican period.' The 'Draft History of Qing' evaluated him as: 'His learning was comprehensive and profound, skilled in geography, especially diligent in the Commentary on the Water Classic; proficient in exegesis, researching bronze and stone inscriptions, able to copy Zhong and Ding calligraphy exquisitely; skilled in parallel prose, writing admonitions and inscriptions, ancient and profound, towering and upright, serving as the spiritual light of Hubei scholarship for nearly twenty years.' Among Yang Shoujing's many achievements, geography was the most prominent; and among his more than 20 geographical works, the 'Commentary on the Water Classic (Shui Jing Zhu Shu)' was the most important. This monumental work is a commentary on Li Daoyuan's 'Commentary on the Water Classic'; Yang Shoujing verified one by one the 1,200 waterways in it, and compiled and drew the 'Map of the Commentary on the Water Classic,' with text and pictures contrasting each other, complementing each other. In addition, Yang Shoujing's calligraphy had a huge influence in Japan, and his book collection was also among the best among private book collectors. It is no exaggeration to say that Yang Shoujing was one of the most accomplished scholars during the 300 years of the Qing Dynasty. Yang Shoujing's Former Residence by the Qing River in Yidu City is a courtyard residence covering more than 500 square meters, of brick-wood structure. The plane is rectangular, with two courtyards and a centrally symmetric layout; the buildings all have gable gray-tile roofs, with blue-brick fire-sealing gable walls painted white. The first entry is single-story, with a living room in the middle and wing rooms on both sides; the second entry has two stories, with a study, bedroom, and book collection tower. After being opened as a memorial hall, each room was respectively opened as Xingwu Hall, Classics Hall, Authentic Works Hall, Posthumous Works Room, Bedroom, etc., displaying nearly a thousand exhibits. The main gate faces the Qing River, and the entire building is nestled among green trees, simple and elegant, a typical building of Tujia and Han ethnic mixed settlement in the Yidu area. Yang Shoujing's Tomb is located in Group 3, Longwo Village, Lucheng Street, Yidu City, completed in 1915. The tomb mound is a circular earthen mound, with a total height of about 3.2 meters, and its lower 1 meter is built with bluestone mortar. In front of the tomb stand 3 stone steles, embedded in stone stele frames, with eaves and ridges carved on them, like a stone paifang form; in the center is a relief bust of Yang Shoujing.

projects.content_zh: 玉泉寺是湖北著名的寺院，天台宗的四大祖庭之一，也是中国佛教历史最为悠久的寺院之一。早在东汉末年，汜水关镇国寺的普净禅师云游至此，便在这里结茅修行。《三国演义》七十七回'玉泉山关公显圣，洛阳城曹操感神'，文中喝破大叫'还我头来'的关羽冤魂的，正是这位普净禅师。而正史中夷陵之战时，刘备也曾亲临当阳为关羽祭祀，并兴建显圣祠。南北朝时，梁武帝因玉泉山形如一只倒置的大船，在此建覆船山寺；隋开皇十三年（593），改名为玉泉寺，成为天台宗实际创始人智者大师的道场。唐代，禅宗'北渐'神秀大师曾从黄梅东山寺（今五祖寺）来此弘扬禅法，玉泉寺从此逐渐兴盛。北宋真宗时，由于明肃皇后信仰佛教，玉泉寺一度达到了鼎盛的规模，'为楼者九，为殿者十八，三千七百僧舍'，常驻千余僧人。当时，玉泉寺与浙江天台国清寺、山东长清灵严寺和江苏南京栖霞寺并称为'天下丛林四绝'，也是'三楚名山''荆楚丛林之冠'。玉泉寺坐西朝东，依山而建，占地面积达到5万多平方米，现存建筑多为明清时期修建。中轴线上有山门（天王殿）、大雄宝殿和观音殿，大雄宝殿前有莲池，左右有祖师、伽蓝二殿、及藏经楼和般若堂。山门外不远是著名的玉泉寺铁塔，山门前还有一道'三楚名山'牌坊。现存的建筑中除了铁塔，最重要的是建于明代的大雄宝殿。大雄宝殿面阔七间约40米，进深五间约24米，高23米，重檐歇山顶，灰色筒板瓦屋顶。室内藻井以下的部分近于官式的抬梁结构做法，藻井以上则为富有南方特色的穿斗式屋架。室内外共72根立柱，全部用金丝楠木制成。大殿上下檐和殿身内部均施以斗拱，共有10种148攒。大雄宝殿的结构在很多方面都保留了宋代的做法。首先，殿身（不包含副阶）所用立柱同高，这与《营造法式》中的'殿堂造'是吻合的；其次大殿的斗拱用材硕大，分布疏朗，在结构中起到了从抬梁到穿斗之间的转换作用，也接近'殿堂造'中有连成一体的铺作层的特点（铺作即宋代对斗拱的称呼）；特别是上、下檐的补间铺作下昂的后尾还用了'挑斡'的形式，平衡了室内外屋顶的荷载，起到了一定的结构作用；最后，大殿的屋顶坡度平缓，举高与进深的比例接近三分之一，这也更接近宋代建筑的特征。20世纪80年代大殿落架大修时，在一块礩礩石底面发现了元代至元年间的题刻；同时，根据碳14同位素的测定，主要木结构的年代在500年上下，廊柱的年代在300年左右。因此推断出大殿的建造年代应在明初，而围廊则是明崇祯年间修葺时增添的。大殿前保存有一口隋大业十一年（615）铸造的铁镬，重达1500公斤，以及元代的铁钟、铁釜等10余件大型铁器。大殿左侧碑亭里还有一幅石刻观音画像，其中观音的形象为男首女身，线条流畅，形象饱满，特别是观音的衣纹仿佛就要随风飘起，相传这幅线刻是唐代画圣吴道子的真迹。
projects.content_en: Yuquan Temple is a famous temple in Hubei, one of the four ancestral halls of the Tiantai Sect, and also one of the oldest Buddhist temples in Chinese history. As early as the end of the Eastern Han, Master Pujing of Zhenguo Temple at Sishui Pass traveled here and built a thatched hut for practice. In Chapter 77 of 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms,' 'Lord Guan Appears as a Saint at Yuquan Mountain, Cao Cao Feels the Spirit at Luoyang City,' it was this Master Pujing who broke through and shouted at the wronged soul of Guan Yu crying 'Give me back my head!' In official history, during the Battle of Yiling, Liu Bei also personally came to Dangyang to sacrifice to Guan Yu and built the Xiansheng Shrine. During the Northern and Southern Dynasties, Emperor Wu of Liang, because Yuquan Mountain was shaped like an upside-down large boat, built the Fuchuan Mountain Temple here; in the 13th year of Kaihuang, Sui (593), it was renamed Yuquan Temple, becoming the道场 of Master Zhizhe, the actual founder of the Tiantai Sect. In the Tang, Master Shenxiu of the 'Northern Gradual' Chan School came here from Huangmei Dongshan Temple (present-day Wuzu Temple) to promote Chan Dharma, and Yuquan Temple gradually flourished from then on. During the reign of Emperor Zhenzong of the Northern Song, because Empress Mingsu believed in Buddhism, Yuquan Temple once reached its peak scale, 'nine buildings, eighteen halls, 3,700 monk quarters,' with more than a thousand resident monks. At that time, Yuquan Temple, together with Guoqing Temple in Tiantai, Zhejiang, Lingyan Temple in Changqing, Shandong, and Qixia Temple in Nanjing, Jiangsu, were collectively called the 'Four Wonders of the World's Monasteries,' and was also the 'Famous Mountain of the Three Chu' and 'Crown of Jingchu Monasteries.' Yuquan Temple faces east from west, built along the mountain, covering an area of more than 50,000 square meters; most of the existing buildings were built during the Ming and Qing periods. On the central axis there are the mountain gate (Heavenly Kings Hall), Mahavira Hall, and Guanyin Hall; in front of the Mahavira Hall there is a lotus pond, and on the left and right there are the Patriarch Hall, Sangharama Hall, as well as the Sutra Library and Prajna Hall. Not far outside the mountain gate is the famous Yuquan Temple Iron Pagoda, and in front of the mountain gate there is also a 'Famous Mountain of the Three Chu' paifang. Among the existing buildings, besides the Iron Pagoda, the most important is the Mahavira Hall built in the Ming. The Mahavira Hall is seven bays wide, about 40 meters, five bays deep, about 24 meters, and 23 meters high, with a double-eave hip-and-gable roof and a gray tube-and-plate tile roof. The part below the indoor caisson is close to the official-style post-and-lintel structure practice, while above the caisson is a column-and-tie roof truss rich in southern characteristics. There are 72 columns indoors and outdoors, all made of golden silk nanmu wood. The upper and lower eaves of the hall and the interior of the hall body are all decorated with bracket sets, with a total of 10 types and 148 clusters. The structure of the Mahavira Hall retains Song Dynasty practices in many aspects. First, the columns used in the hall body (not including the subordinate steps) are of the same height, which matches the 'hall construction' in the 'Yingzao Fashi' (State Building Standards); second, the bracket sets of the hall use large materials and are sparsely distributed, playing a conversion role from post-and-lintel to column-and-tie in the structure, also close to the characteristic of a connected 'puzuo' layer in 'hall construction' (puzuo is the Song name for bracket sets); especially the rear tails of the 'ang' (lever arms) of the inter-columnar puzuo on the upper and lower eaves also use the 'tiaowo' (lever arm) form, balancing the loads of the indoor and outdoor roofs and playing a certain structural role; finally, the roof slope of the hall is gentle, with the ratio of lift height to depth close to one-third, which is also closer to the characteristics of Song architecture. During the major disassembly and repair of the hall in the 1980s, an inscription from the Zhiyuan period of the Yuan was found on the bottom of a 'zhizhi' stone; at the same time, according to carbon-14 isotope dating, the age of the main wooden structure is around 500 years, and the age of the gallery columns is around 300 years. Therefore, it is inferred that the construction date of the hall should be in the early Ming, while the surrounding gallery was added during repairs in the Chongzhen period of the Ming. In front of the hall, an iron 'huo' (cauldron) cast in the 11th year of Daye, Sui (615), weighing 1,500 kg, as well as more than 10 large iron objects such as Yuan iron bells and iron cauldrons, are preserved. In the stele pavilion on the left side of the hall, there is also a stone-carved Guanyin portrait, in which the image of Guanyin has a male head and female body, with smooth lines and a full image; especially the clothing lines of Guanyin seem about to flutter in the wind; legend has it that this line carving is the authentic work of the Tang painting sage Wu Daozi.

projects.name: 关陵
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 当阳市三墩路关陵庙
projects.address_en: Guanling Temple, Sandun Road, Dangyang City
highlights: 关陵位于当阳市区西北2公里
是三国时期蜀汉著名将领关羽的陵墓
现存建筑群落成于明嘉靖十五年
孙权一边将关羽首级运送给曹操
一边又以诸侯之礼将其尸骸收葬于此
南宋淳熙年间开始建祭亭
明成化三年又创建祭祀用的庙宇
陵园内现存建筑包括神道、碑亭、石坊、三元门、马殿、拜殿、正殿、寝殿、春秋阁、伯子祠、八角亭等
整个陵园以神道为中轴线
神道的起点是一座方形的碑亭
始建于明万历三十一年
清道光、同治年间先后维修
碑亭为单檐歇山琉璃顶
亭中的石碑上记载了历代皇帝为关羽加封的尊号
碑亭之后是石坊和三元门
石坊建于明嘉靖三十五年
每棵柱顶上雕一只瑞兽
明间上额阴刻汉室忠良
款识为嘉靖戊午年仲秋吉旦立
石坊之后的三元门俗称红楼、山门或义门
进入三元门便是祭祀建筑群
明间的两根石制立柱上浮雕蟠龙
其他柱子则全部采用楠木制成
正门上悬一块同治皇帝御笔威震华夏横匾
寝殿之后的关羽墓冢是一个周长70米、高7米的圆形封土堆
其上又安装一圈石质栏杆
墓碑为明万历四年所立
并且保存了明清两代多通名人碑刻
其中以明代袁宏道、袁中道兄弟之诗文最为引人注目
清代同治年间的当阳章乡关帝陵庙之图石刻则记载了当时关帝庙的规模和格局
保存了珍贵的历史信息
关羽的陵墓在全国一共有3处
当阳的关陵是埋葬关羽尸骸的地方
在关羽的家乡山西解县
人们为追奠家乡的英雄堆砌起一座衣冠冢
在河南洛阳的关林里则埋葬着关羽的头颅
当年曹操曾为之举行了隆重的葬礼
民间流传着关羽头枕洛阳、身困当阳之说
projects.content_zh: 关陵位于当阳市区西北2公里，是三国时期蜀汉著名将领关羽的陵墓，也被称为'关帝庙''武帝庙'或'关庙'。始建于东汉末年，现存建筑群落成于明嘉靖十五年（1536），此后多次修葺。东汉建安二十四年（219），关羽与孙权交战，败退至临沮被杀。孙权一边将关羽首级运送给曹操，一边又以诸侯之礼将其尸骸收葬于此。关陵最初只有封土，南宋淳熙年间开始建祭亭，元朝增修墓道、墓门，明成化三年（1467）又创建祭祀用的庙宇。陵园内现存建筑包括神道、碑亭、石坊、三元门、马殿、拜殿、正殿、寝殿、春秋阁、伯子祠、八角亭等，寝殿之后为墓冢，墓前有碑亭，总面积将近5万平方米。整个陵园以神道为中轴线，对称布局。神道的起点是一座方形的碑亭，始建于明万历三十一年（1603），清道光、同治年间先后维修。碑亭为单檐歇山琉璃顶，亭中的石碑上记载了历代皇帝为关羽加封的尊号。碑亭之后是石坊和三元门。石坊建于明嘉靖三十五年（1556），为四柱三间石制牌坊，每棵柱顶上雕一只瑞兽，明间上额阴刻'汉室忠良'，款识为'嘉靖戊午年仲秋吉旦立'。石坊之后的三元门俗称红楼、山门或义门，建于明成化三年（1467），此后多次维修。进入三元门便是祭祀建筑群，其中以正殿最为重要。正殿平面接近正方形，面阔和进深均为三间，重檐歇山屋顶，黄色琉璃瓦屋面。正面前设廊，明间的两根石制立柱上浮雕蟠龙，其他柱子则全部采用楠木制成，正门上悬一块同治皇帝御笔'威震华夏'横匾。正殿后为寝殿，寝殿之后的关羽墓冢是一个周长70米、高7米的圆形封土堆，下沿用条石垒砌，其上又安装一圈石质栏杆，栏板上浮雕鸟兽、花卉。墓碑为明万历四年（1576）所立，上书'汉寿亭侯墓'。陵园内殿堂森严，古树苍苍，并且保存了明清两代多通名人碑刻，其中以明代袁宏道、袁中道兄弟之诗文最为引人注目；清代同治年间的'当阳章乡关帝陵庙之图'石刻则记载了当时关帝庙的规模和格局，保存了珍贵的历史信息。关羽的陵墓在全国一共有3处，当阳的关陵是埋葬关羽尸骸的地方。在关羽的家乡山西解县，人们为追奠家乡的英雄堆砌起一座衣冠冢；在河南洛阳的'关林'里则埋葬着关羽的头颅，当年曹操曾为之举行了隆重的葬礼，因此，民间流传着关羽'头枕洛阳、身困当阳'之说。
projects.content_en: Guanling (Guan Yu's Mausoleum) is located 2 km northwest of Dangyang urban area; it is the mausoleum of Guan Yu, a famous general of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period, also called 'Guandi Temple,' 'Wudi Temple,' or 'Guan Temple.' It was first built at the end of the Eastern Han, and the existing building complex was completed in the 15th year of Jiajing, Ming (1536), and has been repaired many times since. In the 24th year of Jian'an, Eastern Han (219), Guan Yu fought with Sun Quan, was defeated and retreated to Linju where he was killed. Sun Quan, on the one hand, transported Guan Yu's head to Cao Cao, and on the other hand, buried his remains here with the rites of a feudal lord. Guanling initially only had an earthen mound; during the Chunxi period of the Southern Song, a sacrificial pavilion began to be built; in the Yuan, the tomb path and tomb gate were added; in the 3rd year of Chenghua, Ming (1467), a temple for sacrifice was also built. The existing buildings in the mausoleum park include the spirit path, stele pavilion, stone paifang, Sanyuan Gate, Horse Hall, Worship Hall, Main Hall, Bedchamber Hall, Spring and Autumn Pavilion, Bozi Shrine, Octagonal Pavilion, etc.; behind the Bedchamber Hall is the tomb mound, with a stele pavilion in front of the tomb, with a total area of nearly 50,000 square meters. The entire mausoleum park takes the spirit path as the central axis, with a symmetric layout. The starting point of the spirit path is a square stele pavilion, first built in the 31st year of Wanli, Ming (1603), and repaired successively during the Daoguang and Tongzhi periods of the Qing. The stele pavilion has a single-eave hip-and-gable glazed roof; the stone stele in the pavilion records the honorary titles conferred on Guan Yu by successive emperors. After the stele pavilion are the stone paifang and Sanyuan Gate. The stone paifang was built in the 35th year of Jiajing, Ming (1556), a four-column three-bay stone paifang, with an auspicious beast carved on top of each column; the upper lintel of the central bay is engraved in intaglio with 'Loyal and Good of the Han Dynasty,' with the inscription 'Erected on an auspicious day in the mid-autumn of the Wuwu year of Jiajing.' The Sanyuan Gate after the stone paifang is commonly called Red Tower, Mountain Gate, or Righteousness Gate, built in the 3rd year of Chenghua, Ming (1467), and repaired many times thereafter. Entering the Sanyuan Gate is the sacrificial building complex, of which the Main Hall is the most important. The Main Hall has a nearly square plane, with both width and depth of three bays, a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, and a yellow glazed tile roof. A porch is set in front; on the two stone columns of the central bay, coiling dragons are carved in relief, while all other columns are made of nanmu wood; on the main gate hangs a horizontal plaque with the imperial handwriting of Emperor Tongzhi, 'Mighty Over China.' Behind the Main Hall is the Bedchamber Hall; behind the Bedchamber Hall, Guan Yu's tomb mound is a circular earthen mound with a circumference of 70 meters and a height of 7 meters, with the lower edge built with dressed stones, on which a circle of stone railings is installed, with birds, beasts, and flowers carved in relief on the railing panels. The tomb stele was erected in the 4th year of Wanli, Ming (1576), inscribed with 'Tomb of Hanshou Tinghou.' In the mausoleum park, the halls are solemn, ancient trees are lush, and many famous steles from the Ming and Qing dynasties are preserved; among them, the poems and essays of the Ming brothers Yuan Hongdao and Yuan Zhongdao are the most eye-catching; the stone carving of the 'Map of Guandi Mausoleum Temple at Zhangxiang, Dangyang' from the Tongzhi period of the Qing records the scale and layout of the Guandi Temple at that time, preserving precious historical information. There are a total of 3 mausoleums of Guan Yu nationwide; Guanling in Dangyang is the place where Guan Yu's remains are buried. In Guan Yu's hometown, Xie County, Shanxi, people piled up a clothes-and-hat tomb to commemorate the hometown hero; in 'Guanlin' in Luoyang, Henan, Guan Yu's head is buried, and Cao Cao once held a grand funeral for it; therefore, the folk saying goes that Guan Yu 'rests his head in Luoyang and his body in Dangyang.'

projects.content_zh: 凤凰山古建筑群位于秭归县城茅坪镇东部，是将三峡库区秭归境内的多处古建筑迁建而形成的建筑群。这里与三峡大坝的直线距离不到2公里，东南方向可以远眺三峡。古建筑群包括屈原祠、江渎庙、水府庙等6处祠庙，郑韶年老屋等10处民居，惠济桥等4处桥梁，以及圣门、迎和门、新滩古井，共23处建筑，占地378亩。屈原祠位于景区的核心，其他的古建筑位于东北山角，按照类型被分为三个区域，北面是祠庙区，南面是石桥区，中间为青滩民居。青滩民居原址在秭归县新滩镇，搬迁后依山坡而建。民居均为硬山灰瓦屋顶，封火山墙造型变化多端，现多已改造为展馆。屈原祠始建于唐元和十五年（820），归州刺史王茂元谓叹屈原'诞灵是所，庙貌无睹'，于是在州城东五里的屈沱建立屈原祠，并作《楚三大夫屈先生祠堂铭并序》。宋元丰三年（1080），宋神宗封屈原为清烈公，并修缮屈原祠，更名为'清烈公祠'。自此以后，元、明、清的数任州官对其进行多次维修，并'以五月五日致祭'。屈原祠原坐落在秭归城东五里屈沱一座山丘之上。1976年，为配合兴建葛洲坝水利工程，清烈公祠迁至归州城东1.5公里的向家坪。这次搬迁实际上是择址新建，除了屈原衣冠冢明清时期的石构件仍按原样搬迁并复原，山门用现代材料模仿原利山门重建，其他建筑均为现代仿古建筑。三峡大坝库区蓄水至175米后，屈原祠的55%将会被淹没，于是再度搬迁，新址选在距秭归新城不远的凤凰山，屈原祠也成为整个凤凰山景区的核心建筑。屈原祠山门为二层重檐歇山，正面竖一道六柱五间牌坊，通高20米。当心间又挑出披檐，下悬'屈原祠'石匾，两侧一对盘龙石柱。两次间分别悬'孤忠''流芳'匾，额枋装饰红蓝色龙凤彩画，屋脊上装饰宝瓶和鸣吻。屈原衣冠冢前的墓碑亦为三层石牌楼，一层、二层三间，三层一间。一层较高，有前廊，廊柱上镌刻楹联，其后为墓碑；二、三层较低，分别设匾额。这座牌坊建于清光绪十年（1884），原位于归州古城东门外的洗马桥桥头。牌坊为四柱三间，高约7米，立于花岗岩基石之上，柱根有夹杆石加固。明间匾额两面皆有郭沫若先生题写的'屈原故里'四字，牌坊左侧还有两块光绪年间的石碑，分别书'楚大夫屈原故里'和'汉昭君王嫱故里'。
projects.content_en: The Ancient Building Complex at Fenghuang Hill is located east of Maoping Town, the county seat of Zigui County; it is a building complex formed by relocating multiple ancient buildings within Zigui County in the Three Gorges Reservoir area. The straight-line distance from here to the Three Gorges Dam is less than 2 km, and the Three Gorges can be seen in the distance to the southeast. The ancient building complex includes 6 temples such as Qu Yuan Shrine, Jiangdu Temple, and Shuifu Temple, 10 residences such as Zheng Shaonian Old House, 4 bridges such as Huiji Bridge, as well as the Holy Gate, Yinghe Gate, and Xintan Ancient Well, totaling 23 buildings, covering 378 mu. Qu Yuan Shrine is located at the core of the scenic area, while the other ancient buildings are located at the northeast mountain corner, divided into three areas by type: the temple area to the north, the stone bridge area to the south, and Qintan Residences in the middle. The original site of Qintan Residences was in Xintan Town, Zigui County; after relocation, they were built along the hillside. The residences all have gable gray-tile roofs, with varied and changeable fire-sealing gable wall shapes, and most have now been converted into exhibition halls. Qu Yuan Shrine was first built in the 15th year of Yuanhe, Tang (820); Wang Maoyuan, Governor of Guizhou, lamented that Qu Yuan 'was born here, yet no temple can be seen,' so he built Qu Yuan Shrine at Qutuo, five li east of the prefectural city, and wrote the 'Inscription and Preface to the Shrine of Mr. Qu, the Three Great Officials of Chu.' In the 3rd year of Yuanfeng, Song (1080), Emperor Shenzong of Song enfeoffed Qu Yuan as Duke Qinglie, repaired Qu Yuan Shrine, and renamed it 'Duke Qinglie Shrine.' From then on, several successive prefectural officials of the Yuan, Ming, and Qing repaired it many times and 'sacrificed on the 5th day of the 5th month.' Qu Yuan Shrine was originally located on a hill at Qutuo, five li east of Zigui city. In 1976, to coordinate with the construction of the Gezhouba Water Conservancy Project, Duke Qinglie Shrine was moved to Xiangjiaping, 1.5 km east of Guizhou city. This relocation was actually site selection and new construction; except for the Ming and Qing stone components of Qu Yuan's Clothes-and-Hat Tomb, which were still relocated and restored as original, the mountain gate was rebuilt with modern materials imitating the original mountain gate, and the other buildings were all modern antique-style buildings. After the Three Gorges Dam reservoir area was impounded to 175 meters, 55% of Qu Yuan Shrine would be submerged, so it was relocated again; the new site was chosen at Fenghuang Hill, not far from the new Zigui city, and Qu Yuan Shrine also became the core building of the entire Fenghuang Hill scenic area. The mountain gate of Qu Yuan Shrine is a two-story double-eave hip-and-gable building, with a six-column five-bay paifang erected on the front, with a total height of 20 meters. The central bay also projects a eave, with a stone plaque 'Qu Yuan Shrine' hanging below, and a pair of dragon-coiled stone columns on both sides. The two secondary bays respectively hang 'Loyalty Alone' and 'Eternal Fame' plaques; the额枋 is decorated with red and blue dragon-phoenix paintings, and the ridge is decorated with treasure vases and chiwen ornaments. The tomb stele in front of Qu Yuan's Clothes-and-Hat Tomb is also a three-story stone paifang; the first and second stories have three bays, and the third story has one bay. The first story is higher, with a front porch, and couplets are engraved on the porch columns, behind which is the tomb stele; the second and third stories are lower, with plaques respectively. This paifang was built in the 10th year of Guangxu, Qing (1884), originally located at the Xima Bridge head outside the east gate of the ancient Guizhou city. The paifang is four columns and three bays, about 7 meters high, standing on a granite foundation, with the column roots reinforced by clamp stones. On both sides of the central bay plaque are the four characters 'Qu Yuan's Hometown' inscribed by Mr. Guo Moruo; on the left side of the paifang there are also two stone steles from the Guangxu period, respectively inscribed with 'Hometown of Qu Yuan, Grand Official of Chu' and 'Hometown of Wang Qiang, Consort of Han Zhaodi.'

projects.name: 远安城墙遗址

highlights: 远安城墙位于沮河东岸
是远安明代古城鸣凤的西城墙
因此也被叫做鸣凤城墙
鸣凤城始建于明成化二年至五年
最初主要是为了军事防御而筑
县治从亭子山南（今旧县镇）迁至此
于是开始大规模地建设城市和集镇
据清咸丰远安县志记载
明代修筑城墙时砌以砖石
城楼则遵奉钦定太监令
当时的均州是整个武当山道教建筑群的起点
其城墙的营建是一项皇家工程
均州古城现已沉睡在丹江口水库之下了
此后清乾隆、咸丰和同治年间曾数次修葺
城墙屡屡遭到暴雨、山洪和日军的轰炸
已经难以恢复以往的面貌
现存的西门开一道拱券门洞
远安县沿着古城墙的外侧修建了一处市民休闲公园
城墙与公园一道成为滨河景观
被赋予了新的生命和意义
projects.content_zh: 远安城墙位于沮河东岸，沿河展开，现存全长600米，是远安明代古城'鸣凤'的西城墙，因此也被叫做鸣凤城墙。鸣凤城始建于明成化二年至五年（1466—1469），最初主要是为了军事防御而筑；城筑到一半，县治从亭子山南（今旧县镇）迁至此，于是开始大规模地建设城市和集镇。据清咸丰《远安县志》记载，明代修筑城墙时'砌以砖石，高一丈二尺，周八百余丈，设四门……其城门以上各建城楼，城楼则遵奉钦定太监令，仿效均州体式'。当时的均州是整个武当山道教建筑群的起点，其城墙的营建是一项皇家工程，很可惜的是，均州古城现已沉睡在丹江口水库之下了。此后清乾隆、咸丰和同治年间曾数次修葺，近代以来，城墙屡屡遭到暴雨、山洪和日军的轰炸，已经难以恢复以往的面貌。现存的西门开一道拱券门洞，高3.5米，底宽3.6米，门洞处城墙长8.4米，高4.2米。近年来，远安县沿着古城墙的外侧修建了一处市民休闲公园，城墙与公园一道成为滨河景观，被赋予了新的生命和意义。
projects.content_en: The Yuan'an City Wall is located on the east bank of the Ju River, extending along the river; the existing total length is 600 meters; it is the west city wall of the Ming ancient city 'Mingfeng' in Yuan'an, hence also called Mingfeng City Wall. Mingfeng City was first built from the 2nd to the 5th year of Chenghua, Ming (1466–1469), initially built mainly for military defense; when the city was half built, the county seat was moved here from the south of Tingzi Mountain (present-day Jiuxian Town), so large-scale construction of the city and market town began. According to the 'Yuan'an County Annals' of Xianfeng, Qing, when the city wall was built in the Ming, it was 'built with bricks and stones, one zhang and two chi high, more than 800 zhang in circumference, with four gates... above each city gate a gate tower was built, and the gate towers followed the order of the imperial eunuch, imitating the Junzhou style.' At that time, Junzhou was the starting point of the entire Wudang Mountain Taoist building complex, and the construction of its city wall was a royal project; unfortunately, the ancient city of Junzhou now lies asleep under the Danjiangkou Reservoir. Thereafter, it was repaired several times during the Qianlong, Xianfeng, and Tongzhi periods of the Qing; since modern times, the city wall has repeatedly suffered from heavy rains, mountain floods, and Japanese bombing, and it has been difficult to restore its former appearance. The existing west gate has an arched doorway, 3.5 meters high and 3.6 meters wide at the bottom; the city wall at the doorway is 8.4 meters long and 4.2 meters high. In recent years, Yuan'an County has built a citizen leisure park along the outside of the ancient city wall; the city wall and the park together have become a riverside landscape, endowed with new life and meaning.

小曾家湾民居位于漳沐村三组小曾家湾
前檐及外山墙青砖砌筑
projects.content_zh: 漳沐村因漳河而得名，村落东临漳河，依山傍水，相传曾氏于明代迁入此地，聚族为村。由于村子地处大山深处，交通不便，因此年代久远的建筑也得以保存。漳沐古民居始建于明朝晚期，在清代道光年间形成了六个建筑群落的规模，其中以曾凡太民居、小曾家湾民居和曾家大花屋三处最具代表性。曾凡太民居位于漳沐村一组大曾家湾，坐北朝南，一进二重，依山而建。墙脚用石块垒砌，前厅为青砖砌筑，后堂为土坯砖墙，硬山屋顶，规模较小，但天井内的木装修很是富丽堂皇。小曾家湾民居位于漳沐村三组小曾家湾，坐西北朝东南，同样依山而建。前檐及外山墙青砖砌筑，内墙用土坯砖。正面为七开间...
projects.content_en: Zhangmu Village gets its name from the Zhang River; the village faces the Zhang River to the east, nestled against mountains and beside water; legend has it that the Zeng family moved here in the Ming Dynasty and gathered as a clan village. Because the village is located deep in the mountains with inconvenient transportation, buildings of long age have also been preserved. The ancient dwellings of Zhangmu were first built in the late Ming Dynasty, and reached the scale of six building complexes during the Daoguang period of the Qing; among them, the Zeng Fantai Residence, Xiao Zengjiawan Residence, and Zengjia Dahua House are the three most representative. The Zeng Fantai Residence is located in Da Zengjiawan, Group 1, Zhangmu Village, facing south, with one entry and two layers, built along the mountain. The wall foot is built with stone blocks; the front hall is built with blue bricks, the rear hall is an adobe brick wall, with a gable roof; the scale is relatively small, but the wooden decoration inside the courtyard (tianjing) is very rich and magnificent. The Xiao Zengjiawan Residence is located in Xiao Zengjiawan, Group 3, Zhangmu Village, facing southeast from northwest, also built along the mountain. The front eaves and exterior gable walls are built with blue bricks, and the interior walls use adobe bricks. The front is seven bays wide...

projects.name: 古夫民居
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 兴山县香溪大道民俗博物馆
projects.address_en: Folk Museum, Xiangxi Avenue, Xingshan County
projects.content_zh: 古夫民居是一组因三峡库区蓄水而搬迁至现址的古建筑的合称，由望山门、陈伯炎老屋和吴翰章老屋组成，现为兴山县民俗博物馆，这三座古建筑也是博物馆的核心。除此之外，博物馆还展出当地的古典家具、生产工具、木雕石刻和民俗工艺品等，各类展品有机地融为一体。望山门原为高阳古城的西门，俗称'西门楼'，也是兴山高阳古城唯一保存至今的城门。城始建于明代，清嘉庆九年（1804）重修，《兴山县志》记载，当时有三座城门：'……周扩至五百二十二丈，东曰开泰，南曰迎薰，西曰望山门。'城门由条石块砌成，正中开一道拱券门，两端还保存了部分城墙，背面两侧有可以登上城墙顶的蹬道。城门之上为城楼，面阔五间，单檐歇山顶，有一圈外廊。陈伯炎老屋原位于兴山县昭君镇响滩村，建于清光绪十八年（1892），为两进两重院落，进入大门后首先是第一进狭长的天井，各个房屋则围绕第二天进天井布置。正中为厅堂，两侧布置卧室，天井左右分别为客厅和神堂。青砖砌筑，灰瓦屋面，硬山屋顶马头墙，外观闭塞而室内空间舒适宜人。吴翰章老屋原本同样位于昭君镇响滩村，原址有两进天井，现仅存第二进，为三合院布局，有厅屋、堂屋和厢房。外观与室内装修风格均与陈伯炎老屋相似，在门前还摆放着一组石质门框，应该是原来第一进天井遗留的构件。吴翰章为清末兴山举人，是湖北一位重要的私人刻书家，惜30岁便英年早逝。《兴山县志》记载吴翰章'尝入都门，走浙西，游湘南，所过都会山川，辄访求其形势险要与古今所以兴废之故，以著述为己任。'他在短暂的生命里著书14种，作品有《楚世家表》《荆西风土志》《双溪杂记》《兴山种艺说》等，遍及家乡的文学、历史、地理、金石、经济政治等方面。
projects.content_en: Gufu Dwellings is a collective name for a group of ancient buildings relocated to the current site due to the impoundment of the Three Gorges Reservoir area; it consists of Wangshan Gate, Chen Boyan Old House, and Wu Hanzhang Old House, now the Xingshan County Folk Museum, and these three ancient buildings are also the core of the museum. In addition, the museum also exhibits local classical furniture, production tools, wood and stone carvings, and folk crafts, etc., with various exhibits organically integrated. Wangshan Gate was originally the west gate of the ancient Gaoyang City, commonly called 'West Gate Tower,' and is also the only city gate of the ancient Gaoyang City in Xingshan preserved to this day. The city was first built in the Ming and rebuilt in the 9th year of Jiaqing, Qing (1804); the 'Xingshan County Annals' records that there were three city gates at that time: '...the circumference expanded to 522 zhang, the east is called Kaitai, the south Yingxun, and the west Wangshan Gate.' The city gate is built with dressed stone blocks, with an arched gate in the center; parts of the city wall are still preserved at both ends, and there are ramp paths on both sides of the back that can climb to the top of the city wall. Above the city gate is the gate tower, five bays wide, with a single-eave hip-and-gable roof and a circle of exterior corridors. Chen Boyan Old House was originally located in Xiangtan Village, Zhaojun Town, Xingshan County, built in the 18th year of Guangxu, Qing (1892); it is a two-entry two-layer courtyard; after entering the main gate, there is first the narrow courtyard (tianjing) of the first entry, and each house is arranged around the courtyard of the second entry. In the center is the hall, with bedrooms on both sides; on the left and right of the courtyard are the living room and ancestral hall respectively. Built with blue bricks, gray tile roof, gable roof with horse-head walls, the exterior is closed while the interior space is comfortable and pleasant. Wu Hanzhang Old House was originally also located in Xiangtan Village, Zhaojun Town; the original site had two courtyards, now only the second entry remains, with a three-sided courtyard layout, including a hall room, main room, and wing rooms. The exterior and interior decoration styles are similar to Chen Boyan Old House; in front of the door there is also a set of stone door frames, which should be components left from the original first-entry courtyard. Wu Hanzhang was a juren (provincial graduate) of Xingshan at the end of the Qing, an important private book engraver in Hubei, unfortunately dying young at 30. The 'Xingshan County Annals' records that Wu Hanzhang 'once entered the capital, went to western Zhejiang, traveled to southern Hunan; wherever he passed through capitals and mountains, he would seek out their strategic terrain and the reasons for their rise and fall in ancient and modern times, taking writing as his responsibility.' In his short life, he wrote 14 kinds of books, including 'Table of the Chu Family,' 'Customs of Western Hubei,' 'Miscellaneous Records of Shuangxi,' 'On Xingshan Agriculture,' etc., covering literature, history, geography, epigraphy, economy, and politics of his hometown.

projects.name: 王家祠堂
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 兴山县峡口镇建阳坪村二组
projects.address_en: Group 2, Jianyangping Village, Xiakou Town, Xingshan County
projects.content_zh: 建阳坪村的王家祠堂是兴山县仅存的一处宗祠，建于清代。平面为一进天井院，有门厅、堂屋和厢房，砖木结构，灰瓦硬山屋顶，堂屋两侧为如意形封火山墙，镂空花屋脊。正立面用灰塑贴面装饰，有门额、贴柱、卷轴、格等图案，左右卷轴上分别书写'亲慈''恭友'，门额浮雕二龙戏珠。大门前立石鼓一对，门上刻有对联一副，上联'追宗祖源流槐兰谱系太原始'，下联'子孙绵衍书画家传司徒先'。在祠堂内还保存有咸丰元年《王氏宗祖历代昭穆位》石碑一通，记载了王氏第一世自明末，从山西太原迁移到兴山至咸丰元年的各世祖宗。
projects.content_en: The Wang's Ancestral Hall in Jianyangping Village is the only surviving ancestral hall in Xingshan County, built in the Qing Dynasty. The plane is a one-entry courtyard (tianjing), with a gate hall, main room, and wing rooms, of brick-wood structure, with a gray-tile gable roof; on both sides of the main room are Ruyi-shaped fire-sealing gable walls, with openwork flower ridges. The front facade is decorated with gray plaster facing, with patterns such as door lintels, attached columns, scroll shafts, and lattice; on the left and right scroll shafts are respectively written 'Kindness' and 'Respect and Friendship,' and the door lintel has a relief of two dragons playing with a pearl. In front of the main gate stand a pair of stone drums; on the door is carved a couplet, the upper line 'Tracing the ancestral origin, the Huai-Lan genealogy begins from Taiyuan,' the lower line 'Descendants multiply, the calligraphy-painting family tradition inherits from Situ.' Inside the ancestral hall, a stone stele 'Positions of Generations of Wang Ancestors' from the 1st year of Xianfeng is also preserved, recording the ancestors of each generation of the Wang family from the first generation at the end of the Ming, migrating from Taiyuan, Shanxi to Xingshan, to the 1st year of Xianfeng.

projects.name: 洋房子
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 兴山县峡口镇黄家河村五指山
projects.address_en: Wuzhi Mountain, Huangjiahe Village, Xiakou Town, Xingshan County
projects.content_zh: 在香溪河畔的大山深处，有这样一栋中西合璧的建筑，'U'字形的平面布局，正层中有拱券外廊，若能设身处地地回到清末民初的时代，在这样的地方出现这样的建筑，确实是一件令人咄咄称奇的事，因而当地人将这座文家大院称为'洋房子'。这座建筑坐南朝北，有正屋七间，两臂偏房各三间，硬山屋顶，砖木结构，总建筑面积达到700平方米。门、窗皆为圆拱形，楼梯、栏杆、合页窗装饰雕花图案，天花板、地板、门窗、梁柱等涂红色油漆。台阶和正屋的走廊，全部用数百斤重的青石砌成，十分平整。屋前有一株银杏树和一株皂角树，老屋历经百年的沧桑，树木却愈发枝叶婆娑，浓荫蔽日。文家大院的主人是兴山的文运久和文运远兄弟，创建于1911年（一说1913年），历时8年建成，据说兄弟俩请来了川汉铁路技师周肇祥来做设计。哥哥文运久曾任清末的六品同知，弟弟文运远1905年赴日本东京留学，在东京帝国大学法律系获得硕士学位，还加入了同盟会，回国后官运不佳，长期赋闲在家，曾主持修建了天主教堂和教会学校。1949年后，文氏兄弟作为兴山县第二大地主被政府处决，老宅被分给7户农民居住，因而保留了下来，也算是时势造就的幸运。如今'洋房子'已经成为一个时代的符号，在墙上还能看到各个时期保留下来的标语口号。
projects.content_en: Deep in the mountains by the Xiangxi River, there is such a Chinese-Western combined building, with a 'U'-shaped plane layout and arched exterior corridors in the middle layer; if one could put oneself in the era of the late Qing and early Republic, the appearance of such a building in such a place is indeed an astonishing thing, hence the locals call this Wen family compound 'Yangfangzi' (Western-style House). This building faces north from south, with seven main rooms and three side rooms on each arm, with a gable roof and brick-wood structure, with a total building area of 700 square meters. The doors and windows are all round-arched; the stairs, railings, and casement windows are decorated with carved patterns; the ceilings, floors, doors, windows, beams, and columns are painted red. The steps and the corridors of the main house are all built with bluestone weighing several hundred jin, very flat. In front of the house there is a ginkgo tree and a honey locust tree; the old house has experienced a century of vicissitudes, but the trees have become increasingly lush with dancing branches and leaves, casting dense shade. The owners of the Wen family compound were the brothers Wen Yunjiu and Wen Yunyuan of Xingshan; it was founded in 1911 (one says 1913) and built over 8 years; it is said that the brothers invited Zhou Zhaoxiang, a technician of the Chuan-Han Railway, to do the design. The elder brother Wen Yunjiu once served as a sixth-rank Tongzhi at the end of the Qing; the younger brother Wen Yunyuan went to study in Tokyo, Japan in 1905, obtained a master's degree from the Law Department of Tokyo Imperial University, and also joined the Tongmenghui (Revolutionary Alliance); after returning to China, his official career was not good, and he stayed idle at home for a long time, once presiding over the construction of a Catholic church and church school. After 1949, the Wen brothers, as the second-largest landlords in Xingshan County, were executed by the government, and the old house was distributed to 7 farmer households for residence, hence it was preserved, which can be regarded as luck created by the times. Today, 'Yangfangzi' has become a symbol of an era, and slogans from various periods can still be seen on the walls.

projects.name: 兴文塔
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 五峰县五峰镇香东村
projects.address_en: Xiangdong Village, Wufeng Town, Wufeng County
projects.content_zh: 兴文塔是五峰县的文峰塔，建于清同治八年（1869）。传说五峰城及其周围地脉轻浮，毗邻的长阳城则地脉凝重，地气外溢，难以出栋梁之材，因此建此塔以镇之。兴文塔塔基以条石砌筑，塔身则为砖砌，是一座六角七层阁楼式空心塔，塔顶有铜制塔刹，通高22米。首层开圆拱门，两侧有一对石质门柱，上面镌刻一副楹联：'云梯直上欣题雁，天阙遥开稳步鳌'，门额刻'兴文塔'。2层除南北两侧，四面开圆洞窗；3层以上每层在相对的两面开圆洞窗；不开窗的墙面则以白粉刷成圆形来与窗呼应。各层收分并不明显，因此塔身显得笔直有力，而每层翘起的屋檐则为整座塔增添了一些曲线的动感。
projects.content_en: Xingwen Pagoda is the Wenfeng (Literary Peak) Pagoda of Wufeng County, built in the 8th year of Tongzhi, Qing (1869). Legend has it that the earth veins of Wufeng City and its surroundings are light and floating, while the adjacent Changyang City has heavy earth veins with earth qi overflowing outward, making it difficult to produce pillar talents, hence this pagoda was built to suppress it. The base of Xingwen Pagoda is built with dressed stones, while the pagoda body is brick-built; it is a hexagonal seven-story pavilion-style hollow pagoda, with a bronze finial at the top, with a total height of 22 meters. The first floor has a round-arched gate, with a pair of stone door pillars on both sides, on which a couplet is engraved: 'The cloud ladder goes straight up, glad to inscribe the wild goose; the heavenly gate opens far away, steadily stepping the mythical turtle'; the door lintel is carved with 'Xingwen Ta.' On the 2nd floor, except for the north and south sides, round windows are opened on four sides; on the 3rd floor and above, each floor opens round windows on opposite sides; the wall surfaces without windows are painted white in circles to echo the windows. The tapering of each floor is not obvious, hence the pagoda body appears straight and powerful, while the upturned eaves of each floor add some curvilinear dynamism to the entire pagoda.

projects.name: 乃见天日坊
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 五峰县采花乡楠木桥村牌坊坪
projects.address_en: Paifangping, Nanmuqiao Village, Caihua Township, Wufeng County
projects.content_zh: 乃见天日坊位于五峰县采花乡楠木桥村牌坊坪，是一座清代石牌坊。牌坊为四柱三间式，以青石砌筑，坊上雕刻有各种图案和文字。坊额正中刻'乃见天日'四字，两侧刻有楹联和题记。这座牌坊是为了表彰当地的节妇而建，体现了清代的礼教文化和石雕工艺。牌坊整体保存较为完好，是研究鄂西地区清代牌坊建筑和民俗文化的重要实物资料。
projects.content_en: Naijiantianri Memorial Archway is located at Paifangping, Nanmuqiao Village, Caihua Township, Wufeng County; it is a Qing Dynasty stone paifang. The paifang is of four-column three-bay style, built with bluestone, with various patterns and characters carved on it. In the center of the arch lintel are carved the four characters 'Nai Jian Tian Ri' (Then Seeing the Sky and Sun), with couplets and inscriptions carved on both sides. This paifang was built to commend a local chaste widow, reflecting the Confucian ritual culture and stone carving craftsmanship of the Qing Dynasty. The paifang is overall relatively well-preserved and is important physical material for studying Qing paifang architecture and folk culture in western Hubei.

projects.name: 盐井寺河神亭
projects.name_en: Temple of the Goddess of Salt and Water
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 长阳县渔峡口镇龙池村
projects.address_en: Longchi Village, Yuxiakou Town, Changyang County
projects.content_zh: 巴人是长阳土家族的先祖，也是长阳远古时期最早的居民。传说中巴人的首领名为廪君，在《世本》《后汉书》和《水经注》中都有相关的传说记载，其中《世本》是一部先秦史籍，是关于廪君最早的记录：廪君乃乘土船从夷水至盐阳，盐水有神女谓廪君曰，此地广大，鱼盐所出，愿留共居。廪君不许，盐神暮辄来取宿，旦即化为虫，与诸虫群飞，掩蔽日光。天地晦瞑，积十余日。廪君思其便，因射杀之。天乃开明，廪君於是乎夷城。在更晚出现的《水经注》中，这个故事有了更多细节。传说廪君送给盐神一缕青丝，让盐神系在身上：如果合适，我就和你一起生活，如果不合适，我就要离开你。盐神于是把青丝缠在身上，第二天，廪君看到一只虫子胸前有青黑色的细线，一箭射向它，盐神便死了，天也晴朗了。虽然廪君与盐神的爱情是一段相爱相杀的故事，但长阳土家族人认为，正是廪君和盐神的结合，巴人才得以繁衍和兴旺。在民间传说中，廪君后来非常怀念自己的伴侣，因此封盐神为德济娘娘。也有人认为盐神死后化为盐女岩，廪君死后化为白虎石，一直望着盐女岩。盐井寺是祭祀盐神的一座寺庙，原名传庆寺，始建于唐而兴于宋，清康熙四十六年（1707）重建时曾有房屋99间，后毁于大跃进和文革期间，现仅存一座河神亭和两座佛塔。河神亭在复建的盐井寺院落正中，当地人称为义渡亭，是一座六角3层楼阁式石亭，通高6米，正面朝东。首层塔身之外还有一圈方形石柱，石柱上刻有羲行字表众姓芳名、亭前憩息自由根源等字样，东面的两棵为盘龙雕柱。2层有三通光绪十三年（1887）的石碑。各层的体量变化很大，3层几乎和屋顶的宝刹一样大小。
projects.content_en: The Ba people were the ancestors of the Tujia people in Changyang and also the earliest residents in the ancient period of Changyang. Legend has it that the leader of the Ba people was named Linjun; related legendary records can be found in the Shiben, Book of Later Han, and Commentary on the Water Classic, among which Shiben is a pre-Qin historical book and the earliest record about Linjun: Linjun then took an earthen boat from Yishui to Yanyang; the goddess of salt water said to Linjun, this land is vast, producing fish and salt, I wish you to stay and live together. Linjun did not agree; the salt goddess always came to stay at night, and at dawn turned into an insect, flying with all the insects, covering the sunlight. The sky and earth were dark for more than ten days. Linjun thought of a way, and because of this shot and killed her. The sky then became clear, and Linjun thus built Yicheng. In the later Commentary on the Water Classic, this story has more details. Legend has it that Linjun gave the salt goddess a strand of blue-black hair, asking her to tie it on herself: if it fits, I will live with you; if it does not fit, I will leave you. The salt goddess then wrapped the blue-black hair around herself; the next day, Linjun saw an insect with a blue-black thread on its chest and shot an arrow at it; the salt goddess died, and the sky became clear. Although the love between Linjun and the salt goddess is a story of love and hate, the Tujia people in Changyang believe that it was the union of Linjun and the salt goddess that allowed the Ba people to multiply and prosper. In folk legends, Linjun later missed his companion very much, hence enfeoffed the salt goddess as Lady Deji. Some also believe that after death the salt goddess turned into the Yannü Rock, and Linjun turned into the White Tiger Rock, always looking at the Yannü Rock. Yanjing Temple is a temple for sacrificing to the salt goddess, originally named Chuanqing Temple; it was first built in the Tang and flourished in the Song; when rebuilt in the 46th year of Kangxi, Qing (1707), it once had 99 rooms, later destroyed during the Great Leap Forward and the Cultural Revolution; now only a River Goddess Pavilion and two Buddhist pagodas remain. The River Goddess Pavilion is in the center of the rebuilt Yanjing Temple courtyard, locally called Yidu Pavilion; it is a hexagonal 3-story pavilion-style stone pavilion, with a total height of 6 meters, facing east. Outside the first-story pagoda body there is also a circle of square stone columns, on which are engraved characters such as Righteous conduct, names of all surnames, Rest freely before the pavilion; the two columns on the east are dragon-carved columns. On the 2nd floor there are three stone steles from the 13th year of Guangxu (1887). The volume changes greatly at each story; the 3rd story is almost the same size as the finial on the roof.

projects.name: 天柱山古建筑群
projects.name_en: Ancient Building Complex at Tianzhu Mountain
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 长阳县鸭子口乡刘坪村境内
projects.address_en: Liuping Village, Yazikou Township, Changyang County
projects.content_zh: 天柱山位于长阳土家族自治县城西34公里的清江北岸，是道教的三十六福地之一，也称中武当。其山孤峰耸立，3座巨石岩峰并列，相距仅4米。天柱山道观始于唐代，清同治年间开始仿武当山大兴建造，修成地母宫、灵官殿、玉皇亭、三帝宫、忠恕门、南岩宫、祖师殿等，在石柱间架石桥2座，并开凿上山石阶3000余级。近代以来，天柱山在抗日战争和文化大革命时期先后遭到破坏，至1995年方修复完成，现存多为在原址新建的建筑，主要有南岩宫、三帝宫、中武当等，还有一对阴阳古井，两井相距不远，而井水常年一冷一热，堪称奇观。
projects.content_en: Tianzhu Mountain is located on the north bank of the Qing River, 34 km west of the county seat of Changyang Tujia Autonomous County; it is one of the Thirty-Six Blessed Lands of Taoism, also called Zhong Wudang. Its mountain has a solitary peak towering, with 3 giant stone rock peaks side by side, only 4 meters apart. The Tianzhu Mountain Taoist Temple began in the Tang Dynasty; during the Tongzhi period of the Qing, large-scale construction began imitating Wudang Mountain, building the Dimu Palace, Lingguan Hall, Yuhuang Pavilion, Sandi Palace, Zhongshu Gate, Nanyan Palace, Zushi Hall, etc.; 2 stone bridges were built between the stone columns, and more than 3,000 stone steps up the mountain were carved. In modern times, Tianzhu Mountain was successively damaged during the War of Resistance against Japan and the Cultural Revolution period, and was not restored until 1995; most of the existing buildings are newly built on the original sites, mainly including Nanyan Palace, Sandi Palace, Zhong Wudang, etc.; there is also a pair of Yin-Yang ancient wells, not far apart, while the well water is one cold and one hot year-round, which can be called a wonder.

projects.name: 鸣凤塔
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 长阳县龙舟坪镇龙舟坪村二组
projects.address_en: Group 2, Longzhouping Village, Longzhouping Town, Changyang County
projects.content_zh: 鸣凤塔位于长阳县城内的东山顶上，登塔瞭望，长阳县东部的山水城郭可以一览无余。鸣凤之名取意于《诗经·大雅·卷阿》：凤凰鸣矣，于彼高冈。梧桐生矣，于彼朝阳。因此鸣凤塔是一座文峰塔，寄望于逢盛世、生贤才。塔修建于同治二年（1863）至四年（1865），八角七层楼阁式石塔，通高近30米，底层边长4米。正门朝南，拱券门，门额嵌楷书鸣凤塔石匾。2层以上每层相对两面开拱门，各层相错，其余各面为浮雕坐佛。
projects.content_en: Mingfeng Pagoda is located on the top of Dongshan (East Mountain) in the county seat of Changyang; climbing the pagoda to look out, the mountains, rivers, city, and suburbs of eastern Changyang County can be seen at a glance. The name Mingfeng (Singing Phoenix) is derived from the Book of Songs, Greater Odes, Juan A: The phoenix sings, on that high ridge. The paulownia grows, in that morning sun. Hence Mingfeng Pagoda is a Wenfeng (Literary Peak) Pagoda, expressing the hope of meeting a prosperous era and producing talented people. The pagoda was built from the 2nd year (1863) to the 4th year (1865) of Tongzhi; it is an octagonal seven-story pavilion-style stone pagoda, with a total height of nearly 30 meters and a bottom side length of 4 meters. The main gate faces south, an arched gate, with a stone plaque in regular script Mingfeng Ta embedded in the door lintel. From the 2nd floor upward, each floor opens arched doors on opposite sides, staggered at each floor; the other faces are relief seated Buddhas.
