projects.name: 如膏书院
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 利川市南坪乡南坪镇，南坪小学校内
projects.address_en: Nanping Town, Nanping Township, Lichuan City (inside Nanping Primary School)
highlights: 如膏书院是利川置县后最早的义学之一
始建于清乾隆五十八年
光绪十八年改书院为学堂
现今位于南坪乡南坪小学校内
现两厢已毁（新建右厢房）
内植两柱直径粗大的桂花树
一枝丫枯萎，略发几枝新芽
山墙内壁及庭院内散存数通碑刻
碑文较为系统地记述了南坪地方建书院、改学校的始末缘由
正厅后起一阁楼与后殿相连
阁楼室内顶棚有八卦藻井
藻井下神龛前立有一块汉白玉分石心
蟠龙石雕龙头昂然向上
阁楼两侧左右对称布置两天井
凸显了大成殿的宽敞明亮
现书院四周围绿树掩映
果真是一处读书的好去处
书院东侧500米处有一座楼阁式七级石塔
与其余两处古塔合称为利川三塔
projects.content_zh: 如膏书院是利川置县后最早的义学之一，始建于清乾隆五十八年（1793），南坪巡检王霖兴建，清嘉庆三年(1798)被焚，历时三年重建，光绪十八年（1892）改书院为学堂，1949年后改为小学。现今位于南坪乡南坪小学校内，围有防护栅栏，保护较好。建筑坐北朝南，中轴对称布局，共三进两厢，现两厢已毁（新建右厢房），仅存前楼、正厅和后殿。前楼名为魁星楼，砖木结构，山门呈拱形，白石灰抹墙面，面阔五间，进深两间，明、次间为硬山灰瓦顶，稍间为单层悬山顶。入山门至过厅，其上为二层三间戏楼，略高出厢房屋顶1.5米，戏台两侧设木梯，与一层相通，可供上下。戏楼前为一院坝，内植两柱直径粗大的桂花树，现一株枝叶繁茂，一枝丫枯萎，略发几枝新芽。正厅为大成殿，悬山灰瓦顶，面阔、进深各三间，均约15米，抬梁式木构架，殿内16根木柱，柱基石雕刻差较大。山墙内壁及庭院内散存数通碑刻，均为正楷阴刻，碑文较为系统地记述了南坪地方建书院、改学校的始末缘由。正厅后起一阁楼与后殿相连，阁楼室内顶棚有八卦藻井，藻井下神龛前立有一块汉白玉分石心，蟠龙石雕龙头昂然向上，气势轩昂，四周密布祥云图饰，造型生动。阁楼两侧左右对称布置两天井，凸显了大成殿的宽敞明亮。后殿为悬山灰瓦，面阔三间，进深二间，靠正殿楼阁处设舞台。现书院四周围绿树掩映，环境清幽，果真是一处读书的好去处。书院东侧500米处有一座楼阁式七级石塔，名凌云塔，又名文笔塔，是如膏书院的风水塔，与其余两处古塔合称为'利川三塔'。
projects.content_en: Rugao Academy was one of the earliest free schools after Lichuan was established as a county; it was first built in the 58th year of Qianlong, Qing (1793), built by Wang Lin, Nanping Inspector; it was burned in the 3rd year of Jiaqing (1798) and rebuilt over three years; in the 18th year of Guangxu (1892), the academy was changed to a school; after 1949, it was changed to a primary school. It is now located inside Nanping Primary School, Nanping Township, surrounded by protective fences, well-preserved. The building faces south, with a centrally symmetric layout, three entries and two wings; now both wings have been destroyed (a new right wing has been built), only the front tower, main hall, and rear hall remain. The front tower is named Kuixing Tower, of brick-wood structure; the mountain gate is arched, with white lime plastered walls, five bays wide and two bays deep; the central and secondary bays have gable gray-tile roofs, while the side bays have single-story overhanging gable roofs. Entering the mountain gate to the passage hall, above it is a two-story three-bay theater tower, slightly 1.5 meters higher than the wing roof; wooden ladders are set on both sides of the stage, connected to the first floor for going up and down. In front of the theater tower is a courtyard, with two osmanthus trees of large diameter planted inside; now one has lush branches and leaves, while one branch has withered, slightly sprouting a few new buds. The main hall is the Dacheng Hall, with an overhanging gable gray-tile roof, three bays wide and three bays deep, both about 15 meters, with a post-and-lintel wooden frame; there are 16 wooden columns in the hall, with relatively large differences in the carving of the column base stones. Several steles are scattered on the inner walls of the gable walls and in the courtyard, all in regular script intaglio; the inscriptions systematically record the whole story of building the academy and changing it to a school in Nanping. Behind the main hall, an attic is built connected to the rear hall; the indoor ceiling of the attic has a Bagua (Eight Trigrams) caisson; in front of the shrine under the caisson stands a white marble heart-shaped stone, with a coiling-dragon stone carving with the dragon head raised upward, imposing and dignified, surrounded by dense auspicious cloud decorations, vivid in shape. On both left and right sides of the attic, two courtyards (tianjing) are symmetrically arranged, highlighting the spaciousness and brightness of the Dacheng Hall. The rear hall has an overhanging gable gray-tile roof, three bays wide and two bays deep, with a stage set near the main hall attic. Now the academy is surrounded by green trees, with a quiet and elegant environment, truly a good place for reading. 500 meters east of the academy there is a pavilion-style seven-story stone pagoda named Lingyun Pagoda, also called Wenbi Pagoda, which is the fengshui pagoda of Rugao Academy, and together with the other two ancient pagodas is called the 'Three Pagodas of Lichuan.'

projects.name: 三元堂
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 利川市忠路镇八圣乡木坝河南岸
projects.address_en: South bank of Muba River, Basheng Township, Zhonglu Town, Lichuan City
highlights: 路边矗立着湖北省文物保护单位所立的三元堂碑志
顺着垂直公路的一段不足50米的水泥铺路向山坳走
一眼便可看见主体建筑为黄色的三元堂
三元堂基址位于背山面水的龙穴之地
堂前约100米处有郁江水流过
木坝河大桥如长虹飞跨其上
远处寨公、寨母两峰并置
道观掩映于这样的大环境中更显清雅幽静
三元堂为清代道教宫观
观内道众长期义渡木坝河两岸过往百姓
据光绪年间利川县志推断
该观始建年代最迟在清光绪八年
现存主体建筑为光绪二十七年在原址基础上扩建而成
依地势逐进升高呈阶梯式分布
中轴线建筑有门厅、正殿及玉皇阁
为土家族祠庙二厅一阁的典型做法
两侧分布厢房等附属建筑
正因为建筑巧妙的布局
projects.content_zh: 由利彭公路下车，路边矗立着湖北省文物保护单位所立的'三元堂'碑志，顺着垂直公路的一段不足50米的水泥铺路向山坳走，一眼便可看见主体建筑为黄色的三元堂。三元堂基址位于背山面水的'龙穴'之地，堂前约100米处有郁江水流过，木坝河大桥如长虹飞跨其上，形成开阔的视域；堂后群山起伏，远处寨公、寨母两峰并置，极富层次感与景深；四周古木苍翠，风景秀美，道观掩映于这样的大环境中更显清雅幽静。三元堂为清代道教宫观，道家以天、地、水为三元，故称三元堂。旧时，观内道众长期义渡木坝河两岸过往百姓，广行善事，也被称为善堂。始建年代不详，据光绪年间《利川县志》推断，该观始建年代最迟在清光绪八年（1882），现存主体建筑为光绪二十七年（1901）在原址基础上扩建而成。道观坐北朝南，依地势逐进升高呈阶梯式分布，砖木结构，共两进厢一阁，中轴线建筑有门厅、正殿及玉皇阁，为土家族祠庙'二厅一阁'的典型做法，两侧分布厢房等附属建筑，周围建有围墙。建筑主体呈明黄色，色彩艳丽，屋顶歇山与悬山共存，屋面高低起伏，错落有致，正因为建筑巧妙的布局，使得道...
projects.content_en: Getting off at the Lipeng Highway, by the roadside stands the 'Sanyuan Tang' stele erected by the Hubei Provincial Cultural Heritage Protection Unit; walking along a cement road of less than 50 meters perpendicular to the highway toward the mountain col, one can at a glance see the Sanyuan Tang with its main building in yellow. The site of Sanyuan Tang is located at a 'dragon lair' place backing onto mountains and facing water; about 100 meters in front of the hall, the Yu River flows by, and the Muba River Bridge spans across it like a long rainbow, forming an open field of view; behind the hall, mountains rise and fall, and in the distance the two peaks of Zaigong and Zhaimu stand side by side, rich in layering and depth; surrounded by lush ancient trees and beautiful scenery, the Taoist temple is even more elegant and quiet set in such a grand environment. Sanyuan Tang is a Qing Dynasty Taoist temple; Taoists take Heaven, Earth, and Water as the Three Primes (Sanyuan), hence the name Sanyuan Tang. In old times, the Taoist priests in the temple long provided free ferry service for people crossing the Muba River on both banks, doing good deeds widely, hence it was also called the Good Deeds Hall. The founding date is unknown; according to the 'Lichuan County Annals' of the Guangxu period, it is inferred that the temple was founded no later than the 8th year of Guangxu, Qing (1882); the existing main building was expanded on the original site in the 27th year of Guangxu (1901). The Taoist temple faces south, rising step by step according to the terrain in a terraced distribution, of brick-wood structure, with two entries, wings, and one pavilion; the buildings on the central axis include the entrance hall, main hall, and Yuhuang (Jade Emperor) Pavilion, a typical practice of Tujia ancestral temples 'two halls and one pavilion'; on both sides are distributed auxiliary buildings such as wing rooms, surrounded by a wall. The main building is bright yellow, with bright colors; the roofs coexist hip-and-gable and overhanging gable styles, with the roof surfaces rising and falling, well-proportioned; precisely because of the clever layout of the building, the Taoist...

projects.name: 花梨岭天主堂
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 利川市凉雾乡花梨村
projects.address_en: Huali Village, Liangwu Township, Lichuan City
highlights: 曾有英国、法国、荷兰、比利时等国的传教士在此传教
教堂入口为一标示性的五拱券山门
过山门径直往前便来到女堂
屋内有展示花梨岭天主教简介的各类图文资料
据传育婴堂名为收养婴孩
实际上常有剖腹剖心之惨
发生了震惊一时的花梨岭教案
光绪皇帝亲笔题匾敕建天主教堂赔款重建
于清光绪三十二年建成
出女堂门前石铺地登九十九石梯可见男堂山门
院门与三面建筑围合一天井院落
檐口与正屋二楼窗台齐平
立面方形砖柱对称排列
四周均有用青石凿成的内大外小的望孔
男女礼拜堂内均设祭台、置桌椅、挂圣像
整个经堂宽敞气派、庄严肃穆
女院经堂正前为一圆穹顶舞台
男教堂则为尖三角形吊顶
正前方十字架上面是一幅最后的晚餐画作
其上是一块书有万王之王的黑匾
左边的展览室还陈列了展品
projects.content_zh: 教堂位于花梨村10组，四周群山环抱，古木成群，环境极其幽静。始建年代不详，初建成时，曾有英国、法国、荷兰、比利时等国的传教士在此传教，现为旧貌重修。占地约10余公顷，建筑面积3000余平方米，分男堂、女堂两部分。教堂入口为一标示性的五拱券山门，蓝灰瓷砖贴面，其后一片翠植，过山门径直往前便来到女堂，分两部分，前为育婴堂，单檐悬山灰瓦顶，三开间二层小楼，屋内有展示花梨岭天主教简介的各类图文资料。据传'育婴堂'名为收养婴孩，实际上'常有剖腹剖心之惨'，'活焚育婴为医用'，后被'义民'焚烧，发生了震惊一时的'花梨岭教案'，光绪二十六年（1900），'大府迫于西人之挟，不得不重惩吾民，以弥衅而修睦'，光绪皇帝亲笔题匾'敕建天主教堂'赔款重建，于清光绪三十二年（1906）建成。女堂后为修道院，坐东朝西，木构四合院建筑，平面呈矩形，面宽约70余米，进深约25米，内有天井，四周有石砌围墙，圈地约3000平方米。出女堂门前石铺地登九十九石梯可见男堂山门，入山门还有两道院门，院门与三面建筑围合一天井院落，建筑为白墙灰瓦顶，正堂为二层楼，左面建筑为一楼一阁，悬山瓦顶，檐口与正屋二楼窗台齐平；右面建筑为礼拜堂，一层高跨结构，穹隆顶，檐口与正屋檐口平齐，立面方形砖柱对称排列，窗明瓦亮，朴素大方。教堂两角建碉楼，据说是用来做了望台，四周均有用青石凿成的内大外小的望孔，防卫严谨。男女礼拜堂内均设祭台、置桌椅、挂圣像，整个经堂宽敞气派、庄严肃穆。女院经堂正前为一圆穹顶舞台，男教堂则为尖三角形吊顶，正前方十字架上面是一幅《最后的晚餐》画作，其上是一块书有'万王之王'的黑匾，左边的展览室还陈列了展品。
projects.content_en: The church is located in Group 10, Huali Village, surrounded by mountains on all sides, with clusters of ancient trees and an extremely quiet environment. The founding date is unknown; when first built, missionaries from Britain, France, the Netherlands, Belgium and other countries preached here; it has now been restored to its original appearance. It covers about 10 hectares, with a building area of more than 3,000 square meters, divided into male and female halls. The church entrance is a symbolic five-arched mountain gate, faced with blue-gray tiles, followed by a patch of green vegetation; passing through the mountain gate and going straight forward, one arrives at the female hall, divided into two parts; the front is the Foundling Home, a single-eave overhanging gable gray-tile roof, a three-bay two-story small building, with various graphic and textual materials displaying an introduction to Hualiling Catholicism inside. Legend has it that the 'Foundling Home,' named for adopting infants, in fact 'often had the tragedy of cutting open abdomens and hearts,' and 'burning infants alive for medical use'; later it was burned by 'righteous people,' causing the 'Hualiling Church Case' that shocked the time. In the 26th year of Guangxu (1900), 'the high officials, forced by the Westerners, had to severely punish our people to quell the dispute and maintain peace'; Emperor Guangxu personally inscribed a plaque 'Imperially Built Catholic Church' and paid compensation for reconstruction, completed in the 32nd year of Guangxu, Qing (1906). Behind the female hall is the monastery, facing west from east, a wooden four-sided courtyard building, with a rectangular plane, about 70 meters wide and 25 meters deep, with a courtyard (tianjing) inside, surrounded by stone walls, enclosing about 3,000 square meters. Exiting the front stone pavement of the female hall and climbing ninety-nine stone steps, one can see the male hall mountain gate; entering the mountain gate there are two more courtyard gates; the courtyard gates and the three-sided buildings enclose a courtyard, with white walls and gray-tile roofs; the main hall is a two-story building; the left building is one story with one pavilion, with an overhanging gable tile roof, and the eaves are level with the second-floor window sill of the main house; the right building is the chapel, a one-story high-span structure with a dome, and the eaves are level with the eaves of the main hall; on the facade, square brick columns are symmetrically arranged, with bright windows and tiles, simple and elegant. At both corners of the church, watchtowers were built, said to be used as observation platforms; on all sides there are observation holes chiseled from bluestone, large inside and small outside, with strict defense. Both male and female chapels have altars, tables and chairs, and hanging holy images; the entire chapel is spacious, imposing, solemn and dignified. Directly in front of the female chapel is a domed stage; the male church has a pointed triangular ceiling; above the cross in front is a painting of 'The Last Supper,' above which is a black plaque inscribed 'King of Kings'; the exhibition room on the left also displays exhibits.

projects.name: 利川三塔
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 利川市团堡镇、南坪乡
projects.address_en: Tuanbao Town and Nanping Township, Lichuan City
highlights: 利川三塔为三处风水塔
即凌云塔、培风塔、宜影塔
均为六角七层楼阁式空心砖石塔
projects.content_zh: 利川三塔为三处风水塔，即凌云塔、培风塔、宜影塔，均为六角七层楼阁式空心砖石塔。
projects.content_en: The Three Pagodas of Lichuan are three fengshui pagodas, namely Lingyun Pagoda, Peifeng Pagoda, and Yiying Pagoda, all hexagonal seven-story pavilion-style hollow brick-stone pagodas.

projects.name: 培风塔
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 利川市团堡镇稍阳坝村
projects.address_en: Shaoyangba Village, Tuanbao Town, Lichuan City
highlights: 培风塔位于距团堡集镇不远的一座小山包上
门楹书绝顶高超联紫气
其余五面各嵌方形的塔铭一方
上书塔序、赞塔诗和建塔捐资人姓名
二层门额阴刻正楷培风塔三字
塔檐下雕各种人物、静物图案
projects.content_zh: 培风塔位于距团堡集镇不远的一座小山包上，山上植被葱郁，枝丫成荫，古塔隐现于密林之中，看不见顶，现保存较好。建于清道光二十六年（1846），通高13米，基座正六边形，边长1.98米，塔门西向，门楹书'绝顶高超联紫气，层刹稳步接青云'，其余五面各嵌方形的塔铭一方，上书塔序、赞塔诗和建塔捐资人姓名。二层门额阴刻正楷'培风塔'三字，塔檐下雕各种人物、静物图案。
projects.content_en: Peifeng Pagoda is located on a small hill not far from the Tuanbao market town; the mountain is lush with vegetation, with branches forming shade; the ancient pagoda looms in the dense forest, with its top invisible, and is now well-preserved. It was built in the 26th year of Daoguang, Qing (1846), with a total height of 13 meters; the base is a regular hexagon with a side length of 1.98 meters; the pagoda gate faces west; the door couplet reads 'The supreme peak soars high connecting the purple qi, the layered pagoda steadily steps to meet the blue clouds'; on each of the other five sides is embedded a square pagoda inscription, recording the pagoda preface, poems praising the pagoda, and the names of donors for building the pagoda. On the second-floor lintel, the three characters 'Peifeng Ta' are carved in regular script intaglio; under the pagoda eaves are carved various figures and still-life patterns.

projects.name: 宜影塔
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 利川市团堡镇野猫水村
projects.address_en: Yemaoshui Village, Tuanbao Town, Lichuan City
highlights: 宜影塔建于清咸丰六年
建于野猫水东南岸边一块巨大的岩石之上
为当地乡绅培植地方风水而集资兴建
建造此塔既弥补了自然景观的不足
又创造了优美的整体环境
其余五面各嵌0.50米×0.7米塔铭一方
二至七层每面各开一半圆形拱窗
门檐绘花草鸟兽等图案
projects.content_zh: 宜影塔建于清咸丰六年（1856），塔临水畔，建于野猫水东南岸边一块巨大的岩石之上，为当地乡绅培植地方风水而集资兴建。正如塔序中所说：'野猫水一带，冈峦四合，隐然如大环，独缺其东一面，望气者曰：不塞其隘，则内外之地脉不束。爰建塔以实之，塔临水得，倒影其中，若投鞭然，送夕阳迎素日，影达彼岸，则流可断而气赖以束……'建造此塔既弥补了自然景观的不足，又创造了优美的整体环境。只可惜古塔年久失修，残破不堪，现今重建。宜影塔高7层，除1层外，其余6层楼阁均高约1.5米，一层砖石砌筑，背面开门，其余五面各嵌0.50米×0.7米塔铭一方，阴刻行书，记建塔经过及咏塔诗。二至七层每面各开一半圆形拱窗，门檐绘花草鸟兽等图案。
projects.content_en: Yiying Pagoda was built in the 6th year of Xianfeng, Qing (1856); the pagoda stands by the water, built on a huge rock on the southeast bank of Yemaoshui (Wild Cat Water), built with funds raised by local gentry to cultivate the local fengshui. As stated in the pagoda preface: 'The Yemaoshui area, surrounded by hills on all sides, is implicitly like a large ring, only missing its east side; the fengshui observer said: if the narrow passage is not blocked, the earth veins inside and outside will not be constrained. Hence a pagoda was built to solidify it; the pagoda by the water, with its reflection in it, like a thrown whip, sending off the setting sun and welcoming the plain sun, its shadow reaching the other bank, then the flow can be cut off and the qi can be constrained...' Building this pagoda both made up for the deficiency of the natural landscape and created a beautiful overall environment. Unfortunately, the ancient pagoda was long in disrepair and in ruins; it has now been rebuilt. Yiying Pagoda is 7 stories high; except for the 1st floor, the other 6-story pavilions are all about 1.5 meters high; the first floor is built with bricks and stones, with a door on the back, and on each of the other five sides is embedded a 0.50m × 0.7m pagoda inscription, in intaglio running script, recording the process of building the pagoda and poems praising the pagoda. From the 2nd to the 7th floor, each side opens a semicircular arched window, and the door eaves are painted with patterns of flowers, plants, birds, and beasts.

projects.name: 凌云塔
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 利川市南坪乡南坪村
projects.address_en: Nanping Village, Nanping Township, Lichuan City
highlights: 位于如膏书院东侧500米处
楹联书撑天剑气连齐岳
是旧时培植文风激励后学的实证
塔二至三层六面分别开六角形、方形窗
从塔基至塔刹逐层收分
projects.content_zh: 凌云塔建于清道光七年（1827），位于如膏书院东侧500米处，为修建书院余资修建，全石结构，通高14米，底边长2.14米。塔底层开门，楹联书：'撑天剑气连齐岳，拔地文星映少微。'两侧壁嵌'塔志''建塔年月'塔铭各一方，是旧时培植文风激励后学的实证。塔二至三层六面分别开六角形、方形窗，四五层各面均开圆窗，六七层无窗，塔刹呈宝瓶形，从塔基至塔刹逐层收分，形如笋，造型俊逸。
projects.content_en: Lingyun Pagoda was built in the 7th year of Daoguang, Qing (1827), located 500 meters east of Rugao Academy, built with the remaining funds from building the academy; it is an all-stone structure, with a total height of 14 meters and a bottom side length of 2.14 meters. The bottom floor of the pagoda opens a door; the couplet reads: 'The sword qi supporting the sky connects to Mount Qi, the literary star rising from the earth reflects the Shaowei star.' On both side walls are embedded one 'Pagoda Record' and one 'Pagoda Construction Date' inscription each, evidence of the old practice of cultivating literary style and encouraging later students. From the 2nd to the 3rd floor, hexagonal and square windows are opened on the six sides respectively; on the 4th and 5th floors, round windows are opened on all sides; the 6th and 7th floors have no windows; the finial is in the shape of a treasure vase; from the base to the finial, it tapers layer by layer, shaped like a bamboo shoot, with an elegant and graceful form.

projects.name: 龙水文庙
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 利川市谋道镇支罗虎头寨
projects.address_en: Zhiluo Hutou Village, Moudao Town, Lichuan City
highlights: 龙水文庙位于利川市谋道镇支罗虎头寨
是开莲和尚的圆寂之地
明嘉靖年间才将佛寺改为文庙
并将孔子的木雕神像请进殿堂内
成为一所读书讲经的学堂
据庙内龙水文庙序碑记载
吴衡山于同治十二年将文庙改建为义学
文庙现存建筑保留了清代义学的原貌
目前尚存前堂、正殿和厢房
建筑的基址是由青砂条石垒砌而成
结构为明间抬梁式、次间穿斗式木构架
龙水文庙序碑现今镶嵌在教室的墙壁上
龙水文庙是鄂西土家族地区保存较好的文庙
具有较高的建筑设计手法和营造工艺
不仅体现了土家文化的博大精深
也达到了少数民族地区的多元化交流的艺术成就
龙水文庙序碑对考查历史上船山的清代教育具有重要意义
龙水文庙便被用作龙水小学
新教学楼的建设正式完工
新建的教学楼紧靠文庙
projects.content_zh: 龙水文庙位于利川市谋道镇支罗虎头寨，现用作龙水小学校址。始建于明初，清乾隆年间曾重修。文庙坐东朝西，占地面积约570平方米。据资料记载，文庙前身为佛寺，是开莲和尚的圆寂之地。明嘉靖年间才将佛寺改为文庙，并将孔子的木雕神像请进殿堂内，成为一所读书讲经的学堂。据庙内《龙水文庙序》碑记载，吴衡山于同治十二年（1873）将文庙改建为义学。文庙现存建筑保留了清代义学的原貌，四合院式布局，木石砖结构，目前尚存前堂、正殿和厢房，建筑的基址是由青砂条石垒砌而成。前堂面阔三间约17米，进深约9米，硬山灰瓦顶，白灰墙面，墙面保存较差。进深三间约12.5米，结构为明间抬梁式、次间穿斗式木构架。《龙水文庙序》碑现今镶嵌在教室的墙壁上，高约0.85米，宽约3米，碑文为楷书，记录了建庙的经过，由进士冉寿益撰文，吴锡龄书写，字体为正楷阴刻，字迹较清晰，保存较好。龙水文庙是鄂西土家族地区保存较好的文庙，具有较高的建筑设计手法和营造工艺，不仅体现了土家文化的博大精深，也达到了少数民族地区的多元化交流的艺术成就。《龙水文庙序》碑对考查历史上船山的清代教育具有重要意义。据当地人介绍，新中国成立后，龙水文庙便被用作龙水小学。2009年，新教学楼的建设正式完工，新建的教学楼紧靠文庙，学生们从文庙中搬出，而教师仍住在文庙中。
projects.content_en: Longshui Confucian Temple is located at Zhiluo Hutou Village, Moudao Town, Lichuan City, and is now used as the site of Longshui Primary School. It was first built in the early Ming and was repaired during the Qianlong period of the Qing. The temple faces west from east, covering an area of about 570 square meters. According to records, the temple was originally a Buddhist temple, the place where Monk Kai Lian passed away. It was not until the Jiajing period of the Ming that the Buddhist temple was converted to a Confucian temple, and the wooden carved statue of Confucius was invited into the hall, becoming a school for reading and lecturing on classics. According to the 'Preface to Longshui Confucian Temple' stele in the temple, Wu Hengshan converted the Confucian temple into a free school in the 12th year of Tongzhi (1873). The existing buildings of the temple retain the original appearance of the Qing free school, with a four-sided courtyard layout and wood-stone-brick structure; currently the front hall, main hall, and wing rooms remain, and the foundation of the building is built with blue sandstone dressed stones. The front hall is three bays wide, about 17 meters, and about 9 meters deep, with a gable gray-tile roof and white plastered walls, with the wall surface poorly preserved. It is three bays deep, about 12.5 meters, with a structure of post-and-lintel in the central bay and column-and-tie wooden frames in the secondary bays. The 'Preface to Longshui Confucian Temple' stele is now embedded in the wall of the classroom, about 0.85 meters high and 3 meters wide; the inscription is in regular script, recording the process of building the temple, with the text written by juren Ran Shouyi and calligraphy by Wu Xiling, in regular script intaglio, with relatively clear characters and good preservation. Longshui Confucian Temple is a well-preserved Confucian temple in the Tujia area of western Hubei, with relatively high architectural design techniques and construction craftsmanship; it not only reflects the profoundness of Tujia culture, but also achieves the artistic accomplishment of multicultural exchange in ethnic minority areas. The 'Preface to Longshui Confucian Temple' stele is of great significance for studying the Qing education in Chuanshan in history. According to local people, after the founding of New China, Longshui Confucian Temple was used as Longshui Primary School. In 2009, the construction of the new teaching building was officially completed; the new teaching building is close to the Confucian temple, students moved out of the Confucian temple, while teachers still live in the Confucian temple.

projects.name: 谌满氏节孝坊
projects.name_en: Chastity and Piety Memorial Archway of Shen and Man's Family
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 利川市谋道镇龙水村
projects.address_en: Longshui Village, Moudao Town, Lichuan City
highlights: 谌满氏节孝坊坐落在利川市谋道镇长坪村北
是为旌表谌满氏守节27年而修建的
根据清同治年间的利川县志记载
署理湖北巡抚胡林翼奉旨亲自题写一块节孝可风的牌匾
谌满氏死于清光绪五年
利川县知县黄世崇奉旨题奖芳徽足式
次年便奉旨修建了这座谌孝科之妻满氏节孝坊
牌坊为仿楼阁式石构建筑
上层正面直书奉旨旌表
第三层额枋横书节孝可风
与额枋对应的背面横书芳徽足式
正、背两面均书谌孝科之妻满氏节孝坊匾
第二层是24孝人物浮雕组像
正面石柱楹联是松柏坚操独标劲节
背后楹联是乾坤正气留巾帼
侧面石柱上记有满氏勤俭持家的事迹
整座牌坊的文字大部分采用正楷阴刻
中石柱底部两侧各有一对石狮
相传牌坊是当地石匠汪德建造的
因其处在一片农田之中
花草、民风、民俗、风物的浮雕图案
这些都堪称是土家族青石文化和牌坊文化的杰出代表
projects.content_zh: 谌满氏节孝坊坐落在利川市谋道镇长坪村北，建于光绪二十一年（1895），是为旌表谌满氏守节27年而修建的。根据清同治年间的《利川县志》记载：'谌孝科之妻满氏，二十七夫故守节，抚孤成立，现年七十岁。'据了解，清咸丰十年（1860），署理湖北巡抚胡林翼奉旨亲自题写一块'节孝可风'的牌匾；牌匾用土漆精心漆制，长2米多，宽1米，目前存在谌家老宅中。据《谌家族谱》记载，谌满氏死于清光绪五年（1880），享年85岁。光绪二十一年（1895），利川县知县黄世崇奉旨题奖'芳徽足式'，次年便奉旨修建了这座'谌孝科之妻满氏节孝坊'。牌坊为仿楼阁式石构建筑，四柱三门三重楼，青砂石结构，宝塔顶。整座牌坊高约12米，宽约7.35米。正中门比较宽阔，可通行轿子和马车，左右两旁门较窄小。上层正面直书'奉旨旌表'，第三层额枋横书'节孝可风'，与额枋对应的背面横书'芳徽足式'。正、背两面均书'谌孝科之妻满氏节孝坊'匾。第二层是24孝人物浮雕组像，非常生动形象。正面石柱楹联是'松柏坚操独标劲节，梅兰清洁漫似孤芳'。背后楹联是'乾坤正气留巾帼，纶悖恩光照达衡'。侧面石柱上记有满氏勤俭持家的事迹。整座牌坊的文字大部分采用正楷阴刻，少量为小篆阴刻，字迹清晰。中石柱底部两侧各有一对石狮。相传牌坊是当地石匠汪德建造的。因其处在一片农田之中，所以保存相对完好。花草、民风、民俗、风物的浮雕图案，颂扬节孝的楹联、诗词，这些都堪称是土家族青石文化和牌坊文化的杰出代表。
projects.content_en: The Chastity and Piety Memorial Archway of the Shen and Man families is located north of Changping Village, Moudao Town, Lichuan City, built in the 21st year of Guangxu (1895), to commend Man Shi for maintaining chastity for 27 years after her husband's death. According to the 'Lichuan County Annals' of the Tongzhi period of the Qing: 'Man Shi, wife of Shen Xiaoke, was widowed at 27 and maintained chastity, raised her orphan to adulthood, and is now seventy years old.' It is understood that in the 10th year of Xianfeng, Qing (1860), Hu Linyi, acting Governor of Hubei, personally inscribed a plaque 'Chastity and Piety Can Be a Model' by imperial decree; the plaque was carefully painted with raw lacquer, more than 2 meters long and 1 meter wide, and is currently kept in the Shen family old house. According to the 'Shen Family Genealogy,' Man Shi died in the 5th year of Guangxu, Qing (1880), at the age of 85. In the 21st year of Guangxu (1895), Huang Shichong, Magistrate of Lichuan County, by imperial decree inscribed and awarded 'Fragrant Virtue Sufficient as a Model,' and the following year, by imperial decree, this 'Chastity and Piety Archway of Man Shi, Wife of Shen Xiaoke' was built. The archway is an imitation pavilion-style stone structure, with four columns, three gates, and three stories, of blue sandstone structure, with a pagoda top. The entire archway is about 12 meters high and 7.35 meters wide. The central gate is relatively wide, allowing passage of sedan chairs and carriages, while the side gates on the left and right are narrower. On the upper front, 'By Imperial Decree Commended' is written vertically; on the third-story lintel, 'Chastity and Piety Can Be a Model' is written horizontally; on the back corresponding to the lintel, 'Fragrant Virtue Sufficient as a Model' is written horizontally. On both front and back sides, the plaque 'Chastity and Piety Archway of Man Shi, Wife of Shen Xiaoke' is written. The second story is a group of relief sculptures of the 24 Filial Piety figures, very vivid and lifelike. The front stone column couplet is 'Pine and cypress firm conduct alone marks strong integrity; plum and orchid purity resembles solitary fragrance.' The back couplet is 'Heaven and earth righteous qi remains in women; imperial grace light reaches the balance.' On the side stone columns, the deeds of Man Shi's thrifty household management are recorded. Most of the text on the entire archway uses regular script intaglio, with a small amount in small seal script intaglio, with clear characters. On both sides at the bottom of the central stone columns, there is a pair of stone lions each. Legend has it that the archway was built by local stonemason Wang De. Because it is located in a farmland, it is relatively well-preserved. The relief patterns of flowers and plants, folk customs, folk traditions, and scenery, as well as the couplets and poems praising chastity and piety, can all be called outstanding representatives of Tujia bluestone culture and archway culture.

projects.name: 崔岩墩墙屋
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 利川市谋道镇寨坝村
projects.address_en: Zaiba Village, Moudao Town, Lichuan City
highlights: 墓葬和房屋结合的独特墓葬文化
雀岩墩碑屋位于恩施土家族苗族自治州利川市谋道镇寨坝村
由晚清秀才罗运章历时一年建造完工
罗运章75岁时病逝并葬于其中
随后其子女以坟墓为中心
并在堂屋中立下墓碑以便祭祀
碑屋是一种将墓葬建在堂屋之后的特殊建筑
由碑屋、墓冢、墓碑三部分组成
碑屋为四列三间木构楼房
墓碑设于堂屋的后壁上
浮雕图案的下方横排用楷书阴刻遗爱堂三个大字
两边用行书阴刻死者可作言行坊表
墓碑两侧墙上刻有墓志铭
墓葬和房屋相结合的碑屋是当地土家族的一种独特的丧葬文化
目前在湖北省恩施州仅此一处
对研究土家族人的生死观念以及丧葬习俗具有十分重要的意义
projects.content_zh: 雀岩墩碑屋位于恩施土家族苗族自治州利川市谋道镇寨坝村，面向鸿鹄山，背靠寨坝梁，地势平坦。建于1929年，由晚清秀才罗运章历时一年建造完工，距今已有80多年。据墓主后人介绍，罗运章75岁时病逝并葬于其中，随后其子女以坟墓为中心，在上面建造了房子，并在堂屋中立下墓碑以便祭祀，80多年来后代一直住在此处。碑屋是一种将墓葬建在堂屋之后的特殊建筑。雀岩墩碑屋坐西朝东，由碑屋、墓冢、墓碑三部分组成。碑屋为四列三间木构楼房，面阔约15米，进深约7.44米，檐高约4.5米，悬山青瓦顶。墓冢为石砌，设在碑屋堂屋的后面，碑屋顶部建廊房。墓碑设于堂屋的后壁上，高约3.8米，宽约1.8米，浮雕图案的下方横排用楷书阴刻'遗爱堂'三个大字，两边用行书阴刻'死者可作言行坊表，先生之风山高水长'。墓碑两侧墙上刻有墓志铭，记载墓主生平。墓葬和房屋相结合的碑屋是当地土家族的一种独特的丧葬文化，目前在湖北省恩施州仅此一处，对研究土家族人的生死观念以及丧葬习俗具有十分重要的意义。
projects.content_en: Cuiyandun Grave House is located in Zaiba Village, Moudao Town, Lichuan City, Enshi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, facing Honghu Mountain and backing onto Zaiba Ridge, with flat terrain. It was built in 1929, completed by Luo Yunzhang, a xiucai (provincial graduate) of the late Qing, over one year, and is now more than 80 years old. According to the descendants of the tomb owner, Luo Yunzhang died of illness at the age of 75 and was buried in it; subsequently, his children, centered on the tomb, built a house on it, and erected a tombstone in the main hall for sacrifice; for more than 80 years, descendants have always lived here. A grave house is a special building that builds the tomb behind the main hall. Cuiyandun Grave House faces east from west, composed of three parts: the grave house, the tomb mound, and the tombstone. The grave house is a four-row three-bay wooden building, about 15 meters wide, 7.44 meters deep, with an eave height of about 4.5 meters and an overhanging gable blue-tile roof. The tomb mound is stone-built, located behind the main hall of the grave house, with a corridor built on top of the grave house. The tombstone is set on the back wall of the main hall, about 3.8 meters high and 1.8 meters wide; below the relief patterns, the three large characters 'Yi Ai Tang' (Hall of Remaining Love) are carved horizontally in regular script intaglio; on both sides, 'The deceased can serve as a model of words and deeds; the gentleman's style is as high as mountains and as long as water' is carved in running script intaglio. On the walls on both sides of the tombstone, epitaphs are carved, recording the life of the tomb owner. The grave house combining tomb and house is a unique funeral culture of the local Tujia people; currently there is only one such place in Enshi Prefecture, Hubei Province, and it is of great significance for studying the life-and-death concepts and funeral customs of the Tujia people.

projects.name: 范家老屋
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 利川市柏杨坝镇团园村
projects.address_en: Tuanyuan Village, Boyangba Town, Lichuan City
highlights: 范家老屋坐落于利川市柏杨坝镇团园村
是当地的豪绅范章廷建造的
据范章廷的家人刘菀云回忆
范章廷到大水井李家给儿子提亲
李家以范家房屋破旧为由拒绝
于是范章廷决定建一座庄园
他将参与修建大水井庄园的全部名匠请来
仿照大水井李氏庄园的设计
范章廷因一场官司死于奉节
后来范章廷的妻子刘氏继续按照丈夫生前的设计方案修建范家庄园
范家庄园的建造共花费了10多年
主体建筑分为两进五院
有一座绣花楼和一座碉楼
庄园大门外墙采用和大水井庄园相同的建筑风格
面壁顶部为波浪形的布瓦饰脊
虽然经过多年的风雨洗礼
今天依然能见识到它的宏伟与精美
范家庄园的正房厅堂被用作团园小学的校园
其他的院落也有当地农民居住
今天的范家老屋遭受了人为破坏
一些工艺精湛的雕梁画栋被铲除
厅堂天井的石刻已换成了团园小学的校训
水磨石柱的大门也消失无踪
院内有些房屋已被改建
有些房屋因无人居住已破损或坍塌
projects.content_zh: 范家老屋坐落于利川市柏杨坝镇团园村，是当地的豪绅范章廷建造的。据范章廷的家人刘菀云回忆：范章廷到大水井李家给儿子提亲，李家以范家房屋破旧为由拒绝。于是范章廷决定建一座庄园，他将参与修建大水井庄园的全部名匠请来，仿照大水井李氏庄园的设计，开始修建范家庄园。正屋厅堂建起后，范章廷因一场官司死于奉节，后来范章廷的妻子刘氏继续按照丈夫生前的设计方案修建范家庄园，直到1949年才基本建成，范家庄园的建造共花费了10多年。建筑兼有中西特色，技艺精湛，装饰精致，被当地人称为'花屋'。范家老屋坐北朝南，主体建筑分为两进五院，有一座绣花楼和一座碉楼，占地面积约2000平方米，建筑面积约1800平方米。碉楼位于院坝左侧，近方形，边长约4.8米，条石垒砌，四角攒尖顶，通高约4层13米。庄园大门外墙采用和大水井庄园相同的建筑风格，欧式窗户，西洋壁柱，面壁顶部为波浪形的布瓦饰脊，虽然经过多年的风雨洗礼，今天依然能见识到它的宏伟与精美。新中国成立后，范家庄园的正房厅堂被用作团园小学的校园，其他的院落也有当地农民居住。今天的范家老屋遭受了人为破坏：一些工艺精湛的雕梁画栋被铲除，厅堂天井的石刻已换成了团园小学的校训，水磨石柱的大门也消失无踪，院内有些房屋已被改建，有些房屋因无人居住已破损或坍塌。
projects.content_en: Fan Family's Old House is located in Tuanyuan Village, Boyangba Town, Lichuan City, built by the local wealthy gentry Fan Zhangting. According to the recollection of Fan Zhangting's family member Liu Wanyun: Fan Zhangting went to the Li family at Dashuijing to propose marriage for his son, but the Li family refused on the grounds that the Fan family's house was dilapidated. So Fan Zhangting decided to build a manor; he invited all the famous craftsmen who had participated in building the Dashuijing Manor, and imitating the design of the Li family manor at Dashuijing, began to build the Fan family manor. After the main hall was built, Fan Zhangting died in Fengjie due to a lawsuit; later, Fan Zhangting's wife Liu continued to build the Fan family manor according to her husband's生前 design plan, and it was basically completed only in 1949; the construction of the Fan family manor took more than 10 years. The building combines both Chinese and Western features, with exquisite craftsmanship and delicate decoration, and is called 'Flower House' by the locals. Fan Family's Old House faces south, with the main building divided into two entries and five courtyards, including an embroidery tower and a watchtower, covering an area of about 2,000 square meters, with a building area of about 1,800 square meters. The watchtower is located on the left side of the courtyard, nearly square, with a side length of about 4.8 meters, built with dressed stones, with a four-corner pyramidal roof, and a total height of about 4 stories, 13 meters. The exterior wall of the manor gate adopts the same architectural style as the Dashuijing Manor, with European-style windows and Western pilasters, and the top of the facade wall is a wavy tile-decorated ridge; although after years of wind and rain, one can still see its grandeur and exquisiteness today. After the founding of New China, the main halls of the Fan family manor were used as the campus of Tuanyuan Primary School, and other courtyards were also inhabited by local farmers. Today's Fan Family's Old House has suffered man-made damage: some exquisitely carved beams and painted rafters have been铲除, the stone carvings in the hall courtyard have been replaced with the school motto of Tuanyuan Primary School, the gate with water-ground stone columns has also disappeared without a trace, some houses in the courtyard have been改建, and some houses have been damaged or collapsed due to no one living in them.

projects.name: 谢家老屋
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 利川市谋道镇龙水村
projects.address_en: Longshui Village, Moudao Town, Lichuan City
highlights: 谢家老屋位于谋道镇龙水村3组
支罗船头寨西侧大田庄
老屋是由当时任四川雅安安县令的谢明正建造的
他见船头寨龙水一带土地肥沃
于是买下田地修建了房屋
由于是在田地上盖房屋
建筑主体分为前后两院
取金包银和步步高之意
后院基址高出前院约2米
阶檐两侧各有一道石栏墙
墙上各嵌一块长约4.5米、宽约0.8米的石刻
上有清代进士谭龙章书写的朱子治家格言及题跋
建筑后崖壁上有楷书阴刻的大田庄三个大字
谢家老屋是利川具有典型代表性的民居建筑之一
建筑内的木雕、石刻非常精美
但窗花、墙面彩绘均被损毁
projects.content_zh: 谢家老屋位于谋道镇龙水村3组，支罗船头寨西侧大田庄，建于1920年。据相关资料记载，老屋是由当时任四川雅安安县令的谢明正建造的，他见船头寨龙水一带土地肥沃，环境怡人，风水极佳，于是买下田地修建了房屋，由于是在田地上盖房屋，取名为大田庄。谢家老屋坐东朝西，占地约1600平方米，砖木结构，悬山瓦顶，建筑主体分为前后两院，逐级拔高，取'金包银'和'步步高'之意。前院面阔约35米，正面是青砖砌花墙；后院基址高出前院约2米，布局和前院相仿。两院门有一道栏墙，大门在正中，门亭在栏墙后，亭上四角攒尖，檐角高翘，柱础高大。正屋面阔约15米，进深约12米，为穿斗式木构架，屋前阶檐宽约2米，阶檐两侧各有一道石栏墙，墙上各嵌一块长约4.5米、宽约0.8米的石刻，上有清代进士谭龙章书写的《朱子治家格言》及题跋，字体为楷书阴刻。建筑后崖壁上有楷书阴刻的'大田庄'三个大字。谢家老屋是利川具有典型代表性的民居建筑之一。建筑内的木雕、石刻非常精美，保存较好，但窗花、墙面彩绘均被损毁，整体建筑保存较好，现在是村民住宅。
projects.content_en: Xie Family's Old House is located in Group 3, Longshui Village, Moudao Town, at Datianzhuang west of Zhiluo Chuantou Village, built in 1920. According to relevant records, the old house was built by Xie Mingzheng, who was then the magistrate of An County, Ya'an, Sichuan; he saw that the Longshui area of Chuantou Village had fertile land, a pleasant environment, and excellent fengshui, so he bought the land and built the house; because the house was built on farmland, it was named Datianzhuang (Great Field Manor). Xie Family's Old House faces west from east, covering about 1,600 square meters, of brick-wood structure, with an overhanging gable tile roof; the main building is divided into front and rear courtyards, rising step by step, taking the meaning of 'gold wrapping silver' and 'step by step higher.' The front courtyard is about 35 meters wide, with a blue-brick decorative wall on the front; the rear courtyard foundation is about 2 meters higher than the front courtyard, with a layout similar to the front courtyard. Between the two courtyard gates there is a railing wall, with the main gate in the center and the gate pavilion behind the railing wall; the pavilion has a four-corner pyramidal roof, with high upturned eave corners and tall column plinths. The main hall is about 15 meters wide and 12 meters deep, with a column-and-tie wooden frame; the front eave terrace is about 2 meters wide, with a stone railing wall on each side of the eave terrace, each embedded with a stone carving about 4.5 meters long and 0.8 meters wide, on which is written 'Zhu Xi's Family Governance Maxims' and a postscript by Qing juren Tan Longzhang, in regular script intaglio. On the rear cliff wall of the building, the three large characters 'Datianzhuang' are carved in regular script intaglio. Xie Family's Old House is one of the typical representative residential buildings in Lichuan. The wood carvings and stone carvings in the building are very exquisite and well-preserved, but the window grilles and wall paintings have all been damaged; the overall building is well-preserved and is now a village residence.

projects.name: 步青桥及字库塔
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 利川市毛坝乡青岩双泉村
projects.address_en: Qingyan Shuangquan Village, Maoba Township, Lichuan City
highlights: 步青桥是人们从咸丰经沙溪至川东的主要道路
川盐东运通道上的一处重要人文景观
对研究川鄂盐运史具有重要的历史价值
projects.content_zh: 在毛坝乡青岩双泉村，有一条青岩河，河上有一座步青桥，桥头有字库塔。步青桥是人们从咸丰经沙溪至川东的主要道路，川盐东运通道上的一处重要人文景观，对研究川鄂盐运史具有重要的历史价值。
projects.content_en: In Qingyan Shuangquan Village, Maoba Township, there is a Qingyan River; on the river there is a Buqing Bridge, and at the bridgehead there is a Ziku Pagoda. Buqing Bridge was the main road for people from Xianfeng via Shaxi to eastern Sichuan, an important cultural landscape on the channel for eastward transportation of Sichuan salt, and has important historical value for studying the history of salt transportation between Sichuan and Hubei.

projects.name: 步青桥
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 利川市毛坝乡青岩双泉村
projects.address_en: Qingyan Shuangquan Village, Maoba Township, Lichuan City
highlights: 步青桥建于清同治癸酉年
清光绪利川县志也记载
施南水（青岩河）河水湍急
桥为拱圈石纵联砌置法单孔石桥
建桥的资金由四川、贵州、江西、湖南、湖北等地的善士捐款而得
癸酉年十月十五日起设局募化
至甲戌年九月十五日止
共募化来往力夫共一百七十千贰百七十五文
各省客商共募化功果三百三十九千九百八百文
本邑共化三百五十六千四百文
projects.content_zh: 据碑文记载，步青桥建于清同治癸酉年（1873），次年建成，南北横跨太平河支流，单孔石拱桥，长约21.4米，宽约4米，孔跨约7.2米，拱券纵联砌置。清光绪《利川县志》也记载：'青岩其地高山耸峙，施南水（青岩河）河水湍急，巨石峥嵘，步青桥因势利导，建于巨石上。桥为拱圈石纵联砌置法单孔石桥，长六米，宽三米'。建桥的资金由四川、贵州、江西、湖南、湖北等地的善士捐款而得：'癸酉年十月十五日起设局募化，至甲戌年九月十五日止，共募化来往力夫共一百七十千贰百七十五文，各省客商共募化功果三百三十九千九百八百文，本邑共化三百五十六千四百文。'步青桥建成后，清光绪乙亥年（1875），在桥北建成字库塔，塔上有长篇铭文，记述了建桥始末。
projects.content_en: According to the inscription records, Buqing Bridge was built in the Gui-You year of Tongzhi, Qing (1873), and completed the following year; it spans north-south across a tributary of the Taiping River, a single-arch stone bridge, about 21.4 meters long, 4 meters wide, with an arch span of about 7.2 meters, and the arch is built in longitudinal connection. The 'Lichuan County Annals' of Guangxu, Qing also records: 'Qingyan is a place with towering high mountains; the Shinan River (Qingyan River) has rapid currents and towering giant rocks; Buqing Bridge, taking advantage of the situation, was built on the giant rocks. The bridge is a single-arch stone bridge built by the longitudinal connection method of arch ring stones, six meters long and three meters wide.' The funds for building the bridge were obtained from donations by benevolent people from Sichuan, Guizhou, Jiangxi, Hunan, Hubei and other places: 'From the 15th day of the 10th month of the Gui-You year, a bureau was set up for fundraising, until the 15th day of the 9th month of the Jia-Xu year; a total of 170,275 wen was raised from passing porters, a total of 339,980 wen was raised from merchants of various provinces, and a total of 356,400 wen was raised locally.' After Buqing Bridge was completed, in the Yi-Hai year of Guangxu, Qing (1875), a Ziku Pagoda was built north of the bridge, with a long inscription on the pagoda recording the whole story of building the bridge.

projects.name: 字库塔
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 利川市毛坝乡青岩双泉村
projects.address_en: Qingyan Shuangquan Village, Maoba Township, Lichuan City
highlights: 字库塔又称惜字宫、敬字亭、焚字炉
是古人专门用来焚烧字纸的建筑
字库塔是古人在传统文化中惜字如金、敬天惜字观念的影响下所形成的一种习俗
这来源于古人对文字的崇拜和对文神的信仰
随之演变成一种祈福的载体
为六角楼阁式空心石塔
二层正面刻有步青桥三个大字和结善士缘须列善士
铭文字可培文风的楹联
三层正面上方刻有字库塔三个大字
下方四周的人物图案雕刻精美
一层的六面和二层的五面均刻有修建步青桥的序文
捐款善士的名字和捐款数目
projects.content_zh: 字库塔又称惜字宫、敬字亭、焚字炉，是古人专门用来焚烧字纸的建筑。字库塔是古人在传统文化中'惜字如金''敬天惜字'观念的影响下所形成的一种习俗，这来源于古人对文字的崇拜和对文神的信仰，随之演变成一种祈福的载体。字库塔位于步青桥北，为六角楼阁式空心石塔，塔有三层，每层有六角翘起，通高约5.7米，塔基座是正方形，由条石砌成，高约0.7米，宽约1.9米。塔一层背面有一圆孔；二层正面刻有'步青桥'三个大字和'结善士缘须列善士，铭文字可培文风'的楹联；三层正面上方刻有'字库塔'三个大字，下方四周的人物图案雕刻精美。其中，一层的六面和二层的五面均刻有修建步青桥的序文、捐款善士的名字和捐款数目。
projects.content_en: Ziku Pagoda, also called Xizi Palace, Jingzi Pavilion, or Fenzi Furnace, is a building specially used by ancient people to burn paper with writing. Ziku Pagoda is a custom formed by ancient people under the influence of the traditional cultural concepts of 'cherishing words like gold' and 'respecting heaven and cherishing words'; this originated from the ancient people's worship of writing and belief in the god of literature, and subsequently evolved into a carrier for praying for blessings. Ziku Pagoda is located north of Buqing Bridge; it is a hexagonal pavilion-style hollow stone pagoda, with three stories, each story having six upturned corners, with a total height of about 5.7 meters; the pagoda base is square, built with dressed stones, about 0.7 meters high and 1.9 meters wide. On the back of the first story of the pagoda there is a round hole; on the front of the second story are carved the three large characters 'Buqing Bridge' and a couplet 'Forming the fate of benevolent people must list the benevolent; inscribing words can cultivate literary style'; above the front of the third story are carved the three large characters 'Ziku Pagoda,' and the figure patterns around below are exquisitely carved. Among them, the six sides of the first story and the five sides of the second story are all carved with the preface for building Buqing Bridge, the names of donating benevolent people, and the amounts of donations.

projects.name: 石柱观
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 建始县高坪镇望坪村
projects.address_en: Wangping Village, Gaoping Town, Jianshi County
highlights: 海拔1112米的山峰坪中突起
石柱观始建于明嘉靖年间
远视酷似巨象欲拖宝座而行
依山势盘旋至山顶见山门
记录石柱观的兴建历史
明清两代被誉为建始八景之一
石柱观主要由正殿及配房组成
几乎全掩映于苍翠林翠之中
正殿之上为六棱形四层亭阁
使两殿形成有机的整体
后堂重檐歇山顶四层楼阁
殿顶上有一六角攒尖顶楼阁
耳房位于前后两殿之间
projects.content_zh: 石柱观，古称蟠龙山朝真观，为清代道教宫观，选址登峰造极，海拔1112米的山峰坪中突起，犹如擎天大柱，为蟠龙山。石柱观始建于明嘉靖年间，几经兴废，坐北朝南，占地面积约700平方米。蟠龙山山体高51米，周长223米，陡峭险峻，几乎无一席平地，山底有一洞穴，岩石前伸似象鼻，两足前支，后股如蹲，远视酷似巨象欲拖宝座而行，洞口不远处有238级石梯，依山势盘旋至山顶见山门，途中有古碑刻数通，记录石柱观的兴建历史。观建于孤峰顶端，如从山顶破土而出，直插云霄，山顶苍松横生，景色奇秀。山西石塔与观对峙，山东有一堰池，形如盆，因而有'左有宝塔映日，右有蛤蟆吐涎，上有石柱冲天，下有金盆偃月'一说，明清两代被誉为'建始八景'之一。石柱观主要由正殿及配房组成，因山顶空间有限，建筑体量较小，几乎全掩映于苍翠林翠之中，正殿之上为六棱形四层亭阁，增强了空间的尺度感。正殿砖木结构，占地面积152平方米，前殿后堂。前殿面阔三间，进深一间，单檐悬山灰瓦顶，高约10米，明间为抬梁式木构架，次间为穿斗式木构架。设石级通往正殿，使两殿形成有机的整体。后堂重檐歇山顶四层楼阁，明间开门，殿顶上有一六角攒尖顶楼阁，高约7米，飞檐翘角，内有木梯可登临阁楼。耳房位于前后两殿之间，硬山灰瓦顶，抬梁式木结构。小庙置于前殿南侧，硬山灰瓦顶，抬梁式木结构。
projects.content_en: Shizhu Taoist Temple, anciently called Panlong Mountain Chaozhen Temple, is a Qing Dynasty Taoist temple; its site selection is supreme, rising abruptly from a mountain flat at an altitude of 1112 meters, like a pillar supporting the sky, hence the name Panlong (Coiling Dragon) Mountain. Shizhu Taoist Temple was first built during the Jiajing period of the Ming,经历 several rises and falls, facing south, covering an area of about 700 square meters. The Panlong Mountain body is 51 meters high and 223 meters in circumference, steep and precipitous, with almost no flat ground; at the bottom of the mountain there is a cave, with the rock extending forward like an elephant trunk, two feet supporting forward, and the hindquarters like a squat; viewed from afar, it closely resembles a giant elephant about to drag a throne. Not far from the cave entrance there are 238 stone steps, winding along the mountain terrain to the mountain top where one sees the mountain gate; along the way there are several ancient stele carvings, recording the construction history of Shizhu Taoist Temple. The temple was built at the top of the solitary peak, as if breaking through the soil from the mountain top and piercing straight into the clouds; on the mountain top, ancient pines grow horizontally, with strangely beautiful scenery. The stone pagoda west of the mountain faces the temple, and east of the mountain there is a pond, shaped like a basin; hence there is a saying 'On the left a pagoda reflects the sun, on the right a toad spits saliva, above a stone pillar soars to the sky, below a golden basin covers the moon,' and it was honored as one of the 'Eight Scenes of Jianshi' during the Ming and Qing dynasties. Shizhu Taoist Temple is mainly composed of the main hall and auxiliary rooms; due to the limited space on the mountain top, the building volume is relatively small, almost entirely hidden among the lush green forests; above the main hall is a hexagonal four-story pavilion, enhancing the sense of spatial scale. The main hall is of brick-wood structure, covering an area of 152 square meters, with a front hall and rear hall. The front hall is three bays wide and one bay deep, with a single-eave overhanging gable gray-tile roof, about 10 meters high; the central bay has a post-and-lintel wooden frame, and the secondary bays have column-and-tie wooden frames. Stone steps are set leading to the main hall, making the two halls form an organic whole. The rear hall is a double-eave hip-and-gable roof four-story pavilion, with a door in the central bay; on top of the hall there is a hexagonal pyramidal-roof pavilion, about 7 meters high, with flying eaves and upturned corners, and a wooden ladder inside for climbing to the attic. The ear rooms are located between the front and rear halls, with gable gray-tile roofs and post-and-lintel wooden structures. The small temple is placed south of the front hall, with a gable gray-tile roof and post-and-lintel wooden structure.

projects.name: 五阳书院
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 建始县业州镇人民大道魁星楼路
projects.address_en: Kuixinglou Road, Renmin Avenue, Yezhou Town, Jianshi County
highlights: 书院始建于清乾隆二十年
因县有建阳、朝阳、当阳、景阳、巫阳这五个地名
向他们提供免费的基础教育
书院现存讲堂、连珠堂以及东西学舍等40余间
以主体建筑讲堂为中心
穿过门楼是书院的第一进院落
是一个较为狭长的引导空间
讲堂后有勾连搭结构与连珠堂相连
学舍和其他附属用房分别对称置于轴线两侧
与主体建筑形成多进围合院落空间
projects.content_zh: 书院始建于清乾隆二十年（1755），由知县邱岱兴建，因县有建阳、朝阳、当阳、景阳、巫阳这五个地名，故得名'五阳书院'。五阳书院属于义学，招收贫寒子弟，向他们提供免费的基础教育。书院现存讲堂、连珠堂以及东西学舍等40余间，坐北朝南，总建筑面积2530平方米，采用合院式布局，以主体建筑讲堂为中心。门房为二层楼房，穿过门楼是书院的第一进院落，长约23.6米，宽约4.8米，是一个较为狭长的引导空间。后面是讲堂，讲堂面阔五间，进深三间，硬山顶；讲堂后有勾连搭结构与连珠堂相连，连珠堂平面为方形，重檐攒尖顶。学舍和其他附属用房分别对称置于轴线两侧，与主体建筑形成多进围合院落空间。
projects.content_en: The academy was first built in the 20th year of Qianlong, Qing (1755), constructed by County Magistrate Qiu Dai; because the county had five place names: Jianyang, Chaoyang, Dangyang, Jingyang, and Wuyang, it was named 'Wuyang Academy' (Five-Yang Academy). Wuyang Academy is a free school, recruiting poor children and providing them with free basic education. The academy now has more than 40 rooms including the lecture hall, Lianzhu Hall, and east and west student dormitories, facing south, with a total building area of 2530 square meters, adopting a courtyard-style layout centered on the main building, the lecture hall. The gatehouse is a two-story building; passing through the gate tower is the first courtyard of the academy, about 23.6 meters long and 4.8 meters wide, a relatively narrow guiding space. Behind it is the lecture hall, five bays wide and three bays deep, with a gable roof; behind the lecture hall there is a connected-roof structure linking to the Lianzhu Hall; the Lianzhu Hall has a square plane with a double-eave pyramidal roof. The student dormitories and other auxiliary rooms are respectively symmetrically placed on both sides of the axis, forming multi-entry enclosed courtyard spaces with the main building.

projects.name: 仙佛寺石窟
projects.level: 国家级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 来凤县翔凤镇关口村酉水河西岸
projects.address_en: West bank of Youshui River, Guankou Village, Xiangfeng Town, Laifeng County
highlights: 仙佛寺东与湖南省龙山县隔河相望
相传始凿于东晋咸康年间
河岸上的石山名曰仙佛岩
在离地数十米的中段开凿3个并列的大佛龛
南段雕造18个并列的小佛龛
造像均采用半圆雕技法
北端刻仙佛寺提名及咸康元年五月款
摩岩造像的雕刻年代尚存疑义
根据造像的服饰特征、题材组合、佛座样式等判断
始凿于初唐至盛唐时期
中国社会科学院丁明夷及中国文物研究所贾广、王去非等学者专家在关于推荐湖北来凤仙佛寺摩岩造像为国家级文物保护单位的意见一文里对仙佛寺摩岩造像群的价值作了客观的评价
该处遗存为长江中游、两湖地区现存唯一的大型摩岩造像
且为土家、苗族聚集区的历史文化精华
具有重要的历史、文化与艺术价值
这样规模、水准的摩岩造像
不仅在两湖地区首屈一指
也为研究鄂西少数民族地区与中原的文化交流、川鄂湘边区的佛教文化艺术提供了难能可贵的实物资料
projects.content_zh: 仙佛寺东与湖南省龙山县隔河相望，北与湖北宣恩县相邻，相传始凿于东晋咸康年间（335—342）。古寺上倚丹崖霞壁，下临碧泓深潭，崖壁上立三尊，依壁建阁三层，因而潭水又名佛潭，河岸上的石山名曰'仙佛岩'，寺曰'仙佛寺'。此处终年橘廊泉飞，四时凝雨，山光水色，古朴典雅，可谓胜景宜人。石壁全长200米，在离地数十米的中段开凿3个并列的大佛龛，大佛坐于莲台之上，高约5.5米，1个中龛，高约2米，南段雕造18个并列的小佛龛，每个高约1米，共计造像22尊，整座石窟全长35米，造像均采用半圆雕技法。北端刻'仙佛寺'提名及'咸康元年五月'款。摩岩造像的雕刻年代尚存疑义，根据造像的服饰特征、题材组合、佛座样式等判断，始凿于初唐至盛唐时期。现筒壁建寺3层，将大小佛像尽置于内。1994年，北京大学宿白、马世长，中国社会科学院丁明夷及中国文物研究所贾广、王去非等学者专家在《关于推荐湖北来凤仙佛寺摩岩造像为国家级文物保护单位的意见》一文里对仙佛寺摩岩造像群的价值作了客观的评价：'该处遗存为长江中游、两湖地区现存唯一的大型摩岩造像，且为土家、苗族聚集区的历史文化精华，具有重要的历史、文化与艺术价值。这样规模、水准的摩岩造像，不仅在两湖地区首屈一指，也为研究鄂西少数民族地区与中原的文化交流、川鄂湘边区的佛教文化艺术提供了难能可贵的实物资料。'
projects.content_en: Xianfo Temple faces Longshan County, Hunan Province across the river to the east, and is adjacent to Xuan'en County, Hubei to the north; legend has it that carving began in the Xiankang period of the Eastern Jin (335–342). The ancient temple leans against red crag and rosy walls above, and faces a deep blue pool below; on the cliff wall stand three statues, and a three-story pavilion was built against the wall; hence the pool water is also called Buddha Pool, the stone mountain on the river bank is called 'Xianfo Rock' (Immortal Buddha Rock), and the temple is called 'Xianfo Temple' (Immortal Buddha Temple). Here, orange corridors and flying springs exist year-round, with condensing rain in all four seasons; mountain scenery and water colors, simple and elegant, can be said to be a pleasant scenic spot. The stone wall has a total length of 200 meters; in the middle section tens of meters above the ground, 3 parallel large Buddha niches were carved; the large Buddha sits on a lotus platform, about 5.5 meters high; there is 1 medium niche, about 2 meters high; in the southern section, 18 parallel small Buddha niches were carved, each about 1 meter high; a total of 22 statues were carved; the entire grotto has a total length of 35 meters, and all statues adopt the semi-round carving technique. At the north end, the inscription 'Xianfo Temple' and the date '5th month of the 1st year of Xiankang' are carved. The carving date of the cliff carvings is still doubtful; judging from the clothing characteristics, subject combinations, and Buddha seat styles of the statues, carving began in the early Tang to high Tang period. Now a three-story temple is built against the wall, placing all large and small Buddha statues inside. In 1994, scholars and experts such as Su Bai and Ma Shichang from Peking University, Ding Mingyi from the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, and Jia Guang and Wang Qufei from the China Institute of Cultural Relics, in the article 'Opinions on Recommending the Cliff Carvings of Xianfo Temple in Laifeng, Hubei as a National Key Cultural Heritage Protection Unit,' made an objective evaluation of the value of the Xianfo Temple cliff carving group: 'This relic is the only existing large-scale cliff carving in the middle reaches of the Yangtze River and the Two Lakes region, and is the historical and cultural essence of the Tujia and Miao ethnic gathering area, with important historical, cultural, and artistic value. Cliff carvings of such scale and standard are not only second to none in the Two Lakes region, but also provide valuable physical materials for studying the cultural exchange between the ethnic minority areas of western Hubei and the Central Plains, and the Buddhist culture and art of the Sichuan-Hubei-Hunan border region.'

projects.name: 牛王庙
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 来凤县大河镇龙潭坪村
projects.address_en: Longtanping Village, Dahe Town, Laifeng County
highlights: 牛王庙是鄂西土家族唯一的一座祭祀牛神的寺庙
缘起于当地土家族和苗族对牛的崇拜
当地人将农历四月初八命名为专门祭祀牛神的牛王节
已被恩施州政府批准为四大民族节日之一
牛王节的来源说法众多
一说是在某年的四月初
一土司与敌交战负伤被迫追兵堵于大河前
一头水牛游过岸驮土司趟过了河
土司为感谢神牛的救命之恩
把四月初八定为牛王节
另一说法为一头神牛为土家人盗取稻种
并为土家人世代耕种农田
牛王庙建于清嘉庆年间
为歇山顶楼阁式木构建筑
一层设有大神堂、禅房、僧舍、天井、厨房、杂物间
用于收藏经书和供奉神牛
是整个建筑的核心部位
牛王庙将吊脚楼与楼阁式相结合
这种阁楼的设计在土家吊脚楼中并不多见
体现了中原文化同鄂西建筑文化的交融
projects.content_zh: 牛王庙是鄂西土家族唯一的一座祭祀牛神的寺庙，又兼作其他佛事活动，缘起于当地土家族和苗族对牛的崇拜。为感谢牛的耕种之恩，当地人将农历四月初八命名为专门祭祀牛神的'牛王节'，已被恩施州政府批准为四大民族节日之一。'牛王节'的来源说法众多，一说是在某年的四月初，一土司与敌交战负伤被迫追兵堵于大河前，时值暴雨倾盆，水势危险，寻不去去路，万分危急之时，一头水牛游过岸驮土司趟过了河，土司为感谢神牛的救命之恩，把四月初八定为'牛王节'；另一说法为一头神牛为土家人盗取稻种，并为土家人世代耕种农田，遂被尊为'牛王'。牛王庙建于清嘉庆年间，坐西北朝东南，占地317.1平方米，为歇山顶楼阁式木构建筑，中轴对称布局，楼高三层，一层设有大神堂、禅房、僧舍、天井、厨房、杂物间，二层设祭祀堂，三层设藏经阁，用于收藏经书和供奉神牛，是整个建筑的核心部位。牛王庙将吊脚楼与楼阁式相结合，这种阁楼的设计在土家吊脚楼中并不多见，体现了中原文化同鄂西建筑文化的交融。
projects.content_en: Niuwang (Cow King) Shrine is the only temple in western Hubei Tujia area for sacrificing to the Cow God, and also serves as a venue for other Buddhist activities; it originated from the local Tujia and Miao people's worship of cows. To thank the cow for its plowing grace, the locals named the 8th day of the 4th lunar month as the 'Cow King Festival' specifically for sacrificing to the Cow God, which has been approved by the Enshi Prefecture Government as one of the four major ethnic festivals. There are many sayings about the origin of the 'Cow King Festival'; one says that in the early 4th month of a certain year, a chieftain was wounded in battle with the enemy and was forced by pursuing troops to be blocked at a large river; at that time there was a torrential rain, the water was dangerous, and he could find no way out; in an extremely critical moment, a water buffalo swam across the bank and carried the chieftain across the river; the chieftain, to thank the divine cow for saving his life, designated the 8th day of the 4th month as the 'Cow King Festival'; another saying is that a divine cow stole rice seeds for the Tujia people and plowed farmland for the Tujia people for generations, hence was honored as the 'Cow King.' Niuwang Shrine was built during the Jiaqing period of the Qing, facing southeast from northwest, covering 317.1 square meters; it is a hip-and-gable roof pavilion-style wooden building with a centrally symmetric layout, three stories high; the first floor has a large divine hall, meditation room, monk quarters, courtyard, kitchen, and utility room; the second floor has a sacrificial hall; the third floor has a scripture library, used for collecting scriptures and enshrining the divine cow, which is the core part of the entire building. Niuwang Shrine combines the stilted building and pavilion styles; this kind of pavilion design is rare in Tujia stilted buildings, reflecting the fusion of Central Plains culture and western Hubei architectural culture.

projects.name: 舍米糊摆手堂
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 来凤县百福司镇舍米湖村
projects.address_en: Shemihu Village, Baifusi Town, Laifeng County
highlights: 是流传于鄂、湘、渝地区酉水流域土家族的一种传统舞蹈
是土家人祭祀祖先与庆新年、祈丰收的集体活动
它源于土家族先民的巴渝舞
土家摆手舞被列入中国第一批国家级非物质文化遗产名录
是专供土家人敬神、跳摆手舞之地
是土家族祭祀祖先和庆祝丰收的集会场所
光绪古丈坪厅志·民族下载
每岁正月初三至初五夜
关于摆手堂的起源无从考究
大多数摆手堂位于偏远的土家族山寨
正如民国永顺县志记载
即所塑像亦无金碧辉煌之侈
舍米糊摆手堂位于村南朝阳的山坡上
与土家语舍米糊的含义
是土家族地区最古老、保存最完好的摆手堂之一
主要由摆手场和土王祠构成
主体建筑土王祠坐北朝南
明间门额楷书摆手堂三个金字
供奉土家族先祖彭公爵主、向老官人、田好汉三尊塑像
projects.content_zh: 摆手舞，土家语叫'舍巴（Sevbax）'其意为敬神跳，汉语叫'跳摆手'，是流传于鄂、湘、渝地区酉水流域土家族的一种传统舞蹈，是土家人祭祀祖先与庆新年、祈丰收的集体活动。它源于土家族先民的巴渝舞，唐宋之时已产生，土司时期盛行。歌时男女相携，编跹进退，故谓之'摆手'。土家摆手舞被列入中国第一批国家级非物质文化遗产名录。'摆手堂'也称'神堂''土王庙'，是专供土家人敬神、跳摆手舞之地，是土家族祭祀祖先和庆祝丰收的集会场所。光绪《古丈坪厅志·民族下》载：'土俗各寨有摆手堂，每岁正月初三至初五夜，鸣锣击鼓，男女相聚，摇摆发喊，名曰摆手。'关于摆手堂的起源无从考究，大多数摆手堂位于偏远的土家族山寨，建筑装饰较简陋，规模也不大，所塑神像也自然朴素。正如民国《永顺县志》记载：'县境土司祠（按：即摆手堂）皆卑陋狭隘，远逊丛林。即所塑像亦无金碧辉煌之侈。特相沿已久，故至今犹有蹈习故者。'舍米糊摆手堂位于村南朝阳的山坡上，与土家语'舍米糊'的含义——'阳光照耀的小山坡'相符，占据最好的风水，前屋正对大小鸡公岭，四周山峦起伏，树木葱茏，环境极佳。始建于清顺治八年（1651），是土家族地区最古老、保存最完好的摆手堂之一，占地约500平方米，坐北朝南，平面呈矩形，前为院（摆手场），后为堂（土王祠）。摆手堂布局十分简明，主要由摆手场和土王祠构成，场院东侧设一小门，为摆手场入口，南面设正门。摆手场三面围砌石墙，宽约13.8米，深约26.5米，墙下植有古柏，摆手场中立杉树一棵，树上挂满灯笼，举行摆手舞时，众人环树起舞，十分壮观。主体建筑土王祠坐北朝南，面阔三间，进深一间，石木结构，单檐悬山灰瓦顶，明间门额楷书'摆手堂'三个金字，无雕梁画栋，显得古朴厚重。堂内现设有神龛，供奉土家族先祖彭公爵主、向老官人、田好汉三尊塑像。
projects.content_en: Baishou (Hand-Waving) Dance, called 'Sheba' in Tujia language, means dancing to honor gods; in Chinese it is called 'jumping hand-waving.' It is a traditional dance of the Tujia people in the Youshui River basin, spread across Hubei, Hunan, and Chongqing; it is a collective activity for Tujia people to sacrifice to ancestors, celebrate the New Year, and pray for a good harvest. It originated from the Bayu dance of the Tujia ancestors, emerged in the Tang and Song dynasties, and flourished during the Tusi (chieftain) period. When singing, men and women hold hands, moving gracefully forward and backward, hence called 'hand-waving.' Tujia hand-waving dance was included in China's first batch of national intangible cultural heritage lists. 'Baishou Hall' is also called 'God Hall' or 'Tusi King Temple'; it is a place exclusively for Tujia people to honor gods and perform hand-waving dance, a gathering place for Tujia people to sacrifice to ancestors and celebrate harvests. The 'Guzhangping Subprefecture Annals · Ethnic Groups (Part 2)' of Guangxu records: 'According to Tujia custom, each village has a Baishou Hall; every year on the nights of the 3rd to 5th day of the 1st month, gongs and drums are sounded, men and women gather, swaying and shouting, called hand-waving.' The origin of Baishou Hall cannot be verified; most Baishou Halls are located in remote Tujia mountain villages, with relatively simple architectural decoration, not large in scale, and the enshrined god statues are also naturally simple. As recorded in the 'Yongshun County Annals' of the Republic: 'The Tusi temples in the county (i.e., Baishou Halls) are all humble and narrow, far inferior to Buddhist temples. Even the statues do not have the luxury of gold and jade. But because the custom has been passed down for a long time, there are still those who practice the old ways today.' Shemihu Baishou Hall is located on a sunny slope south of the village, consistent with the meaning of 'Shemihu' in Tujia language — 'a small hillside illuminated by sunlight' — occupying the best fengshui; the front house faces directly the Big and Small Jigong Ridges, with undulating mountains on all sides and lush trees, excellent environment. It was first built in the 8th year of Shunzhi, Qing (1651), and is one of the oldest and best-preserved Baishou Halls in the Tujia area, covering about 500 square meters, facing south, with a rectangular plane; the front is a courtyard (hand-waving ground), and the rear is a hall (Tusi King Temple). The layout of Baishou Hall is very simple, mainly composed of the hand-waving ground and Tusi King Temple; a small gate is set on the east side of the courtyard as the entrance to the hand-waving ground, and the main gate is set on the south. The hand-waving ground is surrounded by stone walls on three sides, about 13.8 meters wide and 26.5 meters deep; ancient cypresses are planted under the walls; a fir tree stands in the middle of the hand-waving ground, with lanterns hung all over it; when performing the hand-waving dance, everyone dances around the tree, very spectacular. The main building, Tusi King Temple, faces south, three bays wide and one bay deep, of stone-wood structure, with a single-eave overhanging gable gray-tile roof; on the lintel of the central bay, the three golden characters 'Baishou Tang' are written in regular script; without carved beams and painted rafters, it appears simple and dignified. Inside the hall there is now a shrine, enshrining three statues of Tujia ancestors: Duke Peng, Official Xiang, and Hero Tian.

projects.name: 茶堰坪摆手堂
projects.level: 省级重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 百福司镇茶园坪村

堂屋正中远处有一小山包

门额悬挂一块鄂西自治州文化局、博物馆赠送的匾
